description: TransferMyBills is a free and straightforward change of address service designed to streamline the process of transferring bills when you move home.

records.title: Efficient service
records.text: Within few minutes had all utility bills providers been informed and received updates with links very helpful for follow upExcellent service thanks

records.title: Moving is  stressful but using this…
records.text: Moving is  stressful but using this service takes one job away and give you a little peace of mind  so thank you and Happy Christmas to all

records.title: Great guy good clear understanding
records.text: I thought the guy that help me was so polite helping me with each subject of my moving clear instructions very patient as I am in my 70s felt he looked after me very well would definitely pass this company to anyone moving. So stressless can't thank you enough

records.title: Quick and professional
records.text: Just listed address, and bills I needed cancel. 2 hours later all but one was cancelled-

records.title: This was the best thing we could have…
records.text: This was the best thing we could have found for our move!  The admin associated with moving house has been on previous moves, the most stressful part.  Utilities can be difficult to contact and coordinate.  This really took the hassle away and no kidding, within 15 minutes we were all done!

records.title: It was very quick and simple takes a…
records.text: It was very quick and simple takes a headache aware a lot of other things that needed to be done at the same time

records.title: Above & Beyond
records.text: What made this experience great, Simple answer, Luke, to be helped in difficult times by someone I don't even know is something rarely seen. The stress of contacting everyone who needs to know im moving away like my energy supplier insurance broadband mobile HMRC DVLA NHS Council tax and even the wife all informed Luke and the transfer my bills team. Above & beyond professionalism, with a personal phone call to see if all is going well. My Mrs doesn't even do that. Luke thank you my friend.

records.title: I can't believe how simple they made…
records.text: I can't believe how simple they made everything.I have only 6 days to pack up and move, so very little time to spare. I spent just over an hour to accomplish 90% of tasks, with only 2 phone calls necessary. They even helped me register with a new GP and several other things I hadn't even thought of. It was such a simple process.

records.title: Excellent personalised service
records.text: Tyler and Luke couldn’t have been more helpful. Provided a personalised service. I rang to discuss as had some queries, and was given very helpful guidance. Following the transfer, we received a concise summary (traffic light format), with a couple of pending actions to consider to ensure a smooth transition. The whole process took a lot of stress out of our move, with minimum effort required on our part. Would definitely recommend this platform

records.title: So far it seems good.
records.text: So far it seems that using TransferMyBills has saved my aged mother (well, me really!) a lot of hassle - If nothing else, it streamlines the process of closing accounts and opening new ones during a move!

records.title: It is a great help especHeially when ur…
records.text: It is a great help especially when ur mind is winding up to do many things.

records.title: Hadn’t heard of this service before
records.text: Hadn’t heard of this service before. Was easy to use and saved me contacting individual providers and took the stress out of doing it myself.

records.title: Welcome help at a stressful time.
records.text: Moving is so stressful help given was very welcome.I felt more relaxed knowing Transfer My Bills.com was available with experience as to what was needed.Slightly disappointed some of my requests could not be met, so I had extra work to do, but overall I was glad I had their help and would recommend others to sign up for their help.

records.title: Shaky start but remedied!
records.text: After a shaky start when TMB went off line for ages at just the wrong time it was a useful tool. I got a swift and comprehensive response to my concerns and action was taken. I think I experienced a glitch and I’d use this again given their quick and helpful communication when there were difficulties.

records.title: Stress free. The service is so efficient and makes…
records.text: The service is so efficient and makes moving a less stressful and avoids sitting in the phone for ages. Team are so helpful. When inputting my info it wouldn’t allow me to put my correct moving date so nearly never submitted info. Did anyway and glad I did as a member of the team contacted with a quick response to check it was right. So it was easily amended. Thank you.

records.title: Just a bit too quick!
records.text: This was a useful service to help me attached to services I had not thought about. The 4 stars represent that it was quicker than I had thought of because I didn't include my moving dates as these were not set when I made the enquiry.

records.title: Easy and convenient to use
records.text: Easy and convenient to use. Perhaps you might improve by contacting most of the services for clients as not all are Techies. Otherwise great site, would recommend.

records.title: Very helpful site
records.text: Very helpful site, all went smoothly - I just didn't give 5 stars, as I still felt I had to check with suppliers as well, only being over concerned that the transfers hadn't happened - I needn't have worried as all was very easy!

records.title: This is a very good service & I will be
records.text: This is a very good service & I will be recommending it to others .Quick & easy to use ,it’s made moving so much easier.

records.title: The staff i had a telephone…
records.text: The staff i had a telephone conversation was very professional and very helpful towards my questions.

records.title: It removed the task of having to…
records.text: It removed the task of having to contact a number of different suppliers.

records.title: I had a good chat
records.text: I had a. Goods conversation and was satisfied

records.title: Easy to manage
records.text: Easy to manage. Could do with a few more options

records.title: Great thanks helpted alot.
records.text: Date of experience: 08 April 2022

records.title: I am not that clever with the internet…
records.text: I am not that clever with the internet and somehow think I failed with this system. Not to worry as I have contacted all my household suppliers either by phone or by email

records.title: Great idea but not as useful as it sounds
records.text: Great idea, but didn’t actually make it any easier.I wouldn’t use them again and would just do it myself next time.The process is easy and they identify many orgs that need to be notified, and then send them an email. Nearly all of them needed additional information though, so it would have been easier to just contact them myself in the first place. In a one case it actually complicated things using the service.I also HATE marketing cold calls - they will call you (“courtesy call”) telling you exactly the same as what’s on the online dashboard plus trying to sell you services at the new address (that’s how they make money).Overall, the idea is great but not actually as helpful as it sounds and it’s just as easy getting a checklist of places to contact and doing it yourself

records.title: Overly simplified, didn't seem to work
records.text: I think they tried to make it too simple, it wanted to end electricity contracts at my old and new suppliers and didn't seem to contact my local authority at all.

records.title: The team were very friendly
records.text: The team were very friendly, and initially very helpful, but when it actually came to transferring my bills, I had to do most of them myself unfortunately.

records.title: Did not end up using your services
records.text: Did not end up using your services. Hopefully you will be able to help others. M 😀

records.title: Not enough information
records.text: Not enough information

records.title: My energy supplier was Changed which I…
records.text: My energy supplier was Changed which I did not request. Wanted to stay with SO due to exit charge

records.title: Don’t cover majority of companies
records.text: Most of the companies i thought TMB would contact, require me to follow up. So what’s the point!Ps. Thank you to TMB for your follow up. Appreciate you explaining.

records.title: Couldn't transfer energy
records.text: Could only transfer water, couldn't transfer energy or insurance. Waste of time.

records.title: Very confusing
records.text: Very confusing. Never gave me price of other services and never agreed to anything and said they will switch bills.U switch better as they show you what your paying and what others can provide

records.title: Biggest joke ever can't sign in get…
records.text: Biggest joke ever can't sign in get service error over and over change password checked by 5 people all agreed they were the same server said they did not match keep well away from these amateurs use snail mail instead

records.title: Initially easy to use, but it has major problems and no support.
records.text: At first it looked good and easy to use. I set up my home move. After 2 weeks, the status of every transfer (Gas, Electric, Water, Council Tax) show 0 out of 6 updates. But I deduce that some things have been actioned, but not all (eg I received a mail from the new water provider). The system did not tell me I cannot use the same energy supplier at the new address, and it sent the wrong move date to the current water supplier. I asked for support using the online chat, but it said "We are offline, we'll get back to you". Its now been a week with no response. I've had to call each of the suppliers directly, so using their system has caused me more work than doing it myself.

records.title: For some reason you had decided that I…
records.text: For some reason you had decided that I had left a tenancy when it was my own property and then we ended up with two water bills at my brother's address! Not impressed. It means I had no confidence to proceed. It would seem that you have taken no notice of my instruction to stop either...

records.title: You haven't done anything u couldn't…
records.text: You haven't done anything u couldn't have done myself infact I have sorted it all better

records.title: The system continuously shows Error 505
records.text: The system continuously shows Error 505I have emailed in twice for assistance but had no response and then I get a review request from them, Not much help tbh

records.title: Unable to complete the form as my new…
records.text: Unable to complete the form as my new address is not yet registered with Royal Mail, there is no facility on your site to manually edit/input the address so unless this is completed you cannot proceed and complete the form.

description:
Powering over 40,000 businesses nationwide 
We are a leading OFGEM-licensed energy specialist for businesses across Great Britain, with over 25 years of experience across our senior team.
At Valda Energy, we are committed to providing our customers with a simple, secure and competitive energy supply, backed by innovative technology, accurate billing and first-class customer service.




 See how much you could save today 
Get a quote!

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service. Olivia Jupp was very polite & fully understood my needs. She kept me updated regarding contract & changes. I am happy to give her a call anytime I have any issues.

records.title: We have just switched to Valda energy…
records.text: We have just switched to Valda energy and we had a billing issue as we have 3 meters - one of which is not in use. My first bill was estimated and was quite high and was not looking forward to speaking to someone who wouldn't understand me. to my suprise and shock a young man called Harry gave me impeccable customer service and helped every way he could even keeping his word and emailing me the outcome that day. Problem solved and the bill is sorted. Thank you very much Harry for all your help

records.title: Venue Review
records.text: The lady who had the misfortune to answer the call was excellent...listened to my issues, and then solved them...most unusual in this day and age!

records.title: Abbie has been really helpful in…
records.text: Abbie has been really helpful in guiding me through the process of renewing the contract for 12 more months. Great service, thank you Abbie!

records.title: Great service and help from Amy with…
records.text: Great service and help from Amy with setting up our new electricity contract

records.title: Waqqas valda call centre
records.text: Excellent service provide i called with over charged bill and have spoken to several staff members in valda call center until i came across Mr Waqqas he swiftly with in minutes sorted my bill re generated my bills and sorted my direct debit out... very experiance and great asset for the company

records.title: Salman was very helpful
records.text: Salman was very helpful, updated my bill as it was an absolute overcharge. Thank you!

records.title: Olivia Jupp was extremely helpful
records.text: Olivia Jupp was extremely helpful, professional and because of her we signed with Valda for another 3 years.

records.title: Advice was helpful and concise
records.text: Advice was helpful and concise. Thanks for saving me money!

records.title: Very impressive experience
records.text: I was pleased to find that for contacting Valda there are multiple options- email, live chat or a telephone call to a real person. Having a preference for the latter, I was pleasantly surprised to find that I could choose a callback service when the queue was a long one. I received a call from Priyanka Raj within an hour who dealt with my several queries very politely, patiently and efficiently. Her manner was pleasant and kind, and her advice was very helpful. Very impressive customer service. As a new customer, it gives me confidence in dealing with this Company which I hope will continue.

records.title: Helpful and clear when setting up…
records.text: Julian was helpful and clear setting up our new contract on the phone.Can't comment any further on the company as our new energy contract doesn't start until January.

records.title: Neethu was very pleasant and gave me…
records.text: Neethu was very pleasant and gave me sound guidance - Thank you

records.title: The tele conversation did not get off…
records.text: The tele conversation did not get off to a good start but finished on a high. The first two representatives were of little or no use but Priyanka Raj was superb. She explained clearly how the invoice was structured plus provided me with detailed readings on our account of electricity usage over the last few years. I was on the phone for 50mins getting passed around which isn’t great is it ??

records.title: Amy was wonderful helping with my case…
records.text: Amy was wonderful helping with my case and got the price down absolutely competitive to bigger companies. She really worked hard back and forth with her company pricing dept to get prices below I offered. She is truly hard working person  .Speak to her and she will help you get good deals.

records.title: Two months into contract and things are looking good
records.text: We switched our business electricity to Valda Energy at the start of September 2024.  First two bills had a few estimated readings (which surprised us, as we have remotely-read half-hour metering).  Ella, on their online chat service, was very helpful and quick to resolve a typo on our account details that had prevented us from accessing their web portal.  All seems to have been sorted and we've now got access to the information we need.  Hopefully the rest of our two-year contract goes smoothly!

records.title: Moving over to Valda
records.text: Moving over to ValdaI've received emails and encouraged to set up a login, but it wouldn't let me without my account number, which I couldn't find on the emails.However, I used the chat window and the agent was really helpful, answered all my questions, so I'm hoping if I need to contact them when my accounts are with them, they will be equally so.

records.title: Good experience of renegotiating…
records.text: Had a good experience of renegotiating our business energy contract towards the end of its term.  They gave us a better price than the agents who supposedly give you a cheaper price. Many thanks to Olivia Jupp for all her help in getting a good deal.However, we are still waiting for them to fix the new Smart meter whivhbwas installed by their contractor 5 months ago! So one star taken off for this.

records.title: Good result in the end
records.text: I have been a customer for one week and I have been sent a huge invoice based on an incorrect assessment of my usage and it is impossible to contact via email as they don’t reply and as for the live chat, just forget it.All it would take to put things right is for someone to communicate and listen.It’s now been 18hours since my first posting and still no replies to my messages.This morning I received a call from Luke, the operations director, he couldn’t have been more helpful, and my issues have been resolved .Basically I feel that the company tries to be helpful and their prices are good but like all companies these days they are ruled by their computer systems .

records.title: Valda redemption.
records.text: It has been 6 months with Valda so I would like to update my earlier review. During the last few months we have established a rytham which worked well. Most of the problem is the smart meters. The customer service is very good with a call back service that works so problems can be sorted. There are worse suppliers we have dealt out there.

records.title: Helpful, but unnecessary anxiety
records.text: Customer services were helpful and were quickly able to tell me that I should ignore yesterday evening's text -which said the account was now closed. I am sure that you can see how this made me anxious though, and it's not a great start to a supplier/business relationship.

records.title: Renewal of church contract.
records.text: The church's energy contract runs out in December 2024 and we had been approached by 2 brokers providing quotes from various companies. I contacted Valda and Abbie Stayt provided aquote which was more competitive than any of the others. She was polite, efficient, accurate and quick. When I phoned to confirm renewal of the contract she dealt with it very swiftly, there and then.

records.title: I am happy with the payments for energy…
records.text: I am happy with the payments for energy used but..  not happy at being sent a disconnection letter the day after I had already spoke to a person to say the bank had made a payment that I had already changed  ..not valda ..which ment as it didn't go through  it ment the other two payments didn't go through either and I had to wait til the following day to make my payment once bank had recalled the money they took. .also had paid over phone so tp receive a disconnection notice wD totally disgusting and if this is how valda work I won't be renewing .

records.title: Take over of Electricity supply for new…
records.text: Take over of Electricity supply for new premises, handled very efficiently by Tom Maskell

records.title: I have got the good price in market for…
records.text: I have got the good price in market for my business electricity. Serena has helped me through the process. very polite and helping.

records.title: Well done Sean Williams
records.text: I don't like energy companies as they talk a load  of rubbish. However, Sean didn't give me a lot of bull, just got straight to the point, he rang back when i asked him to and I didn't feel pressured. Well done Sean glad to do business with you

records.title: Direct Debit Payments
records.text: We have recently moved our account to your company and for two months you have not managed to take the payment by direct debit.However today I dealt with Anthony Maruland-Carter who has given me his contact details and re-assurance that this issue will be fixed

records.title: Minor amendment delays
records.text: Have been trying to change some minor account/contact details for 3 months and whilst i always received a response within a day or two saying this had been actioned, it never was fully actioned correctly. however, finally Morgan in Customer service replied to advise it had been correctly addressed and low and behold i checked our account and it has. Thank you Morgan

records.title: Confirming payment details - Welcome pack
records.text: Waqas was able to answer my 2 queries quickly concerning amendment of mobile number for SMS messages and confirm that DDR was already set up successfully, ready for change over in January 2025 |(despite keep getting emails saying we need to set up a payment method).Would have scored 5/5 but length of time to get through on the telephone downgraded to 4.

records.title: Valda is ok for me.
records.text: I’m happy with my contract following a very good conversation with Charlie from Valda Energy, who spent time explaining the contract for my electricity and gas. He worked out the differences in my current user and Valda Energy. I have a 12 month contract which is ok. I had a slight hiccup at the start as I didn’t understand how the contracts are renewed. Thanks for your honesty Charlie!

records.title: Its been a struggle and i need a coffee…
records.text: Valda have been up and down and really made us work to prove our bill  was too high .Hopefully we are now there with a normal invoice as we have had a bad week of emails and talk of disconection !! A lovely representative called Maisie made things very easy and talked to me in a very clear way , a credit to herself and the company ..that young lady will go far

records.title: Complaint Resolution
records.text: Thank you to Oluwole who listened to my experience and agreed to resolve my complaint, and to lsabelle who was the only other person who genuinely seemed to understand and made things happen to get my work request carried out, unlike your colleagues who broke repeated promises and failed to make any progress at all.They should be ashamed that it took 8 months to achieve nothing. Isabelle's interventions saved the day and Olu left me feeling listened to and taken seriously. Thank you : I'd like to give you each 5 stars but sadly to whole sorry saga prevents me from doing so.

records.title: Querry with our company bill as we pay…
records.text: Querry with our company bill as we pay 5% vat but if we go over a limit it goes to20%. We were getting charged the full 20% for the whole bill if we went over which is not what we have paid will all the other companies we have been with. He said it is correct but this was not made clear when we signed up and will be leaving when our contract is up next year. The man was pleasent. What i do not understand is that we have a smart meter but all their bills are estimated?

records.title: Bradley was .....inaccurate
records.text: Bradley was most helpful on finding our church a very advantageous tariff.Although the company policy seems to be to insist that you write a review immediately on signing up, which is a little unreasonable.Addendum. Ten days later, text from Valda saying SSE had refused permission to take over the contract. Not surprised- two months too early. Bradley recorded the date for handover incorrectly. All sorted thanks to Catrina, but goodness, not a great start and not great for my peace of mind either! Reduced to 3* to reflect this.

records.title: It has taken numerous  emails and phone calls
records.text: It has taken numerous  emails and phone calls to partly  sort out an issue of overcharging due to a smart meter problem. They eventually  credited  the money they owed but still haven't  sorted out the meter problem.We'll  see what happens next month when a new bill will be issued.....

records.title: Luke from Customer services was an…
records.text: Luke from Customer services was an absolute delight to deal with but the situation we are in is ridiculous. We're a new customer, taking over from old tenants and the communication from Valda has been appalling. With no warning we got an email saying we would be cut off at 2.30pm if we didn't make a payment that hadn't previously been mentioned (we'd been told there was credit on the account). Luke managed to sort it out but the whole thing was unnecessary. Hoping it's smoother from here

records.title: The Chat function is good & relatively quick.
records.text: The Chat function on the web site worked well and I got the answer needed to the question I'd tried to ask on Friday having selected the call-back option whilst in the telephone queue. I'm still waiting for the call-back and it's now Monday.

records.title: This review is for CAROLYN KELLY
records.text: This review is for CAROLYN KELLYCustomer Service of ValdaAfter our huge-huge issue stemming from a Broker ( see older reviews )Carolyn got in touch with myself as she posted on my review.She took information regarding the contract and supply problem along with associated problems created.She kept in touch daily - updating me on what was happening until my supply was put back to my original company via an erroneous transfer, then asked for verification my supply was back so she could close the case.Carolyn ALSO listened to the issues I had with my contract being changed out of my name and how this caused SO much distress as I could not speak with anyone - no longer being the account holder.A sneaky loop hole to close asap!IF ONLY ALL THE STAFF were this helpful Valda.Thank you Carolyn Your help was very much appreciated If I could give you personally 5 stars I would.

records.title: Rating may go up if service improves
records.text: This rating may go up or down as we have just started with Valda having switched from EDF.The only way I can contact Valda is via email and at the moment it is taking a week to get a response from them (it was longer in my previous attempts)Problem is I have EDF due to take a final payment which was provided by Valda estimating what my meter read was (Why I wasn't contacted to provide one I have no idea?)  The meter read provided was incorrect.  So far I am on my third email responding to a request for photos that have been provided on each of the two previous emails.Hopefully customer service will improve as it is the reason I left EDF

records.title: What to do if you have been mis-sold an energy contract by a TPI
records.text: Further to my review on the 21st April 2023. From seemingly knocking my head against a brick wall, I have, today, received an email from Alana, which has been most helpful. The information I was given is, as it turns out, the same as that provided by the Citizens Advice Bureau's website, on the mis-selling of utility contracts by TPI's (Third Party Intermediaries - in this case, Bionic). I cannot comment on Valda Energy, with regard to being one of their customers, as it didn't get that far.

records.title: It took over 10minutes on hold before I…
records.text: It took over 10minutes on hold before I could request a call back. It was then very difficult to understand the person on the other end of the line. She did manage to deal with what I was asking for and very polite.Smart meter installations don't happen after trading hours so there is a chance we will have to close early in order to get the smart meter fitted - not so smart as that's lost trade.

records.title: A lottery of service dependant on who you speak with
records.text: The Customer Service team were helpful and resolved the issue for me, but ONLY after an erroneous bill being sent to me by Valda demanding a sum ten times what it should have been, and after rudeness and no listening from a collections representative.  Any company can make an error and I understand this, but your staff need to appreciate that sometimes the customer may actually be right.  If I had to rate the customer service team I would say 5/5, but sadly your collections colleagues would be rated zero and I would suggest might benefit from some retraining.

records.title: The agent was polite and quick to act…
records.text: The agent was polite and quick to act on my problem. Unfortunately, my problem is still not resolved, as the Valda portal still says my email is connected to my void account.

records.title: Still don’t understand why they take…
records.text: Still don’t understand why they take payments in advance which are always over estimated instead of paying by direct debit for what we use?

records.title: I am a new customer and it took me the…
records.text: I am a new customer and it took me the best part of an hour. Being number 19 in the queue waiting to speak to a customer support person. I then went on to your chat line. Managed to sort everything else out that. But it was very time consuming and very inconvenient. But I did eventually sort out my issues.IM also not happy about the fact that you took a long time to get in contact with me After signing up with you. And there was no clear information about what had  tt be don next as a new company Customer  i had to extract every bit of information by asking you all the question . And your portal is confusing . I was unable to use to reset my password. And the locked outNot a good start !!

records.title: No credit amount mentioned on the bill.
records.text: The person who dealt with my call was very helpful.I am not happy with the way the bills are presented though. I was £169.88 in credit. My son had found that out when he read the meter for me. No where on any invoice has a credit amount been mentioned. The other 2 energy companies that I have accounts with all tell you how much you are in credit.

records.title: Thank you Beth and Paygie
records.text: Beth and Paygie were so helpful. Although Valda in itself is not that great, their customer service and the people working there are genuinely there to help. Speak to them nicely and they will move mountains for you!

records.title: It was absurdly hard work to view our…
records.text: It was absurdly hard work to view our first invoice. You demanded the code - which you had not sent us. Your Live Chat asked for our account number, to reach which I needed the code, but fortunately the chat person cut through this maze and showed me the code. Then it was all OK.

records.title: After 6 months off asking for a paper…
records.text: After 6 months off asking for a paper bill they hopefully have resolved my issue, next month will tell

records.title: incorrect company details/unable to access account to view invoice
records.text: The issue was resolved however the company name on our account is incorrect and we could not access our account as the email was apparently wrong even though the email with the invoice link came through to the same email! However the operator dealt with my initial query about not accessing the account and my call was answered relatively quickly by an actual person

records.title: I liked the live chat with Lizz very…
records.text: I liked the live chat with Lizz very professional everything sorted with my difficulties.I was initially concerned as to how the company was operating

records.title: Things can only get better?!
records.text: Phoned with queries and was told I was first in the queue. 20 mins later I spoke to someone, who told me she couldn't help and she would transfer me. I was again told I was first in the queue, but I still had to wait another 10 mins.  This time the call handler couldn't hear me.  He told me that he would call me back, but he didn't.  I used the message form to send in 4 queries. That was a week ago and I haven't had a reply.  Used online chat today, which was laborious and I had to keep repeating myself, but I think (hope) progress has been made.  Strangely they appeared to have received one part of my message from the previous week but not the other three.

records.title: Experience spoilt by nagging salesman demanding we leave a review
records.text: Switch was straightforward, price and contract all good, Sean Wiliams was competent in selling the contract - all fairly basic and straightforward process which is in line with our minimum expectations. Our experience was then spoilt by his incessant telephone calls asking us to leave a review for him (before the contract had even taken effect). As a small business we cannot waste resource answering daily phone calls about leaving reviews, It seemed he was more concerned with his own ego/performance than considering the impact of his actions on the customers experience. These actions have left us concerned about what our future relationship with Valda will hold as we do not wish to tolerate pushy, nagging sales people.

records.title: We have been on estimated bills from…
records.text: We have been on estimated bills from day one. They can not resolved problems with our meter.We were closed all of july and power off at the mains breaker, howeverv we still got charged 200 pounds. Hard to contact them. Our bills are based on previous tennant who were high consumers.

records.title: Terrible company still taking money months after selling the property
records.text: Terrible company. We sold our property in September 2024 and informed Valda and submitted final meter readings.Despite this they are still deducting money from our account without our permission.  It is now November !3 months !  Despite numerous contacts with them by phone & email they have not had the courtesy to acknowledge any of them and the only correspondence we have received is demands for money and threats of making late payment charges.Worst company I’ve ever dealt with. Finally resolved 7/10/24

records.title: Valda takes money when it shouldn’t
records.text: Valda has been my business energy supplier since 2021 with very few problems until we decided to close the company & move out of the premises then every thing changed for the worse. They ignored the online exit forms that I filled out & the many follow up phone calls to refund my over payments & stop charging me & taking money for a unit that I no longer rented. This is the first time I have paid any bills on reoccurring card payment & it will be definitely the last.Finally today 05/11/2024 Valda has refunded my overpayment due from 3rd September.

records.title: 1st bill and direct debit did go…
records.text: 1st bill and direct debit did go through and sent it to Collections we had shop since 3rd August 24 it's only September now 2nd bill not even due.

records.title: Smart Meters that are not SMART
records.text: As a new customer Valda decided they wanted to install a new smart meter. The previous one worked perfectly for several years without a problem. The new one doesn't - end of story and company commitment to fix it non- existent. Sure price is ok for this current dreadful fuel climate - not sure on the off-shore live chat. Need to remember now to send in a meter reading, although not quite worked out what date with the bonkers 1 week in arrears and three weeks up front process but that progress for you.......

records.title: Very poor organisation
records.text: Upon setting up my account, Valda organised my Gas and Electric account separately. This caused confusion with my account. My direct debit was not set up properly and I received a very rude and abrupt phone call  demanding immediate payment or my Gas and electric would be cut off.Not very happy with the service!!!

records.title: Terrible follow up after an intial excellent reponse from Valda
records.text: I initially wrote this review as "Excellent service through the live chat.  My question about smart meter install was answered and dealt with."  Now as the process has continued I have downgraded this review.  The follow up has been terrible.  There was no continuity.  When the install was finally arranged the engineer arrived with the incorrect meter.  Completely farcical.

records.title: Stay clear!!
records.text: Had a previous problem, had a smart meter put in and made payment plan, 6 months later sent a email given a days notice to sort the whole bill that the smart meter only ever estimates, and charges us double of previous supplier, or they will cut us off if I dont sort in 1 day!! And also miss sold a 3 year contract. A contract ive never seen or had sent or signed🤷

description: Pozitive Energy is a technology-led supplier of gas and renewable electricity to small and medium-sized businesses and Industrial & Commercial customers in the UK. Its unique technology platform uses intelligent automation to deliver lower costs and a better experience for customers.

records.title: Inconsistent but good customer service overall. Early days.

So 4 stars for the main query, but they lost a star for the second.

You were very efficient and sorted all the issues (names and details) very fast!! I Recommend the service.By: Vitoria Vechani PM at Sweet Smile.

records.title: Good customer service

records.title: Chandresh was very helpful and made a…

We missed it as did Pozitive and the site was cut off leaving residents without power for the weekend. It was a costly error with re connection fees however Chandresh Gupta made the stressful situation easier.

records.title: Thank you Sanjay for your help this…
records.text: Thank you Sanjay for your help this morning you were very helpful and calm during a frustrating call.

records.title: energy company cannot do what we…

records.title: Old meter experience Over the last three months I have had…
records.text: Over the last three months I have had really problems with my electric meter and my account finally I have made some progress with the care team at Pozitive and hopefully it will be totally resolved within the next four weeks.

records.title: Richard was 5 stars, shame about his colleague
records.text: Had to make two phone calls to explain they have the wrong postcode for my bills. 1st lady was extremely rude and unhelpful, told me to contact royal mail even though it's correct on their website! I called back and spoke to Richard who was actually helpful and has put in the request to get this sorted. How can you pay a bill on time when the address is wrong and you never received the bill prior to payment date!?

records.title: Anil was very helpful, but the billing team less so
records.text: Anil was as helpful as he could be so I'd give him at least 4 stars.  But the billing team he had to keep referring my query to was less impressive.  Having had 5 invoices all at once, totalling a negative amount, my query was about getting a refund; Anil established that I was entitled to a refund on electricity too.  However, he also established that it would take 15 days for me to be refunded, which strikes me as iniquitous - while I know the amounts are small, you are making use of the money which should be returned immediately (since we have changed supplier, and Anil confirmed this would be the last payment that needed to change hands).  Hence the reduction of stars to three, and possibly it should have been two!

records.title: Pozitive energy get your act together

Why make things so complicated …..  Also issue with meter reading submitted into the portal . A very low  bill was generated had to call to ask for invoice to be look at and regenerated the correct invoice . What is going on , disappointed again by pozitive energy lack of customer care

records.title: I spoke to a nice chap called Ryan who…

records.title: The customer service agent Hardeep was very nice and helpful and helped properly
records.text: The customer service agent Hardeep was very nice and helpful. Overall service of the company is awful. In order to register new tenants it is such a long process. Normal companies have easy process to register people instead of filling long documents.

records.title: Change of tenancy help
records.text: Mamta Bhatia, provided an excellent service in getting a change of tenancy progressed with the utmost priority, she confirmed a clear timeframe of when I would expect to have an update and assured me it would be done!UPDATE:They did not keep to this clear timeframe given. It took a lot longer and was not as straightforward as promised.

records.title: Customer service is very poor

records.title: When I contacted the Call Centre by Phone
records.text: When I contacted the Call Centre by telephone I could barely understand what the call handlers were saying. I had great difficulty understanding their broad Asian dialect. This was compounded by a constantly breaking line. I have since received an email which has poor grammar and reads as if the writer does not have English as their first langauge. If you are dealing with English speaking customers you need English speaking call handlers who have clear pronounciation.

Newton le Willows Cricket Club

records.title: Poor service
records.text: Despite more than one contact and email to advise the required adjustment to our records this company has failed to correct the errors that were made in the original set up.  They then failed to collect our latest payment by direct debit, their error, then charged us a late payment fee.  When they realised the error they then took the payment still including the late fee.  We have had multiple late payment fees in the past due to the incorrect set ups but none have been refunded, and they have never responded to my emails regarding this. The stars received go to Deeksha Dhiman Employee no. 709 who showed great patience over the phone dealing with my frustration, and helping to get the necessary corrections put through. I thank her.

records.title: Despite not having my gas on this month…

records.title: Could not understand clearly in English…
records.text: Could not understand clearly in English what she was saying but got the idea.They sent me a bill for a whole year in one go and wanted payment.I tried to go on their portal but it was asking for a password which l didn't have and it was hard to get hold of them to gain access to the portal but they kept sending a message go on our portal and you couldn't register.They called me and l called them straight back only to find that l waited for a long time then it cut off and it was just music so l gave up (3 times on different dates).There was not enough lea way to make payment even though it was estimated by them and l didn't have a contract with them so it was easier to just pay what they asked for just to stop the letters.

records.title: 53 Pounds for just 19 days
records.text: I only used their service for 19 days as I was switching to Octopus energy. They charged me about 53£ for just 19 days! Also this bill should have been issued to be me in 2021, and they sent it 2 years late!I am giving 2 stars instead of 1 because of the helpful customer service. I would like to thank priya Rathour, and Dilpreet Kaur ( reference number 715 ) for helping me.

records.title: Useless email portal - lack of telephone opening hours
records.text: For the third time, I have tried to resolve my issues by email. However, your server keeps rejecting them. This is not helpful when your phone opening times are only 9.00am to 5.30pm. I also work 9-5, as many of your customers, I am sure, and therefore I have limited opportunity to call Most utility companies have phone lines open 8am to 8pm. The positive is that I did not have to wait long for my call to be answered. My first issue was that I had previously requested paperless billing, and that I had been charged for this even though I had received my bill electronically. My second issue was that during a previous call, it had been confirmed that I did not need to submit readings as we have a smart meter. I therefore, queried why the bill was estimated. I was advised that the meter was "not fully smart" (whatever that means) and that I should submit readings. That's fine, but I was wrongly advised previously.

records.title: Overseas Call Centre - Poor telephony
records.text: It appears that all calls to Pozitiv are answered at a call centre in India. The quality of the digital phone lines combined with the heavy foreign accents meant that despite three separate phone calls, I was unable to communicate well enough to get the answers to my questions. Amrita tried her best and promised to email me some further information (assuming she could follow what I was saying), but the problem is more fundamental. If you cannot communicate effectively, then what is the point of a call centre?

records.title: There are still good people in this world...
records.text: I don't usually leave reviews but had to congratulate BP for the wonderful service at Rivenhall South Service Station, London Road A12, Rivenhall End, Witham. The cashier whose name is Shabeeth was friendly, helping me with my BP reward card. He asked me of I wanted to redeem my points which no-one has ever asked me before and to be honest I've never checked either. £50 off my petrol bill was very nice, thank you very much! By joking apart, Shabeeth and also Lorna were a breath of fresh air. In this chaotic times of selfishness and greed, this evening I saw that there is still good and caring people around. Please BP, recognise these two staff members and if you are members of the public, drop in at this station on A12. It will make your day. I've actually seem other great reviews for this garage which reassures me of the genuineness of these two lovely people. Thank you for your kindness. I will pass by again!

records.title: Coffee drinkers and shoppers blocking access to pumps after fuelling.
records.text: Went to local BP Connect in Dumbarton today to fuel car. On arrival I was lucky enough to get the one available pump as all the rest had cars parked alongside. At most of the pumps there was no-one either at the pump or in the car. Refuelled using BPMe App (which takes a bit of time) and I left before any of the other vehicles that were parked alongside the pumps when I arrived. A queue had formed and was almost backed up on to the A82. It was obvious that the drivers of the cars in question, if not in the short queue to pay, were either shopping in M & S or waiting on a coffee. Why don't they fuel up, pay and then park in one of the available spaces away from the pumps before shopping or getting a coffee rather than block access to the pumps? Staff need to be more aware and maybe there needs to be some sort of signage to prevent this from happening. The drivers of at least 4 of the cars (3 were in queue at paypoint) were blocking access to pumps while they shopped or had a coffee.

records.title: Watch the car wash payment
records.text: BP garage Bullsmoor Way. Something very wrong when you buy car wash. When you pay cash they never give you the printed ticket. They send the staff member out to enter the numbers. Really pleased with the service of both engineer and phone operators from Flogas

records.title: The process of purchasing a new gas…

records.title: First class installation team

records.title: Good to speak to a human being not a recorded service
records.text: I phone Flogas to give them my meter readings every month since July2024 when they became our suppliers It’s good to be able to speak to an actual person and someone who is both helpful and friendly ..They give you all the information you require including the amount you should expect to pay once receiving their invoice … So far I have spoken to Fiona and Ahmed .

records.title: Good communication and installation…
records.text: Good communication and installation happened when and how it should of. Only negative is the trench widths were in everyone's opinion too wide, creating more mess and work than necessary

records.title: Great gas delivery from James Baynham

records.title: Great prices in comparison but getting…
records.text: Great prices in comparison but getting switched over could have been smoother and felt like a few staff wernt that interested really Had to send a few chasing emails as my first contact to flogas was on holiday perhaps I’m expecting a bit much but thought it was a good thing to move over from one energy supplier to another especially for the new supplier Anyway was with flogas in my last house and new house was with another company who also wasn’t that bothered to retain me until it was too late then they came after me offering better rates which still didn’t match flogasAll very odd really

records.title: Polite and friendly delivery man
records.text: Polite and friendly delivery man. Only reason I've not given 5 stars is that I was expecting the delivery the day before.

records.title: Good customer servic
records.text: The customer service I received from Leann Rogers was excellent. She took the time to listen to me and is an efficient administrator. The only difficulty I had was the long wait for a telephone response.

records.title: The guys who carried out the…
records.text: The guys who carried out the installation were friendly knowledgeable and helpful and also left the site clean and tidy .The only downside is that the skip wagon damaged our driveway when picking up the skip and didn’t make us aware of the damage !!!

records.title: A smooth transition from my previous…

records.title: Raya is amazing!

I spoke with Raya who totally took charge of the situation and turned things around. Rays service was 5 stars but I have listed 4 because so far Flogas as a whole were scoring -1. Well done Raya, oustanding work, very knowledgable and incedibly helpful.

records.title: Not so happy customer
records.text: The experience with FloGas was very good - to a point.Pre sales, we had no problems. During the run up to the installation all was fine. The installation and filling the tank went as well as we could expect.However, a letter sent during October informing us that the 'daily' charge was to be increased from 24p to 37p at a stroke was a really damaging experience to us and for us.The only reason we could see was for an increase in profits and not to the benefit of the customer

records.title: This time, you excelled because of your team
records.text: Whilst, in the last 7 years of living in our house we have been struggling to get what we need from Flogas, recently we were refreshingly looked after by Paul M and Gary M who changed the levels we needed for the best outcome for us and our neighbours. They both were efficient and incredibly polite and respectful. Try and keep your pricing affordable FloGas

records.title: Your representative,Matthew Emerson has…

Trying to talk with flogas directly was not so good,We relied entirely on Matthew to iron out any problems that arose,and he handled those with a  good natured and helpful response.Now that we are “set up” hopefully we will have a trouble free relationship.yours Ivor Robinson

records.title: Waiting to hear from you.
records.text: Waiting to hear from you.Are we on your telemetry system yet?

records.title: The first installation team was very…

records.title: Driver Mike
records.text: Three times I was emailed saying a delivery had been scheduled only to receive another one on day of delivery to say it had been rescheduled.  As it happened I still had a good quantity of gas  Yesterday I heard the price of gas was going down, I wonder if that was the reason for the top up!!  Mike the driver is always very polite, efficient and tidy.

records.title: great after care    Following placing an order was not…
records.text: Following placing an order was not trackable. Think the first attempt of delivery went to a n other . Not down to flow gas but they very promptly dispatches anther still no able to track but delivered to my safe place . If parcel had tacking would be five stars as I know DHL does do tracking.

records.title: From contacting Flogas I received great…
records.text: From contacting Flogas I received great service from Shenaz Choudhury who helped us move over to your company.  He also helped us when the online contract would not complete and helped us through the process.  The change over was done much faster than expected by Kelly Grace which we appreciate as we are running low on fuel.  The only reason the review is a 4, was the fact that every time I tried to call the support line, I never received an answer.

records.title: Delivery issues
records.text: Flogas not telling customers online when the put in  bulk order that the deliveries being prioritised to customers with 10% to 15% left when they order due to shortages in January and February this year.  I ordered over 20 days ago and had to phone to find out this info from wonderful customer advisor.  If they stated this on website it would save as many people phoning up.  On the good side the customer advisor who i dealt with was excellent at her job and phoned back when she said she would.

records.title: A long time to get a tank
records.text: A long time to get a tank, installation was good and trouble free.

records.title: My delivery went ahead on the 7th Nov…
records.text: My delivery went ahead on the 7th Nov as advised.  Great.  Why the f+++ do you leave me a note asking “how did we do?”  You delivered my gas, as per my contract; do you want praise?  J@@@@, grow up!  Also stop wasting money on posh high quality cards containing my delivery note, reduce my gas price instead!  (No criticism intended here of the delivery guy, he was presumably just doing what he had been asked to do by FloGas)

records.title: Website is hard work was advised by…
records.text: Website is hard work was advised by driver to buy two new connectors hoses !! And he will bring on next gas bottle delivery and change , I’ve done this but being charged for delivery of hoses , totally not a user friendly site

records.title: After the initial approach I made to…
records.text: After the initial approach I made to the sales team to switch my account it took several weeks and a few phone calls before a contract arrived. When received all has gone smoothly though. Generally good service but room for improvement

records.title: 19kg delivered to a neighbour
records.text: I ordered a 19kg replacement bottle for delivery. The driver delivered to the wrong property, leaving me with an empty bottle still connected and I unable to replace with the full bottle myself.Telephone call made to Flogas who identified the bottle had been delivered to a neighbouring property whose occupants were away. Flogas have arranged for a driver to call back and replace the empty bottle and attached the new bottle so I can use it.

records.title: Flogas, Willowholme, Carlisle.
records.text: Cannot get a reply from telephoning. When visiting site physically, which is difficult and awkward to get to, there is no one there, parking is non existent as it is like Fort Knox. Impossible to order from them by phone or on line. In frustration when going to the bother of driving out of my way to the site. A difficult to find sign was stuck to the railings apologising for being closed and any difficulties experienced! What? Why couldn’t they leave a recorded message on the phone or a scripted message put on line to save us the bother of an inconvenient wasted long car journey and a waste of valuable time. Don’t go there!

records.title: I expected better…
records.text: Although the ethos is why we went for Flogas the customer service was really slack. It took more than 5 days just to get a reply to an email, everything took ages to sort… first made enquiries on the 27th of JUNE and it’s now the 21st of August and I still don’t know where I stand! I had an email saying a direct debit had been set up to go out on the 15th Aug, it is now the 21st and it’s still not gone and total radio silence re: delivery etc. I expected better I have to say.

records.title: then3 stars are for Mack in customer…
records.text: then3 stars are for Mack in customer services. not impressed with the increase. i ordered gas 3 days before price rise, but have to pay the rise because they cant deliver until then, they dont work weekends

records.title: RESOLVED. Dodgy business practices
records.text: EDIT: Many thanks to Debbie from the complaints team in sorting out my problem below. I’ve been a Flogas customer since 2018. Customer service has been mixed but prices were good. They’ve given me a high price for contract renewal so I’m moving to Calor who are much cheaper. Calor have just told me that Flogas are refusing to supply the manufacturers certificate for their tank so calor can’t buy it out. I called Flogas and they don’t want to help. I’ve opened a complaint as they are trying to stop me from leaving to another supplier for a lower price. Dodgy business practices.

records.title: Honest Thoughts
records.text: We are very pleased with the offer that we were given, but it was very difficult to maintain communication with the sales team. But we came through in the end and are pleased with the contract and subsequent service given.

records.title: Ordering was not a good experience
records.text: Ordering was not a good experience as login kept saying error I had to refresh password 3 times before successfully accessing my account, after ordering when I went to pay I noticed a error which i could not alter, I then phoned the number on website got through then was cut off after 10 minutes then was placed in a Queue which said I was 15th and estimated waiting time was 28 and still waiting

records.title: Poor comms & disjointed switch
records.text: Switch process was a trifle disjointed.  Had the welcome email & account details after the lorry had come & filled up the tank with 963L!  This was not authorised by ourselves & as we are low users we did not want a full fill.  Not the start we wanted but Rick in customer services was very helpful.

records.title: Great website, poor transparency
records.text: I found the website easy to use and navigate. However, once my order had gone through I noticed the delivery had been increased from £4.95 to £9.95 without warning! I've been trying to reach customer services but can't seem to get through - disappointing and not what I expected.

records.title: Self dig for tank - site engineer so helpful*
records.text: Like: site engineer "Jamie" was excellent in assisting us when it came to the dig for the pit/tank, thank you JamieDislike: Not much after service to explain how things work (as a new customer)Credit control: just wanted you to sign up to a direct debit - no time taken to make sure customer understands and happy with payment agreement

records.title: Poor Web Page and Ordering System
records.text: I don’t know what has happened to the FloGas web sit3 and ordering system. I tried many times over two weeks to get into the system then had great difficulty ordering the bottles I needed.  Why do companies keep updating web pages and consistently make them worse than they were?  Don’t worry FloGas, you are not alone in making web pages and ordering systems worse.

records.title: Got there in the end
records.text: We finally received the delivery of our new LPG tank yesterday after 6 months of trying to contact the sales representative for my area. Eventually I managed to contact a representative from a different area his name is Ian and was really helpful and things started to move very quickly and well organised right up to the delivery and installation of the tank. The Install team were very helpful and professional. Just a shame it took so long.Kind regards Nick Tomkins

records.title: Flogas failed to advise quantity of pea shingle for backfilling.
records.text: Initial appointment fast and good. Installation good. Failed on overkill size of hole required - excessive for small tank. I ordered 3 ton of pea shingle, when it became apparent 6 ton was required. This should have been advised by Flogas, which meant another delivery couldn’t be made for 3 days and I will have to employ a digger man a further days labour to complete the backfill. Not good enough!

records.title: A now marginally happier customer
records.text: Ordered my gas. Didn’t arrive for nearly 6 weeks by which time we had run out. We were without gas for several days and had to work extremely hard to get an emergency supply. I have now had a conversation with Joel from customer service, who has been very helpful and so I have edited thispost accordingly.I hope that my next series of deliveries are a little less exciting.

records.title: Great people, hopeless system …
records.text: Speedy process from site survey to tank installation. Installation relatively problem-free. All good so far . . . Then, Telemetry system installed but never connected! Once connected, was told I still had to call to order because my account not updated with auto-ordering. That done, I watch the gauge which shows red at 30% slowly drop . .  still no delivery. Now at 11%, told I'm on Priority Schedule list. 2 hours later, Orders call "Delivery within the next 7 days"! 11% will probably last but why the stress? That said, great people at every interaction, FloGas' leadership team should support those great people with a system that works! Less stress for the staff, less stress for the customer, surely a "win win"!I see bland responses to some customers; how about  saying what FloGas is going to actually do to resolve the problem long term, ie, identify root cause and develop a lasting solution.

records.title: Another note about Flogas delivery
records.text: Thank you Flogas for responding to this & delivering a full tank today.Another note about Flogas delivery - or lack of it. We have been turning the heating off in recent days as the tank has gone below 15%.  Having spoken to Customer Service (eventually) apparently they cannot escalate my delivery until I have less than 10% in the tank!  I have previously been told that we shouldn’t let the tank go below 10%??  So what do I do?  Turn the heating back on so that my tank quickly reduces below 10% & hope they get to me before I lose all power. Or, spend February in front of the log burner to eek out the gas until they get to us.  Stuck with a two year contract with little control over cost & zero control over supply. Off the grid sucks without some government help.

records.title: Constantly being sent Docusign…

records.title: Misleading on final statement.
records.text: Rebel energy was my provider for around a year. Within that time my direct debit increased  a great deal from £117 pm To almost £500 pm, due to my usage.  I decided in the end to change providers, as i didnt think i was using that much. When I recieved my final statement from rebel. They informed me I was almost £1,900 in credit, and I would be refunded within 7-10 days. On day 13, I still not recieved it, so I gave them a call to chase it up. I was  informed by a lady called queenie that in order to recieve it, I had to call them to request it. This process seems silly to me, as if it's your final bill, you shouldn't have to request a refund, it   should be automatic. I am now having to wait another 7-10 working days to have it back in my bank account. My final statement from rebel did not tell me you have to ring them to get your money back. I think this needs to be made more clear on your final statement. Thankyou Queenie for sorting this for me today.

records.title: Poor at first, but have greatly improved over the last year.

records.title: Always able to get on to someone

records.title: Nosiviwe was very helpful
records.text: I recently moved into a new rental and got set up with Rebel Energy by one of these companies who "do everything for tenants" - I am not convinced about said companies but that is another story. Rebel Energy started supplying and charging me before the start of my tenancy. The first time I called about it, I was given a lot of attitude by a man who said that I could cancel if I wanted, but I ran the risk of having no supply when I moved in. He suggested that if I gave an opening reading, that should resolve the issue. It did not. I was then told I needed to send an email with my tenancy agreement, which I did. I got an acknowledgement that it had be referred upward but no more than that. I then got notification of another payment coming out of my account. So I called and spoke to Nosiviwe who was really very helpful. She actually did something to address the issue i.e., she cancelled the previous account, set up a new account for the actual day that my tenancy started, and transferred the balance to the new account. She was very thorough and I am satisfied with her service. It remains to be seen what happens with the new account and charges for the period before my tenancy started but like I said, I am very pleased with Nosiviwe's thorough service.

records.title: My experience was not as good as I…

records.title: Incredible frustrating start to using…
records.text: Incredible frustrating start to using Rebel energy. I moved in to my property and had to call three times before they actually sent me a bill. Each agent I spoke to the first two times, said they would email me personally or offered their personal email to send readings over. But each time nothing happened.I called up a third time today and finally, De-Juan was able to resolve my issues as it turned out my email had been spelled incorrectly. I will see how going forward my service is, cause it is great to be able to call up customer services and speak to someone straight away and not go through a million forms or ai bots or menus before getting to a person, however having this frustration at the beginning has been so stressful. I live alone and so waiting in fear of my first bill which was almost 2 months late has not been good. I've been in fear of putting the heating on for weeks cause of the anticipated cost right before Christmas. However I will give you a second chance after my service today from De-Juan thanks

records.title: Billing choice
records.text: I liked the swift response when I declined fixed energy billing, please keep it up.

records.title: DD being increased when there is only a 4 month historySpoke to De-Juan last evening about my…
records.text: Spoke to De-Juan last evening about my account on which my dual fuel DD has been consistently raised since joining REBEL through a switch partner 4 months ago. De-Juan was extremely helpful and understood the issue, he was polite, listened and tried hard to help. The end result is that I am trapped in a contract and have had to agree the same DD as I had with my previous provider so what was the point.

records.title: App and Website rubbish, good phone support
records.text: I didn't even know Rebel Energy were my supplier until 6 months into my tennancy - I signed up with Octopus for gas and electric and it was only after checking my bills a few months in that I realised they weren't charging me for electric. I get a letter in the post saying I owe for months of electricity to a company I've never heard of... Looks legit, Which? recognises them. Unfortunately their website never works properly, I can't log into the app, I only get my bills each month via email. The only plus side is the good service by the phone agents who have been very helpful every time i've called them. Wouldn't use them again, didn't even really choose to use them this time.

records.title: I couldn't switch but thank you for…
records.text: I couldn't switch but thank you for your time

records.title: Nosiviwe was so helpful and provided…
records.text: Nosiviwe was so helpful and provided efficient help into my query.I’m giving 3 stars not because of the above but because Rebel, as a company are inconsistent with how they deal with issues from their app, payments efficiently.

records.title: The thing I disliked was that I was…
records.text: The thing I disliked was that I was unable to see my statements.When I wanted to put in my meter readings the site rejected my account number and also my email address and said there was no account in those numbers.When I phoned up to ask why I couldn't get to my statements the person was not helpful, said that I owed over £1000,  I knew this was wrong as I was over £100 in credit the last time I saw my statement.I have now sent todays meter readings and hope to get some feedback from the customer service.

records.title: I’ve not been with rebel long (only a…
records.text: I’ve not been with rebel long (only a week as they provided for previous person), but I’ve had a real mix of interactions. Emails seemed to be talking to AI and were odd and notunderstanding, but talked to Garry on live chat to sort a very large bill today and was sorted very quickly and took off a big stress, so thanks again to Garry for sorting it!

records.title: iv had months of issues with rebel…
records.text: iv had months of issues with rebel energy, mainly with my gas account. finally yesterday an engineer came out and replaced the meter. i have phoned today to give the meter reads so that my bills are correct and Raeesah was very polite and helpful and assured this was updated to my account and my bill will be generated reflecting this. i’m hoping this issue is now resolved after months of worry and stress

records.title: Mixed bag
records.text: You have a crap computer system, it doesn't recognise 2023 as a year see below. I had a long chat with Luqmaan in Cape Town about his city and my visit there and about my other experiences in South Africa. He was unable to satisfy my request to send me £500 today without me being able to give him a meter reading from each of my gas and electric meters. I have written to my landlord's daughter to complain about the situation. which Rebel Energy is aware of but have been unable to send an engineer to fit smart meters which would be one way to fix the problem.

records.title: Incorrect Billing
records.text: The customer support executive was very helpful in listening to the issue and she has escalated it to the back office team who need to address this and get back to me. The issue is that I see an incorrect overall account balance on the website and the bills i get sent. This is quite annoying given i pay each month by direct debit.

records.title: Rebel Energy is slowly getting better, but not worth it yet
records.text: Rebel Energy is slowly getting better, but their basic features are still lacking. In the last 12 months they've made an online portal and app. The issue is that you still cannot submit a meter reading on the online portal, and the app errors every time I try to provide a meter reading. This effectively makes both pointless. There's potential here, but they need to fix the basics first.

records.title: Unable to login or pay bill
records.text: I moved into a new apartment 2.5 months ago and Rebel Energy were the original suppliers so I've been trying to register with them unsuccessfully. I've called and emailed them numerous times without success. I'm not able to login to their website and not able to pay my bill. This is absolutely terrible service.

records.title: Rebel energy billing
records.text: Checked my app today to discover that Jan and Feb bills had been deleted. When I phoned customer service they explained that bills were needing to be updated due to tariff change in Jan which had not been updated on their billing system. Why this was not done before Jan update to avoid confusion with customers I don’t know. I have numerous issues with rebel energy in regard to billing. I gave an updated customer reading to customer services today so that they can issue a correct bill to me. The reading appears on app for a few minutes but when you go back to check it it’s disappeared again. This is really bad service from rebel energy they need to get their app and billing system sorted out.RegardsMr Raymond Young

records.title: Redeemed Themselves
records.text: Had a mare of a time with the first couple people I coordinated with regarding payment of my bills. However this rating was significantly swayed by Neil who offered me a very fast solution and helped find my payment and get it all sorted within an hour of me calling.

records.title: There was a mistake in recording my…
records.text: There was a mistake in recording my readings on the application as it crashed while using it…The ones who answer the calls , are so nice and talking in a friendly and supportive way, but what happens on real life is that, i am still waiting for my problem to be solved, this was sent to the back office according to the representative who talked to me said, but yet it has been 2 weeks now and still the mistake in my bill is not corrected, I ve been in this new property for the last 3 months but I couldn’t pay any of my bills till now, I don’t know how much got accumulated. I ve been waiting for 2 months now for the smart meter they offered me, but no one came. I am still waiting for all the power bills issues to be corrected. Waiting a lot …..

records.title: Always available when ever you need…
records.text: Always available when ever you need assistance. Socially flexible in explaining us your clients like what she just did keep up the good work.

records.title: Although I am looking to leave rebel…
records.text: Although I am looking to leave rebel energy due to how expensive I’m finding them I called regarding a balance owed today and Celeste was very polite and and help full she gets full stars 🌟

records.title: Sign up process not smooth
records.text: Sign up process not smooth. Called in and promised call back within 3 days and this wasn’t actioned. After I signed up online, was sent email to give meter Reading by 7 December. Went to vacant property to get meter readings (this is a two hour round trip for me) clicked on the link to download the app. I was not able to access the app as no email to confirm my account details were sent through. I called the helpline to be told that I did not need to submit a meter reading until my transfer from the old provider takes place in the next week. I was told I would not need to now give a meter reading until the start of January 2025. I read the email that was sent through by Rebel energy to me stating that I was to give a meter reading and explained all the problems in doing so.  Celeste apologised and said that is an automatic email that is sent out and that she would raise it with back office because the information was incorrect. Celeste was apologetic and it is not her fault however I think this is a big oversight in the automation aspects of how rebel energy do their business. I hope that this is the last of the issues I have fingers crossed.

records.title: It was super hard for me to understand…
records.text: It was super hard for me to understand the operator: spoke too fast and I had to keep on asking to repeat. I had a great call and support the day before but the actions agreed were not actioned and that's the reason why I had to call again. Everything is very confusing

records.title: Poor management, good phone technical support
records.text: App does not work, they keep mixing up my meter readings, , they reply confusingly in emails (suspected AI bot system) Perfect technical support by phone call

records.title: Waste of time
records.text: Weekly emails re bill and payment and credit.Waste of time trying to do anythingMany times i have pointed out that my account is in credit and you insisted i increase the direct debit.It worked out that my bill came a few days before my next payment so looked like it needed increasing.No one understood the situation and my payment was increased.In an effort to make the situation better for me I took the drastic step of increasing my credit even more and paid £300 pound in. And also asked for my billing date to change ( i think this was done)Because my consumption varies over the year i have to ring up and sort things out every march.I tried to use a comparison web site but the company isn’t listed in their list to compare.Words are fine , understanding needs more time and effort.

records.title: They are all bad
records.text: I'm sorry but I don't understand the positives reviews. Customers service operator I genuinely couldn't understand due to their accent I had to ask her to repeat up to three times. Then I find out my issue is because rebel have accidentally closed an account and charged me alot of money. It was only some what rectified after I brought it up. Also I couldn't be given a time frame to which my issue would be sorted... I was just told to call back in 2 weeks. I'm tired and I feel like no one in rebel has done their job properly with my case.Update: Still no updates

records.title: Using Rebel energy App
records.text: Using Rebel energy App. Despite Rebel energy saying they were making improvements to their App , many months later still having issues when entering a customer reading. Again I gave a customer reading on 1st Oct, to then recieve a bill showing it as an estimated reading. And when you go to App you discover that the customer reading you gave has changed to a system reading. This is really frustrating as the only way I can correct this is to have to phone to have bill corrected each month.

records.title: It’s been two months since we moved…
records.text: It’s been two months since we moved into our new place and signed with Rebel, we can’t log in to our account, and we’ve not had a single bill, yet we’ve paid via direct debit those two times. Customer service kept saying website is down hence why we can’t log in.

records.title: not impressed so far
records.text: not impressed so far. I've only been with rebel energy for 2 months but despite numerous requests I am unable to log in to our customer account...I think I'm at 4 requests now.  So when meter readings are needed I have to call them up...this morning yet another 40 minutes wasted on the phoneAddition: following on from a response from rebel,  I have been told that for the last couple of months. Not too bothered about an app, would appreciate being able to log into my account. Also, there is no information on your website stating the app is being worked on so that may be useful for customers to know aswell.

records.title: Despite moving over to Rebel I am…
records.text: Despite moving over to Rebel I am unable to log into my account so I can’t monitor my energy consumption. You have already taken my DD payment which I find very odd.Hope I won’t be disappointed moving over

records.title: Customer Service Email Failures - INBOX FULL
records.text: I have been with Rebel Energy for a few days and I'm due to move into the rental property in a weeks’ time.Currently in the process of trying to set up account portal access. I have been told I won't have access for the first 10 days, no idea why.Also, all my emails are now being bounced back with a 'recipients mailbox is full' postmaster failure receipt.Rebel .. can you delete some of your old emails please?

records.title: helpful
