records.title: Phone answered promptly.  Thank you.
records.text: Very much appreciated that the phone was answered promptly - time is money!    Sorry we had to call you,but on two of  our December bills, the November amount was once again included, so this was an urgent and serious matter for us.    Your customer service gentleman was very understanding.  Our business needs the refund that he assured me we are due.   Hence, we wait completion of this matter.

records.title: Meter reading problem
records.text: We initially faced issues with submitting meter readings through the YGP website, which led to overestimated readings and an extremely high charge on our bill. However, after communicating with the customer service team, they promptly addressed the problem, corrected the readings, adjusted our bill, and arranged a refund to our account within 10 days.This resolution has restored our confidence in YGP. We want to especially thank the customer service team for their helpfulness, patience, and determination in resolving the issue effectively. Their proactive support turned a frustrating experience into a positive one.

records.title: Tazreek was very helpful and tried to…
records.text: Tazreek was very helpful and tried to ensure the problem that I had previously rung about, and not yet resolved, will be sorted. He also helped me out with an immediate issue whilst I am unable to access my account.  I have only given 4 stars as I am not happy that I have had to ring and chase and very much hope I won't have to do this again !!

records.title: Good service
records.text: Very polite, friendly and helpful man, Leo Scott, on the phone who explained my billing issue perfectly. However marked off a star as I now have to supply videos of our meter, even though O have sent photos on two occasions now to sort out our meter issues, but nobody ever responds - so now I have to try again with something I'm not confident at doing and hope someone comes back to us and sorts it out.So brilliant service form Leo today, bt problem still pending

records.title: Devanw J Went the extra mile to help me…

On the morning I had a call with the wonderful Devan, I had already spoke to 2 awful representatives who had been no help at all. Is 1/3 good enough YGP?

records.title: My call was answered within a few…
records.text: My call was answered within a few minutes wait, I spoke with a knowledgeable person who was polite and listened to my query.  The query was not rectified at this point however escalated to the billing team which will be rectified by them.

records.title: Good service from Lamla
records.text: Lamla has assisted me over the past few months to resolve a major issue that should never have escalated as it did . However. Your hold music is AWFUL. The ‘can can’ music is enough to wind anyone up when your on hold - please change this music !

records.title: The lady in question was very helpful…

It should be phoned in on 1st but because it was a Bank Holiday, I was giving it to her on the day our invoice was being raised.   I insisted it should be registered as I had asked the week before how to cope with the BH - she responded and today I have received the bill as notified.

records.title: The guy at customer services was very…

records.title: Waiting for a refund
records.text: Devan who I spoke to today was as helpful as he could have been, but the Customer services team are let down by the processes of YGP. I spoke to Esther who was equally helpful on 22.11.2022. The Customer services team are always polite but I suspect are subjected to unacceptable abuse by frustrated Customers.

records.title: Helpful person on the phone
records.text: Helpful person on the phone , help explain about our meter reading for a new meter fitted hopefully will be able to sort it out . Nice to be able to talk to somebody rather than only internet

records.title: Your advisor Sherwin was helpful and…
records.text: Your advisor Sherwin was helpful and polite….but one hour later I received another phone call on the same matter and an agreement for a callback which never happened.The following day I received a call from the Complaints team on the basis of the review above..I explained I did not wish to make a complaint,just give feedback on their communication issues.Two hours later I received two more emails threatening debt collection despite my having explained that the bill was incorrect and agreeing with the agent that we’d submit bill and photo evidence in two days.

records.title: Was looking for a credit to be repaid…
records.text: Was looking for a credit to be repaid as our contract has finished. Was slightly disappointed by having to contact you for the refund, rather than it being automatic. I was told that this was to ensure that it was returned to the correct account. My view is that you could have contacted me for that information. I am told that the credit will be in my account in 10 days, so waiting expectantly

records.title: Laaiqah Hendricks was attentive
records.text: Laaiqah Hendricks was attentive, polite and exceptionally helpful with the query that I had and explained everything that she was doing to assist.  Also, Laaiqah was sure to explain why she was carrying out a process to resolve the issue and what I as a customer need to do as a next step.

records.title: Thanks for processing my refund so…
records.text: Thanks for processing my refund so quickly after my overpayments. I had been paying my fuel based on estimates and when I got around to sending the actual readings, YGP quickly dealt with the overpayment and processed the refund.A big thank you to Gary Siritzky who was super efficient at delaying with my complaint.

records.title: Myriam very helpful
records.text: Myriam very helpful . However , what is the point of me sending you  meter readings at the end of the month when you always give me estimated bills unless I call in a reading .

records.title: I am hopeful that the lady understood…
records.text: I am hopeful that the lady understood my problem and was able to rectify it whilst also correcting my bill. Hopefully YGP has now got my direct debit details correct.

records.title: Naseerah was fab!
records.text: After trying (with no luck!) to get an issue with you resolved for over a month, today I spoke to Naseerah. She was so helpful, understanding and keen to get to the bottom of the problem. She could see from previous notes that the fault was not ours and has now taken ownership of this case (to save me starting from the beginning each time I call and speak to someone different). She has promised to personally keep in touch with updates on the progress of this issue and has left me hopeful that it may actually get resolved this time. 4 out of 5 stars given at this time purely because the problem still needs sorting. I will update my review accordingly when we have a resolution, but for now, Naseerah was a huge help!

records.text: phones answered very promptly.problems with meter reads dragged on for a yearfar to long

records.title: That you send estimated bills when you…

records.title: YGP service plan review
records.text: YGP is good on service, however, the standing charges price has gone up from 60p to 100p per day in the recent renewal plan.  not very favourable!

records.title: Renewal discussion
records.text: People were pleasant and courteous however I was very disappointed in the prices quoted for contract renewal.  These were 10p per unit adrift from prices I have received from other suppliers.  I would have hoped that existing customers got at least as good a price as that offered to new customers.  Once challenged, the price dropped by almost 8 pence per unit (still 2 pence adrift).  I don't like this way of working, having to argue the price at every renewal.  I would rather be offered the best price first time around.  So I suppose I need to change suppliers yet again.  This industry could do with a large injection of ethics somewhere along the line.

records.title: After receiving the last bill
records.text: After receiving the last bill, which was estimated we emailed the up to date readings. After a few days we got in touch to make sure the correct amount was paid and not the amount on the original bill. The girl on the phone said she could see we had sent in the up to date readings but it didn’t seem anything had been done about it. She was very helpful as far as she could be and said a new bill would be issued. Needless to say the wrong amount was taken out of our account and we still haven’t had a revised bill.Since writing this review we have been contacted and by phone and the person was very helpful explaining why the bill was estimated and a refund will follow in due course.

records.title: Debt recovery Aggressive
records.text: Debt recovery is very aggressive on small amounts. Incorrect detail on invoices holds payments up. The property needs to be clearly marked on invoices especially with Councils who have a number of properties.

records.title: Helpful with sorting out issue
records.text: Helpful with sorting out issuePoliteI did have some trouble understanding as spoke very fast,English wasn’t spoken very clearly

records.title: YGP average service!!!
records.text: We have been with YGP for nearly a year now, during that time we have had numerous issues with the bills.  It took a while to sort out what we needed to pay, the advance energy costs were not explained and generally it has taken a lot of time and effort to sort.  The staff are located outside of the UK so the quality of the telephone line is isn't always that great, it has taken a while for someone to get back to us and at times the information (specifically in response to emails) isn't all that clear and does not always answer what you have asked.  YGP are okay, I would say about average, compared against the energy companies. They are no better and are not any worse.

records.title: Its not been the easiest of journeys…

records.title: My experience so far -
records.text: I initially signed with YGP as had been advised that my business was their priority, I  had advised that i could have a smart meter - This was not clarified that the meter within the clinic had to be changed and I ( wrongly) assumed that it was a plug in- the same as at home. A surprise for me when now being pestered to change the meter which I have advised several times that it is rented and therefore I cannot give consent.2nd to this and I feel most important- I was quoted £277.00 pcm for my electricity - I raised concern at the time as previous to me this was a full time Beautician/ Hairdresser and I am only in clinic 2-3 x a week as an Aesthetics Nurse- Not using much electricity - I then received an alarming £307.00 bill that I had to pay as this was '' the up front payment and the next would be altered at the next invoice' if any alterations were appropriate. The next payment came through as £307.00 again- challenged and had t submit again - This reading was lower than last months - apparently but still charged the same.Still challenged - admission to company not chasing up yesterday so will still have to pay another lot of money - £921.00 in past 3 months for minimal usage and not appreciating that I am only there a couple days a week max as rest of time working in Triaged - having to ask for extra shifts to pay for yet another bill that is not appropriate for usage- I wonder if there is any common sense when all readings have been submitted - even the one to the landlord when the premises was taken over!

records.title: The advisor I spoke to was quick to get…
records.text: The advisor I spoke to was quick to get to the nub of my problem. However three weeks later the problem has not been resolved, DD payments are being taken for a non existent meter!!

records.text: You have failed to provide me with a proper bill since I joined you in September saying you have not received a final reading from E-on which they insist they have sent. They have sent me the final reading.John Bontoft            Acc No YGP500508163

description: AvantiGas is one of the UK’s leading suppliers of LPG and energy solutions like bulk gas, gas bottles, aerosol propellant and biomass. We serve business and residential customers from all sectors and walks of life, providing a professional and safe service via our network of multiple distribution centres, two in-land gas terminals and our UK-based emergency call centre that delivers 24/7 maintenance, service and aftercare.

records.title: Gas delivered as arranged
records.text: Gas delivered as arranged.  Wasn’t in but didn’t matter, driver filled tank and left delivery note.  Been with calor and flogas before Avanti and never have an issue with them (unlike calor).  Deliveries triggered with time to spare to get lpg without risk of running out.  Top marks

records.title: Organised, Efficient and Quick.
records.text: We think the driver is mostly the same person who delivers to us. We are always impressed by how efficient and organised delivery is as the lane access to our property is tight. We are usually still in bed, 8am is often when the tank is filled, and we only see the delivery note when it is left in our letterbox.We wish to thank our driver for being so helpful to us over the considerable period of time we have been customers of Avanti.

records.title: Driver did a great job negotiating into…
records.text: Driver did a great job negotiating into a tight space due to traffic lights outside our house restricting access.  Our usual driver who is always cheerful.  Delivery was also quick from time of order 17 Dec to delivery on 23 Dec.  Thank you.

records.title: missed my email or txt,never checked to…
records.text: missed my email or txt,never checked to see if even got one,but anyhow doesn't  matter heard door so  was glad to get tank top up before  new year,jobs a good one no problems.driver spot on.

records.title: Did the job which he is obviously…
records.text: Did the job which he is obviously trained to do and most importantly to me he left our property secure as we have two young dogs

records.title: The driver was cheerful
records.text: The driver was cheerful, helpful and arrived when we expected him. We have been with you for many years and have never had cause to complain about anything.Thank you and a Happy New Year,                                                     Brian Childs.

records.title: The Gentleman who delivered our gas was…
records.text: The Gentleman who delivered our gas was polite, efficient and friendly. we are very happy with AvantiGas LPG as our gas provider.

records.title: Latest delivery from Avanti
records.text: Your driver is one of my  "regulars", friendly and polite, gas delivery was done with minimum fuss, care was taken when bringing the hose to my tank, passing parked vehicles. Once finished he had time to chat with me always nice. Very safety conscious, wheel chocks placed, fire extinguisher opened, hose reeled out both before and after going to the tank. 10 out 10 as usual.

records.title: DRIVER ONLY REVIEW
records.text: This review is for the DRIVER ONLY -The Driver who delivers to me is the best thing about Avanti Gas, polite, conscientious and cares 100% for his customers. I’m afraid the rest of the business doesn’t work. Again I was promised a solution and the female manager Julie failed to callMe back with a solution to my constant issue. I was promised telematics to be working 11 months ago and still I am being fobbed off.

records.title: Great company
records.text: Great company, lovely friendly and helpful staff. From first contact to final delivery, I would definitely recommend them.

records.title: Driver very pleasant.
records.text: Would give 5 stars my biggest bugbear is having to wait in as no time stipulated a 12hr window for delivery doesn't work for us morning or afternoon would help.Driver pleasant rang to confirm on his way which we don't always get.

records.title: After years of nothing but hassle from…
records.text: After years of nothing but hassle from this company they eventually did what they get paid for.Gas delivered on time on date when my breakpoint was reached.Drivers always have been great but this Xmas credit where its due to their system which worked.Lets hope its not a one off because they have loads of gas because its not been that cold.

records.title: Have no issues with ordering the LPG…
records.text: Have no issues with ordering the LPG bottles and when spoken to the service has been good The only issues i have had is with the accounts team, e.g. chasing an already paid payment.

records.title: NO GAS
records.text: Unfortunatley we had a bad experience with Avanti Gas which was due to the new attachment that they had fitted to our tank which was giving a reading of 20% of gas remaining in the tank.  In fact the tank was completely empty. We lost the heating and gas to the AGA as a result no food could be cooked. Delivery was delayed by a further day due to a problem with the clutch on the tanker, finally we had delivery. But the concern shown to me and the number of helpful  calls from Mr Bret Brookes was by far the most pleasing, helpful and reassuring that anyone could have made. Hence a very big thanks to Bret Brookes.

records.title: Prompt Action
records.text: My experience with Avanti has been mixed and seems to depend on the person who deals with your query. glad to say dean was very helpful, he understood my query and provided a practical solution without any further input from me. well done Dean.

records.title: Thank you
records.text: I found it difficult to actually speak to someone so I sent an email and received a very prompt response from Rihanna. She was really helpful and I was reminded of 'the good old days' when I could place an order by phone and was always happy with the service. The online Avanti works most of the time but I'm afraid I do prefer the personal touch. However, many thanks to Rihanna, she is a credit to your business!.

records.title: As our contract was coming to an end I…
records.text: As our contract was coming to an end I had to enquire as to what the new cost would be. This should come to us automatically rather than having to find out ourselves.

records.title: Improved service
records.text: They are more reliable now as rang us to supply the gas early so not having to get concerned with low gas this winter. Good service and delivery was very efficient.

records.title: So pleased driver turned up and…
records.text: So pleased driver turned up and actually topped up our tank ! Thrilled and hopefully  service like this will continue..  Last few years have been difficult with gauge issues/sticking so top ups weren’t being made meaning we had run out of gas a few years running - forecasting method was not effective. Hopefully now back on track with regular auto top ups and checking workings of their gas tanks.

records.title: I spoke to Les Banton and for the first…
records.text: I spoke to Les Banton and for the first time this year I spoke to a Avanti Gas employee who listened to me. I hope I can speak to Les the next time I have cause to contact Avanti Gas.

records.title: I wasn't at home when gas was…
records.text: I wasn't at home when gas was delivered, but the bottle had been put where it should be and empty was taken away. Usually the delivery guys are very helpful and always connect my gas up.

records.title: Last years deliveries were much better…
records.text: Last years deliveries were much better than previous years.  At the moment my gas tank is running worryingly low, I have updated my gauge reading but I am uneasy about the fact that because of this really cold weather we are having to use more gas than usual to keep warm, I have to think twice about heating my home in case we do run out.  Winters with Avanti gas are not pleasurable experiences I'm afraid.I don't think that we will renew our contract again.

records.title: Better communications please
records.text: I do my meter reading on a weekly basis as my tank supports 4-holiday cottages. I have updated the % on the website. I would like to think that this would generate an automatic flag for a delivery. To date, I have always had to ring up several times to secure a delivery. This is very stressful as you have to wait until the tank is nearly empty. No one mentioned the charges involved in changing supplier at the end of the contract.

records.title: Delivery of gas was fine
records.text: Delivery of gas was fine. Just an issues with the gas tank which they gave an unrealistic time frame for me to sort but after an email they amended this

records.title: Tank query
records.text: Rhianna was very helpful in dealing with my query about the life of my tank and it's maintenance. She then followed up by sending me an email confirming what we had discussed.

records.title: Improvement on previous deliveries
records.text: Based on my latest delivery I have given 4 stars. Based on previous delivery a would not rate higher than 2 stars. I sincerely hope the improvement continues. The driver I would rate as 5 stars, great job.

records.title: Fast delvery and excellent driver
records.text: Order was placed and gas delivered the following day, which has never happened before it’s usually 10/15 days The driver was excellent ie helpful and efficient as are all the drivers. 5 star service however a recent 20% increase led me to drop a star

records.title: Driver and mate were great and very…
records.text: Driver and mate were great and very respectful of garden when delivering.Would have been 5 stars had the office not kept texting the delivery date and the tanker not arriving (3rd time lucky)

records.title: Tip: Think about access to your property and ask for driver who can actually drive!
records.text: We had a driver this time who could actually drive and are not put off by what appears to be a tight entrance but isen't if you can actually drive and gauge the width of their vehicle!

records.title: The drivers in all have been great all…
records.text: The drivers in all have been great all the years we have been with Avanti gas. It was sad saying bye to the driver as he will not be coming here again. It's a shame that Avanti gas is getting rid of a lot of its loyal customers.

records.title: This again over Christmas period
records.text: This again over Christmas period.  Yet another ‘failed’ delivery right at a critical pre Xmas time.  So scheduled on 19th December - side gate opened and left for day.  Returned home with a note - ‘main gates locked unable to deliver’. So despite multiple deliveries through the side gate over many years they decided at a glance that everything was locked up.  So new driver we think!  Phoned to try and rearrange delivery, very patient and pleasant lady (only reason not giving no star) promises as usual a delivery soon.  We are on 10% now and using 1.6 a day with a cold snap just starting.  So another grim start to the year thanks to Avanti.  Two years ago we almost had to cancel Xmas as we were on fumes with old people and young children staying with us.  Didn’t mean we got anything delivered until after the festive and we were on 0.For the sake of my mental health I am starting 2025 with the thought of swapping to oil.Update 3/1/25:  message from Avanti - we will deliver today!  Gate open, I’ve just phoned them and guess what.  It’s NOT today is now tomorrow (Saturday 4th Jan).  Believe it when I see it! Had a reply from Avanti (below about breakdowns?!). So just going to see whether this delivery for today is going to happen at all?! Office is closed.They have turned up today (Saturday) and apparently had a breakdown yesterday so I am changing the review to 3 stars.  Stressful and avoidable from the failed entry on 19th onwards.

records.title: Customer services is rubbish
records.text: Customer services is rubbish! Like has been said before they ‘play god’ telling you how long your gas will last, when our own experience tells you otherwise.Driver however is brilliant 👍🏻, always helpful and regularly tells us to order sooner than site tells us to!! Poor chap is sick of being in the firing line of disgruntled customers!!!

records.title: Some improvement of late
records.text: After a number years of poor service it appears Avantigas are starting to make improvements. I have recently had a need to contact Avantigas and the matter was dealt with quite quickly by Rhianna Hill Customer Service Advisor. I still have an outstanding issue from almost a year ago with regards to upgrading the meters when I was told by Jade Shakespeare, Internal Sales & Support Manager that although she was unable to provide a date for this currently. she had reached out to the Projects team who manage these upgrades to request further information. I am still waiting for an update almost a year later. Consequently, despite the good service from Rhianna, I am only giving 3 stars.

records.title: The driver did not take away both empty…
records.text: The driver did not take away both empty cylinders.And while I'm here, I would like to complain about the Avantigas website. Clunky would be the word. Needs to be a lot more intuitive.

records.title: Change of siting of tanks.
records.text: I have no complaints about delivery driver, they are all courteous and do the job well. My beef is that now the company is wanting to phaseout the small tank, but will not let me have a bigger one. Due to safety issues with the siting apparently. They have been delivering to me for 16 plus years with no problem so why now is it an issue? They suggest I change to bottles and or change supplier. So much for customer loyalty.

records.title: Driver excellent as always
records.text: Driver excellent as always. On the downside we were originally notified on a Sunday that we would have a delivery the following day.  However this did not actually arrive until two weeks later and only after two telephone calls enquiring what was happening.   We have been with Avanti for many years and are sorry to find that their customer service is not as good as it used to be.

records.title: My latest phone call with Rhianna was…
records.text: My latest phone call with Rhianna was the first time I can honestly day Avanti have been at all helpful. Drivers are always polite but customer service is shocking.

records.title: Up sides and down sides
records.text: Up sideThe person - “Adam” ?- who returned my call this morning was very helpful and answered my query and Courtney (please excuse if mis spelt) who I spoke to before “Adam” was pleasant and tried to help but had IT issues.Down sideI have had an issue since the end of January and, despite me contacting and trying to contact Avanti very, very many times, not having calls returned despite being told it would be within 72 hours, I still had an issue yesterday. Thankfully I was finally told this morning by “Adam” that all is resolved. I just hope that this is the case.

records.title: Problem with leaving invoices
records.text: On leaving Avantigas received 2 invoices sent at same time - one said I owed them £105, the other that they owed me £115!  Rang them and when I got through I was told that they were actually going to refund me £160 - but I have not received any such documentation!  Why they could not send me a single correct invoice I do not understand. Lady on phone when I got through was very pleasant though.

records.title: Contract Renewal
records.text: Contract renewal offer price totally unacceptable for customer with high usage.  Phoned and spoke with Les Banton who was very friendly, polite and helpful.  He was able to reduce the price to close to other suppliers offer and less than currently paying.  He was excellent and deserves 5 stars but the company doesn't as they should offer a decent price at renewal rather than making customers contact them to get a reasonable price..

records.title: Advisor Les Banton has to be the nicest…
records.text: Advisor Les Banton has to be the nicest guy in the world. Very polite and helpful. An asset to a mediocre company

records.title: Doubled up my delivery and direct debit
records.text: Doubled up my delivery within a 12 month period when it is usually 14 months between filling the tank. Then calculated usage on deliveries in a 12 month period so they could nearly double my direct debit. Put this to the team and ended up paying a smaller dd than currently which will work out to over £1200 a year less. Gratefull for their cooperation and reanalysis of the data.

records.title: Once I got through the firewall of…
records.text: Once I got through the firewall of endless options preventing me talking to a human - constantly pointing me to online solutions which were actually the problem, the customer service lady I eventually spoke to was 5star++She could not have been more helpful, and quickly, professionally, and politely resolved everything

records.title: New customer worried by this company's reputation
records.text: I joined Avanti from Flogas last Oct.  I have been updating my tank readings regularly and it is now down to 38% (so no panic) but I'm alarmed to see many reports of this company failing to deliver gas as per their contract terms and even letting several customers run out completely.  I will be watching closely, but will not hesitate to sue them for breach of contract if they take my money (my account is in credit by £210) but fail to deliver any gas.

records.title: Eventually sorted issue out after…
records.text: Eventually sorted issue out after twelve months, but did not admit it was their system fault or inform me.

records.title: Gas delivery timing
records.text: Well - all I’d like to see is more communication as to when my supply will arrive. I made an order 22 December and to the 11 January I’ve heard nothing as to when the gas arrives. I’ll be getting close to single % and hope it arrives soon- but what usually happens in north Scotland is it snows just in that single day if the arrival (that no one knows) and the driver says no. So please deliver the gas before the tank drops below 15% in the winter please - that’s called risk mitigation (for the customer)

records.title: High pressure vs Low pressure After reporting a HIGH pressure to my…
records.text: After reporting a HIGH pressure to my boiler as stated by my servicing plumber, Avantigas said the pressure was low and "Parts have been fitted" I stood and watched the entire time your gas engineer was with me. I never saw any parts fitted. Avantigas get your finger out.Harry Cleworth

records.title: Nothing went wrong
records.text: Nothing went wrong, but you're asking about a delivery 3 weeks ago and I never saw the delivery or the driver, therefore unable to comment or give a rating

records.title: Extortionate rate charged per litre
records.text: Although Avantigas delivered before we ran out I am shocked at the amount we have been charged. The last fill was June last year and we paid 52p per litre. This latest fill is 78 per litre. We have had no notification of any price increase either. Will certainly be looking at moving to another supplier

records.title: Very frustrated by your change to a new…
records.text: Very frustrated by your change to a new portal, which would not allow me to change my password to enter “my account”.Customer Advisor, Natalie Money, went all out to helpfully resolve the issue, first by email (unsuccessfully) & then by a very clear & courteous phone call. I am very grateful to her.

records.title: After trying to get a decent price for…
records.text: After trying to get a decent price for my gas supply, I was asked to buy my gas tank for 20 pounds. when l tried to change to another dealer, you would not send the gas-certified, to the new dealer, so l have had to buy from you , cash up front before you deliver to me,l have now done this twice,on both times,after paying,l get an a invoice for what l have already paid for?????

records.title: No app, terrible website awful to manage
records.text: The customer portal is just awful.1) No app, most users access via moble. The web version of the website is utterly terrible. Please deliver a blooming APP !!!2) Tedious flow to update your readingsplanning any delivery is like a roulette wheel3) Technical issues, cannot even log into website4) Managing direct debits is impossible unless you phone up. Customer care takes an age..... will be drawing my state pension before they answer the phone.

records.title: Underwhelmed
records.text: This will be my third winter with Avanti. On each of the two previous ones my tank was allowed to get almost to empty, well below the recommended level, despite my advising Avanti well in advance. The web site is clunky and needs to be improved.

records.title: Expediting a delivery
records.text: 1. The order page needs to show when a delivery is coming - even just in the next 5 days !2. It needs to be easier to contact someone.You make this difficult to do. Maybe a chat system at least (preferably with humans as well as robots)3. There should be some way of escalating a problem. Your FAQs assume that the system works. It doesn't always.4. There are frequent (data) errors on the site which cause the page to hang.5. The login should be simplified. I should not have to say what kind of user I am before I can log in, you ought to be able to establish this after I log in.6. The customer services person I eventually managed to speak to was very helpful !

records.title: Driver could not change bottles had to…
records.text: Driver could not change bottles had to put new ones on myself good job it was not little old lady would have run out of gas.Otherwise did get my delivery with in 2 days

records.title: Never tell us they're coming, just turn up
records.text: Despite stating that they must let us know in advance that they are coming and that the driver needs to report to reception on arrival, it never happens.  The LPG tanks are located on a busy Visitor Centre - on this occasion, the tanker driver let himself in and reversed round the building to the tanks - I'm surprised no-one has ever been run over.  Staff obviously ran out when they realised but we're always having to look for keys for gates, move furniture out of the way etc. when we're busy dealing with visitors - would be so much easier if we knew they were coming!

records.title: Thank you Courtney for your help with sorting out the delayed delivery today. My original review still stands as this is my experience again& again of Avantigas.
records.text: TODAY IS 11/12/24 & THE GAS DELIVERY HAS NOT TURNED UP FOR THE SECOND TIME!!! THE MANAGER COURTNEY SSID IT WOULD BE DELIVERED TODAY AND THE LORRY BROKE DOWN AGAIN!!!! WHAT KIND OF BUSINESS HAS LORRIES  THAT BREAKDOWN EVERY DELIVERY!!IVE HAD A TEXT NOW TO SAY DELIVERY WILL BE MADE TOMORROW 12/12/24. BUT NO ONE AT AVANTIGAS CAN GUARANTEE THIS ESPECIALLY WHEN THEIR LORRIES MUST BE SO POORLY MAINTAINED THEY KEEP BREAKING DOWN. This review is to be continued - let’s see if the lorry can deliver the gas tomorrow . On 3% so will have to turn off heating now until delivery is made. This is so stressful. COURTNEY & RHANNA - I HOPE YOUR HOMES ARE WARM THIS EVENING.  THANK YOU COURTNEY FOR YOUR HELP TODAY IN SORTING OUT THE DELAYED DELIVERY. My first review still stands as this is my experience of Avantigas. The company should be grateful to Courtney for dealing with this query. However - let’s see if the delivery of gas turns up. Thank you once again to Courtney for your help & patience. The portal is fine but does not help when your delivery does not arrive AGAIN & then when you need to speak to a person it takes way too long to get through & when you work full time it's virtually impossible to deal with any complaint that day. It really only works with the basic stuff like paying bills, updating gauge & that's about all I need it for. If I have a complaint I want to get through on the phone easily.10/12/24- In reply to Avantigas reply - I did not contact you in July - last time was Dec 2023 & I contacted you 5 times to ask about the delivery that did not turn up AGAIN  on the date you gave me. The calls lasted from 3 minutes to 39 minutes. The shorter ones being when I could not wait for reply as I work! So your info is incorrect or probably you auto reply as it looks similar to a lot of the complaints made to Avantigas. The 39 minute call I do remember still did not give me a date when it would be made after first did not turn up. Instead of replying to these complaints why don’t you contact me & let me know when you will deliver, I will run out of gas today probably. But I expect I’ll get your auto bot reply again. NOT GOOD SERVICE AVANTIGAS.

records.title: Moved in April and had 26% of LPG
records.text: Moved in April and had 26% of LPG, so placed an order. We're new to this type of supply, so didn't know how delivery etc worked and it wasn't explained at the time. No delivery by  June, so called them. I was given a date but it didn't arrive. A few weeks and calls later, the order arrived. However, a couple of weeks after delivery, we had an email for a demand of £200. When I contacted them, they explained it was because it was a priority order, as we shouldn't have ordered until we were at 10%. How is an order placed in April and delivery in July a priority.  I explained I was not told this at all during the many calls made to them. Apparently they checked the last conversation and the demand was cancelled. We are hoping to change our supplier when our contract ends but we've seen other reviews and it seems they make it extremely difficult to leave.

records.title: This is my second review
records.text: This is my second review. As part of my contract renewal I requested confirmation of safety of my tank following submitted photograph showing a crack(s) of covering. Also, possibility of telemetric consumption monitoring. Contract renewed promptly but still awaiting answers to my two (2) questions

records.title: Goodbye Avanti Gas
records.text: Joined Avanti Gas in September, 2022 due to price increase implemented by previous supplier. 2 year Contract coming up for Renewal/Review. The new price per litre they offered me was double what I’d been paying. One enquiry to a rival Supplier and I’m now paying exactly the same price I’d been paying for the past 2 years. It pays to shop around!!  To their credit Avanti Gas didn’t put any obstacles in my way as regards transferring the Tank over to the new supplier.

description: Extra Gas is one of the North West's leading LPG suppliers.  We offer domestic and commercial LPG installations, deliver Bulk LPG to rural homes and businesses as well as offering a range of LPG cylinders.

records.title: Brilliant Customer Service.
records.text: We have just had the best customer service ever off Val at Extra gas Eccles. We assumed that they supplied Flo gas and went down with our empty bottle. They didn`t do Flo gas, but Val was really helpful she immediately started looking for the nearest supplier and gave us the address. She was so friendly and gave us such good information that after we put the empty bottle back in the car we both said lets just use Extra Gas Instead. She had given us confidence in the company. As a business owners we look for that extra effort, care and attention. Thank you very much Val, Brilliant Service would recommend to all our Family, Friends and Customers

records.title: Ordered late but Sarah pulled out all…
records.text: Ordered late but Sarah pulled out all the stops to ensure we would get a delivery. Thank you

records.title: I would definately recommend if you are looking for a company that actually has great people a phone call away.
records.text: It's rare and a relief to encounter someone so professional, understanding and who actually goes out of their way to really listen and ensure exceptional service delivery. Today my query was dealt with in way that was all of that by Sarah Laidlaw, for which I am grateful.  Can not fault the service provided. Thank you Sarah.

records.title: Always there when needed providing great service
records.text: We moved in to our property just 9 days before Christmas in 2018 and our LPG tank was left at just 11% full. I called round a lot of suppliers and ExtraGas were the only ones who said they would get us a delivery in for Christmas. They did as promised and for the next 4 years supplied a flawless service. Easy to contact and really professional drivers. Great company!

records.title: No Gas, Tank Empty
records.text: I don't very often write a review but I needed to do one for Tracey Tyer who helped me out at Extra Gas in Trafford Park Manchester. Unfortunately I ran out of Gas on the evening of 1st April, on Tuesday 2nd April at 8am I rang extra gas at Trafford Park Manchester and spoke to Tracey who was extremely helpful with my difficult situation not having any heating or able to use my gas cooker, Tracey advised me to send her a copy of the metre which showed empty and she would do what she could to rectify my dilemma. Due to her excellent service Tracey managed to arrange a delivery for me on the 4th April, a couple of days later which saved me over £300 for an emergency delivery it would have Cost me. Please please pass on my thanks to Tracey for the excellent service she gave me, due the excellent service Tracey gave me I will have no hesitation  in recommending Extra Gas to family and friends. A Gold star🌟  for Tracey .

records.title: Brilliant customer service and speedy delivery
records.text: I’d just like to thank everyone involved at extragas when we hadn’t checked the level of our gas and when we did it was less than 5%…an emergency call made to extragas and explained clearly by staff  it could take10/ 14 days but they would do their best…lovely lady and very helpful. A lovely gentleman phoned and left a message to say our delivery was the next day,this was exactly a week after the call…this has happened once before and again they delivered within two days. On a personal note a lovely lady ( you know who you are !) was so caring and checked on me when I was going through my treatment for breast cancer ensuring I had enough gas as my treatment was through the winter months…I’ve been with extragas for many years and always had excellent 5* service…keep up the great work and we promise we will check often, it’s now on the calendar !! Debs and Chris Evans xx

records.title: Brilliant company
records.text: Where to start …… firstly if you are searching for who to commit the next two years of your life to and trust to deliver your gas in a timely manner, please first of all read my (and others) review of Avanti Gas before you commit to them.Thankfully after two years of stress and panic the control was back in my hands. Local fb page recommended Extra Gas and thank goodness they did, it was a company I hadn’t heard of before and didn’t come up on the search for companies that supply our area.A simple request brought back prices that were at least 10ppl cheaper than other companies and after a very easy process we were signed up.Of course the proof is in the pudding , first gas delivery request ….. goodness me it was delivered within a week. No anxious staring at the gas dial wondering whether we will make it, it was delivered - simple as that.Wait, it gets even better. Three months later we have had a tank clean which I can say hand on heart in the 30+ years of it being here, it has never been cleaned by a company. Also, the clean highlighted the need for a repaint and replacement of the lid, something we have been asking for over many years. Last week this was done so we now have a shiny clean tank with a lid that actually works.When leaving Avanti Gas I quoted their price was going to cost at least £200 a year extra and they had the cheek so say that it’s because you pay a premium for a reputable company. My advise is if you want to save money and also commit to a company that treats its customers as living, human being with courtesy then try Extra Gas.

records.title: Extra gas are a excellent company to…
records.text: Extra gas are an excellent company to use for our fuel supplies, they are fast, efficient and very polite Tracey in the office always goes the extra mile to help,

records.title: Same day free delivery of my gas bottle…
records.text: Same day free delivery of my gas bottle for my Bbq, very impressed and the cheapest supplier I found in my area too. Highly recommended

records.title: we recently ran out of gas
records.text: we recently ran out of gas, we have a contract, lead times are a little long hence us running short - however, Extragas sent someone out on Saturday morning and got us back up and running - this is customer service and the reason I have given 5 stars

records.title: Tried to give them a chance but they…
records.text: Tried to give them a chance but they don't seem to want the business as they made it difficult to place an order. Very poor service for a company that claims 30+ years of service.  Back to Cheshire Gas then!

records.title: Awful experience with these guys
records.text: Awful experience with these guys.  Been a customer for 9 years.  They've now decided they can not fill our gas tanks as they don't comply to regulations from 2004.  They should have said that 9 years ago.  Booked to refil tanks and they have refused.  We are now facing a winter without heating and hot water.  Terrible service from them.

records.title: Not happy with these guys as they keep…
records.text: Not happy with these guys as they keep changing the goal posts as to when we can fill our tank up. First it's at 40% then 15% and now 5% !!!! They aren't even in control of the deliveries but a third party suppler whom they can't call and have to contact via email. records.title: Grab your popcorn. Long authentic negative review coming up....
records.text: **Extremely Disappointing Experience with Gair Gas HomeShield Plan**I can't express my profound disappointment strongly enough after my recent encounter with Gair Gas and their HomeShield Boiler plan. This company's lack of professionalism and utter disregard for customer satisfaction has left me absolutely appalled.Despite my compliance with every request, Gair Gas denied me access to their HomeShield coverage. This decision came without conducting the property inspection, which, by the way, they originally insisted on as a prerequisite for the HomeShield plan. Additionally, as per their request I also provided a Gas Safety Check certificate that was both up to date and not older than three months.Upon receiving these documents, they inexplicably, and seemingly without any logical basis, denied me access to their HomeShield coverage, despite me having a brand new boiler installed only 1 week ago! Their excuse? They claimed they couldn't meet my "high expectations." But in reality, my expectations were quite reasonable – simply a reliable home protection plan with no demands on any discounts or waivers.When I sought clarification, their response was nothing short of infuriating. They hid behind vague policies, offering no real explanation for their refusal. It's abundantly clear that their customer service is subpar, and their communication is a train wreck.Let my experience serve as a caution to anyone considering Gair Gas for their services. If this is how they treat prospective customers, I can't even begin to imagine what their service would be like once they have your money.Do not waste your time or money on Gair Gas. Their customer service is abysmal. Take your business elsewhere if you value professionalism, transparency, and respect.

records.title: I think they're appalling
records.text: I think they're appalling.  To join one of their service plans we had to have full inspection of the system and the initial boiler service with them which we did and everything was in working order with no issues of whatsoever. The boiler, the hot water tank and all the valves are newish, the only comment from the engineer was the radiators are old although all are in good working order with no problems. Paid for the initial service separately, although it should be covered by the plan but they said not the first service, and waited two weeks to know whether they will cover the central heating system. Finally after two weeks they decided they can only cover the boiler as the radiators are old despite the fact they're all perfect condition and working order. This come after our current plan with the previous provider has expired which we did not renew as we thought we will be covered by GairGas which was recommended to us as a good local company and we had no issues in the past seven years coverages by different suppliers.  I don't know why we had to do the boiler service with them in first place as all what they needed to do just do a quick system inspection without paying for a service and they could have given us the answer whether they will or will not cover the system there and then without the two weeks delay, however, doing it this way they would not have got the £60.00 service fee which we'll have to do again with another provider to cover the system, so makes you wonder is this just a scam!

records.title: Delay in return of Deposit
records.text: Service was very prompt and professional. My tenants were impressed with the efficiency with which the work was carried out. My only negative comment is that the initial deposit which I paid prior to work being done was not offset from the final bill, therefore,  I'm still waiting for the deposit I paid which as per terms of contract I would receive back upon confirmation of instruction for work to be carried out.

records.title: Review
records.text: The service was professional and friendly, new boiler and heating working very well. Only disappointment is the way the fittings had to be left with bottom part of cupboard open and untidy.

records.title: A first rate service
records.text: Very helpful and good service. The plumber who installed my boiler was polite and hard working.They were very helpful in explaining how my new boiler worked. All in all it was a very good experience and one I'm happy to recommend.

records.title: A very nice chap arrived.
records.text: A very nice chap cleared our blocked loo....a little expensive but well carried out.

records.title: Good plumber
records.text: Plumber did an excellent job - explained everything clearly and was polite and professional. He also fixed a leaky tap for us which he wasn't expecting to do. 5 stars for him!4 rather than 5 * overall because communication wasn't great. I was told to expect the plumber between 9 and 5, and that I would get a call 30 mins beforehand. He arrived at 8, with no call beforehand. Also we had requested two jobs and only one seemed to be on his list. He kindly looked at the second one for us anyway.

records.title: Leaking kitchen sink
records.text: Friendly customer service team who responded the next working day. Alex the plumber was respectful and polite. The job was completed effectively however took longer than expected as he had to leave twice for parts he didn't have.

records.title: First time using Plumb London
records.text: First time using Plumb London. There were initially a few teething issues get the job booked in but they clearly tried to resolve them. It was a relatively simple job just awkward as it was a heavy wall hung toilet. The plumber, Charlie was a nice, normal chap. He came in and got the job done and offered to sweep up. I would give them another go if I need another job done.

records.title: Efficient service
records.text: The appointment was for  the morning, I had a call to say that the engineer was stuck on another job and he’d be there in the afternoon.  Slightly annoying . It’s not always possible to stay in for the whole day. However once the engineer arrived , he was speedy , efficient , polite and tidied up .

records.title: Very good service
records.text: Very good service, I got a quote through Check a trade and arranged for a visit. I needed a shower tray repositioned and various edges re-sealed with sealant.Paul the plumber was great, very professional and did a perfect job.I deducted 1 star only because I was originally offered a date for a visit that was not met twice, probably other jobs got priority.  Overall, I would recommend.

records.title: Great plumber who keep coming until fixed
records.text: Having been through 3 independent plumbers who either don’t turn up or come back I found plumb London. They do what they say - they turn up and they fix the problem. Good advice, prompt and good communication. Boiler now working perfectly after a year of intermittent cold water and lots of challenges. Thank you so much. Highly recommended

records.title: My first experience using Plumb London
records.text: My first experience using Plumb London. I booked a service for my gas boiler. Unfortunately, the engineer was delayed and couldn't come on the day that was booked. I didn't find out until late afternoon which was a bit frustrating to have waited in all day. However, he came the next morning and was very thorough. Plumb London are a bit more expensive than an independent engineer/plumber but I think it was worth it. I'm happy to use them again for future services and any other gas work that may need doing.

records.title: Everything went well with the booking
records.text: Everything went well with the booking. We are very happy with the boiler service and tap replacement work. The only issue was the plumber arrived after the booked time slot 8-14:00 which then impacted work appointments in the afternoon.

records.title: Very competent plumber
records.text: Very competent plumber who explained issues well as was good in both solving immediate issue and longer term maintenance. Would be 5 stars except for missed first appointment which delayed repair.

records.title: Great service, but had to reschedule
records.text: The plumber who replaced my radiator was friendly and worked quickly! I'm no expert, but I think he's done a great job, too!We had some trouble arranging a time for the works to be completed, and had to reschedule a couple of times due to Plumb London's availability. This didn't bother me, but temper your expectations if you have limited times when you can stay home to receive the plumber.

records.title: Overall good service with some timing issue that was resolved
records.text: Booked the boiler service for a 8am-1pm slot. The engineer, Lee, was exceptional, knowledgeable and friendly. In terms of the Plumb London, their line was open and they answered quickly. Unfortunately, on the day, the engineer missed the slot and arrived at 3:15pm. I did not get an update call from Plumb about the delays until 12:58pm; apparently the delay was caused by morning jobs overrunning. I would have appreciated an earlier update as I had specifically waited for that slot, and had to reschedule my other afternoon appointments as a result.

records.title: Boiler Service
records.text: Have used Plumb London for several years now and have always received a good and reliable service.They have always arrived when they promised and will answer questions and give advice on any plumbing matters.

records.title: Friendly, prompt and long-lasting resolution
records.text: The engineer from Plumb London arrived on time and swiftly resolved the leak in my property. As soon as he identified the problem, he gave me various solutions helping me select/identify the one most relevant to my needs.Furthermore, he took the time to help me understand how to prevent the problem occurring in the future.

records.title: Very untransparent about their costs
records.text: Very untransparent about their costs. Would not tell me how they'd charge beyond the first hour. Well they charge a full extra hour even if they spent 1h15 in total. Also wouldn't want to fix, at first, my differential valve for which I had bought the right repair kit/ parts (diaphragm & bolt) as apparently it's "company policy" to replace the whole big valve rather than just the faulty parts! Of course this would require them to come back and spend another 2 hours plus for me to also pay for an expensive part! In the end, they accepted to fix the valve and use my parts but made me sign a paper stating that the work wasn't guaranteed! Incredible, I felt like a hostage and had no choice! The leak is fixed though, I just hope that the job was correctly done as it's not under warranty.

records.title: I felt
records.text: This is from August’23. I had a blocked bathroom sink. The man arrived on time but then proceeded to go through all I’d gone through myself. I kind of felt he was running the clock down to be honest. Finally he decided to use an augur.(?).(Sanisnake) This did the job although some residual “gurgling” continued. My main bugbear was that I was charged for “machinery”. Really? If I hire a carpenter should he charge me for hire of his hammer? The machinery in question was something a commercial plumbing company should have as part of their kit. Sharp practice to my mind. Not good. Beware hidden costs or avoid. Your choice!

records.title: I described the problem ( to replace…
records.text: I described the problem ( to replace old outdoor tap, and to replace old kitchen sink outside waste pipes) On arrival the engineer did not have any replacement parts as mentioned in my report. He therefore had to go and get parts from a supplier. This caused the work time to extend into a second hour and cost more money. The job was completed in a satisfactory manner.

records.title: Good plumber, very pricey company
records.text: Our plumber was friendly, knowledgeable and did a good job. The challenge for us was the expense - this company charge for full hours only, and for use of equipment, so if the plumber suggests trying something else, check with them what the additional cost will be. The company also doesn't mention that their quoted cost doesn't include VAT, so beware!

records.title: A disappointing experience
records.text: A disappointing experience. The booking process and quoted price were very good. The engineer arrived on time to repair a leaking towel rail and was very polite. However. The rail is part of a communal hot water system, a fact that was discussed at length during booking and confirmed as being not being an issue provided the system could be shut down (an arrangement I made accordingly). On arrival however, the engineer explained that he was unaware this was a communal system and wouldn’t be able to work on it. To his credit, no charge was made and I have no issue with the engineer himself who is a credit to his employer. However this all could’ve been avoided if more care had been taken at point of booking.

records.title: Communication could be better.
records.text: I was informed when booking that I would receive a text message when the engineer was 30 mins away. This was never sent/received. In my case this costed ~30mins additional labour as parts of my kitchen needed to be removed to gain access to the problem which I would have done before the engineer arrived... I have a family / school run / keeping the water on as long as possible for breakfast / bathroom breaks was needed as long as possible. Otherwise the engineer was great, sorted out the issue including dealing with a few unexpected problems  So happy with the result.I'm on the fence if I would reuse...

records.title: The installation of a new boilerhe installation of the boiler ws…
records.text: The installation of the boiler was excellent. But there was an additional cost for one of the radiator to be cleaned. The admin side could of been a bit more clearer. The quote for the boiler was different on paper then it was by email. I trust that the quote by email is the price my mum paid. However I was told that the instructions for the thermostat was with all the paperwork that was given. But when I looked I had to download the info which I wasn't able to do.

records.title: I was informed i would receive a…
records.text: I was informed i would receive a message 30 mins before arrival of engineer, but i did not receive this. The engineer was polite and efficient. He fixed 2 out of 3 problems. I was informed i will receive a quote for the other issue shortly. The engineer was on site for 1 1/4 hrs, but I was charged for 2 hours. Not too happy about this.

records.title: Good but pricey
records.text: The service was impeccable but because of a gas leak the engineer who was booked in for a boiler service stayed for 7 hours and it cost me a fortune. I think there needs to be set ‘daily’ rates for this kind of intervention

records.title: Paid for an hour
records.text: Paid for an hour, plumber was here 20 minutes. Job was rushed, plumber was impatient and I’m left with the same problem.

records.title: The work was done but I’ve been overcharged
records.text: I was offered a £10 refund on the service to write a review. The initial consult lasted around 30mins and the issue was found. The cost of that was £108 which I was told would be included in the final fee if I went ahead with Plumb London.The quote arrived - two hours work for a change of T-joint and new tap! The tap was £100 and the T-Joint was a ridiculous price too - you can buy a multipack of T-joints in screwfix for £10! And the new tap like for like is also in screwfix for £20. I phoned to question the quote and they reduced it to one hour plus £40 tap and £16 T-joint which is still a ridiculous price but it just needed fixing so I accepted.I’ve just noticed they charged me for the work and the additional £108 so have requested a refund as I was told this would be included.The customer service was easy to get through to and the engineers were happy but they take your credit card details before they even turn up, so you don’t get a chance to decline payment request if they’re over charging.Looking forward to my £108 refund and my £10 refund for this review.

records.title: Happy with the work but not the billing
records.text: The guy was very helpful and the work completed was great but it took just over an hour and I was charged for 2 (any part of an hour is charged as a full hour). That mean the bill was nearly double what I expected. Shame as I think you could charge first hour and then 15 or 30 min intervals

records.title: Good timing to complete the job
records.text: Good timing to complete the job, but a little bit expensive. I also had an issue with noise from the boiler which I flagged but wasn’t fixed.

records.title: Frustrated
records.text: We were just frustrated about the wrong size sink was ordered and messed about the fitting of the next sink

records.title: Waste of time & money
records.text: Showed up once. Charged £140 per hour + VAT for the time & never came back. Waste of time & money.

records.title: Slow level of service
records.text: The repair was completed today and I now have hot water again. I first booked a callout on 6th July and the company canceled and re-booked on 2 occasions so 18th July completion is much later than I first anticipated. I wonder if I could have got a speedier service from a different company? I would use this company again if I couldn't get anyone else to do the job in a smaller timescale. No other issues, but I think on the hottest day of the year on record the company should give its workers extra money to buy cold drinks and a fan for their van, you get a big fat zero for staff welfare Plumb London, shame on you.

records.title: Mixed experience
records.text: Andy was great - very knowledgeable and showed / explained everything he was doing. The prices were high and I felt pressured by the company to decide there and then to avoid being charged a call out fee. I then had to chase for this to be refunded. Beware of hidden costs also.

records.title: missed appointment but good on second visit
records.text: My first appointment was for 4pm on a Thursday and no one showed up. I called them back and booked them in again at a discounted rate which they honoured. The plumber who came was very good, clear, efficient. I booked them in again for a full replacement which was completed well and on time. My only concerns were the missed 1st appointment and the fact that the removed tank was left by my communal bins - not sure whether this will be picked up or if this will cause problems.

records.title: I was told to expect the engineer…
records.text: I was told to expect the engineer between 11.00 and 3.00. He came at 4.15. Boiler in good condition, so it only took him 15 minutes to check it. Checked the gas supply as well - something that my previous chap had never done.

records.title: On time, but minimal attempt to rectify issue
records.text: They responded to a general work request on checkatrade for a faulty electrical underfloor heating. The display module said 'Lo' which the manual implied was a faulty sensor. I offered to photograph the unit in advance of site visit, but they declined saying they worked with all underfloor heating types. When site visit, which I prepaid £50+ VAT for 1/2 hour, the engineer looked at it for 3 mins and said the panel had a faulty connection and we just needed to buy a new one and left!  My husband and I disconnected the display panel fiddled about with it for about 20 mins and now it's working. What if we hadn't been the kind of people that want to try to fix things ourselves- we would have needlessly paid another £50-60 for new panel, when the engineer made no attempt to rectify the faulty connection himself. I know it was 7pm and home time, but he probably could have at least looked at it and fixed it in 15 mins, given that I had paid for 30mins work.

records.title: Expensive Timewasters
records.text: I called them up to do a simple remastic of a shower tray. It took 4 days for a tradesman to come over, remove some tiles, and then  "assess" that mastic needed to put in (like i asked for originally). A few days later i received a quote for £500 to get the  mastic put in. So i've lost a week, the bathroom is in worse state than before and i'm no closer for the job being completed.Edit: mastic was replaced by someone else, 5 minute job.  Plumb London’s quote for four hours 🤷‍♂️

records.title: Pushy business with the lack of  accountability
records.text: Had double visit, boiler servicing and investigation to identify water pressure issues.Boiler seemed fine and as per investigation the engineer concluded issue is at Thames Water side (low water pressure at mains).Having raised this with Thames Water they’ve made measurements at mains and the water pressure was 2bars which according to the engineer wasn’t even possible.Also today the boiler following his service started throwing heat pump / pressure sensor error.Despite contacting the business twice, there hasn’t been a single response. Won’t use them again.

records.title: Overpriced and salesy
records.text: Boiler was making a strange noise. Plumber laughed as he told us it was decimated - not a sympathetic reaction. Otherwise, his advice was sound and the callout fee was reasonable (60 pound). However, it got a bit salesy after that. The company quoted 1300 more than the two closest alternatives. There were lots of additional charges on their invoice that were included in the price by the other companies. A sales person told me his engineers were paid 900/day and he'd already done me a 'deal' charging 1000 for installation. 14% APR (the other two were 0%), this he said was because the company is family-owned.

records.title: I had a very disappointing experience…
records.text: I had a very disappointing experience with this company. They displayed a lack of professionalism and reliability. Shortly before their scheduled visit, they canceled, claiming there were no staff available. However, it seemed they simply didn’t want to take on the job. I’m left wondering why they waited until the last minute to inform me, causing significant disruption to my plans.

records.title: High callout charge to come to diagnose…
records.text: High callout charge to come to diagnose issues that they couldn't resolve. Offered to come back with parts, but quoted another callout charge and a high number of hours to do the job - so overpriced. Another local plumber attended with no callout charge and resolved the issues within an hour - much cheaper!---Plumb London have since contacted me to offer a full refund, which they have provided, on the basis of me editing this review.

records.title: Poor admin but good workmanship
records.text: Repeatedly provided reassurance that they could complete the job in time but repeatedly failed to meet the new delayed timeframes. Very disappointing. Still awaiting a response to my complaint so can’t say how they respond to that. The plumber was very friendly though when they came, and completed the work quickly and professionally.

records.title: Toilet Cistern and pan
records.text: Toilet Cistern and pan, removed and fitted new one, After the engineer  left we notice that the toilet seat wound’t stay up, Paid 50% if the bill before the completion and they just took the rest of the money without letting us know. bad experience.

records.title: Be mindful of callout fee vs local plumber who can do assessment for free
records.text: Great communication from sales team although they weren’t able to follow through with what they said they’d hopefully be able to do. They say they’re mostly able to do the job there and then, as plumber should have any additional parts that may be needed. They did explain if didn’t have parts this would be an additional cost etc. Plumber was amazing but unfortunately he didn’t have the parts - a set of taps, which I thought would be basic - the additional quote for him to order the taps and come back another day was very expensive, especially as I had paid the call out fee for him to assess. Did find another plumber locally who did the job much more reasonably priced. No promises were made from Plumb London so can’t complain but they did make it seem like they would be able to have done it within that one booking. I also think a set of taps would be fundamental part of equipment that the plumber should have, especially as they said they’d find the plumber for me based on my telephone assessment regarding my problem. Felt like sales team oversold what the plumber could actually realistically to. I only neededtaps changed but he didn’t have parts. I will say again the plumber himself was very lovely and knowledgable.

records.title: Non resolution
records.text: My initial contact with Plum London was very positive; engineer was very pleasant and carried out the task satisfactorily, or so I thought! When an issue occurred after the work was completed, he did return, tried to rectify the situation, but was unable to. I was told that I had to pay AGAIN to resolve a situation that was not there before he took on the job. I am therefore unhappy with this non resolution and would not use them again.

records.title: Poor communication and value for money
records.text: Can’t fault plumber himself, Charlie was a lovely guy and got the job done but communication of company was very poor.Simple job to fix cistern on toilet but a part had to be ordered which meant having to pay for for two separate call out charges- £90ph + VAT each. Second call out to install the part only took the plumber ten minutes. Both call outs were hours late and not within advised ETA of 8am-2pm. For the second call out I had to ring the company continuously all day for updates of when the plumber would actually arrive which ended up being 7pm. Company didn’t once update me themselves so I was waiting around at home all day for no reason. Overall, such a simple job took six days to complete and due to being two call outs, ended up being very poor value for money and poor service.

At Maxen Power, our core mission is centered around prioritising our valued customers. We understand that the energy landscape can be complex, and that's why we offer tailored, flexible, and cost-effective gas and electricity solutions that are precisely crafted to meet your specific requirements.


What sets us apart is our dedicated team of industry experts who are readily available to address your inquiries and provide guidance. We take great pride in consistently exceeding expectations, going the extra mile to ensure that your business has the power it needs to thrive.


When it comes to connecting your business to a reliable and cost-effective energy supply, Maxen Power is your steadfast partner, always here to support your success. With us, you can trust in a partnership built on professionalism, flexibility, affordability, and a commitment to putting your business's energy needs first. Experience the difference with Maxen Power – your preferred choice in commercial energy solutions.

Thanks for visiting our page.

records.title: Billing and inbox

records.title: High price
records.text: Hi i was nearly four years customer to maxen power your service very good only problem the price rate. Only reason i am not satisfied other company dropped the price but maxen power never dropped the price. They still charge high price thanks anyway and good bye

records.title: Worthless Contract
records.text: Due to unfair treatment I do not rate this company at all . What was the point of having a contract on price for a set period when this company just rise your tariff  as and when they see fit. Having said that I found my latest agent really helpful  she has been empathetic a nice woman. Shame she could not help with the huge price rises throughout the contract period.

records.title: I never get a bill sent to my email I…
records.text: I never get a bill sent to my email I always have to ask for it and when I do get the bill it’s never correct. I’m lucky that I take pictures of my meters on daily basis so I can prove my readings are not correct. I have been able to get this sorted out once I get through to my account manager but just wish they would get it right in the beginning.

records.title: Well to begin with a hard selling phone…
records.text: Well to begin with a hard selling phone company bombarded me for a year . records.title: Not our chosen energy supplier
records.text: We ended up with Maxen Power after a fraudulent broker imitated our previous supplier and ended up moving us over. Despite our attempts to move back to our previous supplier via the energy ombudsman we didn't win our appeal as not all the recordings were provided to them and the one that was has me agreeing to a new tariff. It has been a very stressful journey with our bills being much higher than our previous and also having to provide meter readings every month which they don't even look at. Our account manager Waseem has tried to be reasonable with us despite out frustrations so I commend his professionalism. However overall I would not recommend this company.

records.title: This review is not a reflection on Mehr which I have already said and he worked hard to get our issues resolved.

Or none.The only reason I give two stars is due to the lady who i deal with working for this company, does actually help with the problems that keep happening with the account.The very nice lady- Sally.If you have a problem with anyone being rude, or think someone is a liar (blatantly there are many working for this firm) call up the company, ask to speak to Sally, and go through your bill with her.She will agree that the extra 15%charge for late payment charges should not be on there and deduct it from your accountIf you have a 15% charge for not paying direct debit, she will sort you out.Anyone else that works for maxeen power will most likely lie to you.This company uses a very unclear way of getting your business, some guy will call you up, sell you a lie, then your signed up to them, then your bills go north- 3 times!The only thing they have kept the word to, is my standing charge per day.The "fixed rate" is fixed so it will not go down. Its gone up x3 the amount we signed on.The only reason I am staying with them, is due to the lady who deals with my account - Sally, she did get my rate down, and I am looking for a better deal elsewhere.Maxeen power as a company- a complete joke.My account person- she is ace, I hope she wins the lottery and never has to walk back into that office again.Thankyou Sally in accounts, this is the best honest review I can give.

description: We were founded in 1999 to tackle climate change by building a greener, cleaner future. We power homes and businesses with 100% renewable electricity from a community of over 1,600 UK generators.

records.title: Exceptional customer service
records.text: As part of my never-ending electricity supply issues with meters, meter readings, billing, there is one bright light in my dealings with Good Energy; they answer the phone, respond promptly to emails, take the trouble to listen to the problems, and try to resolve them. Most recently, Matt (Home Team C) was unfailingly polite, personable, and really engaged with the latest debacle (Smart meter gone dumb, again, after power outages), booking in the meter company to get things resolved as soon as possible. All after the 5pm end of business cut-off. I am not holding my breathe, but at least Matt's cheerful approach and practical response boosted my mood. To be honest, I stay with Good Energy despite the very high prices because the quality of service trumps any other provider I have used. As a small company they seem to understand how important this is when things go wrong.

records.title: Lou was very helpful and proactive in…sorting out billing
records.text: Lou was very helpful and proactive in dealing with my readings but also on my next question : what to do about my refund. Lou understood and arranged it all in a vert quickly. Customer service should think WITH the customer and not AGAINST the customer. Bravo Lou!

records.title: Great Customer Service
records.text: Updating information and changing bank information on my FIT was made easy with the very prompt responses from their customer service person Gifty.Gifty always replied in a timely manner and explained simply what was required which quickly resoled the issues.

records.title: Complex Billing Issue
records.text: I had a bit of a complex billing issue which Alyssia resolved. The first advisor failed to understand the issue, but once I was transferred to Alyssia they took time to understand the issue and was very helpful. I imagine they had to work with a few stakeholders and was always able to provide an update on what she was waiting for and the what stage the resolution was at. Thanks Alyssia for the excellent customer service!!

records.title: Rachel H from Customer Service is Fab
records.text: Upon moving to a new house the previous owner left me with the account details but this ended up getting strings-crossed as that account was actually closed which led to my account stalling in it's setup. After a quick phonecall with 0 waiting time I got through to Rachel H on Home Team A and she proceeded to very clearly explain the whole process to me, delete the old account, setup a new account and explain how bills will work. Rachel was incredibly patient and kind while being quick and efficient we even had a laugh together over some things. She was also very understanding about which sensitive information I didn't want to disclose over the phone best customer service I've received in a while!
