records.title: Always a quick response to an email…
records.text: Always a quick response to an email with intelligent and considered replies. Agreed and processed account refund on first asking.Thank you Alyssa from Good Energy

records.title: First class communication with Good Energy
records.text: I love that I can email Good Energy anytime and get a very quick positive response. My recent request was to have my email address changed for my login and for future emails. I received the usual high standard response from Good Energy. This time it was from Tara. Thanks Tara.

records.title: Email support with billing
records.text: I contacted Good Energy about some billing issues after having a smart meter installed. Received a very prompt response from Roisin who managed to sort out the issues within a day. Thanks Roisin!

records.title: reducing our direct debit
records.text: Spoke to McLean about reducing our direct debit as we had built up a substantial surplus.  This was arranged the next day.

records.title: Unexpected and delightful surprise from Roisin!
records.text: I ended 2024 with an unexpected and delightful surprise from Roisin that I’m truly grateful for. Without any prompting from me, Roisin provided a detailed breakdown of my energy consumption along with some fascinating insights that clarified doubts I had about my electricity bills.Additionally, she shared suggestions I wasn’t aware of, offering me positive options I can now consider.I want to sincerely thank Roisin for her thoughtful work and dedication to supporting GoodEnergy users!

records.title: Thank you very much Nessa for sorting…
records.text: Thank you very much Nessa for sorting out my over-payment and re-payment.

records.title: Smart meter not sending readings- hopefully resolved…
records.text: I realised that my smart meter wasn’t sending readings which was causing me concern but McLean looked into this and has hopefully sorted it out. I am really pleased that it’s been dealt with quickly and efficiently. Many thanks.

records.title: Donna M did a great job helping us to…
records.text: Donna M did a great job helping us to sort out a problem. She was patient and courteous. We were not happy though to find out that although we changed our email address on the account, we were sent emails to our old email address which led to the present confusion. This Donna talked us through but we are disappointed in the company email changing process which was unclear.

records.title: Faulty Gas Meter
records.text: Apart from the delay in replacing my faulty gas meter, which was due to SMS meter contractor, the whole interaction with Good Energy was very good. Matt from Home Team C was excellent.

records.title: Nessa is always helpful and friendly
records.text: Nessa is always helpful and friendly, so I don't feel that I need to struggle with technical details I can't deal with.

records.title: Consistently within GE I get prompt and…
records.text: Consistently within GE I get prompt and helpful replies and the ability to make contact with an advisor. This process is rare these days with any corporate organisation. I have said this before in my replies to you.  Manashi was prompt and helpful.

records.title: Roisin very helpful, but they harassed us into getting a smart meter
records.text: Roisin from the information team responded quickly and helpfully to a query about how to take advantage of cheaper energy when available (not easy, it turns  out, unless you use your appliances only between 1-4 pm, or have an electric car or heat pump). I don't give them five stars because we were harassed and bullied into getting a smart meter which we neither wanted nor needed, when our analogue meters worked perfectly well.

records.title: Helpful and informative response
records.text: I received a fast, helpful and informative email the same day from Natasha which gave good advice. She is following up the problem with my smart meter.  The service from Natasha should have 5 stars. I've only given 4 stars as the website could make direct contact more straightforward.  The automated phone service should indicate your position in the queue.

records.title: Thanks to Ragil on the phone for…
records.text: Thanks to Ragil on the phone for getting to the bottom of my unrealistic EAC which turns out to be based on an erroneous meter reading by the contracted meter readers. To be fair, GE had already amended the reading at my instigation earlier in the year. Sorting this means my DD will not take an £11 hike! Always worth talking to someone rather than emailing!

records.title: Good service
records.text: Very helpful indeed!

records.title: Quick response by email
records.text: Quick response when asked why so much credit on account and a refund was proposed. Manashi was very helpful and explained clearly and efficiently refund process.Dropped a star as company policy should ensure my account should be managed so I don’t build up as much credit.

records.title: Very prompt response to email request…
records.text: Very prompt response to email request to correct spelling of customer name.  Also fairly quick change from paper communication to email, slightly delayed by being told that this was already in place, which it was not.  Good Energy communicate a lot, generating a lot of paper, hence my provision of an email address and request to change.  Manashi was very keen to help if not in posession of all the facts.

records.title: Good Energy are a small company and…
records.text: Good Energy are a small company and manage to make it quite easy for you to speak to a real human being when you have a problem. Of course, some staff are better than others but most are very good and committed to providing a quality service (Donna M, a recent example).  There can be downsides in dealing with real people but, even with the odd delay or misunderstanding, it's miles better than beating your brains out trying to get a bot to understand what your problem is. I have to declare an interest - I'm a shareholder - but I don't think that prejudices me - they're still my provider of choice. Overall, the quality of standard customer communication is very good.

records.title: Always patient and helpful  a quick…
records.text: Always patient and helpful  a quick response  to any contact I have with them . It was a big mistake going to a different supplier will be more than happy once they have reclaimed my services and I’m back with them

records.title: There was actually quite a mix up with…
records.text: There was actually quite a mix up with installing a replacement meter when mine was required to be replaced as too old and an incorrect reading given by the installer...a human error typo...and then getting access to my online account to resolve...I want to particularly express my thanks to Linda @ Good Energy for her support,she kept preserving until the problem was resolved.

records.title: Good Energy -Smart Prepayment  tariffs
records.text: I have now switched to a tariff with Good Energy that I am told will save me £100-120 a year. Thanks to James of Team B for arranging this. I couldn't find any clear account of what was involved and what I should do so James had to answer a lot of e-mail questions. My account was in credit so this was transferred to my smart metre. I don't think I have received the link to enable me to top up in the future but hopefully that will be several months away.

records.title: I had a question about moving house…
records.text: I had a question about moving house whilst leaving solar panels behind and this was answered satisfactorily by Good Energy Jemma S.She sent me the forms I needed to get my buyer to complete which was very helpful.

records.title: A bright idea
records.text: Laura H. looked into the situation and made a useful and constructive suggestion. She had found out that I had already called previously to reduce my monthly payments which had been set a level I still felt was quite high. So she suggested a variable direct debit as an alternative way to go. Since we have had solar panels our payments have gone down a lot and now we also receive payments for what we feed-in to the grid. So I'm confident this will work well.

records.title: Quick response to query
records.text: I e mailed customer services to enquire about delays in payment of credits from the Solar Savings Tariff. I received a very full reply the next day from Hailey explaining the reasons for the delay and outlining a way forward for us. We are very happy with this action and looking forward to receiving the credits.Received further reply from Gina 5mins later letting us know the credits have now been applied to our account, which we can see on the bill which came through at the same time. Happy to get such a quick response to this!

records.title: Successful, but took a long time to be able to book a smartmeter install…
records.text: Priya booked me a smartmeter install slot and emailed me. Eddie did some good patient work to resolve an issue with SMS to allow me to have this booking. I had been responding positively to numerous increasingly vociferous (but still incoming) emails imploring me to get my superannuated meter replaced for some time, and it took a good long while to resolve, but we're there now. My communications with customer relations were always promptly, politely and clearly responded to, and I will now be able to apply for a new tariff.

records.title: Unfortunately our meter stopped reading…
records.text: Unfortunately our meter stopped reading and I contacted you for help. I was told to go back to the supplier who after 11 years no longer exist.  I have therefore gone to another company that do not use the meter and have said they will sort this out. The only good thin g was the very prompt reply when I requested our Mpas no. and it was sent almost immediately.

records.title: Portal never works for my Fit reads
records.text: Submitted Fit read online and Rachael sorted it promptly. Can't give 5 stars as have never been able to submit via the portal and no one at GE can sort it out.  I gave up after 6 months of trying and sending info/screenshots etc to various people, just ended up going round in circles as GE seem to think I'm doing something wrong so can't sort it at their end. I'm an electrician of 45 years experience, trained solar installer and have no problem submitting elec or gas readings thru the portal!

records.title: It too aaaaaages to get the info I…
records.text: It too aaaaaages to get the info I asked for; but in the end, it came through..All I wanted was a super simple breakdown of the cost of electricity and gas / month. It's taken 20+ emails and requests and waiting and asking again.But in the end it came through good.I don't understand why this simple figure isn't the only figure on my monthly bill.

records.title: Problem with monthly direct debits
records.text: I submitted an incorrect meter reading in Feb (much too high) which GE spotted and queried. I spoke to someone on the phone, submitted a correct reading and believed the matter was sorted. I then received notification that my monthly direct debit was increasing by over 150% just as energy prices were coming down. I queried this, and got a very quick and helpful response from Natasha, which made it clear that GE had used my incorrect reading (which they knew was incorrect!) to calculate my monthly direct debit for the coming year. Natasha was able to cancel this thankfully, but I'm disappointed that GE made this error.

records.title: Good Energy wanted to increase our DD…
records.text: Good Energy wanted to increase our DD even though our account was in credit. The system they use does not seem to allow a proper look at individual accounts. We have solar panels which means that during better weather we accrue funds which, interestingly, GE do not offer to reimburse to us. Fortunately Rachel sorted this out for us.

records.title: Account monitoring
records.text: To commence on the plus side, the helpful and prompt response was very good. Rachael also made a sound suggestion as to how the matter may be resolved to which I readily agreed.But, the 'problem' just pointed to the lack of care in the management of the account. For months the balance had been in credit had reached near One Thousand, Three Hundred pounds before my request for corrective action.

records.title: Excellent green credentials but admin a bit flaky
records.text: Good Energy's business ethos and green credentials are excellent, and I would not wish to use any other supplier.  However, I have found that their office procedures can be unreliable, and mistakes can occur, although the support team are always very helpful and efficient in sorting things out.  It would be better if the mistakes didn't occur in the first place, though!

records.title: Direct debit reduced too much for increased prices
records.text: I had noticed that my direct debit had been reduced very significantly due to build up in credit. Normally that would probably be ok but given the way prices have increased I felt this wasn't an appropriate action by Good Energy. I contacted the company, the advisor, Sultan, was helpful and quickly put things right.

records.title: Despite the claim that balances are…
records.text: Despite the claim that balances are checked each month and direct debits adjusted to suit, it was the third time I had to call for attention to a credit balance of 1k plus. From a monthly payment of 490.00, I was still paying 301.00 and the balance permitted to accrue to 1k plus. On each call however, prompt action ensued to address the matter. On the third occasion, Lisa very kindly resolved the problem by implementing an option of which I had hitherto no inkling. Hopefully, it would also avoid the superfluous credit balance. Thank you Lisa - you are a five-star Star.

records.title: Payments...
records.text: Called today by Maame in response to an email I sent yesterday.  Friendly and competent at sorting out the issue with my direct debit.  As promised a confirmatory email arrived a couple of hours later. Deserves a better review than the back office!Unfortunately the issue shouldn't have arisen in the first place.   I had been paying a reduced amount to clear the large credit that had accrued last winter, and the computer system wanted to increase it again too soon.  Then when I followed the link to update the latest bill with a new meter reading all I got was an error message.  Maybe someone in IT should test their systems more thoroughly........

records.title: Great customer service; poor systems
records.text: Great help from Lisa today in deleting the estimated bill that Good Energy had sent me.  I have found their other customer service people prompt, knowledgeable and friendly too.What lets Good Energy down is their billing sytem.  I elected to pay by monthly direct debit, after sending a reading on the last day of each month.  In practice they often send me an estimated bill a few days before the end of the month - and it's always ridiculously high and bears no relation to the useage in previous years.  Their system thinks a month is 28 days.

records.title: Some problems solved
records.text: We have been using Goodenergy for several years and realised that our credit on our account was very high. Rachael helped us by changing us to a variable charging scheme, and we have hopes for a more reasonable charging regime. We have yet to resolve the problem we have faced for two months in not being able to enter our meter readings on the website, but fingers crossed.

records.title: A very long drawn-out process to have…
records.text: A very long drawn-out process to have the account changed into my name following the death of my wife. There always seemed to be an extra request for information from different staff or teams in response to my emails.Finally Alyssia got the ship on an even keel - the account is now live - and she also very helpfully threw some light on why the process had been so lengthy and gave useful advice on how to contact the right people to have the solar system checked.A welcome professional approach to customer relations. Thank you.Daniel Singleton

records.title: Trouble with smart meters installers (SMS)
records.text: Towards the end of last year I finally agreed to your request to install smart meters. The electric meter had a compatibility issue and didn't from the beginning and also stopped our solar panels working. I now have a date in March for this to be corrected. I think Good Energy should be more demanding of SMS to sort such issues out much quicker. Our solar panels not working caused us worry and stress. However Olivia was very genuine and did her best to make things right. Note: the Date of Experience is only approximate

records.title: Olivia!
records.text: To be honest the only reason it got a three star rating was because Olivia seems to be the only person capable of doing anything! Without her it would have been zero!   My frustration levels were through the roof before I was lucky enough to have my call answered by her.  Olivia, you have a five star rating the company has a three, thank you for saving my sanity and for being so responsive and efficient.  I hope your company pays you well and appreciates you because you are an asset to them!

records.title: Good, let down by bad billing dept
records.text: I was attracted by Good’s commitment to green energy but they are badly let down by their billing department. Slow to install smart meters. Didn’t notice mine had stopped transmitting and just sent my estimates for months without notifying me (meters were communicating fine with the display unit). Most recently I moved out, told them and paid my final usage. Six weeks later I’m still receiving new bills for dates after I moved out, with the team unable to close my account due to an “error message”Reply below rather makes my point - closing an account that has paid its bills should be simple. But the response is not “we’ve fixed it” it’s “we’ll continue to look at this”

records.title: Generation to high.
records.text: Every time I  try to send a meter read I get a message generation to high than what we expected, then does not allow me to send,if we've generated that amount then we've generated it,I should not have to keep sending photographs .thank you Lisa.

records.title: Ragil
records.text: Ragil, I would give 5 stars, friendly, professional and got the job done.  Sadly 3 star overall given because I had tried to set this up and given my bank details which never happened on the live chat and I am stuck with my existing provider awaiting another hefty bill.

records.title: Still waiting for a response.....
records.text: Emailed with 4 queries about accounts. Only one has been dealt with, via a very nice email which included a link to leave a Trustpilot review. However, after a week, I am still waiting for a response on the 3 other points hence quite a generous 3stars.

records.title: Teams cannot talk to each other
records.text: Contacted to ask why we haven't had a bill for sometime, reply was that i was trying to contact the wrong team and rather than pass my email on to the correct team, I had to start again.

records.title: We have solar panels and our account…
records.text: We have solar panels and our account was put on hold early2024. We were told we needed to have the meters read , it’s now October and the meters have been read FOUR times now still no further. I have written to the CEO Nigel Pocklington he forward to his secretary she then forwarded to the FIT department. We haven’t had any trouble since we have been with them but the mark of a company is the action when it does . Very disappointing.

records.title: I fear the worst for Good Energy
records.text: I fear the worst for Good Energy. I have emailed them three times without response asking for information on solar installation. I am now going elsewhere.My previous experience was over FIT verification which ended when I made a formal complaint about their inability to cope with a procedure they put in place. (Meanwhile endless emails promoting heat pumps).

records.title: Exceptionally slow response times
records.text: Good Energy failed to install a working meter at our business premises over the course of 2+ years and their correspondence was extremely sporadic, with one particular response taking three months (no explanation given as to why). They issued payment reminders for wildly overestimated electricity usage and they refused to cover the cost of meter inspections. Once we finally paid for an electrician to assess our system and determine that Good Energy's meter was not even linked to our premises, they proceeded to charge us standing charges up until we asked them to close our account - the final bill arriving six months after that request was acknowledged.

records.title: Highly disappointed with both the…
records.text: Highly disappointed with both the service and the company itself (not such a goods ethics just profit thirsty). They've quadruple not just the unite price but also the standing price. Nothing to do with the increase of energy. They're opportunists taking advantage of the government scheme. And their energy is not even green. It comes from the national grid as with any other provider. Customer support are very defensive and not there to help but protect their interests. Try other providers are all the same.

records.title: Good Energy were fine throughout my…
records.text: Good Energy were fine throughout my contract but when I closed it, there was over £700 in my account. At first they failed to agree a closing meter reading with the new supplier and didn't bother to tell me for 25 days. Now that they have agreed, it will still be another 10 working days before they pay me.(next day) I have now had a final statement and a half hearted apology which means nothing since they will still hold on to MY money for another fortnight

records.title: Very slow to pay missing FiT payment
records.text: For some reason a payment to me for the feed-in tariff (FiT) was missed. After I spotted this (why didn't Good Energy spot it?), it took several communications before they agreed the payment had been missed and then several more communications over numerous weeks before the missing payment was made.  However, it eventually was paid, together with a goodwill payment.  The support person (Maame) was very helpful throughout.

records.title: I've been with Good Energy for FIT…
records.text: I've been with Good Energy for FIT solar payments since 2015. All was good for several years but this last year they've started to become demanding, rude in tone and incompetent. You'll get emails from them to say they've put your account on hold because you haven't done something from a prior email (which they have never sent). They demand new information out of the blue and then add to the email "Your account will be placed on hold and no further payments will be made until we receive this information, and it has been reviewed and authorised." Two weeks ago I received two email dated months ago saying my account had been put on hold, then two emails later to say it was a mistake. I've had enough and looking to move.

records.title: Happy to be moving to Octopus Energy
records.text: My experience with Good Energy has been so-so. Once I had my smart meter installed there was an issue for the first few months. The rates were not synched and the meter was showing the cost of what I was using as less than what it actually was. In the end I was charged more than what the meter was showing because the actual rates were higher. This was really enraging since it felt that I was being purposefully lied to so I can be confortable to spend more.The tipping point was this January when the prices went up and my daily cost has gone up to double what was in December.I have had my eyes on Octopus Energy for a while and was super happy to change. I have full control, transparency and visibility of everything in my account online, have the easiest to use app and no need to wait to chat to anyone on the phone. It feels so refreshing and the rates are significantly lower.

records.title: Received 2 phone calls about smart meters after I informed Good Energy that I did not want one.
records.text: Received 2 phone calls in 2 days from SMS about installing a smart meter. During yesterday's call, the caller asked if I wished to have one installed. I said that I did not wish to have one and I had informed Good Energy about this. In today's call from SMS, the caller asked when I wanted one installed. Told him what I said to his colleague yesterday.Earlier today I emailed Good Energy about the first call from SMS and referred them to their email of 30 May 2022 stating that I would be taken off their smart meter contact list. There seems to have been a breakdown in communications here. I hope that there is no underlying pressure being put on customers that do not have smart meters to have them installed. I understand that customers can opt to either have a smart meter installed or not.

records.title: It’s ok if you don’t need to contact them…
records.text: It’s ok if you don’t need to contact them, but if you do be prepared that the comms will take weeks. You send them an email and have to wait about a week for a response, but if you have something that needs a reply be ready to reply and wait another week for the next email to come through. Very painful. Because of the service I’ve decided to switch to another provider. On exit Good Energy overcharged me by a whopping £714 pounds. The email back from CS confirmed that it will be rectified, but two weeks later the system shows that the next payment was processed, account wasn’t closed and we are back to the saga of email exchanges. Avoid.

description: And it's goodbye from us - the green energy supplier who tried to make the world a cleaner, greener place to live.

records.title: So sad pure planet has stopped trading…
records.text: So sad pure planet has stopped trading they were by far the best energy company I have ever used. Thank you pure planet ❤️

records.title: Just wanted to say how brilliant Pure…
records.text: Just wanted to say how brilliant Pure Planet has been with us, reading the reviews some people have had bad experiences but ours has been fantastic. After a 6 month battle with SSE just to get an account opened we switched to Pure Planet the switch has gone through smoothly and was connected days after we moved in.  Provided meter readings for our first and second months and have recived an accurate bill off these. We have also been invited to have a smart meter fitted which is nice and soon after we joined. Downside or something to be aware of is they do take the first payment in advance so you need to be ready for that when you join!

records.title: Best Service this side of the USA
records.text: We have been members of Pure Planet for quite a while am not sure how long but it’s been quite awhile from our old residence to this one in Auckley,I have not come across anybody else who could hold a torch up to PP,So easy to get along with and no worries whatsoever and I can’t see us changing suppliers if l was scoring points for PP I would give them 60 out of 10 no probs..Here’s to many more years of PURE PLANET Service….

records.title: Pure Planet has been great for us
records.text: Pure Planet has been great for us. We jumped away from eon because of their vagueness, loads of misinformation and unexpected bills of hundreds of pounds. Pure planet have been the total opposite. They are fair, transparent and care for the environment. Highly recommended.

records.title: Brilliant Company
records.text: Best energy Company I have ever been with, easy to use app and they regularly review your account and refund any overpayments or adjust your payment so that it covers any underpayment.  I've been with them over 3 years now and my sister and mother are also happy customers.

records.title: Cannot recommend Pure Planet enough
records.text: Pure Planet are fantastic. Our bill was already cheaper than we expected when we made the switch, but they reduced it further based on our actual fuel usage - surprising given that we're on a fixed contract and they were well within their rights not to do so! Cannot recommend them highly enough!

records.title: Pure Planet have stolen £181 from my…
records.text: Pure Planet have stolen £181 from my grand daughters bank. She didn’t even give them her bank details, they got it from someone elsePURE PLANET HAVE ACTED IMMEDIATELY CANCELLED THE DD AND GIVEN MY GRAND DAUGHTER VERY GOOD ADVICETHANK YOU

records.title: Pure Planet are Perfect!
records.text: We switched to Pure Planet a few months ago now and have been absolutely stunned by how great the experience has been. Switching was an absolute breeze, and we were recently contacted by them to say we were overpaying and they will reduce our Direct Debit and refund the amount we'd overpaid by. This was the exact opposite of our last supplier who tried to increase our bills almost every quarter and would hang onto our overpayments for months, even years. They're also considerably cheaper than our old supplier and providing meter readings via the app couldn't be easier. Will be recommending them to all our friends and family.

records.title: Amazing Service
records.text: Pure Planet are THE BEST supplier I have used for service. Questions are answered quickly and clearly and issues resolved with no fuss. Highly recommended!

records.title: I'm on my third year with Pure Planet…
records.text: I'm on my third year with Pure Planet and have not had any issues. As long as you add your meter readings correctly the bill is always generated accurately and payments taken as agreed.

records.title: A good company.
records.text: I find the company very good and the bills are clear. The only problems I’ve had are the reading of the meters. We are elderly and find it difficult to do, so I got in touch to get the company to read them for us. They came once then the next bills were estimated. I got in touch again and I now have the meters read every month. I know it’s been a difficult time due to Covid so I would say that overall, I’m happy with the service we receive from Pure Planet.

records.title: Well...they provide gas & electric
records.text: Well...they provide gas & electric, they take your money & will cut it off if you don't, what else do you expect them to do?The web account page isn't very inspiring & having to keep verifying your email if you change to a different PC is infuriating. It's an unnecessary security protocol, that wastes time & loses a star as a result, as other companies aren't this paranoid.People have complained about the "lack of phone number", well...how do you think it's this cheap then? They save on overheads like call centres, yes? It's clearly stated before signing up & if people don't like it...don't sign up with them.They were the best long term deal at time of sign up. They're owned by BP as a "non-proft", so are worth a look, as long as the price matches your budget of course.

records.title: Really easy switch
records.text: Really easy switch, everything went according to plan and the communications are good. The only thing I do not like is the difference in the summer dd payment versus the winter - I would prepare to have an even spread acorss the year, hence marked down one star. But other than that all is good. I now even have a smart meter, which I've been trying to get from my other providers for years!!

records.title: Pretty Smooth
records.text: It all seemed pretty smooth, except that we have to take photos of our meters, and submit them.  My electric meter has a problem in where it is sited. and no matter what I do, I cannot see the tops of the numbers, so I can't tell the difference between 1 & 7, and 4 & 9, so if any of them appear on the meter, I always have to do various calculations to make the best guess, as to the reading, based on my readings from the past. etc.  I am worried that I might end up being overcharged, if they just go for the highest possible figure...I do really like the variation between standing orders between summer and winter, though.

records.title: Fine but frustrating
records.text: Generally the handover from my previous supplier to Pure Planet went well - except for the quite frustrating request for meter readings - from both suppliers. I have smart meters for both gas and electricity. That, I thought was to remove the need for the home owner to provide readings. None the less I received multiple requests from both companies. I could find no info on their respective websites or a way of asking if readings were needed. Yes, there was a bot but getting through that system is no easy matter. Eventually I after much effort I did find a way and was told, as I had a smart meter there was no need for readings!

records.title: The switch was easy and stress free
records.text: The switch was easy and stress free. Only just joined Pure Planet so hoping it will be a good company to use.The communication by email and text message was excellent.

records.title: Good start to our relationship.
records.text: Over the last few years I have changed supplier on a number of occasions and this was the swiftest and most pain-free switch that I have undertaken. Whether that is down to Pure Planet or whether it is down to the changes instituted by the Government to make switching easier remains to be seen. I wait to see if and when Pure Planet increases its prices, like the others I have switched to in the past, who seem  to rely on a short period of lower prices than most competitors to gain customers and then hope that some will stay despite this rise. Regardless of that, there is a feel good factor involved in being with a company that uses only renewable energy.

records.title: Fast transition between the old…
records.text: Fast transition between the old supplier and the new one. Simple, easy online application process. Just felt a bit impersonal with no contact with an actual person. Also had to attempt the switch twice because problems couldn't be resolved between the 2 companies.

records.title: Smooth and quick switch
records.text: I have been with pure planet with our main property for s few years and there have been no issues. They are not set up for more than one address from the same email and it took a few days for them to answer my query. Once understood, the switch was very smooth and quick, just had to provide meter readings and it is all done.

records.title: I am sure on the whole this is a good…
records.text: I am sure on the whole this is a good energy company but I have found that it's difficult to contact them and had to wait for replies unlike picking up a phone. I went for the first time with a variable tariff as there was a £30 charge if I wanted to switch from a fixed tariff, never again, I hate being in debit which was a first for me so am now switching to an energy company on a fixed tariff once again and one I can contact by phone

records.title: As it's from green resources I like it!
records.text: As it's from green resources I like it.Also getting the package was not a hard and tricky job.Let's see what happens in the future as we're still new to Pure Planet.

records.title: Simple changeover but my mails to…
records.text: Simple changeover but my mails to explain why the meters could not be read by the allotted time never received a reply

records.title: Thanks
records.text: Thanks, good service. Only issue was we couldn’t start from the date we actually moved in, so started a bit later, but not really a problem.

records.title: Had to chase refund of exit fees following house move.
records.text: Reasonably smooth app-based process for switching in new property. Disappointing that no automatic process for refunding the exit fees incurred when closing account at old property - had to chase this several times via chat function before actioned.

records.title: One little problem
records.text: The only little problem was logging in and sending the photos. Otherwise I have not noticed anything.

records.title: I switched to PurePlanet using…MOneysaving Expert
records.text: I switched to PurePlanet using MoneysavingExpert energy switching process. The switch was simple through the process and happened about2 weeks after.Only issue was I had multiple requests from Pure Planet fo my meter reading asking to take them on different days. I submitted the first readings request but upon going back in to the app only the electric reading had been registered. I tried to submit the gas one again but couldn’t. Maybe it is just an app issue but it was frustratingOverall the switch went very well

records.title: All went ok other than it seems my old…
records.text: All went ok other than it seems my old provider wanted meter readings on different days to my new one. Should be on the same day.I was also over £200 in credit on my old contract - why does it take six weeks to settle and why my new provider needs money up front! Ar well.

records.title: Good UI, Poor customer service.
records.text: So far ui seems easy to use and straightforward.However, customer service is very hard to reach. I used the bot to ask for the meter serial numbers associated with our flat and still haven't heard back. It has now been over a week.EDIT:updated to 4 stars after hearing back from pure planet. Apparently they never recieved a request from wattbot. Im pretty sure it was sent but giving them the benefit of the doubt here.

records.title: Switching to Pure Planet
records.text: I am awaiting for the full switch to happen on my second account but the first account seems fine despite the blocking from my previous energy supplier whom have gone out of their way to be difficult.  Both U-Switch and Pure Planet have been reasonably easy to deal with and I have received good communication via email.

records.title: Watch these guys
records.text: I have been a customer since January on a fixed tariff. I used to give readings every month from a smart meter installed by the previous supplier and my account was in credit as I like being in credit. Then 2 months ago they started using the meter remotely. Now my usage has gone up which is impossible. I spent 1.1/2 weeks in hospital, no one else in the flat. Switch everything off except the fridge and freezer and now I have to pay more. From £24.50 to £34.74 in warmer months and £35.00 to £52.12 in winter months. I don’t use central heating unless I have my kids visit, maybe once or twice in the winter for a few hours. Watch these guys

records.title: Have been very happy with Pure Planet, but too expensive to stay when my fix ends.
records.text: I’m in the process of switching from Pure Planet, though I’d have been happy to stay if they had offered me a competitive tariff when my fix ends in a couple of  weeks. Currently they are offering me just one fix at double my annual current cost. Even the variable rate (pre October rise, and no longer available) meant a considerable increase in cost. I fully expected to be paying more for my energy in the coming year, but not £1400 more! So, I have found a couple of suppliers with fixes at about £300 above my current cost. I’d definitely consider coming back to PP in the future, and to anyone thinking of giving them a go, I’d say you just need need to know you’re signing up for a service that is managed via an app, and that communication can be slow, but like no frills super-markets, that’s why we got a good price.

records.title: I told pure planet that I was not…
records.text: I told pure planet that I was not paying enough on my DD more than once but said ur ok...so my bill has just gone up a extra 150 a month...now just put into leave and on a fixed rate is still 60 a month less

records.title: Bots are not the answer.
records.text: Whilst I like the idea of using an app I don't like not being able to talk with humans. The bot system is very frustrating and you feel that it is designed to stop you having any contact with anyone. Very frustrating and no obvious way of being able to contact an agent. You offer a phone back service but this is an impractical alternative expecting you to wait for your query to be dealt with.

records.title: I have written 3 emails regarding a…
records.text: I have written 3 emails regarding a friend I recommend to pure planet we were both supposed to receive a £50 gift voucher for Amazon. My friend has made 3 payments therefore that can’t be the hold up.The 3 of my emails have gone unanswered. You get a bounce back email regarding receipt but no answer to my query therefore I cannot recommend this company to any one as they don’t honer their commitments I am a very unhappy customer. My complaint has been resolved now so I have increased the star raiting to 3 because it’s taken over two months to resolve. I suggest your customer service department answer emails much quicker then I wouldn’t have had to right so many emails

records.title: How can I write a review when you…
records.text: How can I write a review when you haven’t done anything yet except send me a couple of emails!

records.title: No customer service
records.text: The savings seem to be ok but had trouble entering my meter readings as there is no option to enter your electric reading, so I now have an estimated bill coming which is no good.There is no one to contact so if anything goes wrong and you have any questions, you are stuck talking to a robot and if it can't help you then you are stuck.

records.title: Pure planet is not cheap
records.text: Pure planet is not as cheap as what they claim to be. Electric and gas companies standing charges are outrageous including pure planet. The low price I was quoted has never materialised as I am very careful with my gas and electric. I am sure they can adjust meter readings. I was in hospital for a week and a half and used more gas and electric than if I was here. Everything was switched off excluding the fridge and freezer. How can I use more if no boiler, tv or lights were switched on

records.title: Very good but I don't know how to…
records.text: Very good but I don't know how to contact you

records.title: PP have been quite good in terms of…
records.text: PP have been quite good in terms of switching and pricing.  I'm getting pretty tired though of the lack of customer service.   I made an enquiry three weeks ago now which I've chased every week with the email 'no response'.   You just can't seem to get hold of anyone which means if it goes wrong your a bit knackered.It would seem Jess.... Not in this case.  I've been a long term customer, I moved house, I took the incentive which I'm yet to see and despite having had my contact details for an extensive period of time, your customer service don't seem to respond in the times you quote.    All you have to do is search for my email address, which you've got because I'm a long term customer and respond to the emails.

records.title: IGas first then Electric
records.text: II wanted to know why my Gas was changed a different date to my electric so I did try your Robot, but unfortunately it can only help with basic questions. My gas was something like £12 and my Electric about £42  I needed help but unfortunately could no get any, so paid up as a 75 year old I am not great on the computer or remembering dates think next time I just need to change to someone who has people working for them rather than Robots.

records.title: I was quite displeased that there is no…
records.text: I was quite displeased that there is no way I can communicate with you either over the phone or email.  I did not want to join Pure Planet for these reasons.  Also I had a fall on 2.7.21 and had a Pubic Rimae fracture in left leg.  I was in the hospital for a week and have been at home since 8.7.21 still with continuous pain.  I had no opportunity to cancel the contract with you and am stuck for 2 years!.  No I would not like to join you again or refer anyone!  Many thanks.

records.title: Been with this company a few years
records.text: Been with this company a few years. Service brilliant at first. Then problems with the website. Unable to contact anyone by phone or email. Hence 3 star's.

records.title: So far so good but had a problem when I…
records.text: So far so good but had a problem when I tried to change my password payment date. The reply was that I had already changed and couldn't change again for so many days.Everything else seems to have gone smoothly but I have noticed that my electricity meter reading has not been used in the final bill. I trust that you will be using the same meter reading for the initial bill and not my meter reading Regards Stephen Priestley

records.title: It took two attempts to change and it…
records.text: It took two attempts to change and it was only by chance that I found Pure Planet was proceeding. Not very clear as to what is required and when. Appears to have now gone through. We will see as to how easy this company is to use.

records.title: Too soon to tell
records.text: I cannot give any more as inky been with them a week the change over was easy I would rather review in 6 mths would be interesting to see how bills are customer service . But fine so far .

records.title: Poor start
records.text: Seemed a confused start with the left hand not knowing what the right hand wanted. Each individual contact contradicted the previous and meter readings were requested on more than one occasion. Then was advised that switch couldn’t happen but no explanation given. Wasn’t pleased and complained and then was told it would happen. Can’t say that I clearly know what I’ve signed up for but perhaps someone will  explain in the near future. We can only live in Hope who said switch was clear and easy?

records.title: I have tried to contact you several…
records.text: I have tried to contact you several times because my meter has 3 readings but no contact  as yet ,so still waiting obviously bills can't be accurate  with only 2 readings please advise

records.title: Can we choose a changeover/billing date?
records.text: Dissapointed that the change of supplier means a change of date for billing. I have lost time with my previous, much lower cost tariff, for the remainder of their contract. It also means that the date of meter readings are out of sync, one trip to the meters for electric and another trip to read the gas.

records.title: Hi everyone using pure planet for the…
records.text: Hi everyone using pure planet for the first time .I dont like the 6 month split tariffs and although they stay in touch by email,I prefer a phone number to speak to someone.Having said that,they are slightly cheaper so I will review them again after I have used them for 12 months.Further update from blue planet they say if you are over 65 you can request a call back.

records.title: Fuel is not for iPads. Will come in handy when I have a car but useless now.
records.text: This is not the type of electricity my iPad does take. Start an iPad cable company 😒

records.title: Great until customer service needed
records.text: Been a customer for two years. Until I needed help from Pure planet I would’ve given 5 stars, the app was cool and meter readings easy. BUT recently i needed help and discovered customer service is terrible. There is no phone number, only a useless automated bot, that eventually agrees to pass your query to a real person. Then u have to wait at least a week for a chat response or an email. Agonisingly slow and frustrating. I want to use green energy, but I’m so disappointed with pure planet.

records.title: Customer service issue
records.text: Pure planet has an issue with its customer service.There is no phone number that can be dialled. Only a "bot" which is pretty useless.Once you manage to get past the bot to get transferred to an operator, it takes several days between each email response.If all is well and you need nothing, this is fine. If there is any issue (overbilling, admin issue with the transfer of provider) you are in for a long period of bad communication.I would not recommend

records.title: Communications are a problem
records.text: Communications are a problem. At the request of Pure Planet, Magnum have been here to install a smart meter on two occasions. However, they engineer can’t establish an internet connection. He says I should refer the matter to Pure Planet. I have sought to do this through the Bott system, but that goes round and round in circles, with no evidence anyone is understanding the query. Also, I have an agreement to feed in spare electricity from my photovoltaics, for a payment. How am I going to do that? The Bott system of which you are so pleased provides no answer.  I need to speak to a person. I am prevented from so doing. Alan Leech

records.title: No customer service.
records.text: As others have noted, none existent customer service.despite emails and the use of the app contact "bot" you don't get to resolve issues if you need to speak or write to a human.   While everything is working ok they are ok and the app is good.

records.title: so far very annoying.
records.text: so far very annoying.sent picture of meter reading etc,received notification of receipt of this.since then had 2 more requests for the same informationagain got reply of recieving them.then a mail telling me that because i  had not supplied meter readings thenaccount  would begin with estimated reading..ever had a suspicion you have made a great mistake ?my patience is thin.

records.title: Everything went well until you asked…
records.text: Everything went well until you asked for meter readings.  On your email only the electricity readings were asked for and I could not find a way to send my gas reading.  You have asked for this repeatedly but no gas readings were visible.  So how do I send my readings to you as you will be asking for my monthly ones.  I don’t want to have estimated bills.

records.title: Not impressed so far
records.text: Although the changeover happened fine (not much to go wrong, really), we're  still waiting for a reply to a simple query about our smart meter.  They say email queries take at least a week to reply to.  No other way of contact, although this was made clear at the beginning, but a week to get any reply is a bit much.Don't choose Pure Planet if you want instant contact.

records.title: Not great
records.text: Not great. Impossible to speak with anyone. A ‘Wattbot’ that works intermittently. Procedure for moving into our new property was not explained. I’m still in the process of getting the correct meter readings to the right people, but had no feedback as to whether it’s right or not. Probably because of point 1. I can’t speak to anyone. If I had my choice again I’d choose customer service above green credentials sadly.

records.title: When I decided to change suppliers I…
records.text: When I decided to change suppliers I thought it would be a quick and simple transaction.But it did not turn out that way .It  has taken about 6 seems originally confir.m that I have changed suppliers and several conflicting phone calls with conflicting answers.But hopefully I have been changed to a new supplier and hopefully I willing it cheaper.But it was a bit donting to say the least.

description:
Every day we treat and supply 275 million litres of water and collect, recycle and dispose of millions of litres of waste water safely back into the environment.
Our three million customers live in south west England including Dorset, Somerset, Bristol, most of Wiltshire and parts of Gloucestershire and Hampshire.
As well as delivering essential services, we also support communities throughout our region by offering free resources to schools and colleges and providing financial and volunteer support to local charities.
Our customers rate our services highly and we are recognised by the regulator Ofwat as one of the top water and sewerage companies in England and Wales.
We love to receive customer feedback - good and bad - as it helps us to continually improve our services.
Use water wisely
Save water and money with our simple tips
Need extra help?
Register for Priority Services for free.

records.title: A great example of customer service 👏🏻
records.text: Moving house is always a stressful event, and updating all the relevant companies can be a chore.The team at Wessex Water makes every contact feel like you are the only customer. Nothing seems like too much trouble, and any action is quickly dealt with, whether that's sorting out a direct debit or replacing old manhole covers.It's good to know that you're in safe hands 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

records.title: Easy to use chat facility on your…
records.text: Easy to use chat facility on your website.Swift response, someone came out within a few hours. Helpfulness and polite manner of the chap who came to sort out our problem. Overall fantastic service.

records.title: We wanted to say a huge thank you to…
records.text: We wanted to say a huge thank you to Ben Fletcher (063008449001) for coming out and unblocking drain and clearing up the sewerage mess that came up by my back door last night. Exemplary service. Thank you very much. You made my day. Also thanks to Wessex Water Emergency Helpline who took my call at 1am and sent someone round to assess on Sunday night between Christmas and New year.

records.title: Blocked drain
records.text: Just had wessex water unblock my drain which was blocked right near the main sewer pipe almost 50 m from my house.Just wanted to say a big thankyou to Harry for his excellent work.

records.title: On Boxing Day morning I contacted…
records.text: On Boxing Day morning I contacted Wessex water about a blocked toilet and within a couple of hours a very nice helpful man arrived and with in half an hour had sorted our problem out . His name was James Waite  he was extremely polite and helpful I was very impressed!

records.title: Lovely young man Dave M came and…
records.text: Lovely young man Dave M came and cleared a blockage in the bublic sewer that was backing up to our system - Yuck! The whole process was dealt with within 1/2 a day. Dave was very personable and helpful. Ref 062997597001  Thank you :)

records.title: Happy customer
records.text: Quick reply via the on-line chat service. Hannah was very informative and took the time to find the correct answer to my questions.

records.title: Wessex Water leak repaired efficiently.
records.text: I reported a leak in the Wessex Water service pipe; they attended within 24 hours and told me they would fix the problem within 7 days, which they did.

records.title: Wessex Water brilliant service!
records.text: Wessex Water responded incredibly quickly and were with us within an hour of us calling. We are so grateful to Dave Mitchell, who was professional, extremely knowledgeable and friendly…. And importantly, had incredible perseverance and managed to fix our drain problems! This all happened on Christmas Eve, and just before our entire extended family showed up! We are so very grateful! Thank you, Dave!!

records.title: Bill query
records.text: Wessex Water have always been very helpful and understanding when I've had to speak to them regarding my bill payments. Thank you.

records.title: flowed well
records.text: I mentioned about moving, they were able to answer my questions.

records.title: I was given a link to your drainage map…
records.text: I was given a link to your drainage map for Melton Rd in Trowbridge (BA14 8NQ).I could see no drains marked on the plan - Just roads & buildings - No drains ??My query related to the installed drains - Foul / Surface water or Combined drains.Your call handler advised it was seperate Foul & Surface water drainage.My contractors inspections suggest the drains are combined.Disappointed with reliability of supplied information.Following feedback, I was provided with the updated info below, which has answered my queries.All good.

records.title: A dribble ends up as pond over time.
records.text: After some confusion with getting an appointment for an inspector to attend, when he did the service I received was first class. Mr Goad took the time to assist me in locating the cause of my excessive consumption, explained how a tiny dribble could lead to a lot of water over a very short period of time and went into detail in how to read the meter which enabled him to time in one minute , a 150ml water loss. Tht 150ml loss equated to over a third of a cubic meter per day! A lesson learnt for me and my thanks to him for his attention to detail in his explanation.

records.title: Collapsed sewage pipe that had…
records.text: Collapsed sewage pipe that had collapsed on my Road. As we are the end house WW needed to gain access through our property. This is the second time this has happened whereby they had to dig up our patio. We were non too pleased when they returned however Charlie Taylor (Ref: 6554945) knows how to accommodate a dis-satisfied customer. He is calm, speaks softly and able to diffuse any situation. Charlie also made sure our patio was made good even though it needs repairing. Maybe this can be our compensation WW for all the inconvenience caused.

records.title: Damage repaired
records.text: After a slightly prolonged interaction with the chat bot and being disconnected part way through, I was able to give the details of the location of the problem (a dislodged cast iron cover that was dangerous) and it was resolved very quickly.

records.title: Overall - HQ seems ok
records.text: Web chat was slow - wasn't sure that a human was actually interacting - but someone did actually call me back.Contacted billing team - Chelsea was helpful and has logged a visit to investigate the reported problem.However - Why did the repair team leave the site 10/11/24 when the water meter was not functioning - and  - did they actually damage it?

records.title: Chat box
records.text: Online chat facility was very good.  Can't fault the response from the advisor.   All good so far.  It will be interesting to see how things work out when the engineer arrives.

records.title: Our gunk pot split
records.text: We needed another gunk pot because the original split. Because we had already had one the website would not allow a second. Used the online chat and was sent a replacement. If they are not going to last there needs to be a way of getting a replacement or it's purpose is lost.

records.title: Very pleasant
records.text: Very pleasant, understanding and engaged member of staff dealt with my issue. Very speedy response and dealt with my queries in full and with good cheer. Website link to requesting a sewer plan didn't work

records.title: We found a supply leak
records.text: We found a supply leak.  Water was being lost from WW supply pipe.  Wessex Water responded and fixed the problem within a week which is not too bad at all.  Also agreed a sensible plan for moving forward so we do not get similar problems with old galvanised supply pipes in the future.  Communication was pretty good by phone / chat.  Phone is still to slow and visit 'windows' are still too long - we cannot all hang around for half a day waiting for someone to turn up. Otherwise quite happy.

records.title: Flood fix
records.text: Flood in the house. Called Wessex Water as they are our water company. Martin West and Riley Wood came to fix the problem. Great friendly chaps who worked fast and explained what was going on clearly. Went the extra mile to disinfect and clean up and seal the manhole. 4 stars only because it was nearly 30 hours after reporting the problem that it was sorted even after promises of the same day. (Not the fault of the guys who came they were 5 stars for sure)

records.title: Pushing me to FAQs without having an…
records.text: Pushing me to FAQs without having an answer was too easy. Finding the ability for 1to1 query eventually gave me the quick response I required

records.title: Response to flooding
records.text: Reported flooding to rear og house water and sewage coming from drains. Used live chat. Y very helpful. Neighbours severely affected, eng8neers attended during the n8ght, we were not or neede to be disturbed. Follow up from Molly good. Requested that works to mitigate this in the future be assessed.

records.title: quick remedy
records.text: The response and remedy was quick, but I didn't find out the cause of the loss of supply.The initial interview with the help line was lengthy and frustrating, I appreciate you need to find out as much info as possible but don't treat  customers as morons.

records.title: Reduction due to soak away - customer esrvice could be better trained.
records.text: Rang number that was supposed to take me through to the department that arranged a survey to conform my rainwater drains into two soakaways on my property. Was sent on a very long route to speak to the corrcet team, was transfered and had to retell my request 5 times. Once I spoke to the right department Jay and Lloyd two lovely enginners came out very quickly and confimed that I had two soakaways and could get a reduced bill. Enginners 5 star, customer service 3 star.

records.title: Magdalena knows her job.
records.text: I tried to phone but after a very long wait I gave up. On line Magdalena was as good as gold, asked sensible questions, gave understandable replies, & left me with a positive outcome. Thanked her for her help & she was always polite.

records.title: Good for info. Poor on action.
records.text: Great: given a date for re-opening the footpath from Church rd to Brookside Drive.Not so great: it has been blocked for too long and no commitment to early re-opening.

records.title: Good but could use a little improvement...
records.text: Liam in the chat was very helpful and patient when they shut the water off to our street without notice.  There was no Wessex water staff in the area because they had gone to get bottled water for the outage, which was nice.  They should have notified the households effected first before leaving the scene.  When he returned with the water he was very helpful and apologetic and kept us up to date about the outage from there on.

records.title: A flood of sewage in hospital car park
records.text: A flood of sewage occurred overnight in a patient car park with cars stranded in over 2 feet of foul water at Bournemouth Hospital. I used the chat facility which was useful WW attended and cleaned the car park and repaired the broken manhole cover. Need to be careful using the helpline phone numbers not to muddle the numbers which are very similar.  03456004600 and 03456006400 the latter Northumberland not the helpline. Apologies

records.title: Liam tried to help me but was prevented…
records.text: Liam tried to help me but was prevented from doing so by company policy.

records.title: I reported a water gushing leak in…
records.text: I reported a water gushing leak in Glastonbury. You informed me that it was Bristol Water's responsibility. Having reported same to them, they said it was a Local Authority issue. So I reported it to SSDC. After all this, I note a week later that the leak is still gushing from a roadside inspection panel in  Old Butleigh Road, Glastonbury. Can someone take action please?

records.title: Problem resolved itself when works were…
records.text: Problem resolved itself when works were completed up the road in the village. There was a WW van next to an open stand pipe outside the house that we didn't see and the assistant was unaware of.Assistant was polite and helpful though.

records.title: Website fault reporting not good
records.text: I tried to report a water leak via the website. Most of it was straightforward, however I could not upload a picture (despite it being within size) and then it would not accept a recognised postcode, I tried various and each time I got an error message. I later persevered and ended up reporting via the live chat facility, which worked.... I think, I'm waiting to hear back!

records.title: Wessex Water fixed what they broke
records.text: Wessex Water came to read my meter and found the glass was broken. Replaced the meter, no problem with that. However the water pipe ended up with a lot of dirt in it. Result, our water supply was nil. Initially they said it was works in our area because of a major fault. Our retired neighbour told us what had really happened. Initially they said it would take 3 days to resolve. I made a song and a dance about it and they came next day. So they did fix the problem but it was a problem of their own making.

records.title: No follow up to say what WW identified…
records.text: No follow up to say what WW identified following my contact about a suspect leak

records.title: appointments
records.text: - staff on phone and chatbox excellent- for the appointment - irritation that i only found out at the end of the day that the engineers couldn't come that day. Should have been able to let me know earlier as i took a day off work

records.title: I like the fact that you turned up to…
records.text: I like the fact that you turned up to the difficult to pinpoint leak.I was told that you appeared at the spot of the leak, but after you had left it was discovered that the leak had in fact not been repaired. Another concerned individual spent a conderable amount of time on the phone to complain. After a second visit the leak has indeed been repaired satisfactorilly.

records.title: System stated that all 5 verification…
records.text: System stated that all 5 verification codes it generated were invalid and would not accept any of them.Useless system not fit for purpose.In fairness when I gave up and reverted to web chat they sorted out my problem although seemed to have difficulty ig

records.title: No water supply pressure
records.text: I reported that the water supply to my house has dropped significantly, Chat (Ollie) informed me that there was a problem in my area, no further info. No idea what, So now just hoping it is restored soon, as no water for toilets and cooking.

records.title: Lack of Information
records.text: As a disabled customer, who is registered as a vulnerable customer with Wessex Water - I expected to be given some idea as to how long I would be off supply - I was not told on Friday 29 Nov - and even worse - when I messaged your company - I was not told either !

records.title: Compensation
records.text: To early to tell what will happen. I would say the Wessex Water webchat worked ok which has not been my experience with other organisations webchat!

records.title: Pleasant but lacking necessary knowledge
records.text: The chat operative seemed quick and efficient, however, it was several hours before Wessex Water informed me that they were not the company responsible for my water mains after all. This caused an unnecessary delay in getting the mains leak fixed. It would have been good if, given the name, address and postcode, they could have realised this sooner

records.title: Quick service, sloppy workers
records.text: 3 stars for : Very quick to come out and fix a mains leak in our garden. 0 stars for : We were away when they attended and our garden was left uneven with a very big dip when they dug the hole, no attempt to level the lawn, very disappointing.

records.title: I got the information I needed
records.text: I got the information I needed, but what a cumbersome way to do it! Why can't I just look at my account on line?

records.title: Noisy Manhole Cover Reporting
records.text: I wanted to contact Wessex Water to report a noisy manhole cover.  Once upon a time this was easy: you got a drop-down menu and clicked on 'noisy manhole cover'.  Now, I ran in circles trying to find the old menu and eventually clicked on 'Chat'.  I spoke to a helpful man, called Charlie, and was able to report the manhole  cover.  This took more time than I had expected and is not an effective way to report.

records.title: Wessex Water were quick to respond initially
records.text: Wessex Water were quick to respond to my initial communication. I had contacted them about traffic diverting along our narrow residential street due to Wessex Water roadworks on the main road. Although the initial response was quick they have yet to get back to me with details of any further actions they've taken/ will take to ensure that people drive via the official diversion. And to ensure that cars, motorbikes and large vans diverting along this street drive at an appropriate speed for a narrow, mostly one lane road (with many houses, parked cars, pets, children, a school etc). I await a response!

records.title: [WAS - The problem is not fixed] Now: they're back on it
records.text: Well, there was a problem: strong sewage smell after rain noticed by us and neighbours. Wessex attended (good)Said “we can do nothing” (bad)And records the problem as solved. It is not solved. Does this mean we just have to put up with strong sewage smell regularly in future and go through the charade again? Or can Wessex fix the problem?

records.title: I was disappointed that you were not…
records.text: I was disappointed that you were not able to supply and fit a new manhole cover over drain in my drive even though I offered to pay for it. The original concrete one broke whist clearing a blocked drain.I spoke on your chat line with a lady named Sadie and She was helped as far as she was able too and I do not have a problem with her,she helped as far as she was allowed too and gave me a web site to go on to.However I think wWessex Water could have done more to assist me.

records.title: I reported a drop in water pressure
records.text: I reported a drop in water pressure. After some investigations Wessex told me they had power supply problems at our local pumping station and they were waiting for the power company to investigate. So far so good.A week or so later Wessex called me to ask if we still had pressure issues. The caller did not know if the Power company had resolved the power supply issue! Surely if the problem is the power supply to their pumps then Wessex should know if it's fixed and not be asking me!

records.title: Frustration resolved 8th March 2023
records.text: Previously received paper bills, every 6 months.  Challenging to recall that I previously had signed up on line with Wessex Water.  Frustrating to be locked out of my account after I had successfully reset password. Advised on line to try again later. Tried again several days later, on line account still locked. Thanks to online chat with Sam, who made contact with the appropriate department.

records.title: De ja vu
records.text: After reporting a suspected water leak between the water meter and stopcock, and carrying out some basic diagnostics the customer services booked a visit to identify issue. After waiting 14 days a water engineer arrived today and switched off the Stopcock and the mains at the meter end. He then said that we had a leak between the meter and the house and depending on where on the property may require a private company to repair. He then booked for somebody to attend on the 5 Feb 2025 to ascertain where the leak was. No wonder so much money is wasted on leaks and man hours, especially as all he did was exactly what I had done before reporting the issue.As it is, Wessex water is one of the most expensive water providers and increasing prices by  21% next year. These companies need nationalising.

records.title: Technology not easy
records.text: Tried to report water leak on line but failed. Did via chat box but even that was not easy

records.title: A day without water
records.text: Took far to long fix and not enough information about what was going on , how long to fix and same message on repeat all the time on phone !

records.title: I think the operator tried to confuse…
records.text: I think the operator tried to confuse me by giving unclear responses and couldn’t explain why they were not getting updates from my water provider resulting in them taking too much money each month. You managed 2 stars because in the end we got to you reviewing my payment schedule.

records.title: I was advised that I would receive an…
records.text: I was advised that I would receive an update by text that did not happen. My water supply has tonight gone again.

records.title: No update or notifications
records.text: No update or notifications. Water been off since at least 06.00 this morning & it’s now 15.30.Retired so priority customers

records.title: Very poor service
records.text: The customer service numbers don’t answer or there’s a long queue and the website is confusing When finally managed to get through I was told they were aware of a problem in my area but couldn’t say when it might be fixedReally poor service considering the amount we have to pay!

records.title: Wessex water got in touch to say they…
records.text: Wessex water got in touch to say they would be in touch again by phone by a certain date.  They did phone me before the date they had given me and said they were looking into my high pressure supply problem, when my complaint was about low pressure problem!  they apologized and said they would amend the report and be in touch with an appointment. I'm afraid I can't remember how long they said I would have to wait but I'm still waiting.

records.title: Needs more training …
records.text: Spoke to someone called Jeff today about my bill who was not explaining himself properly and then was abrupt with me. Not good customer service

records.title: Information
records.text: In an emergency communication and updates asap . Access to emergency water supplies and more thought to providing help to the elderly and vulnerable .

description:
Join us on the path to energy that’s better for you, better for your wallet - and better for the planet.
 Get a quote

records.title: Great experience sorting out setup problems
records.text: Having recently moved into a new flat that OVO already supplied, I'd had weeks of trouble setting up my account using the online tools and chat. On ringing the support line, Ryan sorted everything out in about 5 mins. Excellent customer service.

records.title: Very informative lady Helen
records.text: Very informative lady Helen Talk to me through some information that I had not been informed before and because I did not ask but now I understand however I still will not have a smart meter.I really do not trust them many people have had problems with their smart meters with being overcharged Helen with very friendly and very professional.

records.title: Supportive and understanding around bereavement
records.text: What was one of the most difficult and heartbreaking times, informing services about the loss of my mother, Neil, our bereavement advisor couldn’t have done enough for us.  Efficiently, and sensitively organised the change of names of mum’s account to my dad whilst also ensuring that he took us through the process slowly and with great patience and understanding.  Could not fault Neil, thank you so much for helping.

records.title: Sarah was a great help setting up our…
records.text: Sarah was a great help setting up our new account and keeping us informed about the process to view our bills online going forward-friendly and positive. Also took the time to call me back when the call disconnected due to poor mobile signal in our new house, well done

records.title: Positive online help outcome with Graeme
records.text: Graeme my help centre advisor was wonderful, not only sorting out my problem with false gas meter readings but reviewing direct debit amounts, refunds and ensuring everything was working on the app going forward. A shame that the call was necessary, but will be sticking with OVO for this year.

records.title: Your advisor went through the process…
records.text: Your advisor went through the process of setting up a new account in a calm and professional way.He was clear in what he was telling me and patientwith the questions I asked.He explained the 3 pricing options although at this time I had already decided to stay with the Simpler Energy tariff.Satisfied customer.

records.title: Rich was extremely helpful
records.text: Rich was extremely helpful.  He explained how customers are charged for energy and checked that I was on the most appropriate plan.  He also arranged for me to have a new smart meter.  I was very grateful for Rich’s explanation and interest.

records.title: Professional is their middle name
records.text: The CS guy, Nick, was so professional. I was in trouble, he took time to support me every step of the process and made sure that he recommended all available support, both within the company and external help that was available. Brilliant, he changed a day of worry into a relaxed and happy day. Thanks Nick

records.title: Very impressed with the whole…
records.text: Very impressed with the whole experience. I reported problems with my kitchen lights and light switch in the morning and by late afternoon the issues were fixed, by an extremely friendly and competent electrician. No problems at all. Would definitely recommend.

records.title: The advisor was so helpful
records.text: The advisor was so helpful, I explained that my sister had died in November and I wasn't sure what I had to do regarding the final meter reading as she put money on a pay as you go key. The advisor explained the next steps.

records.title: OVO top up app
records.text: OVO are great at fixing issues as long as you have patience. They will definitely get you sorted out but you might have to go through 3 or 4 people to get there. The transition from the Boost app to the OVO app was absolutely awful thankfully the customer services team was able to fix any issues I had

records.title: You don't offer what I need
records.text: Very helpful and well informed man. I don't give 5 stars because you don't offer 2 things I want (1) DD for the actual amount used; and (2) a contract where I pay more per unoit used but no standing charge.

records.title: Last minute panic avoided
records.text: I had been panicking as I could not find a way to submit my FiT readings in time for the December deadline. The telephone call on 31st December, from Kelsey who confirmed that she had received my meter readings, did put my mind at rest.Quite why I hadn't been previously informed that my account was 'on hold' is beyond me.

records.title: Customer service were helpful but as…
records.text: Customer service were helpful but as yet smart meter Gas reading still not registering but could take a few more days as they are keeping a check on it.

records.title: Both my meters are smart meters from a…
records.text: Both my meters are smart meters from a previous tenant who had pay as you go cards! I’ve changed to monthly direct debit! Your app is great but the daily standing charges should be added to the daily charges instead of not including them would be easier to see where the money is gojng

records.title: Communication needs to be more direct.
records.text: FIT and solar work well but any issues regarding the readings submitted can be a problem having to use e-mail communication. Recently had access to Cormac by telephone and problem sorted, much better than wasted messages, thank you.

records.title: Got there in the end..
records.text: My boiler was under service coverage with British Gas.  Five engineers were dispatched to diagnose a pressure loss, yet none successfully identified the root cause; each provided a different diagnosis.
