Consequently, a new annual agreement was immediately initiated with OVO; although i did have two ovo engineers to identify the faulty heat exchanger, followed by a third to install the replacement part.  The system has now operated without incident for one month now. Boiler was only 2 years old.Ovo engineers were very pleasant not like british gas.Let's hope the future and house is hot.

records.title: Operative was helpful and did all they…
records.text: Operative was helpful and did all they could to assist but it took 2 long phone calls and 4 trips to designated PayPoint stores to finally get the credit put on my new card.  A real pain!  Never lose your gas card!

records.title: Generally satisfied
records.text: I am a long term customer of OVO, and am generally satisfied with the service. Whenever I have had to phone for assistance I have found the staff to be friendly, polite and helpful.I live in the North of Scotland and am one of those customers who have had to have our dual meter system replaced. It has not been completely straightforward, and we have had to have our meter replaced twice, but the engineers who completed the work have all been friendly and have explained the issues clearly. We now have a working smart meter and are happy with the outcome so far.I am disappointed that certain OVO services/initiatives that I receive emails about turn out not to be available in my area e.g. installation of an ev charger. The application process was quite involved, so it was very disappointing to have to wait a few weeks only to be told that the service wasn’t available. Could OVO not make this clear in the original email? It puts me off applying for other services.

records.title: The advisor I spoke to was fantastic
records.text: The advisor I spoke to was very pleasant, friendly, helpful and explained everything perfectly.  She answered my questions and assured me that I could down load the OVO App almost immediately, which I did.Great service from her

records.title: Rapid response to my email
records.text: Had a very swift and helpful phone response to an email I sent. Extremely good rep on the phone - Kireel- and most of my issues sorted straight away.

records.title: Final meter reading
records.text: When I eventually got to online chat with someone that could and did sort out my final meter reading for me with ease thank you !

records.title: I’v ovo have come a long way and really…
records.text: I’v ovo have come a long way and really improved their customer service I’ve been with them 7 years now first ovo then boost their sister company for pay go meters I’m disabled and can’t reach my meters but they can remotely make any adjustments I might need in an emergency like transferring credit from electric onto the gas when it’s running low Ovo keep up the excellent work guys

records.title: The person who attended to fit a smart…
records.text: The person who attended to fit a smart meter for the electric was very helpful, polite and thorough, providing explanation and respectful of my property. Those is why the rating is higher than it should be.The person on the phone when I contacted to sign up to OVO following a house move, lacked product knowledge and unable to talk through products, unaware of products on the OVO website, wrongly informed me my property requires a gas smart meter when it twisted a electric smart meter, which I had informed them. Customer service training is required.

records.title: Online account problem fixed
records.text: There had been a long-standing problem with our online account (we had been able to login OK but the site was unreadable). It took a couple of lengthy phone conversations (answered without too long a wait) to identify the problem but it's fixed now and works fine.

records.title: Website not good
records.text: I tried to put money on my account via website, this proved impossible so I telephoned and found it so easy to speak to someone who was helpful, transaction done quickly and efficiently.

records.title: Great company
records.text: Great company. I have been very happy with the supplier and hope to carry on with them as soon as I get my new address.

records.title: The engineer was excellent
records.text: The engineer was very thorough since the fault number covered a number of possible areas that could be at fault. He worked through as many as he could but was not convinced that the problem was sorted. It immediately restarted by pressing the reset button but that had only sorted the problem for just over a day and it returned. He was much more thorough than the first engineer and did everything in his power to find the fault. So far it has continued working for three day so hopefully it is solved. I was very impressed by his perseverance to get to the bottom of it. An excellent employee.

records.title: Sales advisor generally very good was very helpful although…
records.text: Sales advisor was very helpful although at first he was rather unsure about a particular fact of renewal.His follow up was excellent and clear.

records.title: I'm leaving.
records.text: I intend to leave OVO at the end of my contract In April 2025, as the company increased my DD despite my having over £500 credit built up, based on a figure projected at March 2026.The company continues to report on my account based on 2026 despite my having told them that I intend to end my contract in April 2025. Apparently its down to the Computer.Oh please!

records.title: Quite good when everything runs as it…
records.text: Quite good when everything runs as it should. Customer service can be hit or miss, it's luck of the draw on the how much knowledge the advisor has. Billed me incorrectly when I left, and also took a direct debit from me after my contract had ended, so not very slick process wise when leaving. The app also can be very unclear, with billing information constantly changing so it's not obvious how much debit or credit you have.

records.title: Attention to my Smart meter and usage.
records.text: My recent experience was very positive and helpful by a lady wo put my Smart meter back to normal function. I give her 5*. But it has gone wrong again, not giving a daily reading but weekly or more.  In summer I am well in credit but usage in winter increases for central heating which seems not to be considered. You need to increase usage on the Smart meter, so that it will function a daily read.  I will not be turning off my heating to suit my Smart meter or Ovo.  I shall be in credit in Summer and debit in Winter. If necessary contact me about increasing my D/D.

records.title: Ovo energy review after 6 months.
records.text: The direct debit issue of charging way beyond people's use is unnecessary. Also changing people's payments without there consent is a no no. People need to budget and especially those on low incomes? Altering there payment before there aware messes around with budgeting and can cause hardship. The billing is a night mare! why can't you keep it simple with the previous balance and new charges to show first? A simpler view first, then brake it down later in the bill! Customer service has been good even though I did have to explain a couple of times before they understand. The customer services agents where all polite and friendly. Cost wise more expensive than others so, fairly big bills. Like the app for keeping an eye on spending and the usage given over day, week, month etc, this is handy. Making payments is simple with a variety of options like Google, PayPal, bank transfare and banking card etc. Overall have to score it about a 3 out of 5 because of the direct debit and the messy billing. Sort out the billing display it will lead to less misunderstandings and bill shocks!

records.title: Most of the things I buy end up not…looking like what I saw before I ordered it
records.text: Most of the things I buy end up not meeting up or standard. When I see them online they look good and big but when they are delivered they are so small and sometimes not of good quality.

records.title: Refund Request
records.text: The fact the you removed £150 from my gas and  electric account two days ago after me requesting a refund and it still has not been put into my account Thankyou.

records.title: Cheque in the post!
records.text: On 11th November I accidentally overpaid £700, and Immediately requested a refund. However two months have passed and no sign of the promised cheque, despite three people assuring me that it was in the post!

records.title: lacking confidence in OVO
records.text: Firstly Richard was as helpful as he could be and the man that fitted the new smart meter was as well.But it seems to me that the monthly cost is going up from your orginal quote.I expect you have got lots of reasons for this,BUT it does not help me feel very confident about the furture with OVO.Should Ibe looking eleswhere for an energy supplier.Yours Liz Walsh

records.title: Smart Meter - No Signal
records.text: The problem with our newly installed smart meter has not been resolved during the engineers visit.According to the OVO engineer it is unlikely the smart meter will ever receive a signal at our remote location and consequently it will never be able to work correctly.

records.title: No reduced traiff for charging hybrid cars
records.text: We were very concerned that there is no reduced tariff to charge a hybrid car over night.Hi Toby I was informed by your colleagues that due to us owning a land-rover hybrid we couldn't sign up to charge anytime.

records.title: Good people, faulty product.
records.text: Smart meter installation engineer was very good. Call centre handler was very good. Smart meter 'appears' to be faulty and our monthly bill is more than quadrupling at present as a result. The meter is stating we are using as many KW/h in a few days than we did in a whole month!

records.title: Very helpful call attendant when my…
records.text: Very helpful call attendant when my boiler stopped work but when the engineer arrived it was an electrician as the call was logged as electrical supply failure. 5 out of 4 for attention to detail! I then had to call again to get a boiler technician to come out.

records.title: I have good internet but you won’t give me a smart meter
records.text: Your advisor was very polite and knowledgeable and answered all my questions clearly, explaining in more detail one or two points I wasn’t too sure about. My problem is that I have just purchased an electric car and want a smart meter to obtain the discounted tariff you offer. I keep asking and every time am told it’s not possible at the moment, but not saying why. Your advisor explained the reason was because there wasn’t a strong or reliable internet at our property. This is incorrect. We have a good internet signal with 73MB/sec download and 18MB/sec upload, so can you please review my case and provide my smart meter.

records.title: Got my bill…eventually
records.text: UPDATE- I eventually got my bill, hence revised svore, but there was a lot of initial confusion.Simple request for an interim bill became like an Icelandic saga. In the end, I gave up. Two different advisers, two different responses- neither resolved what I thought was a very straightforward question.

records.title: Agent was very polite but incorrect information given
records.text: Agent was very polite but incorrect information provided. Told system would update correctly, still hasn’t. Had a power outage but app showed used electric that day, impossible as out of power for over 33 hours, but still charged.

records.title: I’ve not had any response since…
records.text: I’ve not had any response since informing you that the engineer did not leave a white job card in completion of the meter replacement.

records.title: I’m really fed up I keep reading about…
records.text: I’m really fed up I keep reading about your offers for cheaper bills but has to be by direct debit , I can’t risk direct debit as I’m old and worry about having enough money in bank to cover direct debit , if you send me a bill I know where I am money wise . If I need to borrow to have enough I can but just won’t risk it . I worry about paying my bills with just pension but land up paying more than people who have offers available to them .

records.title: Engineer was great
records.text: Engineer was great, for the meter change. But the shear amount of texts emails etc you get for the 10 days before they arrive is a right pain. Maybe 2 in the ten days but OVO sometimes send 2 a day.

records.title: Engineer did a good job but let down by the auto reading system.
records.text: Engineer did a good job, but the smart meter for the gas would not connect to the system, which means it now has to be read manually & telephoned in to the office. Poor connection system which needs putting right.

records.title: Can’t agree with my energy rating
records.text: Can’t agree with my energy rating. Don’t agree that Fischer heaters are just panel heaters. Had 2 engineers round checking out the house in prep for solar. There has been  a potential problem on the future fitting an isolation switch. Wasn’t really told what the problem was and after a week of waiting for some communication I ended up ringing myself to find out. A very helpful Nick got me the answer eventually. Also, Alison who sold us the system was very helpful.

records.title: Hi Team
records.text: Hi Team I spoke with a member of staff last Monday..he was very understanding and appreciated my Tariff needs.Unfortunately company above can't support a nite tariff for me ...my flat is totally electric..my latest bill for Nov 2024 was £79 ..I work 5 days a week I'm just surprised regarding bill above? description: Business Stream is one of the largest water retailers in the UK and a trusted service provider to over 300,000 business customers. Established in 2008, we have years of experience operating in the competitive water market – longer than any other retailer – and we’re the chosen service provider for businesses and organisations ranging from small corner shops to large industrial estates. Headquartered in the vibrant city of Edinburgh and supported by a dedicated workforce of approximately 350 individuals, Business Stream offers a comprehensive suite of services. These include precise metering and billing, water efficiency support, and innovative water and waste water management solutions. Our forward-thinking approach, coupled with a passion for creating positive impacts, extends beyond mere business transactions. We actively contribute to our customers' success, uplift our employees, engage with local communities, and foster environmental stewardship. Our track record of achievements is impressive, having delivered over £367 million in discounts and efficiencies, reduced water consumption by a staggering 62.7 billion litres, mitigated 3 million kilograms of CO2 emissions, and maintained an average call response time of just 77 seconds. You can find out more about how we’re Naturally Different by visiting our website at business-stream.co.uk. Here, you'll discover how we are 'Naturally Different,' encapsulating not just our extensive industry expertise but also our innovative spirit and unwavering commitment to making a meaningful difference.

description:
Your Business.Our Priority.
We’re a leading water and wastewater retailer supporting over 150,000 business customer accounts across the UK. As the trading brand of Pennon Water Services Ltd—a Joint Venture between Pennon Group Plc and South Staffordshire Plc—we bring over 25 years of expertise in water, wastewater and trade effluent management. 
We simplify water for businesses of all sizes, ensuring they only pay for what they use, with no upfront payments, offering fixed retail tariffs to guard against inflation.
Our services include expert advice on water efficiency, leakage, and contingency, all designed to help businesses save water, money, and time.
Customer satisfaction is our top priority, and our high ratings on Trustpilot reflect our commitment to delivering value, expertise, and simplicity.
Switching to Source for Business is straightforward and hassle-free. Whether you're changing providers or reviewing your current contract, we're here to support you every step of the way.

records.title: "Source for Business" - a nightmare to deal with
records.text: Our contract with "Source for Business" was effective from 29th January 2019. As a commercial laundry we are a relatively large user of water with a trade effluent consent in place, and need to have a monthly invoice in order to show water costs in our monthly accounts.Despite a number of emails and phone calls to our dedicated account manager we did not receive a trade effluent bill until late July. When we received a bill for the water supplied it vastly underestimated the water used despite me having supplied meter readings, and also applied sewerage charges although the supply is used exclusively for laundry processing. I again contacted "Source for Business" pointing out the error and requesting a corrected bill. This did not arrive but instead we received a reminder notice after which I again contacted "Source for Business".  We then received a Disconnection Notice. The amount shown as owed on the reminder and disconnection notices was  overstated by roughly £12,000 and presumably incorrectly included sewerage charges.I then made a phone call to South West Water Business and spoke to your customer service assistant Veronica. Finally some progress! Veronica quickly grasped what the problem was, and promised to contact the "Source for Business" account manager and to report back to me. This was done and I have since been contacted by phone and email by Veronica's colleague Matt, who has undertaken to arrange for a correct invoice to be issued and to keep in contact until the matter is resolved.While writing I would like to comment that the time taken for phone calls to be answered is unacceptably long, with a 20 minute wait being common. The music on hold is a dirge. After listening for 10 minutes I had lost the will to live.

The call back never happened, instead I received an email the following day.All I am trying to get from them is copies of a revised invoice and credit note as these are creating a difference to the balance we have on our company account. These are not available through our online account and were only found by gaining a statement of account from them, detailing all the transactions on the account, two pages worth, for what amounts to four bills, but several withdrawn invoices and revised invoices have been created, ( of which most have not been received), causing us hours of work in trying to reconcile or make any sense of.How can a company operate like this.  It's very concerning when this is happening in a company of this size.

records.title: Unacceptably long delay
records.text: Unacceptably long delay before answering calls on every occasion I have called the call centre.

records.title: Really poor systems and customer service
records.text: I've just gone through the contract renewal process with this company and found their service to be no better than poor.Firstly, they sent me a renewal quote showing a negative saving to be made.  I tried to phone to query this, but gave up waiting on hold after an age.(I've never yet got anyone to answer the phone to me). I sent an email, and got an automated response saying they would respond within 10 - yes 10 - days.  Then received an updated quote, but with no instructions on how to respond.  I queried this by email, another 10-day response email, then a reply (not the least apologetic) telling me to scan and email or post the document back.  The really irritating thing is that I then remembered going round exactly the same loop last year - they haven't bothered to fix it.All these things sound like minor irritants - but this company doesn't make anything, doesn't have to ship anything - all they do is issue paperwork and respond to cistomers - so I'd expect their customer service rating to be 5 out of 5.Which leads me on to their Trustpilot rating.  The company letterhead shows a rating of 3.7....but magically, on Trustpilot (prior to my review) they have a rating of 5.  What happened to the unfavourable reviews?  And how long will this one continue to appear?

records.title: website seems impossible to get on and…
records.text: website seems impossible to get on and then they send threatening emails and texts
