records.title: Very professional engineer great service
records.text: The engineer that came out to clear our blockage .  (Case 00909943) Was very professional he clearly explained the cause of the block and told me what will be done to resolve it.   A great ambassador for your company !

records.title: I recently had a call with Mannan Khan…
records.text: I recently had a call with Mannan Khan from customer service and I wanted to share that the service was exceptional in addressing all my queries. This is my first time moving into my own place and I wasn’t sure how to set up the bills or what steps were involved. Mannan took the time to clearly explain the entire process and helped me set up my account. I truly appreciate his patience and the clarity he provided.

records.title: Communication with Thames Water
records.text: I have had ongoing problems with Thames Water about a high metered bill when they eventually found out l actually had no meter in place.It has been really upsetting getting put on hold, not getting through or being given misinformation about the situation regarding  my overpayment.Thankfully Thames Water customer service staff called Jessica and Alice have been really helpful, patient and respectful towards me even when l have been upset.  I spoke to Alice on Friday afternoon and as promised she called me back today without me having to make contact. l now have a clear explanation of the up-to-date status of my  case. I have been informed it is with the management team who will be working out  how much of a refund l should receive.It has been a really stressful experience with Thames Water and l was ready to blast them, however my contact with the above named staff along with a manager called Michelle has been really helpful. They were proactive around resolution, positive customer satisfaction and unlike others represented Thames Water in a professional and caring manner. I can now go into the holiday season without worrying about my metered water bill or if l will get a refund.

records.title: I had sam cooke fit the water meter
records.text: I had sam cooke fit the water meter. And he was good at explaining things have me extra advise on the water in my flat. Abd was quick with the job. Had good and quick team in customer service get everything booked in. I used the web chat which was quick easy and convenient. So hopefully everything goes well with the meter

records.title: Excellent
records.text: I would like to thank you to thameswater and there customer service team members who helped me toward my bills it’s always great and make you you happy that there’s still people out there who care and support people like us with medical problems and helped them.Thank you Thames water

records.title: Happy customer
records.text: I've been with Thames Water for 2.5 years and absolutely nothing to complain about. After I moved into the property I called TW to have a water meter installed, which was done within a few weeks and what I had overpaid until such time the meter got installed was refunded. At the time of the installation the engineer cared enough to show me where the main tap to the property was which a few months later came incredibly useful when a pipe burst. Now I'm moving out of the property and the process to close the account couldn't be easier, it's all online and no meter reading has to be provided (because as it turns out the meter is a smart one).

records.title: Above and beyond
records.text: I contacted TW for a blocked sewage/waste pipe at 5.15pm, having tried to jet blast it myself. Standard reply of a 3 day turnaround, and it wasn’t super urgent, as I was the first in the pipeline. Imagine my surprise when I got a subsequent message to say that engineers would arrive by 8pm, which they did, and the pipe was cleared by 9.45. Thank you TW, especially Ryan and Nicky

records.title: I recently had reason to call out…
records.text: I recently had reason to call out Thames Water to look at my inspection chamber (as requested by a surveyor )I called them 1.30pm on 21/11, the chap I spoke to was very helpful and assured me that someone would be out within 72 hours. 2hrs later they were on my doorstep. 2 nice chaps and to my delight they found nothing wrong .I can’t fault the service, well done!!!!

records.title: My sewer drains were completely blocked…
records.text: My sewer drains were completely blocked and overflowing and reported online - within 3 hours the team of 3 showed up and worked relentlessly for over an hour to sort out the blockage. This included checking the manholes all up and down the road as well as my neighbours. Really polite and professional, and managed to get  it all sorted in just over an hour. Very grateful and brilliant example of great customer service. Case number 00829279 - just wanted to say a huge thank you.

records.title: I am so impressed with efficiency of…
records.text: I am so impressed with efficiency of Thames Water, I reported a blocked drain at 9 am, at 2 pm a lovely man Joe turned up, he was so professional, efficient and has latest equipment ( camera).Thank you very much!!!

records.title: Plain and ordinary water supplier
records.text: I used Thameswater for two years while renting in London. Just plain and ordinary paying water bills and the supply is what you'd expect.While I was moving out, the system got confused because the direct debit was cancelled. I called the customer service and they pulled out my account information immediately and answered all my questions clearly, which was pretty nice.

records.title: I set up my water bill and I was…
records.text: I set up my water bill and I was shocked on the amount they wanted every month. My monthly bills have risen so much it's really hard. I spoke to a kind gentlemen BIDHAN. He was so kind and patient. I went on and vented alot. He was so informative and explained everything to me and luckily I am so broke I am entitled to some discounts, I still feel the amount is to much, but he made me feel listened to. I am also hopefully getting a meter. Thank you so much Louise

records.title: Improved Efforts After Initial Frustration
records.text: Updated: Following my earlier concerns about Thames Water’s communication and proposed water meter installation, I’m pleased to say their complaints team has been proactive and responsive. They acknowledged my issues, provided clear assurances, and are exploring alternative solutions to avoid disruption to my property.While the initial contact system was frustrating, their efforts to resolve my complaint have been appreciated.--------------------Thames Water’s contact system is absolutely dreadful. After receiving a letter regarding the proposed installation of a water meter at my property, I needed to respond in writing to address my concerns. Shockingly, there is no way to communicate via email to reply to their letter, which is completely unacceptable for matters that require written documentation.Their insistence on using WhatsApp or phone calls for communication feels deliberately obstructive, as these methods are unsuitable for addressing complex issues like this. For a company handling such critical infrastructure, the lack of a simple and effective email contact option is deeply frustrating and unprofessional.Please improve your communication options for customers who require written exchanges to address important property matters!

records.title: Great customer service on the phone
records.text: I have been with Thames Water for almost 6 years now and I have had a very positive experience with them. My payments have all been taken on time and are very reasonable priced. I called Thame's Water today and spoke to Marielle who helped me with my query. She was very helpful and professional.

records.title: Water pipe leak in the kitchen…
records.text: We had a terrible issue recently regarding the water  pipe leak in our kitchen  and the whole kitchen was flooded, at first Thames water didn't help much on it ..but later on very next day .. Mr.Shaun came to the property in person and helped us he was really a  great help.Thank you.

records.title: Sewage blockage
records.text: We live in a victorian semi with shared water / sewage pipework . Discovered that sewage was leaking from the inspection  chamber on our front driveway & immediately contacted Thames Water to report the incident.Was dealt with effectively over the phone initially & a bit later when I called to check progress. Received a text to advise drainage guy was on his way a few hours later & the situation was resolved within about  20 minutes  by the friendly Thames Water operative .Very satisfied with the way everything was handled .Well done Thames Water !

records.title: I would like to dispute a charge raised…
records.text: I would like to dispute a charge raised by Thames Water. During the time I was living in the property, there was a water leakage that went unnoticed for months. I reported the issue to Thames Water and subsequently moved out of the property. Despite always paying my water bill on time, the final bill I have been charged is outrageous. I have set up a payment plan to give me time to dispute the issue, but it was not set up correctly, and I received a collection notice. I was notified to contact the collection agency, and they told me that Thames Water had retracted the collection. Right now, I just want to know if anyone could investigate this matter. I only lived in that property for a few months as a single person, so the bill is obviously overcharged. I am trying to dispute the amount and would appreciate any advice on how to take this matter further.

records.title: waste water…
records.text: I logged a call due to waste water flowing from a drain cover Friday afternoon.In less than 7 hours, the team had cleared and cleaned up the problem.Much appreciated.

records.title: Professional, helpful experience.
records.text: I had such a good experience with Thames Water recently and thought they deserved a good review. A neighbour had a blocked drain and my house insurance sent a private contractor to my house to look at it. He  then caused sewage to come up in my house. Thames Water came out and also sent an engineer to try to help me. They gave me advice on how to clear the room of sewage smells and wrote a report to back me up with my house insurance. They also double checked the drains to ensure it was all genuinely cleared.  They were with me for a long time and seemed to really care. I am really grateful to them as my house insurance were very uncaring by contrast and my house now smells clean again. Both men who came from TW were so professional and helpful.

records.title: Flood cleanup excellent but the flood should not have happened!
records.text: OK this is a mixed review good and bad. Last week our warehouse and yard was flooded, along with large parts of the area of Thamesmead, Abbey Wood and Plumstead. This flood should not have happened at all. It was caused by a brief period of heavy rain which backup up the main Southern Outfall Sewer all the way from the Crossness pumping station to Plumstead. According to what the man from Thames Water told me, there is a person in the Control Room at Crossness and he chose not to  release the backed up sewage water into the Thames with the result that the whole area flooded. Municipal water supply companies get castigated and fined when they release sewage into rivers, so instead of dumping sewage into the sea they decided to dump it into the streets of London.But I can say that the response of Thames Water to our flood has been pretty good. They sent a team of their own to clean up our yard which was covered in a layer of mud and waste the next day. That team did not have time to finish so they paid for a  private contractor came in to complete the job a few days later and our yard now looks better than it did before the flood.So in summary this should never have happened, but after it did I think Thames did quite a good job of helping us to clean up and also very good communications with us.

records.title: No existance customer service !!
records.text: Again, our Thames water bill has an issue.We well understand all water companies need to raise their price, and apparently 12.1% up for Thames water un-metered account. However, our new yearly bill shows 34% up!! Although we are trying to enquire about it via their chat (only way I found to contact them), their Indian agent can’t understand what is the point of our issue at all, totally wasting our time.Found tel help line and tried on Monday, again Indian agent who speaks very unclear English occupied me over 40 minutes without any understanding of the point. Why do you use these useless agents!!This is the second time to write here about their problem. We can’t get their proper attention without Trustpilot…. The Worst Company.Follow up 13/02/24: 1 day after from their reply below, one lady called me from TW to discuss about our issue.She clearly understood and explained the history of our issue.We have been getting reduced charge after the previous overcharged issue (which was not clearly explained at that time), and the term is ending, as well as raising the price happened at the same time, this made 34% up.At last, we discussed in proper conversation, fully understood the situation and happily accepted that.We appreciate that, although this should happen on the first stage of their customer service …I updated 1 star to 4 star, purely to praise the customer service lady who has really valued communication skills. Thames Water should set their customer service standard on her.

records.title: Updated review : This company has been ripping us off…
records.text: I would like to update everyone who has read my bad review about Thames Water. I got in contact with Thames Water today July 6, 2023  and finally the issues were fixed. New meter was installed, a manager named "Hayley"rang me and she has taken the current reading on the new meter, then she has done a manual adjustments and calculated the discrepancies and it took our account into credit and we are due a refund. So I am truly relieved that this problem is resolved now. It's been a pain and now it's resolved I'm happy---------------------------------This company has been ripping us off for years. We moved to this flat in 2016 we got our bill as normal. Then we decided to just wash our clothes to a laundrette to see if it can lower our water bill  because it increases every 6 months. we were most of the time not at home because we both work and we go on holidays every year and leaves the property for like 3 to 4 weeks.. But instead the bill went up each time. We contacted them to ask about the meter where is it and they gave us the meter location, but found nothing. We pay a ridiculous amount of £40, £50 a month in the past years and this year £99. Because they estimated our future water consumption. Load of lies  because they say we have a meter but if we do why do  they need to estimate. My friends and even other people say their bill a month for a household of 5 was just £23.Cut story short, we insisted on having a meter checked until they sent not 1 but 2 engineers to check. But both of them found nothing. Meaning our bill was obviously based on Assessed household charge. No meter or maybe imaginary one. Estimated bill every year. Now they fitted a meter on June 7, 2023 and  in 3 weeks that we wash clothes at home 3 times a week our consumption was just 5.920 cubic meters and it's just £13.48. The date of experience indicated in this review was when we followed up with Thames through whatsapp messaging to ask for an engineer to come over to show us the meter because they failed to send one in 2020 because of covid restrictions but we have been going in circles with them since 2019.

records.title: Online offshore chat service worse than…
records.text: Online offshore chat service worse than 100% useless, over an hour failing to resolve a very simple subject, TW are very unwise not to just close it down. Then tel'd (bit of a delay) and spoke to extremely helpful person in Reading who quickly & efficiently sorted things. My usual interaction with Thames W has been extremely good.

records.title: Initial problems resolved very well by complaints team
records.text: Edit: I made a complaint and it was dealt with perfectly. They sent someone to do a second reading, and from that calculated that we use 270 litres per day and so restated the original estimate. Initial bill was adjusted down to £20 from £60.Original: I received my first bill after 25 days in my new house. 23 cubic meters of water (23,000 litres) for two people. In our previous house we used 51 cubic meters in 6 months. I called to discuss the fact that the initial estimate is obviously wrong.One of the most unfriendly customer service agents I've ever spoken to told me that it's all my fault for not submitting a reading when I moved in. Well, there are several meters at the front of the property and none of them say 'Flat A' so I couldn't have done.In the background her colleagues were shouting and laughing. Sometimes I could barely hear her. So unprofessional.

records.title: Poor Direct Debit plan, good customer service.
records.text: The customer service is very helpful. There was a water emergency, I had no water at the property. I was lucky enough to have an engineer to resolve the emergency at 1030 pm due to late local engineering works around the local area.Billing wise, the instalment plan for direct debit is terrible. My usage is £300 per year, they setup a monthly plan costing £576 a year. That's 76% more than what I required to pay. Crazy!

records.title: Just spoke with Karl who helped me…
records.text: Just spoke with Karl who helped me resolved my no water supply issue within an hour. The engineer I must say should give notice! But Karl was amazing. Thank you

records.title: The black sheep (in a good way!)
records.text: I have recently been moving house, and have needed to cancel many of my bills. Some companies demand you call and wait in a long queue. Others force you to cancel only after you've moved out, so you can't pre-plan and you always overpay. Some even require you to explicitly claim your refund afterwards (seriously TV Licencing - what is wrong with you?). Others charge bizarre cancellation fees out of nowhere.Therefore, it was a breath of fresh air to be able to just fill in an online form for a month in the future and have my final bill calculated in days. Fair. Simple. Easy. Thames Water were the only company to make my move simple.Nevertheless, I am detracting one star because they are a monopoly. Who knows if what I paid on my bill was fair. It was my only option.

records.title: The right attitude can make all the…
records.text: The right attitude can make all the difference.Today I received a bill from Thames water. I was fuming. It is £2 short of double my previous monthly charge. I wanted answers.I called in obviously confused and concerned. I spoke to an agent who completely humbled me. I think his name was Richard (not completely sure). He was brilliant. I felt genuine care through the phone. He was thorough, kind and extremely patient. Nothing was a problem. He went above and beyond to put my mind at rest, and that he did. He put the biggest smile on my face. He is a true diamond. I just had to write about it because it was such a rare experience. I have never had customer service like that. Thames water - thank him, because he made me add stars to the review.

records.title: More than a month to still not resolve my query.
records.text: I reported a possible issue in July, namely that my recorded water usage was approx. 3.5 times what I should expect according to OFWAT and requested a conversation or an engineer to come out and check.I never managed to get through to this company and had to resort to leaving a message via their website - no reply for weeks.This morning, about a month and a half later, I received a voicemail from Thames Water, saying they assumed my query had been resolved, and to contact them again if I still had a concern. I.e. back to square one.Completely unacceptable lack of customer service.UPDATE: In my latest dealings with Thames Water, it seems that this company has invested in better communications with its customers, which was a relief. Well done for bringing about improvement, so I've updated the rating I gave this company from 1* to 4*.

records.title: Received a call from UK customer service rep (update! issue resolved)
records.text: updated:i left an online feedback form asking for a representative from the UK to contact me.  next day i received a call from a rep who was extremely helpful! and another who was also really helpful and was a fountain of knowledge.  it really beats the poor service we get from overseas call centres who don't have the same passion...  utility infrastructure companies should not be outsourcing their customer services abroad in my opinion. it might be ok for certain non critical businesses but NOT for critical ones.  tried to set up water sure scheme for over a year now... the useless customer service agents are so incompetent!  I've never seen such a mess!  please bring this customer service center back to the UK!  i still haven't had my issue resolved because they keep cutting me off every time they can't answer a simple question....i have no idea who to contact

records.title: I have been with Thames water more than…
records.text: I have been with Thames water close to ten years,I might switch to another water supply ,can anyone recommend water supply compay for me please ,bills given to me is high where i live in one bedroom flat with only my wife.i don't know maybe the meter has been checked,we don't use much water in the flat,how come am paying higher bills.

records.title: High bill 2024
records.text: Hi, I was wondering how it is possible that my bill increases more than 50% from 47 per month to 100 per month and in the household we always have the same people, 2 adults and 2 kids under 6 years old. I saw from the estimated meter reading pdf that from 17th of January 2023  to 1st of March 2024 I used more than 85m3 of water per month and from 1st of March 2024 to 30th of March only 18m3 this time was not estimated meter reading but I took it manually. I contacted the customer service by chat, but they do not understand my point, first the estimated meter reading  does not  match with the manual reading if  we compare with previous month from 17th January to 1st of March and second the increase of more than 50%.Thanks

records.title: no financial help
records.text: they read my water meter out front without asking me or telling me at time they were there, says it higher suspect leak, but wont call anyone out. Im a council tenant, looking for work, very little money. Making my anxiety very bad, no sleep and more stress. They won't reduce any the bill I asked due to previous hidden leak end 2021. They won't put me on the social tariff or other tariff to help me out.

records.title: Shocked to have a good experience
records.text: I too have been through hell with Thames in the past (they were supposed to fit a meter,  but screwed up, connected it to my neighbours pipes and billed me!)BUT they seem to be trying to do better.I dealt with a very polite and well spoken man in the Priority Services dept and was pleasantly surprised,  especially after many dreadful experiences in the past.Granted,  the automated phone service will give you ten kinds of ear cancer, but if you persevere and actually get hold of someone, it may not be as bad as you think.

records.title: Good and bad comments
records.text: I'm giving three stars as an averaging out of my experience.Bad points: It takes forever to get through on the phone. I gave up one day after well over an hour. And typing in all your answers for that AI phonebot is pointless because you are asked all the same questions again once you finally get to speak to a human being. As for the The Whatsapp Chatbot - what an utter waste of time. Good points: When I finally got through, my situation was dealt with efficiently, and I was quickly passed on to the bereavement team - clearly British based, without the communication issues flagged up by some other reviewers. I felt the account closure was conducted successfully - (I shall await my confirmation letter and refund cheque in the post....)

records.title: Difficult to claim reimbursement for leakage
records.text: What I liked: we had a leak. Thames Water turned up on the date they said they would turn up and fixed the leak.What I disliked: (1) several weeks' wait for the leak-repair appointment. (2) We received a letter telling us to ring 0800 9808 800 because "you may be able to claim a leakage allowance". The letter did not give any other option for claiming a leak allowance. We rang the number. Despite trying all the options, there was not one option relevant to claiming a leakage allowance. So, I suppose, we will not be receiving a reimbursement. Account number 14359-36432.Update: after trying many different numerical options on the phone to Thames Water, I *did* get to speak to a human. She told me to complete and submit a leak report form online (why didn't the letter Thames Water sent me tell me that?) I will update this entry in due course.

records.title: Direct debit closed by company before taking final payment
records.text: After moving out of the flat I was renting I received my final bill which states:“As you pay with direct debit we’ll take your final payment in the same way”The company decided not to take the payment on the date shown on the bill and to cancel my direct debit the month after. That had a negative impact on my credit score, it did not show as a missed payment but as a closed account with outstanding balance.A day after leaving this review I was contacted by a very helpful lady (unlike my experience with the online chat) who explained that this should clear within a month and what to do if it doesn’t.Thanks

records.title: Utterly hopeless service
records.text: We are in a 1-bedroom Victorian conversion flat which doesn't have enough pipe space for a meter. Their engineer came and confirmed it. Then Thames water send us an estimated bill for “2-bedrooms”.We call them and after waiting over 20 min to speak a human, the operator lady promised to amend it and sending a new postal confirmation in 5 -10 working days. After 10 working days, nothing came.We called them again with 20 min waste of time, then promised confirmation in 5 working days, it’s now, but still no sign.Do we need to call Thames water every week with our 20 min waste forever?Utterly hopeless service. If it was an energy company definitely, I want to swich to the other company. Customers can’t choose the water provider; therefore, their service doesn’t have competitive seriousness. Disgusting…Follow up 25/09/2023:  We supplied our details via Trustpilot following their request.Then, in 4 days, our bill was amended correctly to one-bedroom flat, we got a notification email and a small compensation credit for our inconvenience.We appreciate for that, although it should be done without Trustpilot’s influence…Therefore, we amend our review to 3 stars.

records.title: Ageist policies and a website that doesn't work properly!
records.text: I attempted to ring this company to notify them that an elderly customer (my dad) had died. The respondent asked if I was set up on the account to make changes. I pointed out that the account holder could not tell them he had died. The line went dead. I thought that as my father would not have set-up an online account, I could and update the details that way. I set an account up, but couldn't amend the title to "Executor". Tried to use the online "Talk to us", but after completing all the form presented found the send button was disabled; Extremely frustrating and I wonder how many of their elderly customers use facebook or twitter to communicate with them; A very Ageist policy not to allow emails!Very poor customer service'30 March 2023You'll see the reply of 21st March from Thames Water and I thought it looked good and sent all my details as requested............. Nothing.  They're still sending emails for my deceased dad to my email address; presumably the individual who replied had good intentions, but the system they use is inadequate.4 April 2023Rang me to talk through my experiences and acknowledged that the website needed some updating. Gave me significant confidence, that changes will be made; These won't occur overnight, but the replies I was given certainly showed that the individual I was speaking to was genuinely listening and keen to improve my experience. Hence I've now upgraded my experience to 3/5.

records.title: Customer support useless, 0 user friendly infrastructure, irresponsible engineer
records.text: I recently moved in to a flat, submitted a form to tell them that I moved in. No response after 3 weeks. Contacted their support via phone and via online chat and WhatsApp, the support couldn’t tell me the last time when the meter reading took place or what the number was, their meter installed at a place only reachable by their own engineer. After 1 hour the support stopped responding me and didn’t get me an account.After reading some reviews here, I now see that the support tried to lure me into going with their estimations as they don’t have the meter reading when the previous tenant moved out. What a shame.Update: I am routed to another support, still having a conversation but this one is more knowledgeable.

records.title: Can't login
records.text: I tried a few times this week to log into my account to view the bills. The website keeps crashing I couldn't login at all. I remembered exactly the same bad experience in April this year. Not possible to log into my account. The problem is still not fixed after nearly 6 months! Very frustrating. After my post in one week, Thames water now replied to me suggesting getting in touch with them to get help. I tried to login again today their website seems working now.

records.title: Improve problem handling by phone
records.text: Good response when reporting a problem using messenger via Facebook. No response prior when trying to use the phone to report the problem. This is not good enough when there is a large ageing population in this country who do not use social media. Lack of water in part of the village sorted 4-5 hours once reported.

records.title: Pretty poor telephone system.
records.text: Pretty poor! Telephone system could not recognise my pronunciation (I’m English, British). When put on hold, music blared out of the receiver at high volume (I needed to hold it away from my ear!). Admittedly, the kind employee did resolve matters for me but it was all a bit of a waste of time really...

records.title: This is a very difficult company to…
records.text: This is a very difficult company to reach and when you do get through the staff seem to have no idea about service. Your automated voice service is rubbish, your live chat is not much better and when I called and waiting for 15 minutes to speak to someone I then get cut off.............Since I posted this review Millie from Thames Water has responded to me and taken on board my complaint and are working to rectify matters, they will use my complaint to implement further training where required and I appreciate them working to make amends.

records.title: Meter in my living room why??
records.text: Why is my meter in my living room, it would be easier to read out in the road like the rest of the street.Came today to read meter no covering for his boots so I  refused and that will happen every time.I'm a council tenant so why should I have to pay for the meter to be moved.

records.title: This is one of the most disorganised…
records.text: This is one of the most disorganised companies I have ever dealt with. Things have never been the same since they installed their new online account service. No pattern to their meter readings and subsequent billing. Supposed to be twice a year but just received one after 120 days.

records.title: OK OK
records.text: I left a 'poor' review on 1st march. Within days I was contacted by an excellent customer service rep who went a long way to make things right. All issues now resolved. Thanks 👍

records.title: I have recieved an answer from Thames…
records.text: I have recieved an answer from Thames water regarding more information on my complaint, I was unseccfull in replying due to an internet problem, so I am replying here, our problem with our sewage system it blocks every few months and asked Thames water to please come and investigate the situation further as to why the sewage line blocks so often, it’s so bad we thinking of selling our house which is unfair because we’ve been in our house for 22years now and we love this house, so please Thames water come and please investigate further, I have now given you 2 extra stars for contacting me and wanting more information which I have now given, however youre colleague told me a thorough investigation will be carried out when they came to unblock it, but it was not carried out

records.title: I am astounded that Thames Water has…
records.text: I am astounded that Thames Water has managed to mess up their billing. I have been trying to talk to them for days without success and the online chat has been been unable to sort out my billing issue. I logged online and found my address and account were not for my actual address. I have been trying to get this sorted with them without success.I have spoken to Thames Water and in principle they are sorting out my problem. Once I see they have done, so I will review the rating again.Waited to see if they would sort things out as agreed. They didn't.Finally sorted. I do believe there was good faith in getting this sorted, but it took so long to happen.

records.title: Good customer service
records.text: I like the fact that you can get through to real people.  And when our drains flooded they were out quickly.  On the bad side we have had 4 leaks on our road for about a year - they have been told and still water is on the road.

records.title: Faulty meter led to a bill for £4000
records.text: Faulty meter led to a bill for £4000. It took numerous calls and emails to resolve this, and before they would even look at it I had to pay for a plumber to inspect my home and provide a letter saying there were no leaks. In the end, based on this, TW did issue a substantial refund but I doubt I would have got anywhere without perseverance and a feisty attitude. I feel for the old and vulnerable who might not be able to do this.

records.title: Computer says no
records.text: Just wanted to swap the additional account holder (wife) with the primary account holder (husband). Simple? Computer says no. “Only way” to do it is to shut the whole account and start again. Absolutely bonkers. …nice enough chap on phone though, and feel bad for laughing out loud at him, so 2 stars.

records.title: Understanding Billing
records.text: I think it's only fair to have free water meters or something like that in all homes so it's understandable how bills are worked out. Judging what amount of water might be used in a 3-bed house or flat and basing a water bill on the number of occupants in residence can't be an accurate reading, initially. I believe I mentioned before as an illustration, some pensioners living alone in a family home have been found to use very little water to wash or cook, yet a bill can be high.

records.title: Poor communication
records.text: Every year the cost-per-unit goes up but we never get an email about this. No one in the 'help' centre can tell me how I can get emails from Thames Water every time they put their charges up.UPDATE 6 February 2024Follow-up from the response below. I am not questioning whether the changes are agreed with Ofwat or not and the response below still does not answer the question. My banks, energy suppliers and credit cards write to me each time charges and rates change; I don't understand why Thames Water does not do this.

records.title: Water Meter and Website.
records.text: They installed a meter a while ago for comparison but would switch me over in Oct 24 whether I agreed or not.   Just gone onto the website thinking I could set up a switch to metered on the 1st April.  One click and it just accepts it without asking any questions.   What website allows you just one click before you commit?  Appalling duplicity by Thames. Telephoned to say I did not want to be switched until 1st April as what is the point so close to the end of the accounting year.  The person on the phone tried to help but unfortunately their call centre is abroad and they never seem to have access the full account.

records.title: What happened to communication?
records.text: Thameswater reported a major leak on the Basingstoke Road, Reading last night resulting in low water pressure and possibly no water at all in our area. Went onto the website this morning to get an update: not mentioned at all. Did it happen? Rotten communication.Have read the reply from Thameswater. The issue was not one of the main having burst and it’s repair, rather the lack of effective communication which I thought was clear in my initial review.

records.title: Communication
records.text: I have been in touch with Thames Water for two days.In summary, the cost of water on my unmetered property doubled. There were no changes or works happening or happened at my property.I have tried and failed to get the reason for this 100% increase.I don't think it unreasonable to wish to know the reason for this increase.I have gone round and round in circles using the contact method recommended by Thames Water themselves.I have modified my review as I made contact with a very efficient, helpful and dilligent Thames Water contact.I had an response from Thames Water which I thought was encouraging. However it's now clear that the message was just an automated message.Thames Water seems not to be interested in learning from complaint's.

records.title: Want to speak to someone at Thames Water Good Luck!
records.text: Want to speak to someone at Thames Water? Good luck with that. Perhaps I kept selecting the wrong options but I definitely got the feeling that they didn't want to speak to me. All I wanted was an option that said press 6 to speak to someone. Fed up with receiving estimated bills which meant that our payments kept creeping up I stuck my head down the meter hole to take my own reading and then attempted to contact them. After numerous combinations of options I fell silent and it eventually put me in the queue which gave me a chance to write my review. To be fair when I did get to speak to someone they were very helpful and our future payments were reduced.

records.title: Meter reader please
records.text: Haven't had the water meter read for three years and feel I'm being overcharged by inaccurate estimates. The meters down a flooded hole in the pavement, not something a 70 year old can read. Send a meter reader.

records.title: Dreadful company but no choice!
records.text: Dreadful company but unfortunately with the current system you do not have a choice who supplies your water.They seem to rely on WhatsApp as their main communication method which is painfully slow, as their customer services email is no longer valid and trying to get through on the phone is almost impossible.It is hardly any wonder this shambles of a company is so far in debt if this is a reflection of how things are run.My only reason for not giving 1 star is that when I did finally manage to corner someone on WhatsApp they were fairly helpful

description:
Calling all business owners and entrepreneurs

Are you looking for a business energy and water supplier that can save you time and money?

We are Yü Energy. We’re here to make your life easier with simpler business utilities so you can focus on running your company because let’s face it, no-one wants to spend hours hunting down the best energy or water deal.

Our multi-utility offer, simple fixed price plans and personal customer service are all in place to make life easier for you. And we’re delighted to offer 100% green, renewable energy..

We are a well-established business energy and water supplier, powering thousands of businesses across a wide range of sectors throughout the UK. From small manufacturing and retail outlets through to world famous sports stadiums such as Trent Bridge Cricket Ground and Bolton Wanderers Football Club.

We also offer 100% clean energy, smart meters, electric vehicle charge points and commercial meter installations. We’re constantly looking for more ways to make life easier for businesses so stay tuned for our latest exciting developments.

We work with you to find the right utility solutions for you and your business.
With a speedy service, competitive prices and dedicated, UK-based relationship managers what’s not to love?

records.title: Really Great customer service
records.text: Really Great customer service. Struggling to get my supply As debt was left by previous tenants guy named Kevin who works as a customer service representative helps me all the way to sort it out. There was issue of billing he(Kevin) explained everything how does billing works on in the end he sorted out everything.

records.title: So far we have had alot of issues since…
records.text: So far we have had alot of issues since we moved to YU Energy. Today, I decided to not to communicate through the broker any longer but call YU Energy directly. Sarindeep was very professional, very pleasant to talk to, she listened carefully, came up with solutions and showed me which direction to take. We are far away from sorting out the issues but it's good to get some assurance and good customer service. Thank you.

records.title: With two business sites to resolve and…
records.text: With two business sites to resolve and number of meters in question, Likhona was patient and well versed with the system and was able to resolve the transfer issues on the portal and also with arranging Smart meter installations. Many thanks

records.title: Andra was briliant in sorting out the…
records.text: Andra was briliant in sorting out the movers form. She went above and beyond to help us, and also called me back to give an update via phone and email. Very effiicient and smooth service.

records.title: Evie - great customer service
records.text: Evie, as well as taking our meter readings, also sorted an ongoing issue that we've had for months. We were not able to access our online account and this is finally resolved. Each other person I spoke to said they would send an email to IT, but nothing changed. Evie took the time to look into the issue and resolved it during the message. Excellent service. Thank you

records.title: Spoken with Natasha to resolve account…
records.text: Spoken with Natasha to resolve account issues on the customer portal. Very efficient & courteous service. Problem immediately dealt with & account back in order. Relief to have been served by someone who understood the issue & was able to deliver immediate results.

records.title: Natasha did a great job today for me.
records.text: Natasha did a great job today for me.She is professional and quite nice to solve my problems. set up my direct debit which aimed to avoid delay payments in the future as I am going on a holiday.

records.title: Quick response and resolved my issued…
records.text: Quick response and resolved my issued promptly and profesionally.  Very happy with the service received, thank you.

records.title: quick and easy to register my initial…
records.text: quick and easy to register my initial meter reading(s) and find out information about the portal

records.title: Natasha B was very helpful in resolving…
records.text: Natasha B was very helpful in resolving and raising a complaint about a few discrepancies we had with our commercial electricity bills. I'm glad to see Yu Energy is taking steps to hire and train staff well in customer service. Very pleased.

records.title: Clear and professional service
records.text: Dealt with by Bobbie who was personable, friendly and sympathetic to the needs of the small business requirement. She provided very useful information which helped me sign on the dotted line.

records.title: New customer, two meters
records.text: Nothing on the website registration or introductory blizzard of emails stated that I would not be able to have two accounts on one registration. It takes IT intervention.Nothing in the account titles helps me distinguish between the Church Hall and the Church.Natasha appears to have been helpful, I will know if the accounts get set up properly.

records.title: Rating is not for Yu Energy but for Ali Bashir.
records.text: This rating is not for Yu Energy but for Ali Bashir who was by far exceptional. Having dealt with 5 other people in Yu Energy who made the right sound but totally forgot about the issued raise as soon as they put the phone down. Ali followed you and persevered till problems were solved. So based on my experience the chance is 1 in 5 in having your issues resolved.

records.title: Problems logging in.
records.text: I was having trouble logging in to my new energy account, so had to telephone the helpline. Natasha was efficient in spotting the problem ( their fault! ) & quickly arranged for it to be fixed, so well done there. Downsides were: long wait ( 20 mins ) to get an agent; foreign call centre, so Natasha's english sometimes difficult to grasp, although my own developing deafness must have contributed a little to this. Overall, did what I needed to do quickly & to a high standard.

records.title: Speedy Sei
records.text: Sei replied very quickly and dealt with my query promptly. My issue/complaint is still unresolved, but he explained that it can take up to 10 working days (raised 14th Nov) and provided an email address for me to reply with the relevant screenshots.

records.title: Great work from Shanaaz for a ring back…
records.text: Great work from Shanaaz for a ring back yesterday!

records.title: Great customer service from Rivaldo
records.text: I find Yu energy very expensive compared to other companies therefore would not recommend them on this basis.However when writing a review based only on the service I received from Rivaldo I found him to be helpful friendly and competent-thank you.

records.title: After a absolute nightmare with my…
records.text: After a absolute nightmare with my final bill and spoken to in a very poor way by advisors I fortunately ended up dealing with a Khalid. Khalids Patiance,understanding and approach was first class, one of the best customer advisors I've ever dealt with.The company would not go far wrong him training staff on how to communicate and deal with customers.Thanks again Khalid.

records.title: Problem resolution
records.text: I found the support to be first class.  The staff were polite and nothing was to much trouble. The only reason for not giving a 5 star rating is that the response to the ticket raised is 2 working days.

records.title: Very helpful so far .
records.text: I called to set up an online account as we are a new customer. Chante explained what we needed to do - however the system showed a technical error which she needs to resolve internally. Hopefully we will be on line in the next few days.

records.title: Leighton was very helpful with the…
records.text: Leighton was very helpful with the change over of tenants at one of our management properties and arranged a temporary 3 month contract.Only 4 stars as I was inundated with requests for smart meters to be installed, even when I had emailed 4 times and spoke on the phone lots of times to say the property was empty so Yu could not get access at the moment but when the new tenant has moved in they will arrange for a smart meter to be fitted and access enabled.  Hopefully now a note has been put on the account and the phone calls stop.

records.title: Kudos to the Complaints Dept
records.text: Once my issues made their way to Meg Smith, they were solved in literally minutes, she has made up for weeks of trying to sort out an issue with other staff.  I'm so impressed with her, you need more staff like her!  Exemplary, really helpful, polite and kind.  Completely turned my view of Yu Energy around.

records.title: Chand was very helpful
records.text: Chand was very helpful, patient and polite, and sorted out my new billing details quickly. I would have given him 5 but I was on hold a long time before I got through to him, that's not his fault though, just a sign of the times, so the overall experience is 4 and a bonus point here to Chand would make a 5!

records.title: Thanks to Arjan Dhesi
records.text: Thanks to Arjan Dhesi, we got our contract renewal sorted out much more quickly this year. He was very  quick to reply to emails and immediately phoned us when we requested a call (we couldn't get through the Yu Energy switchboard direct to him).

records.title: So far so good
records.text: Yu provided a competitive rate and a relatively easy sign up process. I’ll reserve judgement when we finally changeover in a few weeks time.

records.title: Pleasant and helpful utility supplier.
records.text: Bobbie Anderson contacted me by email, text and phone to make my account swap as painless as possible (I was slipping into deemed rates). Considering the saving was mine rather than the supplier's, I was impressed at the tenacity , speed and efficiency of the process.

records.title: it was an easy call to handle
records.text: it was an easy call to handle, just to amend an appointment date. done without fuss

records.title: Once I finally got to speak to an agent…
records.text: Once I finally got to speak to an agent my query was quickly and efficiently resolved

records.title: To be honest it has not always been…
records.text: To be honest it has not always been easy dealing with Yu Energy sometimes seems left hand doesn't know what right hand is doing. But eventually you find someone who takes it on & sees it through...Thank you Karine Zindi

records.title: Nicole was very helpful with what I…
records.text: Nicole was very helpful with what I needed done.  I need help from the tech team which disappointingly can take longer but Nicole was great.

records.title: Tried to submit metre readings on line…
records.text: Tried to submit metre readings on line but no box to insert figures or date of reading, made a call on hold for 45 minutes gave up considering wait time 4 minutes

records.title: Not a great company
records.text: Yuenergy haven't been a great company for us and we are leaving but finally got to talk to  someone who was really helpful.Thank you Khalid if only there were more like you at Yuenergy they might be able to keep their customers.

records.title: Buyer beware
records.text: My dealings with Yu leaves me with 8ndifference.when corresponding,  people have been courteous but useless.Seldom has one attempt at solution has lead to a conclusion.  The bill is needlessly protracted.An inability to read the screen before making a call regarding smart metre. Here Yu are the pits. Stupid and useless.Nil star.When I contradicted a bill, a new one was accurately create.Then the DD  was abused by having 2 payments leave my account.When I complained, nothing was agreed and was told it would take up to 28 days to decide.Nil star.When it came to renewal, I was offered approx 76p/unit.No surprise I left on a 24p quote.When I came to Yu, they were the cheapest. Marks out of 10, ill give 2 for the staffs politeness. After all, they can't help the stupid and useless protocol organised by some delinquent.I expect Yu to disappear in this business world.

records.title: Telephone Enquiry
records.text: Initial feedback obtained regarding gaining access to submit meter readings and the account was useful and the service was good. The only thing that would have been of additional benefit was if your systems allowed your operator access so that they could answer a query on smart meters. Although a telephone number was given it was not possible to talk to anyone as I was cut off.

records.title: It's a funny old world!
records.text: What's the world coming to - I received this 'How did we do?" questionnaire before any other comms from Yu? Call me old fashioned but I thought there might be a 'Welcome' email first. Three Stars, because they were the cheapest 100% renewable tariff my intermediary could find, but they pestered me with their marketing tosh before I've even used one kiloWatt of their juice.

records.title: So far, not so good
records.text: Well, so far, not good.The initial contact was great. I couldn't reach my previous supplier by phone so I found Bionic (broker) on the internet.The documentation was easy, and the rates good.However after I had agreed a date for a smart meter installation I got a message saying they couldn't meet the appointment and the responsibility was mine to contact Yu to rearrange. If I didn't, then the deal was cancelled. When I rang I was told that 'there were no appointments for the foreseeable future (!)Then I got an email asking ME to contact YU (again) because there was a problem with the contract.To be fair they answered the phone within 5 minutes ....Then I got an email saying I had to rearrange the smart meter installation, otherwise my contract was void.........and the contract doesn't start for another month!

records.title: Just switched energy providers
records.text: Just switched energy providers. First impressions not great! Received email saying they were canceling the insulation of the SMART meter,  the email bluntly said it is my responsibility to rebook within the next 25 days to retain my current rates. I switch on the 28th August!

records.title: Phones not answered.
records.text: I had to call YU Energy today as I had been sent an email asking me to arrange an appointment for our smart meter to be installed, otherwise our tariff would be increased.I made an appointment for this last week.I was cut off 4 times in total while holding for someone to answer.  On the 5th call I used the call back service.Morgan phoned me a few minutes later and couldn't have been more helpful.  She apologised for Yu Energy sending the email, confirmed my appointment, put a note on my account and reassured me my tariff would not increase. I would give Morgan 5 stars for her service however, trying to get through to speak to someone was not a good experience.

records.title: The call centre recorded message…
records.text: The call centre recorded message claimed they would open at 9am on Monday but was still playing at 9.30. After finally getting through and sorting out my problem I asked for them to send me new log in details to use the online portal, I recieved the same codes as previously and not surprisingly they did not work. Still waiting to get online!

records.title: Missing Monthly Invoice
records.text: I had to ask for our monthly invoice.  It seems the installation of a smart meter delays matters.  I has taken Yu Energy almost a week to respond to my request but the invoice has finally arrived.

records.title: Faulty and mediocre welcome (not reassuring!)
records.text: Just moved to YU Energy on the basis of the most competitive deal available. Super.  However, before the contract has started I today receive account information and am being encouraged to establish an online account.  But when keying in the account no. that is being informed to me in the initial welcome email, I am being informed that this is not a known account number!  Not a very reassuring start and I am afraid that YU is as bad in their admin processes as most other utility providers I have dealt with.

records.title: It took a long time to get through
records.text: It took a long time to get through to someone who actually helped me. I was cut off several times. I kept being asked by a robot for my account number- which I couldn't give it as that is what i was calling about. I got stuck in a loop doing that for a while.Eventually spoke to Khalid. Who is a rock star. and sorted it all. Thanks Khalid.

records.title: Difficult customer service.
records.text: Found multiple issues with my accounts since I started managing the utility department. Only Axel Eckl seemed helpful after numerous calls, emails and explain the same issue over and over again.After 5 months I am still waiting for resolutions however, I feel more confident that Axel will help me get through them since are not easy problems that happened decades ago.

records.title: Thumbs up to Jake in Customer Success Team
records.text: I have had ongoing concerns with Yu Energy but finally I spoke to a call centre agent who knew what they were doing. Jake was articulate, efficient, intelligent. He recognised my frustrations and actively sought to address them right there and then. He was pro-active in seeking to find lasting solutions and empathetic to my concerns. If only the rest of the call ctr could be so professional and competent.

records.title: Answered the phone reasonably quickly
records.text: Answered the phone reasonably quickly. Established that our acciunt number is not recognised and it needs sorting out with IT. Yet to find out if it is resolved, but chap answering was helpful

records.title: Part good, part bad
records.text: Aderonke helped me with part of my problem and took my meter reading. However not being able to see my account details & submit the meter reading myself had to go to the back office with a potential 2 week waiting time to hear back. That is a long time not being able to login to your account and see the details

records.title: After our conversation with the…
records.text: After our conversation with the representative of Yü Energy I was satisfied that they took the time to discuss my case and put into place a time when we can apply a time to discuss the next step of applying a metre in my premises.i still think that a 12 to 14% charge to apply to a different tariff is not acceptable for not having a smart meter fitted . Even though I do read the metre every month and send it in it seems unfair really to customers that have this issue in there contract Surely this is unacceptable in today society and company’s are are just controlling the market and people to there contracts . Things must change in this situation

records.title: I would love to give 5 stars to the…
records.text: I would love to give 5 stars to the lovely lady (Bethany) that helped save my business by personally dealing with my account. Exploring all options and setting a payment plan up. However the credit team are horrible, and just threaten cutting of your electricity rather than helping you solve the issue.  Again Beth from customer care deserves 5star

records.title: Positive So Far
records.text: Positive so far, a gentleman called Shyam was very easy to deal with and has helped us to establish a contract which won't start until December 2024. Better able to provide a more accurate review after they become our supplier.

records.title: Smart Meter installation errors
records.text: As part of our contract we agreed to a smart meter. We had appointments, one was cancelled the night before on the other 2 times  I waited at the church for 4 hours but no engineer. The second time he arrived 1.5 hours after the agreed time and said he couldn't fit the meter as it was in a cupboard.Clearly he was running late . 2 weeks later the meter was successfully fitted without difficulty by a young lady engineer. We were then charged with a missed appointment charge of £100 . Clearly not our fault but that of an incompetent engineer covering his back for his own inability to work to a time schedule. The charge was eventually removed from the invoice but this has left a very sour taste . The administrator( Saif Irani) who sorted the overcharge and arranged for its removal was excellent and could not be faulted in anyway. He was very pleasant , polite and helpful.

records.title: I didn't really receive much help with…
records.text: I didn't really receive much help with my queries and felt dismissed while I was still asking questions. It seemed like they just wanted to get the rating and close the conversation. Overall, not a great customer service experience so far.

records.title: The Yu Energy website is forever hanging
records.text: The Yu Energy website is forever hanging when you try to look pages like Bill History or the Payment pages, for example.It took a while to get through to an agent on their chat facility.They were helpful in giving me the information I needed, but I could do without the delay when trying to do something so basic

records.title: Every IT system is poor
records.text: It seems every IT system is poor they were calling 3 to 4 times a week to install a smart meter but could not do the work. Now I want one - I can't book one every IT system they have seem slow, out of date and ineffective.

records.title: I'm sure Yu energy will be all it said…
records.text: I'm sure Yu energy will be all it said it would be. But this review is about customer services and the people who man the phones as "advisors" Why are they so RUDE? Dp they think they have the right to be so unprofessional? Today at 12.40 (as a new client) I wanted a rep of YU energy to explain why on their email it says "Send us your meter readings for accurate bills" I was MADE to believe a SMART METER would provide all the readings apparently NOT And the officious female rep I spoke to asking why they needed a readings & what was the point, and to ask about various letter after some figures was simply Unprofessional and RUDE speaking over me at every opportunity. If this is the kind of people they employ it will be another scambles like Delta gas & power! Watch this space.

records.title: Ineffective/inefficient customer…
records.text: Ineffective/inefficient customer services. Welcome email says submit meter readings by email, auto response says you cant. Don't answer phone lines. Probably fine if all works well with their web portal but will likely have issues when things don't work/can't be done via the portal.

records.title: Yu Energy upped price by 2% because we requested the billing address to be changed
records.text: Yu Energy issued contracts for new gas and electric supplies. We had given them the correct billing information, but they had used the registered adress in the billing address field. We asked for this to be updated at 5pm, then contracts were re-issued the next day 2% higher. There was no movement in the wholesale price, no new wars or conflicts. EDF did the same to us last year and we vowed to move as soon as our 1 year fix was up. Like EDF, Yu Energy have lost a 34 supply contract before is has even begun, because of penny-pinching.

records.title: When we talk to Nicole we emphasised…
records.text: When we talk to Nicole we emphasised that we don’t want to terminate our contract and the only reason we did cot was because we advised wrongly. We also said that we don’t want the electricity to be cut off while we sorting this out. Nichole asked me to email her the contract that we had with you which we did. Unfortunately although we were told that the electricity will not be cut off and everything will be sorted by her, nothing got sorted and the electricity was cut off!

records.title: Not great service… the most vague…
records.text: Not great service… the most vague conversation I have had with an advisor ever. “If you try again in a few minutes or a few hours, or later in the week, it may work”. Your smart meter engineer isn’t in the area in June, July, August or September. Let make a non confirmed booking in June and then you can call us back if he doesn’t come… nice enough lady, but not a very useful 40 minutes spent on the phone…

records.title: Church Switch
records.text: We have switched the electricity supply for our church to Yu Energy.  They have offered us a competitive price, fixed for two years.  However, I have now been waiting for over a month for their Welcome Pack and - apparently - I need this to initiate an online account.  I have had several promises that the Welcome Pack is being sent but it still hasn't arrived and now they have gone silent on me.  They offer good prices but poor service.

records.title: Upto now I've only had one phone call…
records.text: Upto now I've only had one phone call from someone who was rude at my concerns around a number I didn't recognise and a snotty email from said person threatening to cancel my contract. I'd have thought they would have been more supportive of businesses being aware of scammers. I tried to register an on line account and the account number they gave me registers as invalid. Its all very rude upto now, the two stars are more for the broker who were good.

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧

records.title: After issues with this company that…
records.text: After issues with this company that have gone on for months, I’m glad to deal with someone (Hans) who’s competence and ability to sort out this mess does him credit. Pity other customer service staff aren’t as good!

records.title: Very helpful support
records.text: Really helpful that a member of staff called me back when I didn't get the answer that I needed from the chatbot. The person I spoke to was patient & very knowledgeable

records.title: Hans was helpful
records.text: Hans was calmly spoken and very helpful.  He explained that my request for someone to show me where my meter was, may be rejected due to a recent read of said meter. But he was a credit to your company.

records.title: My Account issues
records.text: Matt helped sort out my My Account as there had been some issues in gaining access to account info. He stayed on the call to ensure i had access to all my accounts, which was very helpful as i'd already had a call / emails with other with other collegues and the issue wasn't resolved. So pleased we are now back up and running.

records.title: Amazing customer service
records.text: The customer service lady was brilliant. She listened carefully to what was quite a complicated problem that needed solving, involving water meters etc. She was thorough in her investigations, sourced the reason for the problems quickly, emailed me the results so I could see what the issues were. She then raised the necessary requests to have the problems sorted with the engineers and reassured me how and when to get back in touch if things didn't get sorted. Absolutely brilliant. I can't praise her enough!

records.title: They lady who I talked to was extremely…

records.title: Pub Co Ltd

records.title: Setting new account
records.text: I previously managed water bills for two properties under a single account.When the lease for one property expired, it was surrendered back to the landlord,  while I continued occupying the other property with a different landlord,  as it's lease remains active.Fir the past year , I have been in contact with Waterplus customer service to request water bill for the property I am responsible for. Despite ongoing communication,  the issue remains unresolved. This morning,  I spoke to Ms Paula, who listened patiently to my concerns, review my previous email sent to customer service team throughout the year, and sought to understand the full context of the situation. She requested some additional information to pass along to the Site Area Split and Merger team to facilitate the account registration process.I truly appreciate Ms Paula's professionalism and effort in addressing my concerns, unlike some staff who were unable to assist without an account number,  leaving me feeling hopeless. records.title: It has taken 2 years....
records.text: We have been dealing with Waterplus over an issue for almost 2 years. It has taken that long to fix, correct and reimburse our account. It started in January 2021 when Severn Trent (we presume) started doing works out-side our property - nothing in correspondence so we took it as a service project. We then received a letter telling us that a leak had been detected and we are responsible to fix this issue - this we undertook. Whilst fixing this issue it became apparent we now had a different meter in place. This is when the whole 'carry-on' started. No one could verify that we had indeed been installed a new meter - no dates, no information what so ever! In order to claim back money for the burst/lost water we had to clear up this issue (by this point we are £1600.00 out of pocket for fixing the leak). It took us lots of phone calls with no results to establish when/who etc did fit our meter (6 months approx of calling/chasing). Waterplus raised the 'issue' and decided in order to clarify that we had another meter (pictures are not evidence....) that an engineer had to attend to record and document that in fact we had a new meter. Engineer number 1 visited (Aug 22) - we followed this up to be told they could not find his report. Engineer number 2 visited (Nov 22) - we then received an Invoice for one of the visit's (yes - we were being charged!) - which I refuted and an apology was made to us and we were told to ignore it. It then took until Jan 23 when I raised an official complaint for things to actually start happening. It has taken until 15th September 2023 for our account to credited for all the incorrect meter charges and finally a Credit for the lost water - which may I add Severn Trent did not want to give us initially which I challenged. I was assigned a very helpful guy called Josh Dunkley In Jan 23 (when I raised a complaint and ststed I wanted 1 point of contact) at Waterplus who pushed and helped clear up our account. He was very good - he was doing the best with what he had at his disposal and he kept us updated on a regular basis on what/where we were up to. It was then a lady called Debbie Backhouse who helped us finally get our credit for the lost water - she actually contacted Severn Trent on our behalf to also support our case and it helped. I have a job to do at the company I work for and it has taken a lot of my time to get this done. Maybe I should send an Invoice in for my time??  I'm just glad we are now at a stage where the account is correct and I can settle our account. Waterplus you did your best - thank you for persisting and pushing this along.

records.title: Water Supply Upgrade
records.text: We wanted to upgrade our water supply: it has proved enormously frustrating.  It has taken 11 months to finally get everything right.  There have been a litany of issues, not all down to Water-Plus (some were Severn Trent): the billing issues were a sight to behold.  They get there in the end and the complaints process does work (eventually), but you have to be very determined and incredibly patient.  The staff are professional, courteous, and hard-working but are ham-strung by an inflexible script and system.  It must be very difficult to work there.  Customer service staff are not allowed to make decisions and certainly not pragmatic/logical ones that they would like to.  It means that any "exceptions" end up having to be resolved by the complaints team: that's the wrong place if you ask me.  Perhaps managers or senior staff need to be quickly taking more of these decisions, and given the discretion to do so if they are not currently able to.  It could save an enormous amount of time and resource.The good news was that we got there in the end (phew!).
