Would have given 5 stars if Customer Services had responded to my enquiry relating to a Smart meter...wanted to know the physical size to check it would fit in the space available. Sent photos and received confirmation my enquiry had been received a couple on months ago...am still waiting for a response!

records.title: Communication and Energy Bills
records.text: We have mastered communication online, however it is still difficult to speak to a person. Having done so, we can manage our account without too much building up in credit. We do not like the way you present your energy bill as it does not take account of the direct debit payment from the start of the month thereby painting an innacurate fiscal picture.

records.title: Georgia was excellent but if scottish…
records.text: Georgia was excellent but if scottish power send me more texts with messages saying im in debt for over a £100 when i only owe £38 I wont be sending a message saying im leaving. I will just leave your company. I am not concerned over RCM details I get a bill for £50 I owe £50 not £100 please let this be the last time I ask for this practice to be stopped.

records.title: I had already notified Scottish Power I…
records.text: I had already notified Scottish Power I did not my monthly payments reducing as we use more in winter they did this without my concent so I had to go into my account and put the payments back up .I do not want to go into the red over winter.

records.title: Gas smart meter not communicating.  It needs changing to sync both electricity and gas
records.text: Scottish Powers app is a fantastic tool to record and report the meter readings,  but sadly I'm still waiting for an engineer to call to sort out my gas smart meter. I have been in touch over a number of years, but engineers have turned up to fit a smart meter, they try to sync it with no luck. Please check out the Comms box, as it's this is not communicating with the online smart meter system.

records.title: Don't know yet only been few weeks
records.text: Don't know yet only been few weeks. Was confused by email from scot power saying problem transferring for me to contact my supplier which I did. They said no problem. When I then call scot power to inform no probs I was told could not discuss as not yet scot power customer.  Even though scot power sent email. Confused yes. Anyway time will tell.

records.title: Took me 40 mins to sort first time…
records.text: Took me 40 mins to sort first time called ,got cut off,keep telling us to do online ,but unfortunately at 74 we are not used to this ,we need to speak to a person

records.title: Disappointed and feel I am now monitoring my daily use
records.text: I was paying an extra amount to cover extra heating costs during winter months. You have cut these payments back quite considerably and I feel I should have the right to pay what I want.

records.title: Your team are very professional but my…
records.text: Your team are very professional but my query is that I live in an apartment where another resident appears to pay approximately between £75 and £100 per month less for electricity than we do ?? Please help!!

records.title: I joined Scottish Power on 28th…
records.text: I joined Scottish Power on 28th December.  I have yet to receive my paper copy of our agreement as I want to know whether Saturdays and Sundays are charged at a lower rate and if so what hours would it be between.

records.title: We had fitted two new meters for gas…
records.text: We had fitted two new meters for gas and electricity in November with a Smart Meter. The November bill did not include the Electricity bill but this was included in the December bill which meant double the usual amount. At no stage did anyone contact me. However the fitter of the meters was very good.

records.title: Very expensive
records.text: I am a disabled widowed lady, I have a low income and cannot really afford to pay what Scottish power is asking, for my gas heating. I'm now scared to use my heating incase it goes up to more each month 😔

records.title: I recently had z new meter installed…
records.text: I recently had z new meter installed but have z £950 credit which was told by customer service that would be refunded, it's now 6 weeks and no contact from SP , I just want my money repaid but been abandoned.

records.title: I have just joined yourselves and I…
records.text: I have just joined yourselves and I believe my account was due to go live around 28th December. I didn't get an exact date of the change and have sent my meter readings to you and asked if you had received them  to date I have not had a reply to my message. Upon leaving my previous supplier I was in credit with them and I want to know if you have received these credit readings to refund my account. EDF my previous supplier was having difficulties receiving correct, upto date readings and I am worried that this may be the case with yourselves. I don't know whether you can check the smart meter at all to be confident you are receiving correct readings

records.title: Direct debit issue
records.text: Having worked out the annual cost of electric and therefore the monthly cost I wanted to amend the direct debit from 30.26 to 42.43 but this was not allowed as you wanted to change it to 45.00 If I wanted to pay 42.43 I would have to pay 56.43 on an account with a credit balance Why??

records.title: Very bad service
records.text: I have been with Scottish Power for many years.6 weeks ago I moved area and home and am still unsure about my account.I cannot log in, apparently there are messages on my inhome device saying I'm not recognised and according to a relative my inhomedevice is not linked to my account

records.title: Smart meter problems
records.text: Very quickly at setting up after moving from British gas. But my smart meter on my gas hasn't been working since I was with British gas. I have had email say they are working on fixing it but nothing has happened in the 10 months I have been with them.Contacted again this month to be told as we are sending the meter reading manual that they unable to schedule a engineer to come and fix it.

records.title: Payments
records.text: Need a updated bill so We can work out payments have not had one since September   even though put meter reading in monthly.

records.title: I do not like being told if my monthly…
records.text: I do not like being told if my monthly payments fall behind I could incur a £5 cost. I think it is rude and big brotherish

records.title: Not a quick enough response
records.text: You’ve known about my smart meter not working, which has been like this for about 24 months. I’m not able to submit meter readings.

records.title: Poor experience
records.text: Everything worked slickly on App except the area used to change tariff. It was unavailable the first few times and then clunky to navigate. It felt like a barrier to changing tariff. Also, when entering my New Year readings retrospectively, as I had been requested to do, I was asked for my account number even although I was doing this within the wrapper of the App. An inconvenience that I believe was avoidable. I feel the Apper wrapper wasn’t really rapping!

records.title: They're OK
records.text: They're OK, apart from pestering me all the time to get a so-called smart meter. I have asked them time and again not to and tried opting out of emails without success so i have had to bar their calls and messages. The other issue is their claims to suggest that 100% of their electricity comes from their own windfarms; everyone knows the power from windfarms is - even on a good day - insufficient, and thus overall a majority of power comes from gas.  I just would prefer them to be honest about it rather than take us for fools with their virtue-signalling.

records.title: Not great
records.text: “Encouraged” to have a smart meter, but still have to give them gas readings,Last year problems with Electricity meter, screen continual blank went on for months, promised someone would come but nobody did.Queried readings, so phoned to speak to advisor, was told not to worry as the bill readings are often inaccurate, but eventually get sorted.Meter set up for economy 7, I don’t have economy 7, asked to have standard reading, told No.Would I recommend a smartMeter? NO would I recommend SP ?NO why haven’t I changed advised by SP rep that there are likely to be problems switching, which could affect my bills.

records.title: Honestly
records.text: Honestly? When a scottish power agent told me I was £300 in credit on my pre payment meter then when next I phoned they had quickly reflected the bill to show £88 - It did confirm my suspicions - I am being robbed blind by that payment meter!!!

records.title: I didn’t get any clear answers from my…
records.text: I didn’t get any clear answers from my chat regarding my sudden huge debit or the fact that my DD had been increased by you without notification in November 2024 Isn’t this illegal

records.title: Requested a refund
records.text: Requested a refund.  You refused to pay it into my account (the account I use to pay you) and insisted upon sending it to me by cheque.  My nearest bank branch is 3 miles away.  I do not own a smart phone.  It is going to cost ME time and money to travel to deposit the cheque you're sending me because YOU owe me money.

records.title: The button to purchase didn't work…
records.text: The button to purchase didn't work several times, so I entered the chat room.  An assistant took far too long to help and in the end told me to 'do it myself'!  Not quite the customer service I was expecting. I tried to get back to my quote to give the assistant some information and the chat window was shut down and lost.  I don't think I did anything wrong, and to be fair, don't think the assistant shut it down either.Tried logging out and logging in and lo and behold, I was able to do it myself!  Signed up for a fixed contract for 18 months, but not sure I would use you again.

records.title: Worse off than before the meter was "fixed".
records.text: After about 2 years of waiting we had an appointment to fix the smart meter fitted in June 2022. The technician left saying it would take about 24 hours for everything to settle down. Now, the smart meter still doesn't work and we now can't read any figures on either the electric and gas meters as the screens are blank. Now waiting for an appointment in 2025 to fix this. Worse off than before. Technician though was polite and informative and very positive.

records.title: Recent promotions
records.text: The £5 energy refund is like the one lloyds bank offered me, of very little use to me as most of the outlets are too far to visit or ones that I would not use. The cheap rate for the weekend from 11 to 4 sounds good but it restricts my leisure time at the  weekends due to having to be at home to use the electric. Why not have the deal on during the night hours. Your reply only described the two promotions that are offer, which I already know about, sounds like a standard answer to any negative response. Didn't respond to having half price electricity during night hours or having the customer choosing what benefits they would like to have.

records.title: I rang to speak to someone from…
records.text: I rang to speak to someone from Scottish Power and as there was a long waiting list advised I should leave my details to have an adviser to ring me back.  Left my information on 2 separate occasions and have not received a call back to this day. Need to speak to someone asp.

description: iSupplyEnergy is in the process of withdrawing from the UK energy supply market and all customers are being transferred to EDF energy. Thank you

records.title: Cheap as chips
records.text: The website was a bit basic, and finding info was a bit tricky at times but iSupply was a classic no-frills supplier. As long as you didn't need Customer Service (and everything was fine for us, so we never did) why pay for it?

records.title: Well Done Again …
records.text: Another enquiry and request dealt with efficiently and effectively by isupply's telephone response staff. Particular thanks to Peter D who sorted my request very quickly. Typical of the responses I've experienced over nearly four years now. Pity it can't carry on. Best wishes to all the team at isuppG.J.W.

records.title: Although I had concerns over the…
records.text: Although I had concerns over the increase in pricing (due to the higherstanding charge), the matter has been very satisfactoraly dealt with.In particular, Charlie Chase has been extremely helpful by respondingpromptly when asked to return my calls and after experiencing difficulty getting through to me, sent an email. When we  eventually spoke, she was friendly and professional and explained everythingwell - a valuable member of your sales team!  I wish all your employeesa good future with EDF.Linda Green

records.title: A 5* Company
records.text: We are with iSupplyEnergy in our current home so had no hesitation whatsoever in staying with them when we move house next month.  Their staff are excellent and could not be more helpful.  They go out of their way to answer any queries and to ensure their customers are happy.I could never imagine going back to any of our previous providers!!

records.title: Could not have been better served
records.text: I could not have been better served when I contacted them to discuss changing our power supplier. Took me through each stage clearly and comprehensively and mad sure that at every stage I understood the process and what I was doing.The friendly personality of the person I spoke with really came across and the whole change process could not be faulted in any way

records.title: Returning customer setting up new account ...
records.text: As a returning customer to isupplyenergy, my email address had changed and so my log-in wasn't straightforward. Natalia who was my adviser couldn't have been more helpful as she supported me to get new access data and then waited to check that all worked as it should. Brilliant. Thanks. BT

records.title: plant this lady in a garden and grow some more....
records.text: Today I spoke to your agent Lola Greenway...A perfect example of how and what customer service should be like.  The lady in question not only managed my issue to my satisfaction but did so with an outstanding lighthearted approach putting me at total ease with her confident and soft manner.  If i could give some advice it would be to use this lady as an example in your training exercises of exactly how your agents deal with customers......thank you Lola your a star.

records.title: Customer Experience
records.text: My experience to today was nothing short of outstanding. Massive thank you to Jacob Harker for all your help with my elderly parents renewal and contracts. Jacob in my opinion when above and beyond and is an asset to your team. Thank you Jacob for making a daunting job really easy. Very happy parents which makes me happy too!

records.title: After having a few problems with…
records.text: After having a few problems with iSupply customer services, I managed to speak to Chris Robbie. He was absolutely brilliant. I had contact with him every day for about a week or so until my problem was solved. He was very friendly, very efficient and couldn’t have done more to help me. In a world where the customer service department in most companies falls very short, Chris Robbie made such a positive difference. Thank you Chris.

records.title: We did have our supplies from isupply…
records.text: We did have our supplies from isupply but we switched for no reason other than we got our energy cheaper. This was probably a mistake considering the trouble we had in the future. There was a problem during switching which meant a lengthy exchange of emails but I can honestly say isupply were great in helping us out, the supplier we switched to wasnt so good. Dawn in collections was an absolute star going above and beyond to resolve this issue. Thanks for the service

records.title: Let you know when delivery is on its…s
records.text: Lets you know when delivery is on its way for convience

records.title: We moved into a home supplied by…
records.text: We moved into a home supplied by isupply by the previous occupiers. We changed suppliers to bulb and awaited a final bill from isupply.  17 days after we switched we were sent a bill including a late payment charge of £30 and threat of £30 more if i do not pay in in 7 days, issue was that this letter was not recieved till today 10 days after it was dated so £60 pounds of charges at a point when we have limited income and no prior notifications recieved. Edit following conversation with Charlie from isupply - issues addressed and charges waived all sorted. Thank you.

records.title: iSupply have been fine although they do not estimate my useage correctly and we have been with then for several years.
records.text: iSupply have been fine although at the start of a new contract they took too much money via direct debit. Last year we paid £39 for about 7 months, I kept sending them meter readings and they then reduced it to £20, I am still owed £33 for last year and my new direct debit is £38 so I guess the same thing will happen this year. This does make me annoyed because I think I could be gaining interest on that money instead of iSupply.

records.title: I have my electric with you for around…
records.text: I have my electric with you for around 6 months and have had no problems yet and I hope I don't, I don't trust energy companies at the best of times.  I am in the process of giving isupply a try with supplying me with gas also.

records.title: Great experience with ISupply.
records.text: Never a problem with isupply. I always provide updated meter readings online and isupply ensure my payments keep in line with usage so no nasty shocks. Not always the cheapest but certainly efficient from my experience.

records.title: I would like to congratulate the…last customer care advisor Kam as noted above
records.text: I would like to congratulate the professional & very helpful customer care advisors I have been dealing with while trying to sort out my electricity account.I have spoken to several & they include;AlisonZaraGeorginaAnetaJulieJadeTommyAll of them have tried hard to assist with my account within the difficult confines of the System.Individually & collectively they should be congratulated for the time, effort & pleasant manner in which they dealt with my queries & concerns in trying to obtain an accurate final account bill.In particular I would like to express my sincere appreciation & congratulations on the service & response I received fromKam, the last customer care advisor I just dealt with.From the moment I spoke to him he was pleasant, friendly, very helpful and professional in the way he dealt with my call.He took ownership of the call and diligently explored every possible avenue to finally arrive at an agreed final amount to be paid.His tanasity & refusal not to let go of the problem until it was finally resolved was very comforting & reassuring.Thanks to him & all his extensive endeavours he managed to explain & we were able to arrive at a mutually acceptable final figure.As a result I was at last able to make the reduced amended outstanding payment & therebysettle my account in full.Kam should be commended for all his perseverance. He is a great asset to the company.I am very pleased and impressed.

records.title: So far has been positive and…
records.text: So far has been positive and painless,just joined,but if it continues to be painless then will be 5 stars.

records.title: Service has been professional
records.text: Service has been professional, I've had no reason to complain, and whenever I've had a query its always been dealt with in a polite and timely manner.

records.title: Had Jurado fully explain the process
records.text: Had Jurado fully explain the process, he was very patient with my constant questions and had all the answers.

records.title: Easy to use service
records.text: Easy to use service, the only issue I really have is that I would have liked to be able to change the date of payment. Which I supply do not offer!!

records.title: Saddened
records.text: I have had good service from IsupplyEnergy and I was very saddened to hear  they will no longer supply my energy. Thank you

records.title: You have been very good but sometimes…
records.text: You have been very good but sometimes hard to ring. So why are you passing me over to EDF

records.title: Painless energy switching
records.text: I spoke with James Brown today and I must say that he was very patient and helpful in answering my questions, he not only explained the switch over procedure in detail but also made sure that I understood and was happy with all of the details before proceeding which I did with savings of £8 per month on my energy bill so all in all it was a fantastic experience, I would recommend anyone to give them a try

records.title: I have been supplied Gas from isupply…
records.text: I have been supplied Gas from isupply for a while now. I was supplied both Gas ad Electricity until my electricity was mysteriously went over to Tonik..?? That contract has now finished and I resigned to isupply for my electricity. I am somewhat peeved that I now required  to have two accounts! The woman I dealt with said that it wasn't possible to use to link them ...this is very inconvenient for me and would like this situation resolved please..kind regards

records.title: I used a couple of switch supplier…
records.text: I used a couple of switch supplier websites .. neither were clear and one showed an anticipated 'saving' that was actually not a saving at all.   The assistant on the phone was not coercive and actually have me accurate usage data for me to be more thorough on the comparisons websites.  Very satisfied with the internet portal for iSupply and the electricity is renewable.  5 stars if a smart meter was available but can't complain in the tariff.

records.title: Matt was brilliant, distinguishing himself from his colleagues
records.text: Firstly I would like to single out the customer care advisor Matt West who was able to resolve my issue quickly and calmly and was exceptionally helpful. Unfortunately a previous colleague of his had not been as helpful and didn't really bother to look into the issue properly.I had experienced an Erroneous Transfer which had led to extra charges. Matt correctly identified this and resolved it immediately.Thank you.

records.title: Direct debt Problem
records.text: After having problems with my Direct Debt for paying my Electricity account.I contacted ISupply i spoke to a lady called Kelly , Who sorted this out for me.She was very good at telling what was happening and why it happened which put me at ease as i thought i had done something wrong.Her attitude towards this problem  was very professional.

records.title: I spoke to Lewis this morning
records.text: I spoke to Lewis this morning.  There is a problem with our Electricity reading which we submitted so we have sent an email today (05/02/2020) with photos of both Gas and Electric meters to:  support team at isupply energy. As we have recently changed suppliers there seems to be a problem.  Lewis was most helpful and we hope he can resolve the issue.  Thank you.  J. Midmer

records.title: Excellent, friendly and patient customer service to sort on-line issues!
records.text: Peter (a new Customer Support Adviser) listened patiently to the trials and tribulations of an outstanding 2-month old issue regarding the start meter reading and, as a result, the fact that the system wouldn't allow me to enter readings on-line.I understand that this is quite common.Peter took the time to talk to his supervisor and sort for me.Now that everything is up & running - very simple to use and value the excellent, friendly and patient customer service.Thank you - hooray!

records.title: Seems to be a pretty efficient company
records.text: Seems to be a pretty efficient company. I switched from another electricity supplier company and there was no problem. My direct debit was increased so I wasn't in a huge debit by the end of the winter - all seamless. I get reminders by email to take electricity readings regularly, so I know how much I am using and can compare to the previous years consumption. I have phoned on one or two occasions, and got through to friendly, helpful customer service folk. So all good - thank you.

records.title: Disappointing and unprofessional
records.text: I have lived in my premises for 15 months since then I have had no correspondence from isupplyenergy they have now sent me a estimated bill for £1004 this is from may 19 to may 20 so I cannot give them a reading for may 20 so now I have tried to challenge by email and phone with no success it is ridiculous I suffer with mental which is now getting worse find the whole issue outrageous

records.title: I wish to state that I’ve had excellent…
records.text: I wish to state that I’ve had excellent service from  staff at Isupply,having recently been given very good advice sorting out problems with another utility supplier. The  staff from Isupply have been very professional, patient,understanding, considerate & polite at all times. They have returned my calls, &  have resolved any problems that I have raised, I cannot fault the service  they have given me. I’m sorry that Isupply  are in the process of closing down, & our accounts will be transferred over to EDF in the coming  months. I would like to say thank you in particular to Peter D, Sophie M, & Ben V,many thanks for their help!!Wishing all the staff at Isupply Good luck in the future Securing new jobs. Jan Doe

records.title: Not happy that i supply did not warn me…
records.text: Not happy that i supply did not warn me of a take over when i renewed my contract

records.title: Poor in communication
records.text: Poor in communication. Could be more informative say via email!

records.title: Go renewed my contract having been made…
records.text: Go renewed my contract having been made an offer that would reduce my monthly payments. According to my account I was also in credit. The move across was all very clean and easy but my first direct debit on day one of my new contract was double that of my old with no missed payments or apparent timing errors and no explanation. Very disappointing

records.title: Phone help.
records.text: Have had a few dealings over the phone with collections. One call handler was very rude and had a complete lack of compassion. However, Josh was helpful and friendly and did the best he could. Just a shame the prices are so high and the deals for existing customers are poor. Because of this I will be leaving as soon as I can to get a cheaper deal.

records.title: I have had no concerns so far and the…
records.text: I have had no concerns so far and the cost has been a small saving on my previous provider. However, I doubt that any one stays with a provider more than about 2 - 3 years as costs go up and people will move to get cheaper. Overall though, as with insurances, costs continue to rise year on year.

records.title: I am not very impressed at the minute…
records.text: I am not very impressed at the minute with supply,getting emails saying read your meter as you may not being charged the correct amount,finding out my electric jumped a whopping  27 pounds more a month,someone coming round every 3  months to read my meter as im not able to do myself this is my first year with this company i am now paying more than the company i left sorry put 3 stars meant 2.

records.title: Honest opinion
records.text: 1. Telephone contacting takes forever to answer           - poor2. Acceptance of Customer Meter Readings rejected.   - poor3. Answers to Questions I raise are not clear and sometimes very confusing                                                                      - poor4. Advice on a more beneficial tariff available to me is wrong, for example I am told on my last bill I could save £29, whereas I would be charged £30 for terminating my current contract early - poor5. I think I am being generous giving a 3 star rating, as 2 would be more accurate

records.title: I can't pay my bills. (Or can i?!)
records.text: The system is pretty awful at the moment. I did get a call from a friendly chap at the weekend who assured me it was being looked into & that my direct debit was actually set up correctly (Despite the webshite showing it as not being)Good customer service, poor webshite.

records.title: Convoluted and slow online system
records.text: The online system is slow and when joining up, unclear. Nothing feels easy or quick which is difficult when you have to do it all yourself. I rang a meter reading through and almost 2 weeks later, it’s still not registered. On top of this, I have registered for multiple accounts and they are listed in the emails with MPAN numbers! I don’t know them and so can’t distinguish between each accoubt. The fact that each supply has to have a different online account is also frustrating and time consuming. Not a good or easy Customer experience!

records.title: They rang me to offer me a renewal deal…
records.text: They rang me to offer me a renewal deal at better than my current prices ...very good ! BUT should they be ringing me without contacting me by email or in writing first ? I was immediately suspicious it might be some scam. Ok it wasnt a scam because I made various check questions, however I think it is bad practice for any company to be ringing its customers ie getting them used to the idea that they can be rung out of the blue by their utility company or bank or whoever -This just invites fraudsters to try their luck.

records.title: Supply situation is satisfactory BUT
records.text: Supply situation is satisfactory.  Problem is online account. I am never able to open what is to me totally unnecessary security.  I know am an old fool but can't remember password. Never been able to see my account.  Just send as an ordinary email.

records.title: I was led through the process very…
records.text: I was led through the process very clearly by Melissa and the dedication to certain causes was well described and navigated through. All with a never tiring Melissa perfectly audible chatter. Professional and understanding of the fact I had three screaming kids in the background.I would say that at the cost of my phone call the process was a bit overlong. Maybe go for a free number?

records.title: THE PROBLEM OF METHOD OF PAYMENT,LOG IN AND SEND OF ENQUIRY
records.text: I THINK I WOULD LIKE TO HAVE A PAYMENT CARD RATHER THAN DIRECT DEBIT PAYMENTS. I ALSO HAVE GOT EMAIL TO READ MESSAGE FROM YOU BUT I AM NOT ABLE TO DO SO BECAUSE I DO NOT REMEMBER USERNAME OR PASSWORD. THERE  DOES NOT SEEM TO BE ANYWHERE WHERE I CAN FIND OUT WHAT EITHER ARE. NOR ANYTHING TO CLICK ON TO SEND MESSAGE/ENQUIRY TO YOU.

records.title: Not very happy
records.text: It was expected for me to contact my passed supplier- British Gas and l couldn’t get through. You have the contacts directly not me. I have not had a message to say that my electric account has been accepted by British Gas as l had with my gas.what happens if l have no electric come January 7th ?

records.title: The service I got today was great
records.text: The service I got today was great, however, my opinion of iSupplyEnergy is very poor as it has taken many phone calls with false promises made even by a senior advisor who on Friday made a number of promises, none of which he kept!! However Jurado was great today and kept his promises as evidenced by the e mails I have since received, it is a shame the previous advisors were not as good as him!!.

records.title: excessive standing charge
records.text: I cannot understand why the standing charge for gas and electric is twice as much per day when I commit to a three year contract, than it is for a twelve month contract.  Surely loyalty would encourage the reverse. So I now have 12 months to find a more reasonable supplier.

records.title: It would have been a llot higher butler down
records.text: It would have been a llot higher but I feel I have been let down with sorting out a change of suppliers  I have had to wait longer than I should have  to change gas supply  so I end up paying more  for longer previous I was very happy with isupply

records.title: Everything was going well until....
records.text: Everything was going well with my transfer to you until I tried to send my meter readings on my transfer date. Electric reading went fine but Gas reading would not go as screen keeps saying it did not agree with my last reading, strange as this was my first reading.I hope this does not happen when I send future readings, because if it does i will be very annoyed and will not be staying with you for very long.

records.title: Shambles.
records.text: I was with isupplyenergy last year for 6 months in a rented property and the service was awful.From the get-go, their difficult-to-use website and payment system were confusing and the charges they laid out were unclear.Not only was it a mission to submit meter readings - pictures required to be sent via email for validaton - their meter reading validation team sometimes took up to 3 months to validate the readings and correct the overpayments made on the account!Once we'd vacated the property and ended our service with isupply in December 2019, we were pleased to receive a final bill with interest in our favour and thought "well we're not going to use them again, but we're glad for this outcome"....Until April the following year where I started receiving "you have an unread message" from isupplyenergy notifications and started receiving calls saying I owed money on the final bill - the final bill that I thought had been issued 4 months prior and stated we were due a refund on overpayments.I went onto their customer portal to see that all of the online statements had been rewritten with a reissue date of April 2020 and we were now owing money.As it panned out, after many calls discussing the unclear billing system, they had issued a wrong final bill in December and we did indeed owe money. We paid the new bill, and finally washed our hands of it- but with a bad opinion of how poorly run this company is. Will not recommend. I would give one star, but I can't fault how kind and patient the customer service call center was during this shambolic encounter.

records.title: Very poorly run company
records.text: First company given to me by 'looks after my bills'. Although everything ran smoothly for the duration of my contract, upon leaving, various problems arose.Four months after paying my final bill, another bill arrived stating I owed £225. This bill was paid, but I had to go through all my old bills and calculate my usage to ensure it was correct. All this despite giving ISupply constant meter readings.After paying this sum, and now another 2 months later, the money is still showing as owing on my account, and I have had no correspondence with ISupply as to when this will be resolved.ISupply still owe me £75 for Gas, and have done for 6 months.

records.title: Not good enough.
records.text: I was unable to give a reading for over a year because my meter needed fixing.Multiple appointments were made and cancelled on me during that time. One appointment just wasn't attended. My contract came up for renewal and because I couldn't give a reading I was unable to leave and put on some 1 year default deal which I'm sure isn't cost effective. Sam, customer services - you were dealing with my complaint and now you've disappeared off the face of the earth. Not helpful. They are being taken over by EDF or someone anyway so this is all a bit pointless.

records.title: Being kept in the dark
records.text: Why am I being told that iSupplyEnergy is going out of the market and in April I will be with EDF. When I only spoke to them yesterday to renew my account for this year and was not told of the change that was coming, or was the young lady that I was talking to also being kept in the dark? I now have 14 days to look around.

records.title: Poor
records.text: Very poor customer service throughout length of the contract.Very poor website Only good thing seems to be the price but even on that you end up overpaying by hundreds and can't get the money transferred back.I hope EDF do not use their staff.

records.title: Beware- nearly 3 months later they wanted more money
records.text: Beware- I was with this group and had previously reported problems. All over and done with in January 2020. on 9th April I get texts saying I owe them money. The complaint line was not working. I spoke to a lady and got this resolved but you need to beware that they will do this 3 months after you though this was over.

records.title: Was told my change over date was the…
records.text: Was told my change over date was the 20th March. At this time you already new you were pulling out of the UK. I now am being transfered to EDF energy, a company I have had my supply with before and did not want to choose again. Now I am tied in for 2yrs unless I pay to come out. I should habe been told about this before I completed the change over!

records.title: Very poor service don't forefill
records.text: Very poor service don't for forefill the promise of cheaper bills one day 25 pounds in credit the nexted day 15 pounds in red doesnt do what they promised was contacted by tom he was friendly and said because some inconsistenty he would look into my bill but give no discount

records.title: A little confusing. I phoned today but operator unable to discuss our account although happy to listen to issue. Ultimately he was unable to help- seems like running down cooling off period to me!
records.text: A little confusing. Our contract was up for renewal and advised new rates would save us up to £200 per annum based on our previous usage. Signed up to new rates and had our monthly payment increased to £102 / month from current DD payment of £35 and this with us being considerably in credit?? So how is this saving us money?

records.title: Put me on a bizarre tariff based on the…
records.text: Put me on a bizarre tariff based on the fact the house was empty before I moved into it. I told them it wouldn't be right, but they didn't listen. Now I've been slapped with a £250 bill. Every single time I submit a meter reading, it gets rejected and I have to email a photograph. Never had it work properly once.

description:
kinex specialises in looking after small businesses across the UK. We provide essential services they can rely on and we do it in an honest, simple and effective way.

We provide outstanding value for money on business line rental and calls, broadband, mobile, energy and water services. And it’s all supported by our dedicated UK-based customer service specialists.

That’s why switching to kinex is the essential choice for any small business.

records.title: Amazing customer service
records.text: I spoke to Carl Heaps today who made my experience ordering my Business Broadband and Landline super quick, easy and efficient. Going more than out of his way to help with problems with address’ on my end.Couldn’t have been an easier process, I would definitely recommend to anyone.

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: The gentleman that I spoke with from Clear Business was extremely helpful, very thorough in explaining the products and services offered and my questions were answered fully. Thank you!

records.title: Third time using Kinex
records.text: Third time using Kinex, this time to add broadband and VOIP, they make it very easy to change, prices are very competitive, staff are very knowlegable, helpful and friendly. And compared to other potential providers, second to none.

records.title: Friendly and helpful service.
records.text: For many years of dealing with Kinex, we've had good service and always polite and friendly help, if needed, from a real person on the telephone. This is such a pleasant change from listening to robots reciting irrelevant recorded messages. The products are reliable and competitively priced. Michael phoned to offer other services but unfortunately we are still under contract but have noted dates for future. When I told him I am soon selling the business to a new owner he wished me a happy retirement. A pleasure to deal with.

records.title: A lovely, cheery, Friday afternoon call.
records.text: Received a call from Mike re services supplied to our company and was there anything they could do to assist us further. He was bright, cheery and very pleasant to chat to having read previous notes of my earlier contact with Kinex which saved me some explaining where we were with our account. He offered his direct contact details for my use in the future which I'll not hesitate to use. A very good customer experience, thanks Mike.

records.title: Iky really helped me overcome an…

records.title: Easy to deal with and good value

records.title: Good customer service

records.title: Good service.My experience with Kinex has always…

records.title: Kinex are a very good company to deal…

records.title: Nathan was brilliant..

records.title: Still receiving bills for no service…
records.text: We were with kinex for years and recently changed to a different supplier as it was a better internet speed for less money. We are no longer with you so I’m not paying it. I spoke to someone (again!) today who said they would sort it out and send me confirmation but I had nothing so still unsure whether the invoices have been cancelled. I’m not spending any more of my time trying to call you to sort it out, it took me 40 minutes on the phone this morning. I’m too busy for that. Sort it out please.

records.title: Lovely person on the phone but not able…

records.title: Switching to fibre optic connection was…
records.text: Switching to fibre optic connection was straightforward enough, but I stayed home all day expecting an engineer to arrive. Only when I rang for an ETA was I  made aware that all the work takes place in the exchange. The procedure  could have been more clearly explained. Other that putting off other things unnecessarily, it was fine.

records.title: Signed up for home phone
records.text: Signed up for home phone, home broadband and work phone.Transfer process not as straight forward as expected, plus broadband is slow and unreliable.Also contacted about signing up for Electricity supply, which I believed I had agreed, not to receive any confirmation, which I have chased on a few occasions still not to receive anything.

records.title: We have been with Kinex for about 2…
records.text: We have been with Kinex for about 2 years.  Internet at home, from where I do just under half of my work, has been very slow.  Not complaining, I decided to change to another provider; thus I can't blame Kinex.  Once I got to discuss this with Kinex, they offered me an upgraded high speed package, the router for which I installed today.  Too soon to judge, but I am positively looking forward to a better service over the next year, and thank Kinex for listening, thus far.

records.title: Not exactly what I expected
records.text: At present I must admit that I am not 100% satisfied with the service - my company ordered fiber broadband but only ADSL was connected and I had to call to arrange a change - the person I spoke to kept me on hold for more than 10 minutes and never once came back on the line during this time to apologize for the long wait. Seems that there still a lot of work to do for Kinex to be excelling in customer service...

records.title: Kinex were speedy and professional in…
records.text: Kinex were speedy and professional in resolving my problem once they answered the phone eventually, which was after about 20 minutes of me listening to a recorded message telling me I could resolve most problems by logging onto their Customerzone site. The problem was I couldn't logon. Their servers had apparently spontaneously rebooted incorrectly.

records.title: Issues resolved
records.text: Had a few issues to start will but they did sort them out with an acceptable decision in the end .Thanks to a very nice lady called Shannon who went above and beyond to be as helpful as possible to get a resolution . A couple of the customer service team could learn alot from her . The company gets 3 stars and and a 5 star for Shannon .

records.title: Things can only get better....
records.text: I didn't get off to a good start as I took on a contract that I was assured by the salesperson that I would be paying much less than my (then) provider. In fact, after the first year I will be paying much more for my telephone and internet package. However, after complaining about this kinex have tried to make things better. I won't get a package for the low amount I had with my previous supplier but kinex have been polite, helpful and understanding. Be very sure about what you are signing up for!

records.title: Brilliant response spoiled
records.text: Great when I finally got to Sarah - before that constantly hearing that you are experiencing an abnormally high level of calls is annoying, especially as we all know that is a regular message and caused by insufficient staff numbers.I was told by the first advisor after spending timewaiting, then 10 minute being talked to, then being told I would be transferred dirctly and then keptwaiting for 30 minutes.Sarah resolved a complex issue very quickly. Thank you

records.title: Broadband problems
records.text: We started our contract in November 2017 and have had problems with a slow Broadband service which frequently dropped out. After trying several times to get through to Customer Services the problem was eventually resolved by a very helpful advisor and at present we have full service which we are hoping will continue.

records.title: Frustrating contacting them
records.text: I find that once you get through to the customer service team they are very helpful and usually resolve the problem quickly. However trying to get hold of them in the first place is a nightmare. Many times I have waited over half an hour or longer on the telephone trying to get to speak to someone. Whilst on hold you are advised by the automated answering service that you can log onto your customer zone and request a call back. Not much use if you are ringing to report that your internet is down!!

records.title: Disappointed Business Customer
records.text: Unfortunately the agent who visited my business made promises which were not honoured by the company - 3 x 3months free line rental, unlimited broadband and line rental at a lower cost than I was paying. Despite numerous queries etc I am now paying more than I did with previous suppliers.

records.title: Promises not kept
records.text: The sales rep assured us that the transfer from our other provider would be seamless and automatic. We would not have to do anything. Instead, my internet simply went off, and I had to ring Kinex to be talked through setting up the router and connecting all my office computers. Having said that, the technical support I was given was then brilliant - calm, polite  and very patient with a customer like me who is sometimes slow on the uptake. Together we managed to get most of my equipment up and running in an hour.

records.title: Your staff are generally good
records.text: Your staff are generally good, but our implementation day was a disaster and I still want to discuss this with you. The long wait, on hold, every time I phone you, is unacceptable. One lass, to whom I spoke on the phone, had a fairly high-pitched voice and she was almost impossible to understand. Our Fibre Broadband has been a nightmare in its first month - one of your staff told me that this often happens and that it's usually fine after the first month. I really hope it will be, as this has really been affecting business.

records.title: Good price but a few niggles compared…
records.text: Good price but a few niggles compared to our previous supplier. They said they would pay out early closure penalty but months later still not sorted (over £200). Only getting somewhere after i had to chase and still not sorted...Time will tell if they desrve more or less stars.

records.title: We’ve had broadband fitted but yet to…
records.text: We’ve had broadband fitted but yet to receive the router it’s been a week now

records.title: Unethical organisation
records.text: Unethical organisation. This is the third time I have written a poor review about this company. We are a property management company with a portfoilio of properties. We have purchased a new property and Kinex were supplying the water. Their Invoices are a complete work of fiction. They overcharge by 200/300%. We provide accurate meter readings and they continue overcharging. Each time they charge interest on the excess amount that we do not pay. They make it impossible to only partially pay a bill. They will only accept payment for the full (fictional incorrect) amount. Don't use Kinex or Clear Business if you can.

records.title: Still Do not recommend...final closure
records.text: FINAL UPDATE OCTOBER 5th (1* to 2*)Customer Service was polite and following my energy complaint they did issue credits and re-billed me correctly.  They did stop chasing me for money (account was closed).  They did follow up and, although took 2 full months to process, i did finally receive my credits due.For Kinex:  I would recommend that when a Customer complains about error's in their invoices that you reverse the invoice in its entirety (like other Suppliers).  Sort the issue and then re-bill.  Don't continue to chase your customer for moneys due and force them to complain and escalate to get the issue resolved.-------------Advised 4th August that I am due a refund.  It is 24th September and still no refund yet, when they thought I owed them money I was harassed daily with calls, texts, emails and letters.Another example of why, even when my complaint had been dealt with, I cannot recommend.Wow, I am really shocked at the reviews that are more than one star.  DO NOT use this company.  Always take photo's of your readings and stand firm.  It is the only chance you have.  If enough Customers complain then maybe Regulators can do something about it.  I am so very glad that I did not take a contract with them.Update: I hope my review does not get removed because I did not provide more information to a standard response of "I will look into the issue".  It is a true reflection of the service I have received.  I am no longer a customer of Kinex and I have raised a formal complaint to address the issues of my incorrect billing.  It is my hope that 3 months later and numerous phone calls and emails will find resolution next month.

records.title: EXCESSIVE AND FIXED TERMINATION FEES
records.text: Although the customer service is very good - answered relatively quickly and by clearly spoken Native English speakers - the value for money must be looked at very closely.  Termination fees are HIGH and set in stone.  Beware entering into a contract with Kinex!Kinex contacted me to say that they could do nothing to change the termination fees.  Sorry about that, bad luck.  The fees are high and you are unlikely to see any savings with your phone or internet fees.

Internet is slow too.

records.title: Patricia from collections was great,so helpful.
records.text: Due to cashflow issues we had a outstanding balance with Castle Water. I spoke to Jamie in collection who point blank refused to be of any help whatsoever.I then rang back and spoke to Neil who was even worse. He was so rude, condescending & very unhelpful.He refused to answer any of my questions & threatened to end the call claiming that i refused to listen him. records.text: was pleased to not have to wait hours to get through to someone as has been a previous experience.Chris Friel was knowledgable and efficient.

records.title: Good Customer Service
records.text: Carole Perikleous was very friendly and helpful in trying to resolve our high estimated bill.  Although she was unable to resolve the problem during our call, I felt confident that she noted all our concerns and had passed on to the relevant team. Not so happy with the recent billing issues though with Castle Water.

records.title: Great Customer Service
records.text: Made a call today Kieran Ollis sorted my query quickly and made the interaction easy.  A really friendly knowledgeable person.  5 * to him I've taken a star away as the length of time on hold to get through was frustrating.  However obviously not Kieran's fault.

records.title: Last night I tried to send an email to…
records.text: Last night I tried to send an email to Castle Water without success as Noreply is not attended. I went to the website and found the telephone number. However, I did not know the customer account number.I waited for about 30 minutes and I manage to speak to a ladyMartine Colbourne who was apologetic and was very helpful.She started by taking the company's details and my email address. She gave me our account number for future reference and she sorted everything out for me.I could have given 5 stars but the contact email was not available. However, I received an outstanding service from Martine.

records.title: Good customer service
records.text: I never had any problem when speaking to their customer advisors and they always manage to resolve the issue/s I have. Today I spoke to Christine Purdie and she was very helpful and efficient. Thank you

records.title: Generic question on opening documents
records.text: I could find a list of documents, but not how to open a chosen item.  This is  a generic question.  The agent answered my query well, but first wanted to know my position in the "business" and telephone number.  Is there a user manual explaining how to operate the Castle Water Portal?  If not there should be one.

records.title: Issues resolved by phone quickly.
records.text: Tried to make amendments to the account details via the online portal which did not work so had to contact by phone, I spoke with Paul who was polite, funny, affable and resolved my issues quickly. Thank you Paul.

records.title: Ayyan was professional even the line…
records.text: Ayyan was professional even the line dropped off couple times. but he called me back to ensure everything been handled properly. Much appreciated that. but the waiting time for the call was long when i tried to reconnect to the team...

records.title: Whilst Chris tried to be helpful my…
records.text: Whilst Chris tried to be helpful my experience was not so good! I reported a problem in August as we cannot read the meter in question as it is too deep.  The case was reported and Chris tells me that it has now been escalated but could take up to12 months as Portsmouth Water have to deal with the problem.I contacted PW but they would not discuss as the complaint needs to come direct from CW

records.title: Retrospective billing
records.text: We had a short lease on a shop in Hampshire, and it was only when I was sorting out the bills that I realised that we had paid nothing for water. Much to my surprise, the water was SOLD by this company in Scotland. Our first contact was 10 days AFTER we handed the keys back! Although the initial bills seemed reasonable, they kept billing us, including a final demand for the month after we left. This letter had 2 contact emails, One of which SEEMED TO BE IGNORED and one which generated an automatic response saying "THIS INBOX IS NO LONGER IN USE".When I finally managed to speak to a person, they were extremely helpful and managed to get the account closed with a small refund, but the final statement gives me no idea how the total liability was calculated.Their staff, Paul and Calum, are extremely helpful, but I am not sure how robust their systems are.

records.title: Took far too long to get through to…
records.text: Took far too long to get through to someone. Mohd-Ayyan Surve was very helpful and explained things and I hope they have been resolved but historically I have had bad experiences of CW getting things terribly wrong so time will tell

records.title: 1 out of 3 staff are trained.
records.text: The last person that I spoke to was fantastic. This is a billing issue and it looks like we have progress. He pulled it up to a 3. Previously, Kirtan and Michael from the collections team had proved themselves at best incompetent. The fact that people with such poor attitude and training have no escalation is laughable. The billing engine is a joke and I wait to see what answers we get. However the last person I spoke to understood the problem and came up with a way forward so I am hopeful the mess will be sorted out. If I had only spoken to them this would have been a 5.

records.title: I stayed more than half an hour on hold…
records.text: I stayed more than half an hour on hold before being able to speak to someone.Once I was connected to Scott, I was able to explain my issue and Scott did his best to explain but there was still an issue with my account.Scott raised a case on the portal, hopefully we will soon get to the bottom of it.

records.title: Mr F.Campbell was very helpful in…
records.text: Mr F.Campbell was very helpful in clarifying my enquiry, however it can take up to 30mins for Castle Water to finally answer your call. Not that great being that they are dealing with business customers.

records.title: Fraser did his best to help but his…
records.text: Fraser did his best to help but his hands were tied. We were erroneously charged £900 for September, instead of the usual £30, but despite informing Castle Water early, there wasnt the capacity to stop the ddr to be not collected. A small company like us can not afford to pay £900 instead of £30.

records.title: Getting in touch was very trying
records.text: Getting in touch was very trying. I gave up with telephone after waiting 25 minutes to speak to someone. Online chat was better but kept being timed out before my problem was resolved

records.title: Never Give Up !
records.text: For the past 5 months I have been trying to sort out a water bill which jumped to £6000 overnight !! No one would listen that an adjacent meter had been read in error. I was promised a reread, account to be on hold and still official letters arrived with financial warnings. I finally managed to speak to a really helpful Complaints Officer called Thomas Young and all has been sorted - our meter was proved and our reading was from someone else's meter, our bill was revised to £380 !!! Thomas Young has kept me informed this past ten days and is a real asset to Castle Water. He actually should have five stars but the score above relates to the total experience over the past 5 months, the time I have wasted, the emails I have sent, the photo's I have taken etc

records.title: It took about 15 minutes for someone to…
records.text: It took about 15 minutes for someone to answer my call. Which was frustrating enough as it is, but add to that the fact I was calling to resolve errors that Caste Water made, and I was already disappointed with the company's service. That being said, when I spoke with David Burns, he genuinely listened to my concerns, and made actions to resolve them; I trust he'll get my problems solved satisfactorily.

records.title: The customer support I received from…
records.text: The customer support I received from Mariam was top notch. However the customer service on the whole is lacking far behind. Castle water are third party. Affinity supply the water and Thames sewage with castle water supplying admin services. Why three companies? It is more than a month and I am still awaiting the resolution of the complaint. It is really disappointing as the customer service complaint is not relayed to billing and admin automatically. It takes a few calls to set things up properly. I kept on getting notices and warnings of debt collection despite complaint being pending.

records.title: Chat function is time limited!
records.text: Matthew Harold was amzing and sorted my issue out but other advisers did not know what they were doing! also their chat function kept logging me out after a certain time and when i raised this with one of the advisers she said it was because i had been inactive on the chat for a time which was not true at all and i dont think she took it seriously or sorted it out! castle water, please sort your chat out!

records.title: Another extended hold before answer.
records.text: Kieran answered my call was polite, knowledgeable and helpful. Great CS. If the review was about him alone. 5 stars.However, commercial water bills are very complicated and he didn't have all the information I needed available to him. Consequently, after a 41 minutes call, including a very extended hold time, the query is ongoing. All could have been avoided if the relavent information was, as indicated, on the website. It wasn't.

records.title: Outstanding ticket to be resolved
records.text: Robert Warwick was very helpful in dealing with the 2 accounts and arranging a ticket to transfer a credit balance from one account to another and escalating an outstanding ticket. However ticket outstanding to be resolved have not been actioned despite request 06/01/2023 which I was assured would be resolved by 13/01/2023 when payment on the account was due.I have no choice but, to pay the balance on the account and then apply for a refund when the ticket is resolved to avoid late payment fees

records.title: Drawn out experience with our account
records.text: We have had an ongoing discussion with Castle Water for several months now and in the end I had to write to 3 of the directors to get anyone sensible to talk to. Disappointingly I had to write to 3 of the directors to get any proper response. However, I would like to say how incredibly helpful and reliable Mr Thomas Young has been in helping us sort our account - without him I would still be going round in circles. Now the situation has been resolved but have just heard from the accounts department that it could be another month before we get our refund! So stars for Thomas but not for Castle Water!

records.title: Francesca Cafolla, thank you!!!
records.text: The automated phones are not great and the music is very loud. I have rung three times now to cancel a supply and was told that we were no longer supplied by Castle Water. Wrong! Nobody was able to resolve my issue and I have had operatives who are not particularly helpful. However, today I spoke with Francesca Cafolla and she was really helpful, found the problem and resolved it for me in minutes. Thanks you!!

records.title: Reference to Payments in Bank account
records.text: We have set up a  number of direct debits to help us manage our accounts. However when I view our bank statement you make it very difficult for me to know which account the payment was made.Today the reference gave me no idea which account the payment was for. The ref was a PR 100111149748 - what on earth does this refer to on the invoice. I had to call to find out what it was. The lady was very helpful.

records.title: A long delay in the call being…
records.text: A long delay in the call being answered.  Sadly, this has become a common problem with utility companies. The person who did eventually take the call was very helpful and had there not been over 20 minutes wait beforehand I would have given a 4 or 5-star rating.

records.title: Castle Water's online systemsreveiew
records.text: Castle Water's online systems are somewhat labarynthine. The phone help desk does provide plenty of direction but very clunky. Despite a long wait to speak to an adviser when I did speak with Scott Ross he was exteremely clear, helpful and constructive. I would mark give that experience 5* (stars)

records.title: Cannot really rate things at the…
records.text: Cannot really rate things at the moment, as we only have confirmation that an appointment will be made.  As this has been ongoing for years - we will wait to see the final outcome.  At that time happy to re-comment and rate

records.title: Patricia Furie did her best to help me…
records.text: Patricia Furie did her best to help me so I hope her efforts will have some effect. I have repeatedly tried to get Castle Water to note on our file that our watedr meter is under the manhole cover on the pavement outside so we are unable to read the meter every month!

records.title: The usual big company experience.
records.text: The usual, no-one answers the phone.  So I went on webchat, the response was fairly quick.  The first advisor wasn't particularly helpful when asking about billing frequency and overdue bills, and ended the chat whilst I was typing another question.  The second advisor gave me completely different answers, was very helpful including passing on a link on how I could adjust my billing frequency, something the first advisor told me wasn't possible.

records.title: I spent far too much long on hold and…
records.text: I spent far too much long on hold and the chap I talked with didn’t really listen to anything I was saying before going on hold again.

records.title: We had an urgent issue with billing
records.text: We had an urgent issue, I could not contact anyone through the online messenger so I had to call.I was on hold for at least 25mins before I got hold of anyone. We discussed the issue for around 7minutes and whilst the receiver was sympathetic of our issue, it is still not been resolved.I am still awaiting an update to try to resolve the issue.

records.title: Totally confused
records.text: Half hour on the phone . Got ct off twice . Still none the wiser . I have been inundated with different billls none of which makes sense and to top it all off I’ve received at least 4 requests to set up a direct debit when I already have one in place. Absolute joke

records.title: Spent ages holding on for a live agent…
records.text: Spent ages holding on for a live agent ended up with a live chat.  Sorted out one problem but not the fact that I could not login on their portal.  Would be very helpful to be able to get through to a live operator.

records.title: false claim
records.text: The staff that went to read meter quoted obstructions to reach metre and/or it being locked in a cupboard. UNTRUE, the cupboard was never locked for the past 8 years!! Had to call in and give the meter reading which WE HAD NO PROBLEM reading - no obstructions to the locality of the meter, nor it being locked inside a cupboard.

records.title: your website does not appear to contain…
records.text: your website does not appear to contain the word leak!?

records.title: While Thomas Mills was wonderful in his…
records.text: While Thomas Mills was wonderful in his support and understanding of our issue, we felt really let down by Castle Water.  We had no posted bill or invoice and nothing via email and this led to Castle Water referring us to a Debt collector.Thomas worked really hard to ameliorate the problems and has agreed to send a bill in the post as we do not use internet banking and all our bills are paid by cheque.  We would need a corresponding bill for any cheque in order to satisfy our Auditors needs.

records.title: Absolutely dreadful
records.text: Absolutely dreadful. After two lengthy telephone conversations, no one was able to tell me how much we should be paying, provide us with a bill, confirm what tariff we are on, or whether we are metered or unmetered. One person said we were and another said we definitely weren’t.They’ve even had the audacity to bill us for an entire year in advance (2025) and then tell me we’re behind with our payments !!The only reason I haven’t given one star is that they were polite on the phone.

records.title: Mission impossible to talk to a human
records.text: As one can expect, to talk to a human is mission impossible. Virtual assistant asks you for the details, which you give. Then human assistant connects asks again for the same details and eventually ends chat if you don’t respond for few minutes. Yet you have to wait ages until you get human to talk either on the phone or on the chat.

records.title: Poor handling of billing failure
records.text: Suddenly 5 years worth of bills appeared from Castle Water with a substantial cost attached.  The basis of charge was different from what had been applied previously but they seem more interested in getting some money than in validating their bill.

description:
See what you could save with  Octopus Energy 
Get a quote

records.title: I recently contacted octopus as i was…
records.text: I recently contacted octopus as i was having trouble making monthly payments.  Anji was more than helpful , not only delaying payment date but reducing amount payable each month and putting me on a standing charge holiday for 6 months and onto a fixed tariff to help save me money. Also provided me with lots of links for more help and advice . I can't thank Anji enough and highly recommend octopus energy who have always been very helpful and supportive when needed.

records.title: Superb service
records.text: The service we have received today from Octopus has been fantastic. When our gas meter stopped providing gas on an extremely cold day, Alex B provided us with regular email updates in a helpful, professional and friendly way. Our engineer Sal was superb; friendly, knowledgeable and thorough. Within hours of our request our issue was fixed! Big thanks to everyone involved.

records.title: Setting The Industry Example
records.text: My life experience of business is that it grows apart from its customers as it gets bigger. I can’t say it will never happen to Octopus but you won’t find a better example of dealing with customers in a considerate and meaningful way. They listen and look to help. You can contact them easily. They are efficient. Long May it stay that way.

records.title: Super fast reply to my emails by Molly…
records.text: Super fast reply to my emails by Molly who answered my questions re fixed tariff fully and clearly.Excellent service from a great energy provider  that really is conscious of providing really good customer service.My sincere thanks to Octopus.

records.title: I can highly recommend Octopus Energy
records.text: I can highly recommend Octopus Energy. They are the only energy company which are recommended by the trusted 'Which?'. Since changing to them over two years ago, my gas and electricity charges are lower, and they notify me when a cheaper tarriff becomes available. Their website is excellent - very easy and clear to use, and their customer service is also first class. Highly recommended!

records.title: Relatively easy to contact customer…
records.text: Relatively easy to contact customer services and speak to a pleasant person not a robot. Changed to a fixed dual tariff. I requested no change to my monthly payment as my balance usually equals out in winter. Representative advised if there is an excess balance in May time to claim it back and start to rebuild. Very happy with the service.

records.title: Top quality service from Octopus
records.text: I recently noticed that we were not receiving updates for our electric smart meter and I contacted Octopus to see what was wrong. I received a very quick response from Emily K.   explaining what the issue was and that she would investigate. Over the next few days I supplied some manual readings and each time Emily responded promptly. I was kept informed throughout the process and Emily has confirmed that the issue has been addressed. I was totally satisfied with the response from Octopus and in particular the response from Emily K.

records.title: Excellent & Easy
records.text: The information online us always easy to understand, however when I give had to phone which hasnt been very often, the customer service team are excellent. The online account has games to earn points against bill, and options for saving energy. And who would want to leave the cute little octopus 🐙

records.title: Simple
records.text: Octopus make it very easy to move to a new fixed tariff ahead of time. The whole process is so straightforward and took 30 seconds. The customer service at Octopus is also amazing, which means so much in an age where customer service doesn't seem to exist anymore!

records.title: Excellent support - thank you!
records.text: I was unable to renew my tarriff on time despite multiple emails from Octopus to me. I was distracted due to a bereavement in family. When I explained this, Tamy from Octopus very quickly addressed the matter for me and also offered her kind words.I really appreciate this gesture. Not to mention I have been a very satisfied octopus customer over last year

records.title: Do you qualify for help with energy bills due to age or illness?
records.text: The help and information you gave me was much appreciated but unfortunately my lack of computer skills let me down and I could not negotiate the financial questionnaire! Perhaps sone time in the future this will be made easier for older people, i.e if you earn more than £….. you will not qualify for assistance!Thanks once again.

records.title: Good at the important stuff, but irritating
records.text: Good Prices.Clear & infrequent automated communication.User friendly account information & billing.Very childish design & a front end that is clearly written for a phone, not a PC.Very keen to push gimmicks of prize draws & rewards. Had to repeatedly ask to stop receiving automated messages pushing gambling.Overall - Good at the important stuff, but a few irritating things that are personal to my experience.

records.title: Energy switch
records.text: My overall experience with octopus has been a good one. Leah was very helpful via email detailing what I needed to do to get my energy switch back on track. I am however disappointed that nobody from octopus informed that my switch had not originally been approved especially after I deposited money into my account to get my switch activated.

records.title: Joe, excellent energy advisor.
records.text: We've had an issue with our smart meter since it was installed in November. Despite repeated phone calls to Octopus the problem was not solved until we spoke to Joe today. He quickly checked, and rectified the difficulty with the smart meter. He was very pleasant, helpful and efficient. We were very impressed.

records.title: Communication 10/10, Price 10/10
records.text: Communication from Octopus has been great from the moment the company took over the supply of energy to my home.As a long term pensioner, I need to be careful where I spend money. Other suppliers have quoted a low figure then gradually increased the monthly outgoings. Octopus has started at a figure and maintained that.

records.title: Actually love this company
records.text: Actually love this company. App is very good and customer service has been excellent.  The only glitch is getting my new Octopus Mini to work properly, despite best efforts from Laura in CS, the hot pink dinky box of doom will not play ball

records.title: Sindi
records.text: I was very happy with the service given to me by your Octopus representative Sindi, when I entered some information in error and which she rectified. This was a great relief and she is to be thanked very much for it.Once again, thank you very much. Bryan HIllan

records.title: Octopus are a great company to deal…
records.text: Octopus are a great company to deal with and very competitive, if there is a fault I would say their website is a bit confusing. Entering meter readings is easy but trying to work out your usage & balance needs a scientific degree!

records.title: I decided to switch as my old supplier was getting expensive …
records.text: I decided to switch as this were getting expensive, i spoke to rose and she talked clearly and precisely about all the terms and conditions making it easy for me to understand. I've only just started with them but pretty good so far.

records.title: Only giving 4* because of Edward
records.text: Edward was very knowledgeable, friendly and (compared to the other people I’ve spoken to at Octopus!) the only competent member of staff that appears to work there!  The others had no idea what they were talking about and I was actually advised by the person before Edward to leave and find another company, which I have done!  If it wasn’t for him you’d be getting 1* only but he was my most recent experience

records.title: Excellent Service from start to finish
records.text: I had been looking at getting solar panels for a while, and after being switched over to Octopus Energy and using their own in-house team found to be slightly cheaper from what i had been originally quoted.The team who took me through the initial consultation, to Nneka who was the dedicated contact through the rest of the process the communication was superb. The installation teams were quick, efficient and polite when here and the various teams - scaffolders, roofers and electricians all worked well to get the job done. Small points - which stopped giving 5 stars...issue in getting refund back, two were taken accidentally but was resolved quickly by Nneka, also a couple of cracked roof tiles which were also quickly repaired by the team.

records.title: Maggie at Octopus was very good at…
records.text: Maggie at Octopus was very good at explaining and helping me with my issue.Still have smart meter connection problem but Maggie/Octopus energy did all she/they could. Need the data communications company to sort the connection!

records.title: Octopus Home Mini resolved
records.text: I received an Octopus Home Mini and had a few months of teething issues before it started working. Customer support always gave clear and helpful instructions, but neglected to tell me what might be wrong or what they were changing behind the scenes to make things work. Having to reset the device for the 4th time with no explanation as to why it'll work this time is annoying!

records.title: Limited success!
records.text: The company appears to be doing its best to keep prices low, with limited success. I am annoyed that I have built up a credit of over £1000 but there is no offer of reimbursement or even a lower monthly direct debit to allay some of the excess.

records.title: Spoke to Gracia today re my account
records.text: Spoke to Gracia today re my accountShe clarified and answered all my questions raised by myself. A good first time experience as far as I am concerned.Thank you Mr Smith

records.title: Got through to speak with Giselle nice…
records.text: Got through to speak with Giselle nice and quickly.Unlike other utility companies, and for reasons I won't bore about, I do have to deal with several of them. They are usually the low point of "customer services".She 'got' my request (for a copy statement as the one before last hadn't arrived in the post) and said she'd send a copy and gave a rough time estimate for receipt.She was pleasant to speak with.The only reason for not giving 5 stars is that I haven't actually received the copy; which was only requested earlier this afternoon.I like Octopus sending paper statements, even though I supply meter readings online. In contrast, British Gas keep taking me off paper statements.And I like Octopus generally: I'll be moving my British Gas to them. And when another supplier of gas and elex.
