(Shell Energy) elsewhere gave up operating, it was welcome to learn that my account would be moved to Octopus, rather than one of the other big companies I'd moved away from in the past.And a refreshing change from Scottish Power who I had to try to deal with recently: the less said about them the better.

records.title: changing tariff
records.text: Octopus advised me I could benefit from a new fixed term rate. The saving is modest but does extend the term of the fixed rate. There is no exit fee so if circumstances change I can review my tariff again.

records.title: Prompt and helpful customer service
records.text: My call was answered more quickly than any previous energy supplier I've had. Ayobami patiently helped me through the process of changing two tariffs. His english was clear, I would give five stars if he had spoken a little louder

records.title: I received an horrific bill
records.text: I received an horrific bill, with dates not even correct and a figure for a month's gas which just couldn't be true.  I spoke to a lady named Lezanne who credited me back with the amount they overcharged and sent me an amended statement.  Lezanne was very polite and helpful.  The only thing now is I find I'm not trusting my smart meter.  Unfortunately I can not get down to read my own meter.

records.title: Direct debit date change
records.text: Seemed interminable but answer time not that bad.  Respondant was excellent; intelligible, understanding and effectual.  Instantly grasped the nature of my issue, made and confirmed alteration to direct debit date to just before payment due, rather than a month prior.  Maybe Octopus should look harder at the DD date and not unfairly capitalise on earlier than necessary payments.

records.title: just switch tariffs to 12M fixed which…
records.text: just switch tariffs to 12M fixed which shows I will pay less a year in gas and electricity charges. However, I'm being forced to pay more per month, really not sure how that works considering my account is approx £1000 in credit.

records.title: What do you review on a energy…
records.text: What do you review on a energy supplier?Services are good however prices keep rising with no real justification.Daily standing charges, for what and who.UK has wind turbines and massive solar so how can this be beneficial to the user.Solar installations are expensive yet heat pumps a grant.Benefit more from a solar installation yet no grant as i'm sure DNO don't want to take you off the grid and be self sufficient?Unfortunately i am unable to give a individual rating due to increased tariffs

records.title: Really disappointed that it took this…
records.text: Really disappointed that it took this company a year to issue my first bill .. for a full years usage. And failing to apply a credit for all the solar energy I’ve returned to their system. However I’m pleased that my issues were resolved promptly saving a long disputes procedure and additional stress.

records.title: Electricity prices
records.text: The prices increase a lots I’m retired and health conditions  in the last 4 years the price increase 400 per cent  I have changed all the lighting for energy saver and the prices increase I don’t wenderstend wats going wrong 👎

records.title: Increase to DD
records.text: I called Octopus as I was emailed to say DD was increasing even though my DD covers my bill each month. The operative agreed no increase was needed and said I would receive an email straight away confirming this. No email confirmation receive so now feeling uneasy that the increased DD may go through. Hopefully will be as agreed.

records.title: I could not fine any reminders from…
records.text: I could not fine any reminders from Octopus that my fixed contract was running out, so have ended up paying 60+ days of standing charges that I would not have had to pay. It was just by chance I noticed that the monthly bill had increased by £15+ / month.I have now renewed the fixed contract, which I believe is good value.

records.title: It went in the quote 124 a month to 127…
records.text: It went in the quote 124 a month to 127 a month just by agreeing to rejoin pretty poor really,it's lucky we don't use much as we're both out working

records.title: Scott was extremely articulate.
records.text: Scott was extremely articulate.He was very helpful; made amendments easily.However, I had to prompt him to reveal that there is a 'variable' direct debit.Scott did not ask me the specific date that I wished my money to be transferred.

records.title: The direct debit set up is way too…
records.text: The direct debit set up is way too high. A whole lot of data analytics is used to determine that and several plots are displayed to convince the customer about it. but essentially it is not for the customers benefit because one can not change the payment easily to make them realistic. I requested to pay as per the usage simply as I have been given a smart meter which should make it possible, but nothing happened. Not happy with the service received, particularly as it is claimed all over the place.

records.title: I love octopus energy but my tracker…
records.text: I love octopus energy but my tracker tariff is ending and the cost per unit of the new tracker tariff is increasing. I don’t understand why if it’s a tracker tariff?Secondly, timing, I was told on the 1st January my tariff was ending, but this is the day when the latest price increase comes into effect. So I miss the opportunity of a lower tariff.

records.title: continue to be rippred off by industry
records.text: very disappointed to see the daily standing charge - even if I don't use electricity! - going from 47.25p to over 61p per day under the new tariff, so not really making too much saving, no matter how much I might try.  I'm sure the pipes it runs through don't suddenly cost more than they did before the change is made to my tariff!!! No justification for this.

records.title: This whole "energy crisis" is nonsense
records.text: This whole "energy crisis" is nonsense, a cash grab for all the suppliers, yet what choice do we have?!?! We've more renewable energy being produced than ever before in human history but yet there's "a crisis" I for one ain't buying it...... Yet still I need to pay for it......

records.title: Disappointed from my recent bill that…
records.text: Disappointed from my recent bill that despite my switching tariff at the beginning of December when last fixed tariff ended had not applied to both electricity and gas so my gas bill has gone through the roof. Have adjusted now. Also a portion of the bill indicates it is estimated when I ensure readings are supplied at the end of every month. Not impressed

records.title: Transferred to Octopus at the of August…
records.text: Transferred to Octopus at the of August 2024 and submitted opening meter readings (I’m on a dual tariff). Spotted that once the readings appeared in my online account the day and night readings had been mixed up,   phoned to request a correction. Emailed on 24 September as readings were still showing wrong on the account, no response and as at today are still wrong. I am entering my readings correctly each month but for some reason they keep showing wrong once on the account and no-one at Octopus appears to be interested in resolving this.

records.title: My storage heater has stopped working…
records.text: My storage heater has stopped working after a botched smart meter install. I've now been without hot water for 8 days, which also happened to be at Christmas. Octopus refuse to accept the blame and CS agents also say they'll call back but don't. X support told me to book my own electrician. I'm chronically ill, so find this service has not been good at all.Edit: Michelle on the X support was extremely helpful today and booked an emergency engineer. The original installed the wrong meter but an engineer visited today and has fixed the issue...

records.title: Good energy company until you leave and…
records.text: Good energy company until you leave and they hold on to your near £1000 credit for over a month.Still have not received despite phone calls and emails.Good response time to customer complaints, just a shame they can't actually back up what they say and refund me

records.title: The advisor  was very patient and…
records.text: The advisor  was very patient and explained how the problem had occurred, by not having my  correct email.  Resolved the issue and have paid the outstanding payment. Direct debit reinstated at £75.

records.title: Dislike the method of switching I felt…
records.text: Dislike the method of switching I felt as if it needed a plain stay or switch press method

records.title: The standing charges are outrageous…
records.text: The standing charges are outrageous considering the cost of gas and electricity. It’s time it was scrapped altogether. In particular it is not fair on pensioners who have little money to play with. I really think if you dropped your standing charges you would encourage more customers.

records.title: Tariff change
records.text: I wanted to change to fixed. I had to read the instructions 3 times. It wasn't totally clear to me that once I was on the Change tariff page that if I clicked Confirm I was going to get the Changed tariff. I expected to have to actively pick an option. Hence it took 12 minutes when it could have taken 5.  I realise that you perhaps deliberatly introduce some friction so I reflect on what I am doing and read the appropriate terms and conditions but I was getting annoyed. I could easily see what I needed ie there would be a small reduction in the monthly payment. But to me the UI and UX was odd. I kept thinking where is the ACCEPT button before the CONFIRM button. I was about to waste your time with online chat or a telephone call

records.title: Good at first then massive unnecessary hikes
records.text: Good to begin with then same as all the rest.Good deal, nice service, easy switch then suddenly, after a few months increase my payments by £500 a year! No change in usage and on fixed tariff. Must have lowballed to encourage switching. Relentless in pushing smart meters in every communication (must be falling behind on targets). It's sad when a company that markets itself as  friendly and honest behaves like this, it feels worse than when the big companies do it.

records.title: Octopus changed my tariff from fixed to variable before end of contract.
records.text: I was unilaterally changed by Octopus on to a flexible tariff from a Fixed tariff, within a month of the fixed tariff starting.  After 3-4 emails still not satisfactorily sorted.  .  I was told in a email reply that it would not be possible to reinstate the original fixed tariff.   A phone 5 minute call sorted out the mess.  It just seems that Email is a poor form of communication when it comes to sorting a problem like this.  To this point, no one has actually apologised or come close to explaining how this happened.

records.title: Issues
records.text: I don't get sent regular bills/ usage anymore and every time I call up to find out about it they say they will send out now but it never arrives until I have to get in contact again.The problem is down to the smart gas meter not sending readings since it was replaced - I have been told they are going to fix this but it has been around 2 years now with no resolution

records.title: Very expensive!
records.text: Very expensive!Elderly pensionerPhoned them to enquiry about their tariff off peak time, like night time, been told in order to pay less at night I would have to pay more during the day!Claiming to help pensioners, really? You don't say.I always pay my bills on time, I pay them but they still send me a 'statement' to say I owe them money!Claiming to help pensioners, really? You don't say!They very expensive and don't send invoices but 'statements' Claiming to help pensioners, really? You don't say!They are supported by Which, so one would expect to see them in Which traders listing where one can post a review, but pfttt not there!Hmm! Their director prides himself in not using a personnel department, you don't say, really? No wonders!

records.title: Had to clarify several times with the…
records.text: Had to clarify several times with the agent. As the agent was unsure of the information she gave me. Hopefully she has actioned my request correctly. Was not convinced….

records.title: Can’t believe I’ve been waiting over…
records.text: Can’t believe I’ve been waiting over two years to install the second generation smart meters and still waiting .. and I’m a pensioner with a heart condition

records.title: Same as every other supplier - ripping off the public
records.text: Octopus supply is as it is with every other supplier - there is no differentiation and the customer service ads are nauseating.Bottom line is that Octopus are still harvesting massive profits whilst duping people with their customer service offering. There has been NO upgrade or difference to my supply side, yet the standard charge is more than double it was a couple of years ago. The energy prices are more or less stable and not rising over the long term, yet every so often an additional tariff increase comes along.I am still paying for all those people who were "rescued" from failed suppliers a couple of years ago - why aren't those people paying for their cheap risk gamble now that suppliers like octopus have a new hoard of captive customers? Why am I paying for the general, and somewhat forced, installation of "smart meters" that are neither smart nor useful to anyone but supplier money collectors. Crooks one and all!

records.title: No one knew anything
records.text: We bought a new Electric  Car. We phoned Octopus Energy  for advice to no avail.we wanted to know the Tariffs, what times we could charge the car for the best prices.we spoke to at least 3 people, No one knew what we were talking about. Very bad customer Service.

records.title: The engineer who installed our meter…The Moaning Intaller
records.text: The engineer who installed our meter was the most miserable person who just moaned out loud as the job wasn't as quick as he thought. Told us he earns 80k a year and works very little. Said to me that it is an awkward job so do I really want a smart meter. When I said yes he grunted. What a misery!!

records.title: Octopus are good but want to know how…
records.text: Octopus are good but want to know how much using on the day. Sometimes yesterday figures are not updated

description: The trusted energy company

records.title: Great news that together energy went under 👍🙏
records.text: This company where a nightmare to deal with in the past nothing but stress. And this is the best thing that has happened. I’m sure there are a lot of customers who can escape from together energy now. Justice works in mysterious ways😁.  Absolute trash company. The last time I could not give them 0 stars for there disgraceful unprofessional service. But as the company is know gone for ever that’s a definite 5 stars. No more screwing new customers over.

records.title: Had my heating changed over to electric…
records.text: Had my heating changed over to electric storage heaters but they couldn't be connected to the meter as it needed to be changed. Rebecca T was very helpful and gave regular updates to get the problem resolved as quickly as was possible. A huge asset to her team.

records.title: Connor, Brilliant the only person in this…
records.text: Brilliant the only person in this rubbish company who has been very nice helpful and resolved everything I needed answers on. Connor needs a big pay rise and he should be teaching all the other useless staff up to manager levels how to talk to people and resolve issues. Thank you Connor

records.title: Have to give good feedback for the…
records.text: Have to give good feedback for the assistance provided as called me back twice at a more convenient time due to it taking so long to get through in the first instance (just shy of 2 hours). Couldn’t sort the issue over the telephone so booked for someone to come out to help.

records.title: Employee saves me £420bill
records.text: Together Energy sent me a 'Debt Collection' 1 year after leaving their company without ever making correspondence with me first, or sending a final bill.Upon ringing Together Energy, I was most upset at the £453 debt I had received out of the blue. Lewis H was understanding and took time to look into how and why this bill had been created. He explained why it was over a year late and found an error in one of the meter readings which had been submitted.He quickly rectified this and brought my final bill to £14.I was ready to write a complaint in regards to how I'd been passed over to a debt collector after 1 year no correspondence, but Lewis took the initiative to look further that what the 'computer calculated' and found a much more reasonable and accurate final bill!!Thank you Lewis.

records.title: Today I received first class help from…
records.text: Today I received first class help from Abigail who works on the Support Team at Together Energy.  Not only did she calmly and efficiently sort the immediate issue but she also advised me as to the way forward in this Company.  She is a true asset to Together Energy.

records.title: I needed advice and help to choose what was best for me.
records.text: I was very concerned about the high jump in the cost of renewing my contract with you, and had no idea what to choose or how to go about it,       I eventually after a long telephone wait got through to a lady called Lynsey Nicholson.   I explained my situation to her, she then proceeded to discuss the alternatives I had to choose from.    She advised me of the best deal to go with at this moment in time whilst the market is so volatile.      I found her reassuring and was happy to go with her advice.

records.title: Dealing with the Probate team
records.text: My mother passed away before Xmas and I needed to get final readings and get the bills transfered to myself and set up new DD to ensure the house remained connected to energy. Amanda S in probate team could not have been more compassionate given circumstances and dealt with the whole process efficently and professionaly. First class service.

records.title: Katherine was amazing
records.text: Katherine was amazing, have dealt with a lot of customer experience personnel over the years, I wish they were all like her, chatty, jokey but understanding.Proper asset to your company.Only issue I had was the amount of time and number of calls I had to make to get to talk to someone, but all put right by Katherine.

records.title: I have been trying for at least 8…
records.text: I have been trying for at least 8 months to rectify a problem , I spoke to Alex today and even though the problemIs not yet resolved , I  feel that somebody has actually listened to me and is trying to help and I’mConfident that we will get this problem rectified

records.title: I was with Bristol Energy since 2016…
records.text: I was with Bristol Energy since 2016 and they had some of the lowest tariffs, consistently beating the competition. GR8!Had a smart meter fitted which saved time sending meter readings. I also downloaded their App which was ten times better than logging on a browser. I would track and compare my current and historic usage so easily. Shame they've gone bust. The big players will now just be gobbling up more turf.

records.title: Recently joined the company and I am…
records.text: Recently joined the company and I am only reviewing my today’s support from customer service team. Support provided by Greg,good knowledge of their system and very professional.Went the extra miles when booking another phone call in order to be able to provide meeter readings and issue an up to date bill.

records.title: A view on Together Energy
records.text: Today I had a long conversation with josie of Together Energy who was very helpful, understanding, & methodical. She has raise a complaint as requested & emailed me the details. Pity the Payments Team at Together Energy were not as efficient. She was a good ambassador for the company.

records.title: Glitch in billing system
records.text: I received a dept collection notice for over £1000 and was alarmed. Called together energy to sort it out and turned out it was a glitch in the system and the £1000 was the total I owed over the whole time I was with them, and didn't include any of my direct debits which had vanished for some reason.It has been forwarded to billing to review. I am happy wth the customer service I received, however not happy with being in this situation to begin with.

records.title: Done everything he could
records.text: The gentleman who called me back after I was on the phone waiting for an hour and 37mins the day before done everything he could to push the rectification of our problem. Which is, on our portal when we enter our meter readings (with the previous occupants being on economy7) we have a day rate(1) and night rate(2) but these number seem to have switched around so we can not enter a lower figure. It has happened before but unfortunately it's not an instant fix (hence 4* and not 5) But he assured us roughly 10 days to fix this type of issue and it shouldn't affect anything.Very helpful. Hopefully this is resolved and we won't have to make the same call again.

records.title: Together Energy - Not The Best
records.text: Emma was very helpful and professional and managed to resolve my problem very quickly. Thank you Emma. However, after waiting over 14 months to get the refund due to me, numerous telephone calls where it takes over an hour to get through to customer services, and finally threatening to get the Ombudsman involved, I will not be using Together Energy as my supplier in the future.

records.title: Great service when I got to actually speak to somebody
records.text: Jamie who rang me this morning was really helpful and answered all my queries.However I had to request 3 call backs before I got to speak to somebody and the wait times in the queues were over 2 hours.

records.title: Account query                          …
records.text: Account query                                                         Very helpful & friendly young man. Query sorted quickly & effectively..

records.title: Wendy was Very helpful and sorted my…
records.text: Wendy was Very helpful and sorted my query.

records.title: Finally got a call back from together…
records.text: Finally got a call back from together energy today after a few months trying to hold of them. I am happy now it has been resolved and now getting switched back to my old supplier thanks to the person who called me back today from together energy.

records.title: Kathleine Was very professional
records.text: Kathleine Was very professional, and tried to sort out my query. I’m in credit on my account and I had to submit recent readings and so she recalculated my bill, I sent emailed pictures of which she tried to locate several times. I have been allocated a call back in 2 weeks when it has been passed through billing department

records.title: Started poorly finished well
records.text: My initial experience with together energy was terrible. On hold for hours and hours every one I spoke to was very poor.However that all changed when I spoke to Rebecca who was incredible. She understand the issue and rang me daily 3-4 times while sorting it out to assure me she’s dealing with it. Something I was waiting 6 weeks with and feeling very frustrated. She managed to sort out in 2 days.

records.title: Belated Response.
records.text: It's taken me the best part of three weeks to get a response from Together Energy, after being notified by e-mail of the fact that my current energy contract was finishing, asking me to renew with them and to contact them. Several e-mails were ignored and it took many attempts to get a telephone call back over several days. I put this down to the fact that they obviously haven't enough people to deal with customers.However, when I have managed to speak to someone, they have been very helpful, despite what I would imagine, being under a lot of pressure. I don't appreciate TrustPilot attempting to put unsollicited cookies on my laptop, which I will now delete.

records.title: New meter installation
records.text: I had an issue with the installation of a Credit meter. After a couple of emails the matter was dealt with effectively and satisfactorily. I am confident that Together Energy's customer relations team are focused on providing a quick resolution to queries.

records.title: Finally sorted!
records.text: Problems getting my final bill finalised, which has been going on for 2 months. Eventually got a call back from Gabriel who was extremely helpful & got it all sorted in one phone call.

records.title: Oliver Jenks is 5 stars
records.text: After switching to Together Energy I had a problem with my meter stuck on prepayment mode. After a few calls to customer services I ended up talking to Olly. He dealt with the issues quickly and went above and beyond in dealing with my complaint

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: After several communications with this company I was lucky to receive a call from Scott  He was efficient and solved my query and processed the money owed to me  which I hope to get in the next couple of days.

records.title: When  i finally got though after…
records.text: When  i finally got though after ringing for near 3 days.Thank you for doing a great job under difficult cecircumstances .My problem was delt with pending buy the young lady in a present and courtious  way.

records.title: A complete mess salavaged by their customer service staff..
records.text: To be completely honest this was a bit of a mess, starting with the portal not accessing, then my previous supplier stating they were still supplying me with gas. And trying to bill me too. Coupled with my fixed charges being increased. Supposedly fixed til 2024. I took a day off to sort this and only got it resolved 40 mins ago(24 hrs later). Just request a call back otherwise you will be on hold for hours..literally.Still once l spoke to the staff they have agreed to sort the issues so here's hoping. Take note so far your company are shocking! The saving grace is your staff who operate the phones,who are awesome. So your staff 10/10.Your company 5/10 so far.

records.title: Good but stuff takes over weeks to…
records.text: Good but stuff takes over weeks to process

records.title: Jaimie was very helpful
records.text: Jaimie was very helpful. Unfortunately he couldn't get the link to work from my email to my portal. He has promised to try to do this today and if he manages it I am happy to change my review to a 5 star. Transferred to sales which was answered after about 35 minutes. John Paul couldn't give me a quote as needed more recent meter readings. Promised to call back after 10 minutes to give me time to get them. Hour later still awaiting my call back...

records.title: Incorrect Statements…
records.text: After receiving 3 incorrect statements in the last year, I again had to speak to a customer adviser today, the first one, who did not give his name, was no help at all, he actually made things worse, but I rang back, when I had calmed down, the person I spoke to was called Jamie, he couldn't have been more helpful, he sorted everything out and put our mind's at rest. I wish Together Energy would be more careful with the statements they send out.

records.title: It was good to have the option of the…
records.text: It was good to have rhe option of the call back, I made a mistake by ordering a smart meter, the lady said i needed to speak to the team and give me the number and I have tried it and its not recognised, I have e-mailed you for this to be resolved as I rent the flat and I cannot have a smart meter as I'm not the owner of the property.

records.title: Billing dept. 1 star - Customer service dept. 4 stars
records.text: Their billing department gets 1 star, for sending me a bill, 9 months after me changing to another energy supplier. The bill was miscalculated and showed that I owed them over £2,300. Their customer service department gets 4 stars, for responding to my queries and solving the problem within 2 weeks. After the bill was recalculated, I ended up £560 in credit. Waiting for the cheque at the moment.

records.title: Efficient!
records.text: GABRIEL.This advisor lives up to his name "ANGEL." Articulate ,patient,polite and clarity in all areas of my bill and best cost effective tariff really got excellent result.,If calls are recorded, this call good advisors training tool recording.If all advisors were trained to Gabriel's standard,there wouldn't be any need for people to complain.10 out of 10.he deserves it

records.title: it was very difficult to get through on…
records.text: it was very difficult to get through on the phone i waited for an hour and a half the first time and over an hour the second and third time i tried,i left my number for a call back and eventually got one 48hrs later,they answered the queries and the matter was resolved satisfactorily.

records.title: Incorrect final bill
records.text: I have just received a final bill for £149, ten months after moving house. This includes 4 months of gas and electric after moving for which they charged £560. Wendy was very friendly and helped me to get the details sent to the billing department and request my £411 credit refund. She has promised that it will all be sorted out by next week. I hope I will not be put into their 8 weeks complaints queuing system. 5* for Wendy only 3* for the company

records.title: I am still trying to understand why an…
records.text: I am still trying to understand why an utility service provider does not have a payment link. All their payment must be either bank transfer or direct debit. It's 2021,yet I can't find a link on their portal to pay.

records.title: Mixed messages ?
records.text: I received an initial mail asking me to state if I would like hard-copy bills by post as well as online. I said initially I would, but it now appears I can only see my bills via the Portal.On the Portal, I was asked to enter my meter readings - but the gas reading entry was blocked. Then today I was told only to enter the reading on 4/10.Mised messages, but not serious for me yet.

records.title: Bad experience but Raymond is brilliant
records.text: I left them back in July and all of a sudden I got texts from CRS (debt collectors) stating I owed £1500! I had no knowledge of this debt previous to this. After looking back at my bills it seems like on my final bill they charged me over £800 for my gas and electric for only 20 days of use!! I had emailed them numerous times to try and sort this, but they aren't replying. I managed to get a call back once, of which I was told there had been a mistake and it was being sent to the billing team. The only saving grace was Raymond, he was the only person I spoke to who took the time to explain the charges, rectify the mistake on the bill and get it all sorted

records.title: Poor first experience with Together Energy
records.text: I was on hold for 30 minutes before I got to speak to a representative.Once answered my call was handled very well by Andrew. He was polite and courteous and resolved my issue as best he could. I was still disappointed however as the portal link sent by Together Energy doesn’t work and will now necessitate  another call to give my meter readings. This is all totally unnecessary. It should have been possible to do it all online.

records.title: DD increased drastically without…
records.text: DD increased drastically without explanation. Rang up and sorted it out, or so I thought, then another e-mail came in informing me that my DD would increase drastically again. Tried ringing but hours have reduced from those stated on website so e-mailed support and got no response. Raised a complaint via the portal and got no response so eventually ended up ringing them whilst at work, couldn't get through so selected the callback option. Customer service (Kathleine) rang me back and was very helpful and has raised another complaint for me about the previous lack of response. Think we now have the issue sorted out, just waiting on Kathleine ringing me again today to confirm. Can't knock the customer service reps but the company itself needs a shake-up.

records.title: Think carefully before signing up...
records.text: My experience trying to become a new customer has been the worst! 1.5 hours to get through, the sales team get things mixed up, they keep losing data, don't phone back and after two weeks I have almost given up. I have tried three times now to open a new gas and electricity account, and it's impossible. They don't want your business...and this is how I am treated before I have signed a contract!!! Updated 28/12/2021… it took ages to get my account opened, but now open, online portal is good. So far, getting better.

records.title: Much better now
records.text: After having issues with not getting bills, staff not able to help, smart meters not communicating, staff making promises but not actually delivering, I got through to someone called Kevin today. What a revelation - managed to sort out all my various issues in one phone call. And as I was in significant credit managed to arrange a refund too. It was going to be a one star review, but Kevin on his own has raised it to a 3.

records.title: Really poor (apart from Raymond Byrne!)
records.text: Really poor. Over charged for a while due to wrong meter reading and lack of billing/Information from TE. Raised it as a formal complaint 6 weeks ago and no response since. Constantly on hold and no reply to emails. Will be contacting ombudsman in 2 weeks time. Please see the TE support group on Facebook before signing up with them. I originally had this as 1 star but changed to 3 thanks to Raymond Byrne sorting my issue. He seems to be the only one in the company who listens and deals with problems promptly. Thanks Raymond

records.title: Keenan was very helpful and was able to…
records.text: Keenan was very helpful and was able to send me an email straight away so that I could send a photo of my meters. Unfortunately Together Energy had not realised that I was on an Economy 10 which meant that I have 2 meters. One of my meters is still registered with my previous supplier. Keenan assured me all would be resolved within 10 working day.

records.title: Not impressed
records.text: My first call was from a young man trying to sell me their product when I wasnt interested he tried to emotionally "encourage" me by telling me how he needed the sale!!!! The second time I was called I had a very nice young lady and decided to proceed my energy provider gave me better deal so phoned to cancel and have had no end of further emails as though I was continuing have had to keep emailing to cancel not impressed

records.title: Was unable to upload a meter reading…
records.text: Was unable to upload a meter reading when i was originally told to,2 days later i got it resolved but i did worry for those days that i was doing something wrong and had no communication from Together Energy about my problem.

records.title: Mixed review
records.text: Was with together energy for a year with no problems, switched company at the end of my contract because their prices suddenly sky rocketed. They took my final payment but failed to mention that I had to cancel the direct debit so I gave them a call to ask why it was still going out, got a brilliant lady called Nicole who was very helpful, she put me through to team to cancel direct debit…and I’ve managed to write all the above while I’ve been on hold 🙈😂

records.title: At your own risk
records.text: Aftsr months of trying to resolve my problem and get a refund, Rebecca was extremely helpful. Listened to my issues and resolved them whereas previous customer service agents promised but never delivered. Highly impressive and professional, polite and did what she promised. Thanks.However, there was NO REASON for me to have to wait nearly 6 months for a refund and getting my query passed around and mostly never getting a call back or a satisfactory response has put me off this company. If you do your research, you will see this lack of communication and errors happen quite frequently

records.title: shambles
records.text: the person i dealt with on the phone was quite helpful but she needs to be the company is a shambles, after falling into arrears, which i only take partial responsibility for as their team who are meant to keep on top of such things failed to do so. we had a smart meter fitted 4 months later we are still receiving estimated bills. when i called to find out why they didnt seem to realize we even had a smart meter.

records.title: Poor Customer service / No customer service
records.text: I have been given a years worth of gas bill in the last month changing my direct debit from  £190/ month to £370? nothing has changed here, must be a mistake cant email cant get through on the phone been waiting over 24 hours for a call back. really frustrating !!

records.title: Disappointed to find out after being…
records.text: Disappointed to find out after being talked into switching, that the monthly price that I was quoted, had been averaged out over the course of the year. Whilst my tariff may be cheaper in the summer months, it is going to be more expensive during the winter months. Not the end of the world I know, however I find this tactic very sneaky and underhand.

records.title: I have already given a review which I…
records.text: I have already given a review which I thought was a good one but now I am getting a bit frustrated as I had settled my final account and payed by card in full which was payed. now I received a email to say that a payment will be taken out of my account which has been  payed now by direct debit so now trying to get in touch with them not very good as of this is the second time of trying and I have been on hold for over 1 hour and all I get Is music playing not very good service . am going to try and do this on line see if that is any better .

records.title: Your staff are most helpful but
records.text: Your staff are most helpful but, unfortunately, I was unable to connect to your customer service team (even to be put on hold) so I had to call your sales team.  They put me through to customer services but I had to wait 40 minutes before I eventually got through to an adviser. I was then put through to your revenues team.  All in all, the whole process of changing my direct debit date took 55 minutes!  This is simply not good customer service!

records.title: Still waiting on credit to be repaid.
records.text: Switched to another supplier in August, I am in credit of £120, my final bill states credit will be paid within 10 working days. Email requesting reimbursement only received  automated reply. Subsequent emails have not been answered, after 2 months still no refund! Obviously money in their bank is more important than good reviews. Ombudsman will be my next port of call.

records.title: Get used to being on hold.
records.text: Get used to being on hold.If you can get hold of an employee, they're usually polite and helpful. But getting hold of someone usually takes hours. I'm on hold as we speak for 1 hour 30 minutes and counting, so using my time productively...UPDATE: They hung-up after 1hr45mins

records.title: Online meter reading not responding
records.text: Always have to try several times to submit meter readings and still cant get through. Haven't got the time to keep ringing. What's the point in doing things online if one has to keep ringing to do something as simple as submitting a meter reading.

records.title: Price Hike
records.text: Contacted Together Energy because their system was claiming I was in debt to them by about £1200 and had my direct debit increased by £100 based on estimated meter readings, even though an electric meter reading was provided as recently August and a gas meter reading would naturally accompany that, they claimed that it hadn't been logged in over a year.I attempted to contact their team multiple times over the course of two weeks requesting callbacks and finally managed to receive a call while at work.The customer service agent I had, Kathleine, was very polite but kept repeating herself which I put down to nervousness, though she unfortunately spelt my name wrong on numerous emails and repeatedly requested I leave a review.I provided new readings and was informed that my account was now in credit but I am not confident that that information is entirely accurate, I am due a call back from their revenue team to address my direct debit but I won't hold my breath.Overall I'm disappointed by the company's customer service, extremely poor account managing and substandard communication.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.

records.title: Understanding and Efficient.Georgina Bassey was very helpful and…
records.text: Georgina Bassey was very helpful and efficient,  and equally importantly, understanding of my predicament.  I rang Calor Gas first thing at 8am on 2 January as my gas tank was empty.  Due to my circumstances she arranged a priority delivery for me later the same day.  No fuss, no bother, just calm efficiency.  I am both impressed and grateful.  The delivery driver was also very helpful and friendly and helped me start my boiler once he had filled up the tank.

records.title: Excellent Customer Service
records.text: What a pleasant change to have a friendly and efficient delivery person.  We had a delivery of LPG on Wednesday, 2nd January 2024 from Calor and Kevin Shute was the delivery driver. We got a telephone call from him 5 mins before he was due - which was extremely helpful as it gave us chance to call our dog in from the garden and have the gate open ready.  Kevin was such a pleasant person chatting and very efficient making his visit extremely pleasant.

records.title: a good customer services experience
records.text: It was easy to contact Calor with no protracted waiting times or a telephone system that tried to make you do all online rather than speaking to somebody.  The person I spoke to was extremely polite and friendly and was easily able to check and answer my query.  So much better to speak to real people thanks so much

records.title: Excellent service from Calor today
records.text: Excellent service from Calor today. A swift resolution to our problem. The thought of no heating and snow on the way, was a worry!Bob Edment was here quickly and resolved the issue. We cannot thank him enough.

records.title: Great engineer
records.text: We had what we thought was a boiler issue so we got our heating engineer out who did checks and advised that it was an issue with the regulator on the tank and said we needed to ring calor.The call centre operator i spoke to i felt was sticking to a pre written script, didn't appreciate me trying to get to what the issue was but I was given my reference and assured I would get a visit from an engineer. I wasn't confident that this would happen.But a few hours later I got a call from Daniel C to confirm what the issues were we having and giving an ETA.Daniel was cheerful and friendly despite the long drive and after checking where everything was he needed, got on with job, once completed Daniel checked everything was working and we were happy, taking the time to explain the changes and what we needed to know before leaving for the rest of his shift.Written from a toasty warm home.

records.title: Calor, a shambles! Craig however, a Godsend.
records.text: Calor in general have been inconsistent with information and overly eager with irrelevant information and phone calls that we have felt harassed by. On the other hand Craig the customer services person we spoke to today went out of his way to help us. He was understanding, listened to us without interrupting and completely understood our situation. He was polite, professional and courteous. We were left with an end result we were very happy with, entirely due to his help. Calor you are a shambles, Craig you were a Godsend.

records.title: Emergency call out that was dealt with…
records.text: Emergency call out that was dealt with very quickly.Gas regulator had failed so was without heating and hot water.Mark Simms from Calor arrived and provided a temporary fix with the regulator he had with him. We now await the correct part.Very pleased with the service Mark provided in very cold conditions.

records.title: Very quick delivery
records.text: Very quick delivery, advised that it would be delivered within 7 days but arrived the next day. Good communication. Cheaper than buying from local stockists. I will be using again when I need to refill.

records.title: Really knowledgeable chap.
records.text: Dan Saunders was really knowledgeable, explained things well. Was curtious and polite and has hopefully left us in a better state. The only niggle I have is the problem can happen again and of the tanks were serviced today they would ‘fail’ and have to be replaced but I have to wait until 2026 to fail them … bizarre policy but not the engineers fault.

records.title: A Thank You note Calor Gas
records.text: I recently experienced an issue with our gas supply, and I’d like to extend my heartfelt thanks to your team for their assistance. Initially, I was sent a YouTube guide to troubleshoot the problem myself, but unfortunately, it wasn’t applicable as our tank is outdated. Not wanting to take any risks, my husband and I decided to call back, and your team promptly arranged for an engineer to come out.The engineer arrived within an hour and worked tirelessly to identify and fix the issue. Thanks to his expertise, we were able to relight the pilot and restore our gas supply. While my menopausal brain couldn’t quite remember his name (Super Dunmore?), I hope this reaches him as a sincere thank-you.Additionally, I’d like to thank the wonderful ladies who coordinated the engineer’s visit. Your quick and professional support made all the difference. Truly grateful for your excellent service!

records.title: Calor recently replaced our Bulk LPG…
records.text: Calor recently replaced our Bulk LPG tank, and the whole thing was carried out in the most efficient and friendly manner..So to Graham McPeake, Mark, Kev and Doc many thanks...I've knocked off a star since the reason for the tank change was that we're shifting to FloGas as they offered us a price per litre that was almost half that we were paying Calor....But that doesn't diminish the professionalism of Graham and his team..... Thanks fellas......!!

records.title: Overall the service was excellent
records.text: Overall the service was excellent.  Would have given 5 stars but the day it was due to be delivered they did not turn up with no phone call or email to let us know.

records.title: Brilliant service
records.text: Brilliant service, was delivered a day early which was great but I could have been out so a little notice would have  been perfect 👌🏻

records.title: Warren and James C were great
records.text: Not terribly impressed with the salesforce, but once the installation team got involved everything went very smoothly.  Particularly impressed with Warren and James C.  Worked hard, and did a great tidy job.  A credit to the Company.

records.title: Happy Customer
records.text: Easy too use online...retailer emailed same day for when delivery would be...phoned when was arriving came few days earlier which was good..definitely recommend it.

records.title: IT issues
records.text: Website not easy to navigate. Difficulties downloading the CRA after delivery of the gas bottle but download eventually resolved. Pleased with delivery of the gas bottle by local Calor gas supplier.

records.title: The delivery driver was absolutely the…
records.text: The delivery driver was absolutely the best. Really helpful and went above and beyond. Delivery was a day early (not his fault).  As we weren't expecting him we didn't hear the door. The driver called the number on account and made sure we got our delivery. I would give 5 stars if delivery was on the day notified

records.title: Spoke to Jess Souter twice today
records.text: Spoke to Jess Souter twice today. It was a bit complicated but she was very patient and professional.A credit to your Company. By the end of the day, she managed to resolve the problem for me.I felt that she showed that in Calor, customers still areimportant and demonstrated the fine balance of following the company"s requirements yet still listening to the customer.    Kevin Cawkwell.

records.title: Excellent Service
records.text: We are a major account holder that has seen excellent service provided by Ian Murphy, Account Manager for our site. Apart from providing on-going solutions for our large site that has 16 tanks, he has also been instrumental in raising the Calor Gas gas delivery performance which dipped drastically by ensuring gas deliveries are on-time during the critical busy periods, when gas consumption is very high. Well done Ian!

records.title: Calor deliveries
records.text: Difficult to schedule a delivery as Calor believe their telemetry system is accurate and only schedule as such. However I've previously run out of gas twice due to its inaccuracy.Jackie Freestone pf Calor Customer Service is however excellent and most helpful.

records.title: I applied for full auto ordering and…
records.text: I applied for full auto ordering and text message advice and got positive reply by return. Well done Calor

records.title: Mostly a great experience
records.text: I have a bulk LPG tank, so I signed up for auto-top-up. Sadly someone in the office didn't process my signed contract, and I ran out of gas Friday afternoon. Spoke to Calor on the phone, agent was very helpful and flagged me up for an emergency delivery. They were able to get to me on the Sunday, so I wasn't without heating for too long. The delivery men, Adrian Davies and Kevin Thomas, were very friendly and efficient. Top marks to everyone at Calor except the person in the office who received my contract and didn't process it.

records.title: Gas cylinder delivery.
records.text: I wasn't hoping that the delivery driver would have taken the gas cylinder into the house and connected it for me  as I found it difficult to lift heavy items. But apart from that the delivery was OK.

records.title: Quick and good work
records.text: The work we had done was carried out amazing well. Professional, courteous and quick. Bob Edment, the engineer that came out to us, was lovely and told us everything we needed to know in the best way possible, he worked quickly and treated our property with care and respect.

records.title: Easy to order online but had to ask…
records.text: Easy to order online but had to ask customer services for email confirmation and delivery date. Delivery took a bit over a week from a great local company. They said go direct to them when we need a new one rather than through the Calor website and they’ll deliver next day. Overall pleased but feels like the Calor website order process added some extra time

records.title: Reasonably priced and good delivery service
records.text: Reasonably priced. Advices note said 5-10 working days before delivered and would get e mail to confirm. The delivery actually came next day after ordering but as no e mail received I wasn't at home to accept. However, the delivery man phoned and arranged to return later in the day so actually got a 24 hour delivery at second attempt. Fix the (lack of) e mail advices and it would be a 5* review!

records.title: Friendly efficient service at the…
records.text: Friendly efficient service at the Guildford depot. Payment method (giving card details over the phone while actually standing at the customer counter) is a bit weird, but not really a problem. I will buy refills of Patio Gas from here in future.

records.title: Communications poor - driver excellent!
records.text: I was informed my empty calor gas bottles would be collected on the 8th, but they arrived to collect them on the 4th, which meant moving the heavy gas bottles unexpectedly.However, the driver - Harry Walker - was friendly, professional and helpful.  Calor - he is an excellent ambassador for your company and I hope this is recognised in some way...

records.title: Tom Hopkins is the most efficient…
records.text: Tom Hopkins is the most efficient person I’ve come across in any email communications between myself and companies. I have been most impressed by his helpfulness and quick responses in transfer of LPG from JGas. Tom has relieved me from a lot of pressure in meeting the criteria for transfer of my bulk tank when JGas wanted to replace it with 2x 19kg bottles - completely inadequate to run centralHeating. Thanks to Tom my switch is going ahead  I’d give him a gold star for customer services. Christine Milne Ross-shire / by Inverness

records.title: Change of bulk gas tank in poor weather.
records.text: I tried to delay the fitting of a replacement bulk gas tank as the weather was poor( snow and ice).Having contacted Calor to express my concerns I was surprised to see the tank change team arrive, Despite the freezing weather they made a very good job of changing over the tank with no complaints or moans, indeed they were a pair of friendly , helpful guys who did a great job. Well done them.

records.title: I was without gas for a few days
records.text: I was without gas for a few days, but finally, the technician arrived on Wednesday morning. He confirmed the tank was actually empty, even though it showed it wasn’t. He said hed report it for repairs, but that’s something I’ll have to follow up on. Before leaving, he made sure the boiler was up and running again, which was a relief. He was really helpful and friendly, so I’m glad my multiple calls to customer service worked..........

records.title: Calor themselves were brilliant
records.text: Calor themselves were brilliant, from the minute I contacted them about issues I was having with delivery from the dealer they were extremely helpful and resolved the issue.My problems were with the dealer, who was over a week late with delivery and was not contacting me with updates.

records.title: 10 year safety check
records.text: Took a while from requesting to receiving the 10 year safety check which is why rating is lower. Holly, at Grangemouth, was terrific...friendly, human and diligent...continued to request despite getting no result. And Graham McPeake, engineer, was friendly, courteous and did a good job cleaning the tank (and hopefully with the checks).

records.title: Ordering (online) or Phone Call
records.text: Ordering Online, no conformation email,text or call.Gas arrived over a week later and wasn't sure if the order had been processed. With this in mind I spoke to my local Calor Depot (Osney Trading Estate) and they  did not know anything about the online ordering process so re-ordered a bottle via them. 1st bottle (online order) turned up a day later & 2nd bottle arrived today.  I've now had to pay for a second bottle !!  Delivery  Drivers excellent dropped bottles at front door ( I have a long steep driveway) both very professional .

records.title: Delivered a week earlier than scheduled
records.text: The gas bottle was delivered, but arrived a week earlier than the date confirmed by email. Fortunately there was someone in to accept the delivery and handover the empty gas bottle

records.title: Changing to Calor Gas as a bulk supplier
records.text: The customer contact (via phone) was good.However I had to do all the work - to take multiple pictures of the gas tank from different angles - they asked me to call my previous supplier to establish various facts (which I declined to do) they (the engineers) then relied on my statement that the tank was on a concrete plinth rather than send out an engineer - which I strongly urged them to do. My first contact towards the end of June suggested that I would just sit back and relax..Not quite...

records.title: It was a cold Christmas
records.text: We have waited since the 23rd December for someone to confirm when our tank would be replenished. After a further 3 - 4 phone calls, today a very nice gentleman arrived and we now have gas and heating. We would like to Thank the Driver Mr J Payne as he was very friendly and efficient and is a credit to the company. If it hadn’t been for his professional attitude the rating would have been lower.

records.title: Tank replacement fiasco                                                       Installers Dave & Ben did an excellent…
records.text: Installers Dave & Ben did an excellent job no complaints at all. However the service from Calor at the office end is total rubbish. The tank had to be replaced because it had not been pressure tested in accordance with the 10 yearly Pressure System Safety Regulations. They have now installed a second hand tank which on inspection will be out of date on its pressure test within a year and presumibly will need replacing again. Pathetic!!!!

records.title: Petty problem spoils 50 year relationship - now resolved
records.text: Problem now resolved. Thank you. Calor sent someone to collect the empty cylinder.Having been satisfied customers of Calor for more than 50 years we now have a problem. They are trying to charge us £69.99 for a cylinder which was not collected due to a collection of circumstances, none of them of our making. A very sensible woman in the accounts department suggested I wrote an email outlining the circumstances, which I did. Result - two copies of the same bill - by the same post - demanding payment. I have now written again explaining our personal situation and why we cannot physically move the cylinder ourselves to return it to a depot. I await a response. All they have to do is collect it. How hard is that?

records.title: Calor are a bit hit and miss as far as…
records.text: Calor are a bit hit and miss as far as service is concerned. Took ages to set up a new account when we moved in until we were almost out of gas during winter. Had a tank renewed and engineer was brilliant. Mostly unhappy about contacting them as more often than not if you use their online message service it’s ignored. Their website is awful and statements are months old. Calor seems to work like the 1980s rather than 2024

records.title: Tank now full
records.text: After 4 days without  gas, Simon came to fill the tank first thing on Wednesday.  He confirmed that the tank was empty rather than the third full reading Calor had on its telemetry system.  He said it would report back to get it repaired (which I suppose I will need to follow-up on) and before he left made sure the boiler restarted.  Very nice and helpful fellow. It looks like my repeated calls to customer service paid off.

records.title: I had problem with calor gas when i…
records.text: I had problem with calor gas when i bought my mobile home, only when i wrote a bad revew, i got quick and good respond. Now i signed a contract with them, but i can't get enough informacion, like, delevery's...though that i would get automatic delevery when my tank is undir 20% but, nothing. Can't find it anywhere on my online account? How to go about that? In last 4 day's, i orded gas, maked requeres on line and phoned! It's freezing Now and not heard anything..Just saying, high demand..but i got about 3% left and probably will run out, im hoping not!

records.title: Delivery chap was lovely…BUT!
records.text: Delivery chap was lovely, and we were very pleased to see him! The reason was that we were on fumes as the auto top up system brought us right to the edge of running out before triggering a delivery. Customer services take over an hour to answer and then can’t give you any useful information about delivery.

records.title: Good and Bad
records.text: Excellent response from Graham McPeake who attended rural location very quickly to reconnect gas supply.  Tank supply had been closed by gas delivery driver for an unknown reason when we were out.  Both he and the Calor Emergency Operator were knowledgeable and very helpful.  But the initial advice of the supply closure (via printed slip that looked like standard marketing) was totally inadequate   We had no notion of supply turned off until Aga and boiler failed that evening.  Result is no overnight heat and no Aga for several days which is a direct and outrageous consequence.

records.title: Discontinuing 3.9 is NOT Customer Service
records.text: Jenny at Norwich Calor Gas Depot was most friendly and helpful. Full marks to her. BUT the Calor Head Office decision to discontinue 3.9 Propane Cylinders is a disaster for me as nothing else will fit for me (and many other people). This decision was a Customer Service Disaster. Please reverse the decision.

records.title: Gas bottle underside check!
records.text: happy enough with the delivery of gas, yet to try on our pizza oven, not so happy with it making a mark on my carpet in the house when my daughter took delivery of the bottle. must have been oily on the underside and I am left with a mark I cannot get off.

records.title: Driver not customer orientated
records.text: Driver broke one gate and apparently wasnt going to tell me about it until I questioned him. I’m not annoyed the gates broken as it was in need of repair anyway- what’s annoying is he wasn’t going to bother telling me. Also didn’t bother closing another gate upon leaving, annoying as my dogs could have left my property without me knowing.

records.title: Drivers great, customer service not great
records.text: Drivers always courteous and polite.Customer services still needs improvement, drivers don’t have access to tank if we’re not in and promised advanced calls never happen which is a nuisance. Credit refunds are also a continuing issue, sometimes taking 3 months.Communication on prices are also lacking, you have to waste 5 minutes on hold when you call them up to find out. Prices are not advised when you order either, it just doesn’t feel like the organisation is very joined up and therefore not a very satisfactory customer experience.

records.title: Calor gas - No notification of maintenance
records.text: Calor gas visited my property to change out my original gas tank. The staff that completed the work were efficient and carried out the work in a timely manner.The only reason I marked Calor down, was that I had no prior notification that this service was going to be carried out.I work away from home, so if I was working away then there would have no access to house to reset the boiler after maintenance.  In winter time this could have had dire consequences.

records.title: As a new customer coming on board i was…
records.text: As a new customer coming on board i was disappointed the gas bottle was filthy and filled with cobwebs and dirt, the deliver driver made zero attempt to knock on my door to deliver the bottle and just left it in my front garden (i have doorbell video footage).Paying £100+ i expected better service

records.title: A problem getting a delivery or even a date
records.text: Well again it's the Calor system I think. We were placed on delivery by telemetry and I'd rather phone to order. I have been logging on to Calor almost daily for the past 2 weeks and our tank is reading less than 20%! I was told in November in my account login we were down for a delivery on the 2/12 and it keeps moving, yesterday was 13th and today it says the 23rd of December. To add insult to injury it is asking those who need a delivery to book it before the 10th and to order it at 30%,and not to leave it to where we are now. What does it take to stop all this stress given that the weather has to be bad just before Christmas and the truck might not be able to get here. Calor seems to come on here and just deliver to 1 or 2 customers on here instead of more and there are more than myself stressing...the system is not efficient!

records.title: stressful and awful customer servies
records.text: A lot of this process has been very stressful and time consuming. We were given a start date for installation of a tank. Which then got moved forward. But then no one showed up and then the same the next day when we were promised someone would be here. During the wait No delivery instructions were passed onto various companies for delivering equipment so a lorry was stuck on our driveway for 2 hours and tore up our grass. Then the tank arrived but no base for it to be put on as no one had told him a change of dates. So we have wasted a lot of time being home and change our schedules to accommodate a 1 day tank install which felt like a whole week. Once Charlie and Matthew arrived 3 days later than scheduled things went smoothly. Other than the tank being installed the wrong way than mentioned on arrival. They did a good job of leaving things tidy

records.title: Striking us off the Calor account system is a nightmare!
records.text: This is the 3rd time I have to write to Calor to strike us off of their account system as both previous times I've send a letter and an email to request this and no answer whatsoever and no result either.Every year around this time the Calor Account Statement comes in stating that we have to pay £ 0.00 right now.I wish to be striked off of their system as I do not wish to be a customer of this company nor do I wish to be accociated with them anymore since the last time we had issues with closing our account and getting the balance back (see our previous complaint here).Since we both are wasting time and paper on this ongoing Account Statement with no reply to my communication, I am using this channel again to get something done unfortunately.Let's see: "Hi, this is Zoe: can I help you?" Yes, strike us off your accounts please!Customer number: 40708898Can you send us confirmation of striking us off your accounts please?Update: 11-11-24:Email from Calor that the above has been rectified in their system.

records.title: Hopeless customer service
records.text: Hopeless customer service. It is extremely difficult to get through on the phone. They don’t reply to emails. When you call, there is this annoying recording saying “due to exceptionally high call volumes…..”. They have used the same recording for at least two years. It is therefore not a case of exceptionally high call volumes but them being understaffed and badly organised.If you don’t have to deal with them, use another company.

records.title: Every month I get a letter threatening…
records.text: Every month I get a letter threatening me with a debt agency if I don’t pay my account arrears . Last week I received a phone call chasing payment , I told the guy I pay every month at least £80 towards my account . “ oh , I’ll just have a look “ why did he not look before the call !? I’ve phoned the offices in Scotland and they said it’s marked in my account that I pay every month , they could not be more helpful . But I am 68 years old and this amounts to harassment and just gives me a fright every time I get one of the letters or a telephone call .

records.title: NO gas in our tank = illegal to do!
records.text: Calor once again is putting me and my family into a stressed situation without gas being delivered.Order made on the 11th Dec to be delivered 21st Dec which didn't arrive. I called today 2xtimes to find out when they are coming stating we now have below zero gas in our tank in an emergency situation (yes, winter, we need gas to cook and heat the house, hello?). Calor still not able to help even though the position they put me in is illegal and state of emergency!

records.title: Having had a reply via Trust pilot l…
records.text: Having had a reply via Trust pilot l was told my refund should show on my next statement. That arrived yesterday...no refund shown ! Am l surprised? NO.  I'm a pensioner owed over £250 since beginning of  November . I would appreciate another  informative response from Calor.

records.title: Shockingly bad customer service
records.text: Shockingly bad customer service, on average I’m emailing them 3 times over a 10 day period in the hope of a reply. Got the app but you can’t submit meter readings on it you would think with the money they make on their expensive Lpg product they would invest in better customer services and a better user friendly website. Even when you do manage to speak to so Ei Ei it’s sounds like their operating out of a porta loo

records.title: absolute shambles
records.text: I am leaving a review in the vain hope I might actually get a reply. I have been trying since May to register as the new home owner. It's virtually impossible to do. having spoken to several advisors the account still hasn't been changed to my name and I still haven't received a welcome pack. I now have very little gas left and cannot place an order..as I need to be registered! Probably the most frustrating company I have ever tried to deal with.... given I'm trying to become a new customer?Update: a few days after leaving the poor review I was contacted by Calor and my outstanding issue was finally resolved.

records.title: Not Delivering
records.text: Seems like we are being hit by the delivery problems stated in other reviews. Already phoned them twice this week to say tank is registering empty but despite platitudes to say we are marked for emergency delivery we have not had any. Each time takes half an hour to get through and wife is going into meltdown.If it doesn't get sorted I guess we'll be looking for alternative suppliers.

description:
Bulb is the UK's biggest green energy supplier. We want to make the whole industry better. And there are three ways we're trying to do that - we're making energy simpler, cheaper and greener.


COVID-19 UPDATE
Dear members,
We understand that coronavirus (Covid-19) may be causing some concerns about managing your energy. So you know, we’re open for business as usual and on hand to help you.
 
We’re here to help on chat, email and social media:
Check our help centre for up to date information. And if you need help, you can get in touch using our online chat service, by email or on social media. If you’re in an emergency, experiencing financial difficulty or cannot contact us using one of these channels, please call us on 0300 303 0635. 
 
There’s support available if you’re having trouble:
We offer free support services if you or someone you live with needs help managing their energy supply, so let us know if coronavirus has put you in a position where you need extra support. If you’re concerned about paying for your energy please do get in touch with us with us so we can help. 
 
For prepay members we’ve put together some advice. If you’re self isolating and need help with topping up, please let us know.

records.title: Best company
records.text: Good service in case of problems.Good customer service.

records.title: Happy customer
records.text: Company has been excellent at the voucher scheme. Friends of mine who are with different companies have had so much bother getting vouchers towards the cost of living scheme. Very happy with service bulb have provided me with. Even during their change over everything has run smoothly. Would highly recommend.

records.title: Excellent Customer Service by Ellie
records.text: We have been having some issues setting up an initial change of address energy supply but a call with Ellie from the team has helped resolve this. She has been really helpful and managed to resolve our query at first point when we have been passed around for the past month between different suppliers. Great service, thank you, loved it. 👍🏼

records.title: Wonderful!
records.text: Bulb have always been great in the 4+ years I've been with them. Fitted our smart meters (which we requested) free of charge and the app is really handy.Their customer service reps have always been extremely helpful when I've needed to contact them, even during the Government's energy grant query nightmare. I'm still recommending them to others now - such a shame they're having to move to Octopus - I can only hope they're anywhere near as good.

records.title: Amazing company
records.text: I've had ever so amazing experience throughout my year being Bulb customer. I have just recently switched my solar power Export electricity to them (now Octupus), which was straightforward, swift ans a super  easy process. As Bulb has been taken over by Octupus, I can't really comment on the company. My previous Export Payments company was horrendous and it's well known. Glad to be in good hands now.

records.title: Reliable, honest, easy to use,  and green!
records.text: Everything is clear and easy to use. No spelling errors, poor grammar, punctuation, or bad links!Information is succinct, staff are really helpful, knowledgeable and clear.I'm very happy with Bulb but sad that it couldn't survive without Octopus.

records.title: Excellent Service Rainbor Shine
records.text: Every time I've had a problem the team at Bulb have been amazing. Including sorting me out some emergency credit when my top up card started playing up. Its the little things like when they email me to make sure I'm okay or need help regularly. Such a shame they've had to be taken over. The customer service is amazing!

records.title: Bulb best company out there
records.text: Bulb have been brilliantly for me. Kept me fully informed of different help available through the cost of living crisis. Also very approachable when I have any type of enquiry. Wsy better than my other utility supplier.

records.title: Lazarus Seerpath TOP BULB EMPLOYEE
records.text: Lazarus SeerpathThank you so much for sorting out my billing issue  which was pending past over 6 months. This morning I called 8 times & 7 times call center staff hangup the phone simply because they couldn't understand the  issue & were not having CAN DO ATTITUDE  like you.During the day I was asked to pay £1368.45 & by evening when you took the ownership to solve the issue I ended up in £1560 credit refund on 3 different accounts. This proves your ability to solve problems & you deserve to be a resolution Manager.You won my trust in bulb over 6 employee's who hang up my phone today due to lack of willingness to solve the issues.I hope this review is forwarded to the Director of Bulb to recognize outstanding performance of Professionalism by  Lazarus Seerpath.I wish you all the best in your career & keep solving the challenges you come-across successfully Many ThanksRegards

records.title: Constant updates on price rises and account condition
records.text: Constant updates on price rises and condition of your account is very useful.I’ve never had the occasion to call apart from setting up the account several years ago. It was easy and helpful.So far the Octopus takeover has been easy to understand and  trouble free.

records.title: Customer service number was a bit…
records.text: Customer service number was a bit confusing but overall good service.

records.title: They are doing ok. :)
records.text: Well, apart from a hiccup when the price rises first hit, which led to a doubling of our monthly payments, and a  large positive balance, I'd say they are pretty good. Since the smart meter was installed they have reduced my payments, despite price rises. I'm aware that there is government help with this but it's still welcome. Basically, unlike a lot of horror stories I've read about other suppliers, they look after their customers.

records.title: Been with Bulb for a few years now
records.text: Been with Bulb for a few years now. App is a delight to use. My only gripe is they dont half like your money in their account, and not yours. Im currently £850 in credit, and I only spend about £300 a month. Im guessing part of the business model is they speculate on the money markets with our credit.

records.title: Regular upfates
records.text: Informed regularly of forthcoming changes to account and changes in prices. Account information clear to follow. Usually actual meter readings can be submitted on a monthly basis but last email did not include an option to do this !! Direct debit had been reduced although actual amount used was greater than this. Account is still just in credit but has drastically reduced. Was surprised direct debit did not remain unchanged due to usage being above this.

records.title: Always been straightforward.
records.text: Always been straightforward.Easy app and website.Could do with a bit more graphical information on energy usage.Slight niggles about being prompted to reduce payments when obviously bills are going to go up.Shame that market conditions have meant that Bulb has to go, squeezed by the tentacles of Octopus

records.title: It was the cheapest available at the…
records.text: It was the cheapest available at the time before the energy crisis... probably still is, but haven't checked in a while.Had mixed results with customer service, some very good, some useless.Keep sending me emails that I don't want and/or are inaccurate.No complaints in general.

records.title: **Resolved** - A complete and utter disgrace.
records.text: ** EDITED TO REFLECT RESOLUTION **For anybody reading this, I have left the original review, below, for full transparency.Within a few hours of receiving this review, Taylor from Bulb got in touch and worked incredibly quickly to get this fully resolved. I think from initial contact from resolution was less than 24 hours.His communication is immpecible, which was hugely welcomed and appreciated following my experience.If any of the Bulb/Octopus Management Team are reading this, Taylor should represent your gold standard of customer service.Orignial review follows:*** To cut a long story short, Bulb moved us over to a pre-payment Smart Meter 8 weeks ago. On the old meters was a combined approx £176 of our money.For the past 8 weeks, I have been trying and trying to get this money out of Bulb, but to no avail. Multiple emails have been met with complete radio silence.In the meantime, without any real warning (and despite having an open complaint), they moved us to Octopus, without the credit.Today I have, eventually, received a completely unacceptable response from Siyanda: "This account was migrated to Octopus, talk to them" - basically palming me off.At this point, witholding this money is nothing but fraudulent.I have every intention of taking this to the Ombudsman this week, who I hope can help with this.
