records.title: I love Bulb/Octopus
records.text: I love Bulb/Octopus, always have. Used them in a prior property but Scottish Power for gas as that was a prepayment meter and didn't want to faff changing. I would never use another firm now, everything is so simple and app-based. I'm careful with electric but not with heating as i have a newborn (my heating is on all day every day) and have always managed to be in credit, even with the current climate. App more than easy to use and understand, kept informed about changes, have had no issues with setting my DD to an affordable amount and so easy to send monthly readings 👍🏻 obviously would love for it to be cheaper but can't really complain too much. No issues, never had to spend 6 hours waiting on the phone either. I've only had one phonecall about smart meters too, and they accepted that I just didn't want one. Not pushy, and not annoying. They do the job and leave me alone.

records.title: Overall good but a with caveats
records.text: I've been using Bulb for a good few years now and overall I've been very happy with the service. Their website is intuitive and easy to use, their customer support, apart from possibly being understaffed is generally good (at least in my limited experience) and their pricing prior to the energy crisis was very competitive.The reason for a 4-star review instead of 5 is for 2 reasons. The first one is related to them increasing my monthly charge a couple of years ago. They did this because I had a short spike in energy usage during the winter and for some reason estimated that I will use this amount of energy for the rest of the year? They doubled my monthly cost despite my usage being well under their projections and when I spoke to their customer support they just told my they did so I don't acrue too much debt (which again was nonsense since I was well below their projections for energy usage) and refused to lower my charge. The second reason is the interesting timing of the review request. I see that Bulb recently have been review bombed by people having genuine bad experiences and it seems to me like they sent an email to their customers hoping to get some positive reviews that would balance out this negative wave. This seems shady to me and I wouldn't feel comfortable not mentioning this point in my review.

records.title: Complaint Update 17/06/2023
records.text: UPDATE: 17/06/23 - After finally getting to a senior member of staff I was able to settle this matter. Though settled, I do still feel strongly that this process has taken this long and has been this difficult to resolve.26/05/2023Clearly they've given up. Some of the worst customers service I've ever had to deal with.I have been receiving threatening messages regarding passing on "credit" I received at the end of my contract with Bulb, that they are now requesting back from me, after receiving an email saying that this amount was canceled, and therefore my understanding was that the account was closed and done with. I then continued to receive threatening messages that this credit I received,  admittantly by their error, would be passed to a debt collector.It always amazes me how easy it is for them to threaten these actions, however when the customers wishes to make them accountable for their incompetence there seems to be no liability. You are also forced to wait on phone lines between hours you are at work. They have no means of contacting them outside of the hours most people are at work, and they have not been replying to the 5 emails or more (I've lost count by this point). CC'ing both the support, help and complaints departments.I have started to seek the advise of Ofgem and am looking to get this resolved still with a manager at Bulb.I have been promised a direct conversation with a manager 3 times now. I have been first promised I'd be called in 24/48HRsThat deadline passed and I called again, I was hung up on once and then 2nd time told I would be called within 1hour. This promise was not delivered.I have called the next day and had been hung up twice once from being put on hold and the other no explanation. I have now been promised I'd receive a call in 3hours. I don't hold up much hope and as the deadline of 27th May to pay before handing onto a debt collector I think this pressure tactic is immoral and should be compensated for. It will certainly be what I push for when contacting the Ombudsmen.UPDATE: 27/05/23 - They asked for my details seemingly for appearances sake on this platform to try and present themselves as having tried to resolve this issue. I have still not received any kind of contact from Bulb, nor the Manager I was originally promised to resolve this case.They have purposefully disconnect me multiple times by assistants that seem unwilling to help. Disconnecting once or even twice is common but for the line to be disconnected 6/7/8 times is suspicious as a means of deflecting any accountability, causing the customer to simply give up as the stress to try and reconnect them is usually enough to force someone to give up due to the hassle. I hope BULB are reading this follow up, I have never given up, I will continue to pursue this until the company and those managing it are held accountable.I have since paid back what they asked for since they had not removed the threatening behaviour of passing the fees onto a debt collector.100% Accountability for customers, 0% accountability for the company. Disgusting behaviour I see from so many companies in this sector and in banking. I will be pursuing financial and non finical lose compensation through Ofgem for the stress caused through out this entire process.

records.title: Complaint Resolved at last. Thank you.
records.text: So here I am yet again complaining at the appalling Bulb customer service!!!! Basically my usage for the passed year has been minimal. Monthly payments for both has and electricity combined has been an average of no more than £80.This usage is recorded on the app, so Bulb are clearly aware. However the Bulb app suggested I increase my payment to £214 per month and stated my monthly usage was £290!!!! This is laughable when my actual monthly usage is recorded. I’m actually over £400 in credit. After weeks and weeks of getting fobbed off by staff at Bulb who have no idea what they doing, I eventually spoke to someone at Bulb who immediately identified the my smart meter was coded incorrectly and causing the incorrect future estimates. He was very apologetic and agreed that the App was very inaccurate in terms of my future usage. He stated he would address this and get back to me the next day. He even sent me email confirming this. I was relieved to say the least but still annoyed that I’d been fobed off for weeks.Well guess what? No further response from Bulb despite them promising to correct things and they are now ignoring my emails!!!My last Trust Pilot comment on bulb was publicly fobbed off!!!!This company clearly no longer care.****Update****Since this review, Bulb have been in touch and the issue is now resolved. It’s such a shame when you have to resort to public forums to get anything done.Nevertheless, credit where it’s due, thank you Ollie for Bulb for resolving this issue for me.Much appreciated.

records.title: In the middle of December I realised…
records.text: In the middle of December I realised that since August, we had only been charged for the standing charge for gas and our smart meter reading had been the same every month since then. (We didn’t turn the heating on until the end of November so December was the first time the bill should have considerably increased.) I contacted Bulb and explained the situation. The person I spoke on chat to looked at my bill and immediately understood. She explained how to take a manual reading and ask me to take and send her a photo of it. I did and she logged the reading onto my account so that the bill would be corrected the next month. The next month came around and my meter reading had been overwritten. Yet again, I was charged for the standing charge and no more. I contacted Bulb and Chesere Petersen replied to my email where I explained the situation. She was helpful and once again updated the meter reading to the manual once I’d photographed. She did ask me to get an updated reading at some point so I went to do this the following week and found that the display was no longer working and I could not take a reading. I went back to Chesere and  she said that I needed to wait five working days. After I followed up again, she checked and said that Bulb were receiving the readings. When I asked what the reading was, it turned out it was still the number that hadn’t changed from August. At that point she asked me to take a video of the meter not working and send it over, which I did (I’m not sure why someone can’t believe you over communication, especially when it’s very obvious that readings aren’t being received). She said she’d contact the metering team and they would be in touch imminently to send someone out to repair it.I waited two weeks and hadn’t heard anything so I followed up with her but did not receive a response. I then contacted Bulb’s general email and asked when the engineer would be in touch. I was replied to by Norma Dlamini. She hadn’t seemed to have read the situation and just kept asking for photos of the meter. At this point I’d sent several photos and a video already. I pointed out that Chesere said that I was on the engineer’s list and asked if that was that untrue. She then changed her tune and said that the engineer would be in touch. I asked if there is a rough turnaround time where I should expect to hear back eg. is it a month, two months etc. She said that there is no turnaround and was generally very unhelpful.I don’t understand why Bulb haven’t noticed they haven’t been charging me correctly or why they can’t send out someone to repair the meter after harassing me for a couple years to get a smart meter fitted – they seem unbothered. I don’t want this to drag on for months so that I suddenly receive a massive bill and have to be put on a payment plan. If I know the amount now, I can moderate the heating use if necessary. If I receive a massive bill months down the line, I’m sure they’ll sudden be very assertive in demanding their money! All I want is for an engineer to come and fix this.

records.text: I have been with So Energy for many years and found them excellent being able to speak to a customer assistant easily on the phone and would have previously given them 5 stars. I am a pensioner and not great with technology and today spoke to a lovely member of staff re best tarriffs.I explained that my current So Lily tarriff finishes today and in October when I got in an online bill it said I could save money on the So Sunflower tarriff.  I therefore said I would change to that tarriff when my current one ceased. Today I phoned to ask if there was anything better before tomorrows changeover and was told So Walnut was now the best tarriff.  I asked if I could go on that tarriff as the new one had not started but was told that I would have £100 of exit fees as I had already chosen a new tarriff in October which would start tomorrow. Asked if this could be waived and after a wait when this was discussed with someone I presume senior was advised I was past the 14 day cooling off period which had been sent in an email document that I had not opened, my fault.  I asked to speak to a manager to query why I had to pay an exit fee when all I wanted to do was change to the best tarriff the day before my other one ceased but was told this was not possible and it was a policy decision.  Costs are expensive enough particularly for pensioners without paying more than is necessary. I hope this can be changed but told there is no address to write to and can not speak to management hence the not so favourable review.

I’m now stuck with not being able to top up gas’s as apparently I have to use direct debit now which hasn’t been set up and as I can’t top up clearly no way of doing emergency I have a 1 year old daughter and could be left without gas depending on how long it last me I am not happy !!!

records.title: Hi i had a reply to my prevuous post on…
records.text: Hi i had a reply to my previous post on here below to say someone would phone me back after missing a call regarding my post.Could someone tell me if someone is going to phone back pleaseThanks

records.title: I have been having issues with my smart…
records.text: I have been having issues with my smart meter. I have put 55 pound on over the last 2 days. But the amount has not registered. Called utilita they answered then hung up on me tried again and same thing. 11.12.24 called again spoke with Donele who was brilliant and has sorted my issue. So review has gone up to 3 stars . Utilita still need to review their call operatives. Also whilst I was on the call found it hard to hear the call handler as it sounded like the call centre was having a party.

records.title: Call centre staff are great
records.text: Call centre staff are great , helpful, polite , doing their best. Do not take your anger out on them.They are let down by utilita uk , the smart meters and inhouse displays that don't work. An industry that don't care , an ombudsman that looks the other way , and successive governments that take donations from power companies.Einstein would spin in his grave if he saw that smart meter advert

records.title: Problem eventually sorted by Customer Services rep.
records.text: After many tries to top up but codes not being accepted, my gas supply ran out. I called Customer Services but after 45 minutes I was left completely in the dark by one C.S rep and looking at a bleak weekend with no gas supply for heating our home, hot water or cooking. However 24 hrs later after another call, I was helped tremendously by a 2nd C.S rep who knew exactly what he was doing. He fixed my problem and restored my gas supply, reinstating all of the credit I thought I had lost. Unfortunately the problem cannot be cured until an engineer comes to replace the smart gas meter, but I am just grateful to the CS rep for getting me a working supply again. I will give him the full 5 stars but the 2 star rating goes to Utilita for having such a poor lead time on engineers calling. I have been told this might not be until June / July 2025. Please Utilita, lets get this lead time down to a more manageable time of maybe a week or two.

records.title: Having previously left a review …
records.text: Having previously left a review hoping I wouldn’t have to contact utilita, 4 days later I am still waiting for connection to display. Asked by utilita operative to press various button on both meters, no change.Whilst I received text messages informing me that a “remote” connection would be happening (13/12), one cannot send a reply. The chat box is worse than useless. I have no PAYG available. Not happy

records.title: Think twice before joining
records.text: My fourth/fifth call to Utilita that has lasted over an hour since joining in Oct 24. I’ve never had a working home display meter, I’m on my second hub now - still not connecting to Utilita network. I have been incorrectly requested to provide a copy of my tenancy agreement when it’s not required in my circumstances. My services were cut off a week after installation despite my engineer ensuring that they wouldn’t while I waited for my top up card. Poor communication throughout my experiences, Utilita have been nothing but complicated. Customer advisors are very friendly and helpful, but nothing is ever truly resolved . This isn’t the service I expected, particularly for your priority service customers with disabilities.

records.title: Utilita has been a nightmare
records.text: Utilita has been a nightmare. Despite living in a small 3-bedroom house with two children and minimal gas usage (only heating and hot water), they claim my annual usage is 20,250 kWh of gas—far above average. I’ve spoken to over seven customer service reps; some were helpful, but others were abysmal.After months of reporting overcharges, they admitted to just £24.50 in May 2024, but I believe the issue is much bigger. They offered a goodwill gesture, which I refused, as their investigation feels incomplete. Avoid this company until they improve their billing and customer service!My complaint is now with the Ombudsman and Utilita are omitting files that are relevant to the case. Unbelievable

records.title: Lies… all lies!
records.text: Lies… all lies!! I was told i was going to recieve the Airfryer AND the blankets, and yes iv got the blankets but no airfryer. A friend was told she wasnt entitled to either yet she recieved BOTH, bare in mind i applied weeks before she did so the fact they say its a ‘first come first served’ is clearly a load of rubbish. Also they say they are ‘out of stock’ but people are still getting them 🤔 obviously they are just telling everyone what they want.

records.title: I gave up waiting in the end
records.text: I gave up waiting in the end for a human advisor. I wanted to know how to transfer some of my electric to my gas because it was running out and I am a severely disabled pensioner who needs gas for heating. But I gave up after a while without getting the help I needed

records.title: When I transferred the money it went…
records.text: When I transferred the money it went into savings.  Why not able to transfer from gas to electric straight away.  When it came to withdraw from savings it gives you the option to put in how much you want to transfer. I did this several times and it wouldn't do it. Eventually I used the preset amounts. I had to do this three times to get to the amount I wanted to transfer. Please find an easier way or at least the options you do give work.  Very stressful indeed. You end up thinking it's something I must be doing wrong which is why older people don't trust the Internet. Thank you

records.title: FRUSTRATED!!
records.text: I get an error message when trying to download my latest bill and tells me to contact them, Their Chat does not help and only other contact methods (eg Facebook) I don't use so am completely without any help. This is not good enough!!!Thanks for getting back to me. Hopefully you will be able to resolve the issue.

records.title: Utilta must pick and  choose who gets…
records.text: Utilta must pick and  choose who gets what. I applied for the electric blanket and air fryer & was refused. Still waiting for a card to pay electric.  This company is useless, never answer the phone, takes months to do anything, also refused cold weather payment, when I had it last year ID LIKE TO KNOW WHY THIS COMPANY HAS 4&HALF STARS?MINUS 10 SHOULD BE THE REVIEW HOW DO I SWAP SUPPLIERS?

records.title: Top up issues and unprofessional support agent…
records.text: Had an issue with a top up made but not added to account, tried multiple times to call and follow instructions however kept saying system issues so I called to try and speak to a person. The person I got through to had their TV on or something in the back ground really loud and at points in the call I could hear other people laughing and then the person I was speaking to kept laughing too. Ultimately the issue was sorted but was a really unprofessional call.

description:
Everflow is an award-winning, customer-led utilities company serving businesses across the UK with environmentally-friendly water supply, waste collection and telecoms services. 
Everflow’s mission is to ‘make utilities simple’ which is why all of our services are designed to save you time and money, freeing you up to focus on growing your business.
If you're one of our customers or brokers, please leave us a review – we would greatly appreciate your feedback.

records.title: Information Required for Court Claim
records.text: I had been promised information from another member of Everflow on New Years Eve but that email did not arrive.  Anne-Marie was not only helpful, she sent the email with the details I required whilst I was on the call.  She was polite, friendly and very efficient.  Thank you Anne-Marie.

records.title: Setting up login
records.text: Allan was really helpful and patient in helping me with my query. He calmly waited until I managed to get the login sorted.

records.title: Negotiating a realistic water leak allowance
records.text: Following a leak in our water supply, between the meter and building early in 2024, Everflow Customer Services Department helped us to achieve a significant water-leak allowance with Thames Water.  This enabled us to reach a settlement of all the outstanding invoices.As a community village hall, we have very limited resources to monitor usage of utilities and meet unexpected costs arising from unusual events.Everflow Customer Services were supportive and sympathetic in helping to resolve our problem.Ron Howard,Chairman, Management Committee,Hampstead Norreys Village Hall.

records.title: Excellent Service
records.text: This is the first time I had to call Everflow. The chap I spoke to was friendly, helpful, knowledgable & sorted out all my queries & questions. He helped me set up my portal, told me where our meter is, so that I could send an accurate reading. Give the man a pay rise! Thank you

records.title: I had a query regarding our account and…
records.text: I had a query regarding our account and Anne Marie was very helpful and resolved my queries.

records.title: Phone answered within a reasonable time…
records.text: Phone answered within a reasonable time and Megan was friendly and dealt with my query quickly.

records.title: Anne-Marie was a joy to speak to.
records.text: I made a call to see if someone could help me find my water meter. Anne-Marie was very helpful even giving me the "whatthreewords" reference, and looking on the overhead view to help try and find it. She was kind, funny and a pleasure to speak to. I have now found my meter, as I couldn't find it while on the phone because it was dark and raining but Anne-Marie kept me in good spirits. She's an asset to your company and I hope she gets to see this review.

records.title: Very friendly and helpful told me where…
records.text: Very friendly and helpful told me where meter was nad explained everything I needed to know

records.title: We had a person at the end of the phone…
records.text: We had a person at the end of the phone who took time to listen and understand. i wasn't refered to email, but was put through to another person that sorted out the problem there and then. A breath of fresh air in a world that is time consuming and frustrating.

records.title: EXCELLENT SERVICE
records.text: The operator I spoke to was a straightforward cheerful person.  She was easy to understand and her communication was excellent.  She made every effort to be helpful, making useful suggestions and appeared to understand the issues raised.   She also followed up the call with the questionnaire we had talked about.   I do hope I am able to speak to her again when I ring this supplier.

records.title: Everflow has been far from a great…
records.text: Everflow has been far from a great experience : their method of "assessing" and invoicing has ben a  nightmare and is why we are leaving.having said that Julie in  customer complaints has brought matters to a satisfactory conclusion and thanks to her

records.title: I have had ongoing problems with ever…
records.text: I have had ongoing problems with ever flow since I joined in August 2024. missed collections, late collections, over charging my account. Not getting back to me in a timely manner. Everflow charged me for 4 collections and only gave me 2 and have spent months trying to rectify their mistake. I cancelled my direct debit till they rectified the mistake and to avoid them over charging me and I notified them of this. Once they realised their mistakes and corrected them I made payment the next day only to find they had already put my account on hold and suspended my services (which they assured me they would not do on 2 occasions) this now means I have just paid for a service I won’t receive this week. Absolutely frustrating.UPDATE: they have contacted me I spoke to a lovely gentleman called Luke who sorted the situation out for me and applied a £20 refund for the inconvenience. Really appreciate it thank you Luke

records.title: Onboarding
records.text: We were given assistance to set up our account on the portal. The service was friendly and efficient.

records.title: Adviser very patient and explained…
records.text: Adviser very patient and explained things well. This was my first contact with Everflow.However she gave me the wrong account number which caused some confusion,which was sorted out.

records.title: Excellent Customer Service
records.text: Thank you to both Charlie in Customer services and Janet in payments, both have been excellent is resolving a query on an invoice.  The phone call got cut off, but Charlie rang straight back, Janet has done everything she said she would do in helping to resolve my issues. Both these staff delivered excellent customer service, both lovely to deal with, thank you to Charlie and Janet!

records.title: Service Levels
records.text: Update:Everflow have been in touch with a resolution - we are on our way now to being happier customers - thanks to Caroline and Julie.We are satisified that we now have the relevant contacts in order to service the account and move on.Looks like things have turned around now.PREVIOUSLY: Shocking Company to Deal with. Service levels are very poor.Very unprofessional looking emails - thought they were fake!

records.title: It all seems to work well but . . . . .
records.text: It all seems to work well but repeated requests that we read the meter (while paying you to do so) show a negative feature. We do not live at the supplied property and its meter is in any event about 75 yards from it. We see little attraction in kneeling down on the grassed verge trying to decide which of 6 meters on a manifold is relevant!

records.title: I spoke with Sophie who was very…
records.text: I spoke with Sophie who was very helpful and polite she apologised for the problem we had incurred. Sophie also spoke to her manager to see what could be done to amend the problem. It was very pleasing to resolve quickly the problem re your invoice.

records.title: I spoke to a lovely women called…
records.text: I spoke to a lovely women called Stephenie. She was super helpful, helped me understand what I needed explained. Made the call very easy and somewhat enjoyable as she was very cheerful. Really appreciate it, I was having a bad day. Stephanie, if you're reading this..  you're the best!I cannot remember the date however! Apologies. X

records.title: Emma PD has been very helpful in…
records.text: Emma PD has been very helpful in sorting out a problem on the account when our bills were too high due to an incorrect read on the account.  I can't fault how Emma has dealt with the problem although not sure that the way this was dealt with originally was really to the credit of Everflow and their policies.  They wouldn't refund us or even put our DD on hold until they had proved that their meter reader was wrong!

records.title: Water bills 2 months in advance
records.text: I queried the fact that I am paying 2 months in advance for my water bills. I received an email response from Megan very quickly who explained the system to me in a very precise way. I still do not fully understand why the company is estimating my business water bill, and then taking a meter reading and adjusting the next bill accordingly.  Why not take a reading, produce a bill on the actual reading, and eliminate the need to estimate anything?

records.title: Spoke to Jill in Customer Services
records.text: Spoke to Jill in Customer Services, she was able to view our account and advise me on our latest bill.The explanation was very clear and informative, she even went the extra mile and advised me on how not to get a bill like this one going forward.

records.title: Needed help to make a change of account…
records.text: Needed help to make a change of account email address, this was completed via the online chat and details updated/changed as we chatted.  Great service and not having to wait for days for a response.

records.title: Great company and service
records.text: Great company and service, however I have an issue with the recently new format of the  pdf water bill I receive, they are readable on screen however they are NOT READABLE when I try and print them out either in Black on White or in Colour, I have contacted Customer Services twice now, once in January 2022 AND AGAIN IN February 2022 I was adviced the Format will be changed soon.Kind regards,Stewart,City Printing Services.

records.title: Newly signed up to Everflow
records.text: I am new to Everflow but found the switch over extremely straight forward. The representative, Daniel, explained everything clearly and how the change over worked. They were very competitive in their pricing and were efficient in their response and support. I would like to comment further but I feel it is better to wait until it is up and running so that I can make a fuller assessment. Mike

records.title: Estimated Bill
records.text: Spoke to Steve about our estimated Bill, who listened and was very understanding and gave me solutions.Only issue is I still have to let DD go through and then get a refund, hopefully! Everflow should give more time to resolve issues, as this has happened before!

records.title: Everything good about the package
records.text: Everything good about the package of contract and information provided.  I have a couple of niggles, neither of which would in any way stop me using Everflow.Getting a reading at the right time to ensure an accurate invoice is sent is difficult because we don't have permanent staff.With a lot of colour on the invoices is quite annoying as I have to print off all invoices for the annual accounts.

records.title: Lady who I talked to was very helpful…
records.text: Lady who I talked to was very helpful and answered all my queries and made adjustments to our account details.  Thank you very much.The only problem that I encountered was that when being put through to the 4 option on the phone there was no answer with the general queries.  Instead I went through to the number 1 option, even though this was not exactly the correct fit, and was helped by a lovely lady called Stephanie. I tried the number 4 options 3x.

records.title: Quick and efficient
records.text: The process was quick and efficient and the communications clear and helpful. There were a couple of points which could be improved and which stopped the score being a 5: - before the sign on email, a call centre staff member attempted to call by mobile; as the signal was not goo the call did not go through but no voicemail was left. So my attempt to call back was time consuming and effectively unnecessary as the representative then emailed anyway. If an attempt to call is made, leave a voicemail to reduce the waste of time in call back attempts- the information on meter reading is vague. It is unclear whether or not it is important to take a reading.

records.title: Understanding Invoice
records.text: Phoned customer services and spoke to Charly, it was comforting to have someone who clearly spoke the English language and was able to navigate me around the invoice in simple terms. Personally the way the invoices are detailed you need to go on a college course to understand. At the end of the conversation I had a much better understanding.

records.title: I got an answer.
records.text: I got an answer.Company had checked my account.Sid I had £800+ credit, but didn't say anything about paying the credit back.

records.title: I had difficulty with the website
records.text: I had difficulty with the website till I chatted with Billy and he supplied me with the information needed. The website i find very user unfriendly

records.title: Update to; Issue bill on Friday, threaten legal action on Monday
records.text: Update to previous 1 star review: Later the same day I received a call from Caroline Watson , services manager.  After seeing the email I'd received this morning she apolgised for what was clearly a mistake on the part of the debt management department, and stated that she would raise the issue to the CEO.  I was highly satisfied with the way that Ms Watson dealt with the matter, I would give her 5 stars, but Everflow have been let down by their automated systems, hence 3 stars overall.Original review: I received a bill on my business account on Friday and this morning I got a "NOTICE OF DEFAULT" email, stating "Urgent payment is required in full. This is your last opportunity to resolve your arrears before the balance increases with additional collection fees...You have failed to respond to our numerous contact attempts. As payment has not been received, your account is being prepared for escalation to a debt collection agency. If payment is not received this week we will levy additional charges.Additionally, a collection agent may visit your premises, we may commence legal action, and /or possible disconnection."As if this wasn't bad enough, the period I'm being billed for is 7/10/24 to 7/11/24.Obviously I'm angry about this and the extra work that it has created for me, but I worry about the effect that this kind of bullying tactic would have on a more vulnerable customer.

records.title: Paying 2 months in advance, really!
records.text: I have been with Everflow since the start of the year. One thing to mention before switching to this provider is that they charge 2 months in advance, so beware,When my contract ends I will be going elsewhere.Update, pleased to have been contacted by Caroline from customer services so quickly to discuss my concerns.So customer services 5 starunclear billing plus advance payment 2 starsNew rating 3.5

records.title: Good customer service, impenetrable bills
records.text: Good customer service, in response to enquiries. I simply do not understand why the billing has to be so complex. I don't even have a water meter so it's not as if there's any actual usage to take count of. The bills are utterly incomprehensible. Mind you, I find that for other utilities also.

records.title: Helpful Service
records.text: Needed to phone customer service, quick response, helpful advisor Steve, and all questions were answered clearly.Would be 5 stars, but we have only had 1 meter reading in the last 12 months which has impacted our ability to budget for our water bills effectively.

records.title: Wool eyes
records.text: Didnt like the fact that I was given a price for the contract then they changed it before the 1st payment and said the price was correct at the time but always have increases in April!!!Not mentioned before switch new price very nearly as much as previously with business stream and a lot of work for very little savings for the business!!

records.title: Too early to tell really.
records.text: Too early to tell really.Sales person was good but, as with almost all organisations, you ring up for a simple query and you’re quickly into the wait a long time for answer, unusually high call volumes etc routine. Then asked about an app and touchID and was told not available.So rather average so far.

records.title: Lack of communication
records.text: I informed Water Plus that the meter had been changed on 31/1/23. It then took until early June for the Severn Trent engineer to visit and tell me what I already knew.Everflow then contacted me and told me what I had been telling them since February 2023!! Meantime, I was unable to use the portal to enter monthly meter reading.

records.title: Contract setup issues
records.text: On setup they used different rates than the agreed contracted rates so first bill was overcharged. Took a couple of weeks to get it sorted out but eventually did, credited us for the overcharge and since then no further issues.

records.title: The people I spoke to on the phone were…
records.text: The people I spoke to on the phone were helpful but everyone relies on customers scanning and emailing information. I Found this difficult and posted information which took longer to set up the account. You must realise that the older are not completely computer users.

records.title: The billing is really good and easy to…
records.text: The billing is really good and easy to understand however, I have asked many times for the meter to be read or moved as is is very difficult to lay in a busy drive way to hold a camera over the hole to take a picture of the meter to get the reading.  Risk assessment says, extremely dangerous.

records.title: Meter problems
records.text: It took sometime to identify what the problem was with the account but when it was discovered it was rectified quickly

records.title: Unfortunately I received my first…
records.text: Unfortunately I received my first invoice which is not for the amount I was quoted.Since I have not had any other interaction with the company I am disappointed as I was put forward by Bionic and they were very clear that the issue I had was being billed for more than I was quoted previously.

records.title: Can't speak to a customer service…
records.text: Following my review I have received a call from Customer services and 1 of my issues has been rectified together with a£20 credit as a goodwill jester My 2nd issue is being dealt with and hopefully will be sorted this week.

records.title: When you send an email for a water…
records.text: When you send an email for a water reading why is the meter number and other deltails not on the email so insted of having to find all that information we can just send a meter reading!!!

records.title: Check your bills for added charges
records.text: you have a habbit of adding extra charges without any explanation as to what they are for.previously you added over £500 to our  bill & it took months to sort out with the help of ofwat

records.title: I received my DDR confirmation…
records.text: I received my DDR confirmation addressed toDear  NA/NA       ???Not professional.The sales team were very helpful and polite at all times  without being pushy

records.title: Not switched yet
records.text: We haven't switched over yet so can't give a higher score.  However I have used Everflow whilst working for a previous Company and the service was always good.

records.title: water changeover
records.text: We have just moved the Everflow, and the change over has been a little bit challenging at times due to issues such as not being charged VAT, the 2 companies not working well together on the changeover. However, I have found that the customer services team respond quickly to any query and try their best to help - a massive improvement on the previous company - Kay in customer services has been very quick to respond in particular

records.title: Reported a faulty water meter in early…
records.text: Reported a faulty water meter in early 2023, at the time the agent said it will be checked the next time they read it. I learned, via email in Oct 24 they never read meters! We agreed to them replacing the faulty meter recently but they want to charge us for equipment we do not own and their lack of maintenance and meter reading.

records.title: Great to start with but predatory…
records.text: Great to start with but predatory renewal terms trying to force us to continue with them, and big price hikes after initial contract - well above competitive market rates.

records.title: dont keep pressure selling
records.text: The service is fine but dont keep phoning me up every 3 days trying to sell you waste service. its pressure and I dont want it

records.title: Not great customer services on this…
records.text: Not great customer services on this occasion. First time I've had to contact the CS team due to a very high bill (nearly 4 times more than normal) which they advised could be due to a leak - they said they'll send me some self check leak document. Which they've not. I requested for them to send me last 6 meter reads - which they've not. And we've checked internally to the shop and there's no leak hence reaching out to CS team. Been 2 weeks since I last heard from them. Have sent them 5 to 6 emails.

records.title: Incorrect invoicing
records.text: Had an invoice for the Church In July saying we were nearly £900 in credit but now we allegedly owe over £2000. The meter is apparently being read but not sure how as it’s impossible to read it (I’ve tried). I’m paying £130 per month (we were paying around £40 per month) until they sort it but there doesn’t seem to be any movement from them. Perhaps I should stop my payment then they might do something. Only reason you’re getting a 2* is because the ladies on the phone were pleasant and tried to help.

records.title: They want your arm and leg to end policy.
records.text: A great company until you no longer require them. My business moved from the property that we were paying for and therefore cancelled the policy but Everflow is pretty much calling me a liar and wants a copy of my lease with end date or copies of conversations with landlord. Shared with them a snipet of lease with details but still wasn’t good enough - was told they wanted to see the legal signatures. I was literally paying the company £12 a month for water rates and they are making it so difficult to close the policy.

records.title: Asks for meter reading when nearly unreadable
records.text: Recieved an unexpected bill of over £900 based on estimated usage so decided to follow the Everflow's advice to send a water reading each month. However our water meter is outside in the road on a corner so it's dangerous to get to and when I opened it up and dug it out the cover is all scratched so it's nearly impossible to read. Luckily a neighbour came over and had magnifying glasses and was able work out the number on the meter with me by guessing some of the numbers based on the estimated read. I asked everflow if we could get the meter replaced or even just the cover changed to make it readable. An agent called Natalie replied and informed me that it's still readable so it can't be replaced.

records.title: meter reading impossible
records.text: I have advised that the water meter is under water and the meter is not readable. I have sent photos confirming the same as requested by you. Yet you continue to request that i undertake a meter read. Months ater the meter is still under water.

records.title: No problems for years until now
records.text: No problems for years until now. No longer receiving bills by email, and unable to set up the online portal account as the verification email never arrives. And customer service not answering emails or phone?

records.title: I received an email saying they had…contacted me
records.text: I received an email saying they had tried to contact me. But they hadnt as I didn’t have any missed calls I responded to this effect, so they checked they had the correct phone number, but still didnt try it to contact me to see if it worked.!!

records.title: I have made the best choice by going…

records.title: Very helpful staff

records.title: I am happy with their customer service…
records.text: I am happy with their customer service and the filter itself. I love the taste of it. Also the hot and cold water option makes my life very easy as a mum of 2 children. Thank you monso water providing us that good service

records.title: I have had my water filtration system…
records.text: I have had my water filtration system for a year now and I highly recommend if you want clean and pure tasty waterThank you monso water Today lady attend the servise she done her jop perfectly

records.title: I am very happy with monso water..taste…
records.text: I am very happy with monso water..taste of water is great..costumer service is amazing Highly recommended Thank you monso

records.title: Monso misty
records.text: Really friendly and helpful staff clean and quick installation throughout. Water quality and taste is wonderful recommend to everyone.

records.title: Water test amazing and also ı happy…

description:
Wave is an award-winning, national water and wastewater retailer and we’re here to support organisations who are working hard to run better, the businesses striving to grow faster, and the companies dedicated to going greener.
Helping our customers manage their water and wastewater is what we do. We want organisations to count on us to find efficiencies and sustainable ways to reduce consumption, to help drive down water waste, and save money on their bills. We use our specialist knowledge and expertise to support over 300,000 customers from SMEs to the Public Sector, large industrial sites to country-wide commercial organisations.
But our work doesn’t stop there. We’re committed to making a difference in local communities through volunteering, social value days and charity work, as well as enhancing belief and potential amongst the next generation as part of our Social and Sustainability Promise.
Our commitment to our people, customers and our planet has all helped us to become the only retailer to be awarded Water Retailer of the Year twice, in both 2021 & 2023.

records.text: John was particularly helpful today, explaining details very clearly and making changes to our online account that I was not aware of.

records.text: Angela was very polite and helpful. I gave her quite a tricky query to tackle and she did everything I needed to resolve it. What a star, thank you.

records.title: Very helpful initial support
records.text: Had a surprise with a recent bill. Massive charge compared to years of small ones. Whilst I did wait for over 5 minutes for the phone to be answered Hannah was immediately helpful and kept me advised of her intended support at all times. I felt reassured someone was actually keen to sort out my problem. She called me back after making internal enquiries and sent helpful photos of our meter and their records over a period of a few years. The issue is still outstanding but so far, very good service.

records.title: Lost metre mystery.
records.text: Laura was so helpful and pleasant this morning and helped put my mind at rest.My metre which is somewhere in a field hasn't been read for 6 years  as no-one can find it. Hopefully now she is on the case it will get sorted.

records.title: Today after a lengthy dispute in…
records.text: Today after a lengthy dispute in closing our account witn Wave & Northumberlandwater, Edward who has advised us over our issues in this matter phoned me today and after further discussion with him, the saga was finally resolved, settle and closed AMEN.I would emphasise that I doubt this would have been amicably settled without the assistance of Edward and this is greatly appreciated.

records.title: Very helpful.
records.text: Petra was very helpful checking the progress of the transfer of my account and closing meter readings.One Delta - English is not Petra's first language: no problem with the conversation with her throughout, but perhaps without context I had to ask her to repeat her name on first connecting. Just a thought.

records.title: Disappointing not to be able to phone but …
records.text: Disappointing not to be able to phone today but unlike other chat experiences Tracey was on line quickly and resolved the issue effectivelyWanted a transcript which I was told would be offered when the session ended. However the session didn't seem to end itself so I lost that opportunityEDIT: I found that when the chat window closed, I was offered transcript after all which I downloaded successfully!

records.title: Good customer service
records.text: The representative was polite and gave me the information I requested.  He assisted with my query and we came up with a solution.I marked it down because I was on hold for a while and my call was cut off on the first try.

records.title: Customer service confusion resolved by Complaints team
records.text: We had a problem with changing the amount of water returned to sewer as we can demonstrate that most of the water is used for irrigation. The discussion started in Dec 22 and by Oct 24 we had spoken to many different customer advisors who came up with many different requirements. It was pushing water uphill, so we finally raised a complaint. Things changed! Within hours, Edward Duncan in the complaints team sorted out what the issues were and within days we had the contract changes in place. Then he was able to obtain retrospective implementation and obtain a refund. So, a great pity that the regular customer service could not resolve issue but full marks to the complaints team!

records.title: Good Customer Service can change your view!!!
records.text: Experience wasn't great, until we finally spoke to Edward - complaint had been open for several months and every time we called to try and clarify the situation, we were just told the problem was our fault.Finally, we spoke to Edward, who just took the complaint on, instead of passing us from pillar to post and dealt with it professionally and actually did what he said he was going to do.  Turned out the issue wasn't down to us, but due to a storm putting on extra units - thank you Edward!  I hope you gain the recognition for the work you did here.

records.title: Ed in Wave Customer Services - 5 stars
records.text: Ed has handled a complex 4 year dispute over incorrect bills with sensitivity and diligence, resulting in a reduction of our bills.  His customer care skills have been second to none and he has always done what he said he was going to do (which is refreshing especially in utility companies), keeping us informed every step of the way.  I would give Ed himself 5 stars but I have to mark down Wave overall because of the length of time elements of the dispute  took (through no fault of Ed's)! Without him we would still be in dispute. Thank you for your help Ed.

records.title: Thank you Tony!!!!!
records.text: After a terrible terrible experience with Wave for several years, with your technical billing problems that they still haven’t fixed, we have been fortunate enough to find Tony in the SME Customer experience team, who has been a star, and is now getting bills produced manually.So many thanks Tony, your help is greatly appreciated, But come on Wave, pl get your systems sorted to make Tony’s life easier - you’ve had this problem for about 5 years now and it’s still not sorted…….

records.title: Great people when you need to call
records.text: Thank you Angela for your help on our call today. A conversation and not just a transaction. It's what good customer service looks like, and have always found the Wave team very friendly and human.Wave, we've had a smart meter fitted last month unannounced by Anglian Water, but can't gain access to the hourly reads to try and identify a potential leak they advised us about. Anglian refused to share the hourly data and the View Consumption History on our customer account doesn't work. Please can you fix this so customers can spot any unusual consumption to quickly spot a leak? Thank you :-)

records.title: People make your business - look after them!
records.text: Great service from Angela who helped me enter a meter reading when, for one reason, my Wave had locked me out of my account. Angela was very polite, friendly and professional. and sorted both the meter reading and the login issue immediately and without any fuss. What a woman!!

records.title: I had need to trace the water account…
records.text: I had need to trace the water account for a recently acquired commercial property.Alex sent me information but for a reason beyond my comprehension it got lost in the net. Alex promised to send a copy when next available  but forgot over the weekend. Donna followed up her colleagues and the email was received Monday.All very helpful but timing lacked a little concentration.Telecalls to Wave are a little slow.

records.title: Chat works ok for straightforward…
records.text: Chat works ok for straightforward queries. But website search is hard to use ie couldn't find anything relating to direct debit mandate changes. Also they have always spelled our customer name wrong and there is nowhere on the site to change this.

records.title: Helpful in resolving historic problem on account
records.text: Our client was the subject of an identity theft which resulted in claims against our client. The issue had existed for sometime, but with the help of Paul, the matter has now been resolved and closed to our client's satisfaction. Paul was courteous and helpful in resolving this issue.

records.title: Jayne Adam
records.text: The ONLY thing that made the experience great is JAYNE Adam, SME Team Leader, who corrected an ongoing problem that we keep having with Wave, who keep assuring us it is solved when it is not. After the 3rd or 4th time of erroneously receiving £10,000 bills which aren’t ours, Jayne has been charming, patient and highly competent. The problem is at Wave’s administrative end. I cannot recommend Jayne Adam highly enough. All companies need a Jayne Adam.

records.title: Did not have to wait to long to speak…
records.text: Did not have to wait to long to speak to someone and Chloe was very helpful and changed the details on our account which I was unable to do on line. I could understand all she was asking ( which makes a change ) and in less than 5 minutes all was complete. Thanks Chloe a great help.

records.title: Ian  CreditControl Advisor
records.text: Ian , Credit Control Advisor very friendly and professional. His explanations very clear and advised me of next steps to be taken and time frame.

records.title: Tracey was great on the live chat
records.text: Tracey was great on the live chat.  No long pauses (like with other companies) and she actioned my requests without any fuss.  After dealing with some of your competitors and speaking to south africa all week, it was great to speak with someone UK based who understands their job.  Please give Tracey an extra days holiday this year, she's earnt it!

records.title: Richie
records.text: Richie, the customer service rep, was amazing, very nice, very helpful. But, I am not happy with the service Wave have provided and the fact they are trying to charge me triple the water I was being charged on a domestic rate vs business rate. Water is water, how can this rate hike be justified?

records.title: Excellent complaint management
records.text: As the landlord of a commercial tenanted property I had to repossess, I had a very difficult time with your customer services team who I found obstructive and unhelpful when trying to switch the account into my name temporarily (prior to a new tenant coming in) to enable me to pay daily standing charges etc as the property was empty.  However your sullied reputation has been saved by John who dealt with my formal complaint very well indeed.  He has sorted out the issue and was very apologetic.  Super work John!  I would give you 5 stars if this review was all about you!

records.title: From terrible le to brilliant
records.text: My initial dealing with wave utilities as someone who has never been a customer of theirs stemmed from an debt collection agency erroneously contacting me through a misguided Google search After many hours to said dca and to wave utities I was tearing my hair out, as nothing was being done. Finally a man called Phil fothergill got involved and saw what had happened and sorted the whole stressful situation out very efficiently. Hence the ediumnstar rating....wave went from terrible to brilliant thanks to this man

records.title: Chasing clarity on our business…
records.text: Chasing clarity on our business account as the meter was faulty... DD of £200 seems high considering we appear £1000 in credit. Awaiting an update form the wholesaler to get an accurate re-allignment of typical usage going forward. First requested this early Dec, now being informed we still have to wait another few weeks as the wrong form was submitted?. Not ideal, but contact centre chat was helpful at least.

records.title: The first time i phoned a man answered…
records.text: The first time i phoned a man answered the phone & said he was not able to answer my question regarding the new charges & breakdown of them & was going to put me onto someone else who was able to answer my question . I waited for 10 mins without reply & terminated the call . i then rang again & spoke to a lady who was able to attempt to explain the new charges & breakdown of them . I advised her that i had not been informed of the new charges from april 23 & furthermore felt that the breakdown of Potable water metering & fixed supply charge was a complicated , confusing  & unecessary way of providing bills to its private customers .Furthermore no mention was made about the increase of 5% for sewage rate charges . Mr R C Hurren

records.title: Getting less cr@p.
records.text: Hmm... not sure how to score this. I called the help line which was promptly answered and spoke to someone who was very helpful and pleasant. 5 stars for that and a great improvement on a couple of years ago when you'd be in a phone queue for 40 minutes and talk to someone who really couldn't be bothered.  However Wave still has issues, notably the billing system appears to be a random number generator spewing out multiple and contradictory bills, credit notes and final demands for payment. Also, I initially tried the online query form and after ten days have still not received a response, hence why I called the helpline. In summary, some progress, a really good helpline, but a long way to go.

records.title: Disastrous experience now sorted (hopefully)
records.text: Disastrous - 5+sign-in attempts to my account with "Wave UK"which handles two mains water supplies to our house and farm in Essex UK interrupted by another firm also named "Wave" operating out of Toronto Canada. Complete muddle but hopefully now sorted by Donna.

records.title: Denise is always helpful and deserves 5…
records.text: Denise is always helpful and deserves 5 stars. Wave however are a different case.  Take ages to sort any communications, send debt collectors to collect what is not owing and then charge for doing so. When every thing is sorted I will be looking at alternative suppliers.

records.title: Direct Debit taken but no Bill received

records.title: Need to tell wave we are moving
records.text: Need to tell wave we are moving, signed up for online account twice, no follow up email, online chat very good but why can't you fix this and why can't I fill in online that I am moving. back to another online chat. A lot of wasted time

records.title: Timely response.  But meter location still unknown...
records.text: Good to get a response 1 week after sending the enquiry.  Pity the response was quite vague and didn't confirm the actual location of the water meter.  The saga continues - hopefully the "complex query" will yield the real answer within the next fortnight.  Here's hoping!

records.title: Can't get a bill correct despite…
records.text: Edit. Updated 23rd January 2023.Wave could not get the bill correct despite sending them all the information and substantiation they requested in the first instance. Then when they finally (after 6+ months) got the dates and usage correct they add a disconnection and re-connection fee that occurred with the next customer to our bill. I explained this to Wave and asked them to remove it (the fee was dated after the final billing period), but they refused. Had to go through the complaints process to get it resolved. Once Rachel got involved it did all get sorted. If I were to rate the service based on the Complaints resolving only then it would be 5*. This however, would not be a reflection of the whole experience. Therefore I have upped my initial 1* review to 3*.

records.title: No e-mail address provided

records.title: Redeemed Faith
records.text: I had a payment query and wanted some help. The advisor I spoke to was extremely condescending and very unhelpful and awkward. I ended up putting the phone down as I was getting extremely frustrated with her tone, lack of help and the remarks and sniggering after her comments. However, after leaving feedback her manager phoned me back personally and apologised assuring me this would be addressed and training given to assure this service is not repeated. The manager was extremely helpful and personable and obviously demonstrated good service was important to the company.

records.title: In 6 weeks still have not received my…
records.text: In 6 weeks still have not received my final bill? The lady who delt with my enquiry was most helpful she couldn't have done more for me . It is the system that needs to be looked at.

records.title: Unhelpful staff member
records.text: Unhelpful staff member, was not prepared to remove debt collection charges when they have incorrectly been added to our account.Staff member could not advise when issue would be resolved.Issue was resolved within 12 hours however, the manor of the staff could be improved and be more friendly towards it's customers

records.title: Chasing payment without invoice.
records.text: No invoice has been received from Wave yet a letter appears demanding payment of the aforementioned non-received invoice and a fee of £14.50 if no payment is received in 7 days. Why not phone to check the situation? After all they demand your phone number every time you call. So I email the address on the letter and a day after get a reply saying they ‘aim to reply in 5 working days’, which with the weekend makes Wave ‘entitled’ to charge the £14.50 time penalty without even answering the query. So I’ve paid these bullies the amount today without the physical invoice I need (it’s a charity). Shambles. Not the first poor performance, there was a response before but the distinctly customer unfriendly style persists.

records.title: No closer to an Answer
records.text: I do not feel that my questions were answered. Our account could not be closed due to a Wave system error and there was no timescale provided for a solution, nor an apology for the delay as a result of an internal issue. I am no closer to receiving a refund of credit balances on account dating back at least 4 months. I appreciate the explanations attempted and understand that it was not the agent's fault, but no real substance or information provided.

records.title: Wave has reopened my account invalidly
records.text: Wave has reopened my account invalidly. I moved out of a commercial property on January 31. I informed WAVE of this and asked they close the account. Our landlord is falsely claiming we are still liable for the lease, and Wave, going only by his word, has reopened the account. This should not be allowed to happen.

records.title: I would advise not to use live chat…
records.text: I would advise not to use live chat unless you have a long time spare and want to lose the will to live.  Probably easier getting through Security to the White House! Name, email, address, account number, balance on account, telephone number and still wanted a bill number and bill date.  All this when able to set up DD online so easy only to find they hadn't allocated a payment so DD was too high.  When they eventually found the payment could not amend without meter reading which I have to email anyway!

records.title: Wave keep raising my DD payments and…
records.text: Wave keep raising my DD payments and its not required at all due to the seasonal usage of water. Every year I need to contact them after recieving a scary letter to DOUBLE my payments. What a waste of time and they should be reimburing me for the hour I have just wasted once again! The advisor was helpful and tried to understand what I was saying. Poor company policies I would guess!

records.title: The wait time this morning 12:01 until…
records.text: The wait time this morning 12:01 until around 12:25 was too long! However, when Joanne answered my call she was extremely polite, helpful, knowledgeable, friendly and really efficient, calm and orgainised.

records.title: Poor response rate
records.text: Poor response rate - it took almost a month to respond to our email, even though Wave's automated response states it will aim to respond within 10 working days, so due to this I have scored 2/5 accordingly.

records.title: Wave are very hard to do business with
records.text: Wave are very hard to do business with. Each phone call begins with a compulsory trawl through all your contact data, even if you say nothing has changed they still insist. They force a password change on your online access every 6 months. You enter your current password to log in but then find until the change is done you actually don't have any access. The boxes offered for your 2 matching brand new passwords will self-populate your new passwords but depending on your screen only then will you see that you have to re-enter the old one again - when your system has just saved the new ones and overwritten the old so you are now locked out. Until you phone them, and go through all your data again...... It really has to be smoother than this please Wave.Continuation....email sent to Wave on 14/2/24, acknowledged same day by email with a reference number and saying 'aim to respond in 10 working days' (a long time for a response anyway but that's the stated Wave service offer). 14 working days on now and still no sign of a reply (versus the next day responses on Trustpilot).

records.title: Shocking customer service
records.text: Shocking customer service, poorly replied and it was only when I said I will escalate that I got a little more detail. Very very poor and unhelpful when you are trying to move forward with bills.

records.title: Excellent, highly recommend
records.text: Ref: 13888682Contacted Severn Trent via WhatsApp on Friday 3rd January about a blockage that was causing my outside drains to overflow. They arranged for someone to come out no later than the 6th January.Sean Hudspeth & Joe Townsend attended on 5th January, quickly figured out the issue and resolved it. Very polite and explained the issue when I asked. Cannot recommend severn trent enough.

records.title: High Quality service
records.text: As a water company I had low expectations. How wrong can you be. Minor leak reported via internet. Had visit the following day and acknowledged. That there was a leak at boundary box. Street stop tap now replaced with again super service from ST contractor. Contractor reported low pressure and again followed up by ST the following day.

records.title: I called ST to rport a blocked sewer…
records.text: I called ST to report a blocked sewer system across 4 elderly persons bungalows on 1 Jan  and within 4 hrs Mathew Riley and Tom Allport arrived in the dark evening and successfully cleared all blockages after much effort.Efficient and courtious.Thank you, Graham T. Job ref 13886945

records.title: Christian and Lewis feedback
records.text: Christian and Lewis were very helpful and kept me informed of what was happening when they attended. They sorted the initial problem and a further team will come to resolve the additional work required. They offered to clear up the garden but due to frozen equipment was not possible. However they have requested that the next team do this when they visit.A big thank you to them both.

records.title: A credit to Severn Trent…
records.text: Severn Trent Engineer William Dean our reference No 13887765 called today to assist with a ceased mains water tap in the street. Water needed to be turned off ASAP due to flood in house. William was professional, extremeley polite and very reassuring. There are a lot of tradesmen who could take a leaf out of this young mans book. Replacement tap required, would be great if William is part of the team.

records.title: Reference number 13888725- brilliant service!
records.text: Reference number 13888725. Sean Hudspeth and Joe Townsend attended our house today to clear a blockage from our drain pipe which meant the sinks in our house were backing up with sewage, this meant we were unable to use any facilities. They came out within the allotted time(less than 24 hours)  and were so friendly and helpful, they cleared the blockage and explained everything thoroughly. A credit to Severn Trent. Thanks again lads !

records.title: Blockage
records.text: 13882856Had a blockage from start to finish Severn Trent were very professional and kept my mind at ease. The telephone call I had was excellent every thing explained in detail.Also the engineers were first class being Christmas Eve I thought they might be a bit down, but totally the opposite Graeme Isaacs and George Gardner just cracked on and got the job done with minimum fuss!!!Hopefully I won’t have to see them to soon, but if I do I’d be more than happy to deal with again!!!

records.title: Chris is Ace
records.text: Our main engineer Chris finally solved a problem we've been having for months on job ref 13886101. We recently had a pavement stopcock fitted after he first came to check our pressure was low in our house, the pressure is still low in parts and after he assessed the different taps in the house he deducted that the fault was in a pipe somewhere in our kitchen. Now that we know the fault lies within our house we can call a plumber in to sort the problem ready for a combi boiler installation.

records.title: Severn Trent Engineer Lucy Chesterman…
records.text: Severn Trent Engineer Lucy Chesterman our reference No 13888638,my flat water supply was stoped for 24hours last night i called Severn Trent water emergency number at 2am. early in morning Engineer Lucy pop up and quickly fix water pipe in out side and inaide my property,like angel she show up and saved me,I was desperated.lucy was friendly,hardworking,professional and enthusiastic.she quickly fix problem I really appreciate her ....

records.title: Great service in 2024
records.text: This is not super recent, probably 3rd quarter of 2024, Mdm Harjit Kennedy picked up my call and she was so helpful, so reassuring and professional.  She clarified my water bill and helped me settle my confusion.  I am learning today, Severn Trent really has great service overall. Really appreciative of her help to clarify my bills.  Happy New Year Mdm Harjit Kennedy!

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service this morning from William Dean. Turned up on time and explained everything clearly. 13884153

records.title: Prompt response
records.text: Very pleased that Severn Trent came out next day once we discovered a leak and although they were unable to completely fix the problem with the leak being on our premises, John Powell diagnosed the problem and talked us through the options. He did manage to reduce the flow too. Ref no 13877080

records.title: Job no 13856836
