The bureaucracy and excessive contacts were misleading and unnecessary, I received calls saying they were coming on a certain date then text messages cancelling on more than one occasion. It's no wonder your men actually doing the jobs are so busy and stretched. I suggest you get rid of the paper pushers, telephone texters and callers and employ more field staff.

13882947.  I had difficulty working with website form to report a leak so phoned in the end.  I was surprised to have a call from Shane Hill later the same day to say he would be at the leak soon. He then phoned after he checked it out to tell me he would arrange for it to be repaired in a few days' time.  He was courteous and friendly.

records.title: Polite & helpful
records.text: Paul H was very polite, helpful and got the problem sorted without the need for a bigger job! Thank you 😊Order number 13881503

records.title: Few water leaks in our local area
records.text: Few water leaks in our local area, sewage spills into the local river seem to be limited in the past year.

records.title: The gentlemen came and told us the…
records.text: The gentlemen came and told us the problem and has created a job to be done by seven Trent he was polite and informative and kept us informed of all that was being done. Darren Briggs was very helpful. 13865649 was the job number.

records.title: I had a visit to my property from Wayne…
records.text: I had a visit to my property from Wayne (13862338) to look at pressure/flow issues. Wayne was pleasant, easy to interact with and open about what the problem may be, what the next steps were and actions he was going to take moving forward.Overall I was very happy with the visit and help provided

records.title: Another estimated bill
records.text: Review updated after receiving a call about why the meter is not being read ...it appears that there is a fault with the radio transmitter....being sorted ...and many thanks to Alex for his reply and chat ...a very professional member of staff.  Try reading the meter instead of forcing  a pensioner to kneel on the pavement ....unless you would care to add me to your payroll!Estimated bills are not what we expect.

records.title: After a few issues getting a call out…
records.text: After a few issues getting a call out to unblock a sewer pipe, the engineers were absolutely amazing. Tracy M and Chris H soon had the issue sorted and were so cheerful. Whatever you pay them it isn’t enough. Thank you guys

records.title: can't fault the engineer, the customer service phone line though.....
records.text: 13861195 (Mo Nuur). I can't fault the engineer, arrived when stated and he was a good hour here inspecting for the cause of our issue (cellar filling up with water with no obvious source, we'd already had Homeserve and a sewage team to rule out internal pipes or drains/sewers). While there's no definite answer still and we're awaiting lab test results of the water he ruled out many possible sources and was able to discover a multitude of other issues happening in the street that may be contributing factors (for example, he found out almost 10 houses next to us all have leaking pipes).Phone line is a completely different matter, and one that will probably be on a separate review when the complaints process is completed.

records.title: Severn Trent inspector Mo Nuur came to…
records.text: Severn Trent inspector Mo Nuur came to investigate a noisy pipe problem on a shared water main. He was very polite, friendly and professional. A valve on the main was renewed. Unfortunately this hasn't resolved the problem. He will be coming back to try to identify what is causing the noisy pipes. Mo has been very approachable at all times and is certainly an asset to Severn Trent. Thank you.

records.title: Drain blockage
records.text: Gave us courtesy call before arriving which is always good. Arrive at job very polite and professional. Sorted the problem quickly and efficiently without any fuss. Left the work area clean and tidy. Thanks Anthony wilkes and mark nicolas

records.title: Ref: Neil 13761863
records.text: Ref: Neil 13761863 Neil was very helpful, explained clearly what he had done and what might happen next.  ST responded immediately to our initial report of a  leak and told us when to expect a follow-up visit.  Neil fixed a leak at the boundary box straight away and  arranged for further investigations.  He left clear contact details and we can call him at any time for more information.  A very pleasant experience.

records.title: There was a report of a sewage leak on…
records.text: There was a report of a sewage leak on our street. It turns out that the pipes had deteriorated and broken down at the back of my property so they repaired the leak. A few days later there was a smell of sewage and when they investigated, they found that there was a blockage of wipes at the interceptor. Andrew was the guy from Severn Trent who attended and was very helpful with this and explained how wipes can block drains. The problem being is that it is a shared drain and so neighbours must be throwing wipes down the drains. Andrew was reassuring and helped by providing neighbours with a leaflet on do’s and don’ts.

records.title: When we logged the fault we were told…
records.text: When we logged the fault we were told it could take up to 4 days to fix which was disappointing. The fault actually got fixed in 2 and the team that came out to fix the problem, Ant and Kayleigh, were very friendly and helpful and got the job done quickly and efficiently. They diagnosed the root cause of the problem which will need more work doing by Severn Trent and logged a job for this to happen too.

records.title: I never give a five.
records.text: I never give a five.. Please try to not to dump waste into our rivers and lakes, and the sea. instead of paying your shareholders loads of money, invest my money into updating the infrastructure to cope with the waste water.  Thank You.

records.title: Usually I find it very easy to pay my…
records.text: Usually I find it very easy to pay my water bill but for some reason I had difficulty getting the page to accept my card number. It took me three or four attempts to enter the number, so I don't know what the problem was. Once this was done though, my payment was dealt with quickly

records.title: Asking a question
records.text: Even though things have been sorted out you still haven't told me why the e mail address and password I've been using for 2 years wasn't all of a sudden registering? I'd be grateful for a response please. Thank you.

records.title: Job No 13653358
records.text: Job No. 13653358. The guys on site, (Jamie R & Paul M), were excellent. Quickly cleared access to water stop tap and checked the tap was working correctly. I'm afraid their office tended to confuse rather than clarify as their "Track your job" gave the impression the job was completed a few days before they arrived on site, which left me thinking they would not be arriving on the date discussed.

records.title: It is interesting how
records.text: It is interesting how, after the showing on the 9th of December 2024 of the documentary on the BBC program Panorama on Seven Trent Water investigating river pollution and in-house finances, there was an influx of positive reviews with job numbers attached. It's just an observation, but some reviewers are not that silly. I hope you give your loyal employees a Christmas Bonus, not just the board of directors & shareholders.

records.title: Dan Ford messaged me and within 10 arrived
records.text: Dan Ford messaged me and within 10 minutes he arrived at our shop. Waterplus were unble to change our water meter as they could not turn the water off. They asked if Severn Trent could fix the problem, Dan was unable to fix the problem as it appears a new stopcock is required. He has started the process that this can be done, requiring the council to give permission to dig up the pavement to gain access for this.

records.title: I had nearly ten visits and they…
records.text: I had nearly ten visits and they couldn’t locate or resolve the problem. All the workmen were very polite and apologetic but still could not fix the problem. A workman called Mo Nuur came recently and resolved the problem instantly. If he had come first then I would give a great review, but with the length of time and amount of previous visits I have say the service was poor.

records.title: RUDE customer service agent
records.text: Had to call as had email from them saying I had a faulty meter, fair enough, but the guy I spoke to was beyond rude. Said one thing, then when I challeneged what he said he denied he had said it and started shouting at me ! Refused to listen to what I was saying, made incorrect assumptions about my lifestyle, refused to pass me onto a manager / supervisor. I WILL call back, I WILL make a formal complaint, however, I WONT speak to rude individuals who clearly have no understanding and are prepared to lie to me. Good job the call is recorded !!!!!Update: After a call from an exceptional agent the matter has been resolved. Fair play to seven Trent for reviewing the matter quickly and going above and beyond to sort the matter out.

records.title: I have recently provided a meter…
records.text: I have recently provided a meter reading which read the same as an interim reading when a member of your staff, visiting where I live, sought one. She asked for this to help her with whether I was paying too much or too little following your rise in rates earlier this year.Notwithstanding that reading, I sent the other on the first of the month which I have been doing for many years. This time, when asked why I was sending the reading, instead of replying 'for information only', I requested a bill. Two emails later, confusion reigns. They were both entirely different, therefore I remain thoroughly confused. I await clarification. Therefore, only three stars.

records.title: Good app
records.text: App appears to work fine, did most of what i wanted,  but on another topichave plumbing issues, probably air in system, and it need bleeding somehow, severn trent dont offer any real plumbing service.You would have thought severn trent could give a certification if a plumber passed courses with them and even a trades man paying 2.50 a month to them and a small day course acrredut and a severn ttent plumbers list would be nice, im surrounded by corporations who are oxy moronic and need there fat whipping out of them, they look and smell like doughnuts and custard creams

records.title: Had a leak outside mine and the…
records.text: Had a leak outside mine and the neighbour’s house one Friday night and noticed the reduction in my water pressure, phoned the Severn Trent water company to report the issue at 9pm. They said the team should be there within 12 hours….  I rang again on Saturday morning at 8am and told them I had no water, they said it should be before 1pm.   ‘Adam and Justin’ from Severn Trent water turned up at 9.20 to do the job, very polite and knowledgeable and soon sorted the problem and explained what it was!    Well done and thank you J. James

records.title: not happy with severn trent payment scheme
records.text: I'm paying my next bill off as quickly as possible in the largest amounts I can afford as a pensioner. Severn Trent offered me a payment scheme last year, I think I missed one payment possibly two. They said they'd been trying to get in touch with me, which is untrue. They had e.mail and phone no's. and I received no contact, until that is they informed me, in a threatening letter that they would be referring me to a credit collection agency if I didn't pay the remainder of the bill which was about £60. Very poor experience. I don't recommend their 'Big Difference' scheme. I feel that they lack understanding in regard to old age and the financial pressure many people are under. Best to pay quickly if you can and avoid upset or worry. Amy no missed calls or email?

records.title: Cannot set up direct debit online and…
records.text: Cannot set up direct debit online and call centre closed at 6pm when i finish work at the same time.You need to have longer opening times for working people and enable people to set up direct debits online without technical problems!!!!

records.title: To many screen to go through…
records.text: There were to many screen to go through before I actually made the payment all you want is one screen put your payment details in and pay not 4 screen. Also PayPal option would a good option so you can pay without having your cards at hand

records.title: Front line teams are great
records.text: Joe and Megan CF05 and the previous team who came out to us were great and deserved 5 stars, they worked hard to shift our blockage, the first team doing overtime.However, waiting time for unblocking a blocked and flooding sewage drain has moved from 48hrs to 7 days, meaning we have to restrict water usage in the house for that time. Management do not communicate with you when the work is not straightforward and you need more than one team. You are left wondering when the next team will come.

records.title: Online payment problem…
records.text: Unable to make online payment for second half year installment because it was not due until 1st October and message on st website informed me that online payments of less than 99p were not possible. Had to phone st to enable me to make an online payment which I did as I have always done before payment was due.

records.title: I have been trying to understand my…
records.text: I have been trying to understand my account with the different bills that come through and it doesn't make sense with dates etc.  I seem to be getting two bills? Tried going onto the guides and emailing to get advice but to no avail

records.title: No Bill email only late pay texts
records.text: The site is easy to navigate but there seems to be discrepancies with bills being sent to email.Alot of the time I only know I have to make a payment when I receive a text message saying I haven't paid my bill

records.title: They just don’t turn up!!!! (Unless you post a poor review)
records.text: Severn Trent were called last Friday (7 days ago)  as I am having problems with my outside drain. Initially I called Homeserve as I am insured with them and they came out and after investigation ascertained it was the main shared drain that was either blocked or damaged and this was the responsibility of Severn TrentThe homeserve engineer called them for me and also sent a VYN of the problem I was told Severn Trent would be out by close of play Monday  Despite numerous messages and phone calls to them they still haven’t shown up Just today 4 different people have assured me they would visit as the job had been dispatched   I’m still waiting as of 7-45pm I’ve made a complaint but when is anybody going to actually turn up to even look at the drain let alone fix it!!!!!After posting this review the engineers turned up the next morning It was indeed the shared drain and the engineers (Craig and Courtney) were fantastic, nothing was too much trouble and they kept me up to date with what was happening  6 days later I have had no problems It’s a shame it took a review to finally get Severn Trent out but I have upgraded the review to 3 stars purely on the basis of the 5 star work by Craig and Courtney

records.title: Online bills hiding the option of two-part payment
records.text: For the most part our water supply is fine, although one troublesome main in a neighbouring village can still cause problems.My comment relates to online annual bills which, in my view, deliberately hide the fact that payment in two parts is perfectly acceptable. The online bill, sent seven weeks before any payment is due, seems designed to encourage early, full payment. The old paper bill on the other hand made the two-part payment option quite clear.

records.title: Website is buggy
records.text: Website is buggy, reported it via survey for two months. No fix.It now makes you enter billing details even if they're the same as the acc details. It makes you enter the email address even though you login via email address. When selecting a information box the website zooms in that much you can only see one character.Possibly an attempt to push people into direct debit.

records.title: Fiddly on the mobile
records.text: Found it very fiddly at times making the payment via my mobile. I had to do a couple of bits twice. Plus getting the bank code from my messages was another frustrating thing. I don't imagine I'm the only 84 year old a bit slow on line.

records.title: Very Nice Customer Service Rep, But a VERY Long Wait.
records.text: The customer service staff on Twitter were lovely when they finally got around to dealing with my inquiry, but I had to wait online in the queue for over FIVE HOURS, by which time I'd managed to work out how to deal with my mum's online account problem myself. I had the day off and could stay at home to wait - I wouldn't normally be able to do that.Management, you need to employ more people. With the money you are making from the current water charges, it would seem you could afford it.

records.title: I had forgotten my password
records.text: I had forgotten my password.  I tried 4 times to change it and every time the message said I did not fit the criteria - which I checked and had!  Luckily I remembered my old password word

records.title: Had rats and the problem was identified…
records.text: Had rats and the problem was identified in the sewer. ST asked me to organise a CCTV and drain report (where does one find this) to come out. Then advised 90% cases customers need to foot the bill themselves.

records.title: Ian Smith
records.text: Ian Smith, Paul Scott 13852903. Came out to gas service 25/11/24 Just an update, the engineers who came to fix the leak told me yesterday the leak is not where the gas service engineers said it will be, still the leak location is still unknown, it looks like the gas service was not efficient as I thought it would be. I am changing my review

records.title: Needed Severn Trent to look at our…
records.text: Needed Severn Trent to look at our drainage. Told they would send someone within 72 hours. 72 hours later after waiting at the house for 3 days, contacted to say its another water company's area of responsibility. Utterly useless customer service.

records.title: Bill with a date from 03-2024-03-2025…
records.text: Bill with a date from 03-2024-03-2025 and they harassed and treat  with penalties etc. Water is not great and pressure on a tap  is medium to low. Do not recommend.

records.title: Shambles of a company
records.text: Poor management, operatives who can't see or smell sewage leaks, repeated calls to eventually find the few in the workforce who do actually work. E.g. local pumping station, over whelmed ever winter, obvious what the issue is but ST find excuses to not do the work. It wikk have cost more in over time attending the site than to fix the problem.Shambles of a company

records.title: Communication
records.text: Communication poor. My email has remained the same for 20 years still they send letters saying they can't email me.  No communication until the last minute in any issue. I had a water meter installed was not sent any information on standing charge then told i was behind on payments. Communication Severn Trent...always the key

records.title: It was incredibly difficult to leave…
records.text: It was incredibly difficult to leave the flat as the information you wanted was not accepted as it was too old. I was unable to move in with my partner on your records as there is NO WAY of moving out.

records.title: Very difficult to get hold of anyone…
records.text: Very difficult to get hold of anyone via the telephone, you tend to wait a long time, they do have a call back facility but even then you have to wait, there's no way of emailing them as far as I can see, and no online chat service where you could at least talk to a bot.  All probably due to staff cut backs and cost saving to the detriment of the customer.  Like everything now it's all heading app based, which is unhelpfull for the elderly who may not have a mobile but will be forced to get one, nice!

records.title: This Company is the worst of all the…
records.text: This Company is the worst of all the Water Companies I am a Pensioner and disabled and without my permission they took a large amount of money from my bank account saying I had used a large amount of water for one Month which is absurd I have a direct debit which is always been the same as well as the amount I use  I am absolutely disgusted. I intend to take action for theft.

records.title: Terrible customer service.
records.text: Merrily paying by installments, then out of the blue, a bill turns up. Currently on the eigth installment, but the website has been reset to the first installment and somehow I'm now owing more. Customer services didn't seem to understand anything, and the 'contact us' on Facebook messenger has been unanswered for 3 working days. Customer service is shocking.  Seems they have a fault with their billing system or something like that, but not admitted to yet. It's not like you can just switch suppliers either.

records.title: The perfect day

records.title: Mathew Fedar

Matthew has truly gone above and beyond, doing everything possible to resolve the matter swiftly and efficiently. i'm grateful to have had his assistance. wishing him all the best and thank you again.

records.title: Great service

records.title: sjivonne gave a really excellent…

records.title: Lwando has been extremely helpful…

I could not have hoped for a better service.  I am so pleased that I was able to speak with Lwando today in regard to our Ruby Energy account, thank you so much.

records.title: Kit fully understood what i needed to…
records.text: Kit fully understood what i needed to sort out, she sent me kinks with the correct form to fill out on line and return.

records.title: Sjivonn was helpful and agreed that…

records.title: Daniele sorted the issue of my billing…
records.text: Daniele sorted the issue of my billing with great care.

records.title: Thanks Asi
records.text: The advisor that helped me today, Asi, was very helpful, thorough and did her utmost to resolve my ongoing issue. I feel confident now that things will be resolved. Thank you Asi.

records.title: Justine was very quick and polite with…
records.text: Justine was very quick and polite with her response

records.title: I was contacted by scammers claiming to…
records.text: I was contacted by scammers claiming to be Ruby Energy who were after my bank details. I spoke with Justine Jacobs via Ruby's chat portal to confirm whether or not I was being scammed and she was very helpful.  Saved me from making a big mistake! As a side note, be careful with unsolicited calls claiming to be Ruby!

records.title: Very helpful …
records.text: The lady i spoke to was very helpful spoke me through my options. she also offered to help with anything else. the only problem was that the phone kept cutting out.

records.title: Fast response
records.text: Fast response

records.title: The chap I spoke to was very helpful…
records.text: The chap I spoke to was very helpful and polite, he is looking into why I’ve been charged so much for my gas which is also with Ruby. If he sorts it for me he will have earned 5*

records.title: Overall a good experience
records.text: Overall a good experience. The operative seemed helpful but at times. I did not get a clear understanding of the way the company processes a newly onboarded customer. We wait to see how things progress.

records.title: Good customer service
records.text: I have had some good experiences dealing with Ruby, the only problem is, the departments do not talk to each other, but today a lovely lady called Zikhona, sorted everything out for me. Thank you for all your help.

records.title: Spoke to Brenda Ntshona today
records.text: Spoke to Brenda Ntshona today, who was helpful and gave me the information required to deal with my query.

records.title: Portal access issues
records.text: I was having endless access problems to your online portal. I was ready to give a 1 star review after spending over half an hour on an on line chat with your Company only to find the portal access still didn't work. Sebo today sorted everything and followed up with a call back to check. So thank you Sebo, she deserves 5stars for her patience in resolving the problems.

records.title: 5 stars for Lynn
records.text: I would leave a 5 star review for the lady I have been dealing with Lynn C while sorting a change of tenancy, but as she is the only reason we have stayed with this company I had to take a star off, Lynn was amazing, so helpful and clear and willing to explain what was needed.but I did find the 4 calls a day while I was working with her from other people in the company, even after contracts were signed, really annoying! They def need more people like her if they want to keep customers and hound people less when surely it must show somewhere there has been contact!

records.title: Quick and efficient service.
records.text: Quick and efficient service.Took a phone call from Ben Stewart today regarding an electricity supply - he offered us a Landlord's account on better terms, with lower rates for standing charges. Made the sign up process very straighforward. Thank-you

records.title: They have been brilliant through what…
records.text: They have been brilliant through what has been a traumatic experience! Who would have thought just getting electric could be so difficult 😞 be careful if you use a broker and don’t be afraid to approach the company directly would be my advice.

records.title: First customer service I've been satisfied with.
records.text: Spoke with Sashen regarding my account. He was very helpful and informative - but not the usual support I get from the company. I wouldn't choose this company again. Been with them 7 years & it's cost me a fortune, as you get tricked into staying & bills rise, even when in a fixed rate contract! My January electricity bill is almost double the usual costs, although the business has been quieter through January & we have been closed more than other months - it doesn't make any logical sense.

records.title: Direct Debit problem
records.text: Online chat with Cashiefa Seegers regarding ongoing problem with direct debit. Now sorted - thank you!I would have given 5 stars but this was the third time I have had to request that the late payment charge be removed as direct debit was in place. Hopefully this is now finally resolved....

records.title: Excellent CS but poor company operation
records.text: Chris, the customer officer, was amazing and patient answering all my questions and explained things in details. One star off was the chaotic switching arrangement and the unprofessional sales representative (to be fair to BES, the s.r. should be under a broker, so BES should not be liable for that)

records.title: Owam - model Complaints Handler
records.text: Owam. He is what made the experience bearable and it was his professionalism that has resolved the issue. BES as a company, I still despise! The creation of the recent issue is entirely their fault and had been an absolute pain to deal with. Owam however, went above and beyond to find resolution. We’ve agreed on one today. Many employees of BES could learn a thing or two from him!

records.title: Dealt with Matthew Feder on virtual…
records.text: Dealt with Matthew Feder on virtual assistant. Took my meter reading and updated my account with it. He was very helpful. Would have been 5 stars but the chat box seemed to work quite slowly.

records.title: The main problem in dealing with BES is…
records.text: The main problem in dealing with BES is you never know which office you are dealing with or is trying to contact you which can lead to confusion. However dealing with Chevon was easy and she went out of her way to make sure all of our queries were dealt with

records.title: Professional and helpful
records.text: After having a bad experience with the service provided by your company via the phone and internet today, this customer service rep was professional and helpful and managed to resolve my issue quickly. She was polite and reassuring. I was so relieved to finally get through to someone who was willing to help me with my issue as well as raising a complaint about previous service.Thank you!

records.title: Kris-lyn is an asset to the company
records.text: Kris-lyn is an asset to the company, I believe in the past I have given her a 5* review.  She is one person who seems able to make things work properly and corrects other peoples mistakes.  It's just a shame she's in the complaints department so things have already gone wrong before you get to her.

records.title: I had a chat conversation with Justine…
records.text: I had a chat conversation with Justine Jacobs, she was helpful. I think you should have credit notes available to download on your portal in the same way you do invoices.

records.title: Pleasant gent
records.text: Pleasant gent, helpful only downfall was line was breaking up so had to keep repeating,

records.title: The person in customer services was good, the company is terrible
records.text: The person in customer services was very good. However the company, in how they invoice, are terrible, in the space of 2 days I had 3 different invoices for the same period.they always deny I have recorded my meter reading online, even though I have a mail from them proving the meters have been read !

records.title: I got thousands of calls from their…
records.text: I got thousands of calls from their sales representatives and it was all resulting into a bad day for me until I spoke with Yandiswa who verified and made the experience better.

records.title: I had nothing but issues with the…
records.text: I had nothing but issues with the credit control department, I got sent to a manager from this department Naz & he was brilliant! Resolved my issue and worked tirelessly to make sure I was sorted & okay

records.title: Change business address
records.text: Called to transfer my account to a different address which I couldn’t do so had to cancel and start again! The person I was speaking to kept on asking me the same questions over and over. I had no problem sorting out my water but changing my electric was a different story in total it’s taken me about a month to sort out.

records.title: Very poor experience
records.text: Liked - call handler Kris- lyn Crouch very professional Dislike - all other aspects of the process and the poor systems of BES. This has been an unnecessary episode created by your inadequate systems that should not have happened and due to your inadequate systems took far too long to resolve causing me the customer huge amounts of time and stress. It would be interesting if you read and act on this.

records.title: They made a mistake but they fixed it.
records.text: Ruby Energy mistakenly added a second property to my account and emailed me saying I was responsible for paying the electricity, despite it not being my property. After leaving a review here, they phoned and apologised and removed the 2nd property. I have amended this review accordingly.

records.title: I could not register for an online…
records.text: I could not register for an online account to access my invoice, as there was an error, told to wait 5 day or pay £8 for an invoice to be posted. Was asked to set up DD, but they didn't understand we are a very large company that can't pay in that way but kept asking. handler was ok and just doing her job but i hope the invoice doesn't come and i am expected to pay immediately when i cannot get access to the actual invoice.

records.title: The gentleman was very helpful
records.text: The gentleman was very helpful, he explained how and when to read and submit the readings each month. He was very polite and patient but I did have difficulty in understanding him at times.

records.title: Charlotte was attentive to my concerns…
records.text: Charlotte was attentive to my concerns and effectively resolved my issue, which I truly appreciate. As a busy business owner, I simply don’t have the time to receive multiple calls each day from the Ruby telesales team, so I commend her with 3 stars for her efforts in addressing my needs but the team does need to read the notes before attempting to call me.I would have given her a 5-star rating if it weren't for the challenges I've faced with the company overall. My experience previously with BES Utilities and now Ruby Utilities has been far from smooth. I’ve encountered issues such as inflated bills and persistent problems with smart meters, among other concerns.While Charlotte’s service was commendable, it’s clear that the company needs to improve its overall operations to ensure a better experience for its customers.

records.title: The Person/people on the phone are…
records.text: The Person/people on the phone are brilliant, The company is a disorganised mess. I have tried, with no exaggeration around 30 times to have my name put on as the main account holder and NOTHING has changed. The people you speak to on the phone are all really nice and helpful but they're clearly working with a broken system. People on the phone 5/5. company 0/5.

records.title: Chat function is useful as it's…
records.text: Chat function is useful as it's typically a long wait to get through by phone. Takes a while to get through security but that's ok. Rep was helpful and I followed her instructions regarding following up with an email, however the generic reply from the email address bears no resemblance to my query.  Maybe it'll be fine :)

records.title: My Issue was Dealt with
records.text: My Issue was Dealt with I initially called BES to query the refund that was sitting on our account, once I had spoken to them they advised that the refund would be sent through. A higher score would have been given had the refund been sent automatically as it was an end of contract. Another thing that reduced the stars was the long wait on the telephone and then being cut off without a call back.  Also a long wait on the Web Chat. Otherwise both Customer Services Employees were polite and competent.

records.title: I spoke to Rene
records.text: I spoke to Rene , to day to discuss a large bill, she has booked me a smart meter appointment so this doesnt happen again. I had over £700 taken out from my account, im a micro-business, never would I ever use this amount of gas in 1 month. She was unable to help me with a refund, however has told me to contact them back on 31st to submit another reading to help resolve.

records.title: My call handler today finally resolved…
records.text: My call handler today finally resolved my problem but only after it took lots of phone calls and wasted time to reach a common sense conclusion that I had been asking for all along. The overall issue is that BES does not listen to the customers enough and does not communicate contact details, property entry problems, etc to the contracted companies who do the meter fittings and repairs. Communication is not good.

records.title: Meter reading
records.text: Tried to phone through a meter reading as online account wouldn't let me. Was asked to email a photo of the meter as proof. Have tried to do this twice, both times getting a mail failed response that "couldn't be delivered due to: Recipient email server rejected the message."

records.title: Trying to get a refund
records.text: Trying to get a refund (not a credit on account)  after an estimated bill is a joke. My bill was over £200.00 more than i normally pay so attention to detail has not been applied. I have been assured I will have this paid back into bank account within 7 days......I have been here before (March 2023)  and it took me over 2 months to get my money back .Customer service Lorna was most helpful but obviously her hands are tied within the company rules.

records.title: Change to account details
records.text: Was on a live chat with Fatima, got through all the Data Protection details and was cut off mid chat, reconnected to Therlo. Had to go through the whole details again.  Had to email also, but was being told emails were not being received, despite me sending them from two different email accounts at our end.  All I needed to do was update contact details and direct debit bank account details.  Around 50 minutes on live chat to do this!!

records.title: Rang due to a problem with the Website…
records.text: Rang due to a problem with the Website as I couldn't access my invoices. Charl assisted and was helpful, resolved my problem and got me back online. I was a bit disappointed that he wanted to 'assist me' with my feedback. For reference though,  we won't be renewing our contract with them when it expires in January as frankly, they are the WORST company we have ever dealt with for Business utilities.

records.title: It has got to be easier than this!!
records.text: I have found the whole experience of dealing with BES extremely challenging. No one will speak to me on the phone, the chat line becomes a long drawn out affair, just answer the question. I realise that your area of expertise may restrict an out right answer, so why not give details of whom from the start!!A senior complaints operative was due to phone me at 14;00 ( 8/3/23 ) today, true to form no phone call. We were due to discuss our contract and invoices which were due to be emailed, this didn't happen either, not a firm I would recommend to anyone. BES Utilities.Just an update, 10/3/23, well there isn't one really, still no reply from this company even though it stated a reply woulld be forth coming.

records.title: Literally so bad
records.text: Literally so bad. They contact you all the time, so it seems like they're across everything. But they've charged us incorrectly, sent out engineers to site who aren't qualified for the job, and when you ask for help on these issues, it's like starting from scratch every time. Really poor and I can't wait until our contract is up.

records.title: Respectful agent.
records.text: Respectful agent.However, useless information. I needed a new meter for a new business from a 3 phase supply which exists. I was advised by Ruby that I needed to contact local provider and that these current providers (Ruby9 don't supplythe meter. WtfI contacted local main power provider.They advised they don't provide the meter only wires 'to' the meter.2 hours wasted time discussing this with Ruby and local mains provider.Ruby who clearly don't know jack Shite about what they do provide is frustrating to say the least.Wasting my time is disgussing.Meter is crazy, I will be changing provider (Ruby) and seek out a company who can provide a new 2nd meter for a new shop from existing supply.All boards and wires and ready to connect to a new meter.I can't stand inompetent service providers no matter what business they provide.

records.title: Wasting my time
records.text: When Ruby Energy took over from BES I noticed my invoice address had been amended to my residential address. I tried to make the amendment online but when I pressed submit it did not update. I called a customer support colleague who went through various questions to pass DPA/security. I passed with flying colours. However, I was told that I would have to further send an email to confirm my address change!? And even to change my phone number. If I was changing my name I can understand that further evidence may be required. But to change a address should have been a simple task made super hard. No other company has this process - probably because it's not necessary. It was not my fault that the address has been incorrectly updated in the first place! Wasting my time.

records.title: Spurious business practices
records.text: I called up Ruby Energy to pay my final bill after they have stalled my getting out of contract with them. I believed I was giving my details to pay my final bill, but then I get notification that I have set up direct debit with them, which I never agreed to. I didn't want any continuing relationship with them and they have terrible service, they prolong any chance of severing relations.

records.title: Slow customer services
records.text: Customer services are generally slow and unhelpful, there is the odd person who is super helpful and willing to help, but everyone else makes it difficult to get anywhere and would rather just pass you onto someone else.I needed an issue sorting and I had to ring up multiple times a week to get anywhere then after complaining multiple times it was finally sorted over 4 weeks later.

records.title: Not a great company
records.text: I keep sending them readings, yet they still keep estimating our usage since we took over business tenancy, despite me sending them pictures of the readings when we took over. We have not used any gas and i have sent pictures with proof yet still have not had the bill adjusted. Called them this morning and 4 hours later I'm still waiting on a call back.

records.title: Precious is a valued member of your…
records.text: Precious is a valued member of the BES team! I have been having a long standing issue with my Gas Meter as I am being billed a large fee each month for the Gas at my holiday rental. Yet, nobody has been in the cottage since December 2022 and although I submitted a reading recently having to journey down to Cornwall myself they claim the meter is faulty. As a consequence I am still being billed an estimated tariff. This is very frustrating as a business owner as I need to always call BES for an update. This particular issue has been going on for months. That said Precious is always polite and helpful and she has asked for me to call back in one month.

records.title: Some representatives are extremely helpful
records.text: Priscilla Mdlankomo.was extremely helpful in an extremely complex case. might I just add- make sure you get everything in writing! I am now being charged £30.86  for putting in a meter because someone else didn't pay their bill  - disgusting - I was told there would be no charge.

records.title: Finally
records.text: Finally, after nearly two months, hopefully the change over of tenancy and accounts to domestic from commercial, has been resolved. Only today did I receive straightforward answers and clarity as to what is going on. There seems to be a total lack of communication between your various departments which has created so much unnecessary delay and major frustration. I don't know how many times I, as well as my landlord, have had to explain and reply to phone calls, emails and letters that I am a private residential tenant and not a business. Up until today, I would have rated your company zero stars. However, today, the two ladies I spoke with were very helpful, patient and resourceful, so I have upgraded to 2 stars. It seems that only today has the process been fast-tracked, having been told yesterday it would have taken unto 40 days. Just on today, I would have rated 4 stars, maybe even 5.

records.title: Trying to submit a gas meter reading
records.text: When trying to submit a gas reading it normally states that my reading is too high and it won't be accepted. I then have to crawl into a small cupboard to photograph the reading. Then I have to pick the reading up from my laptop to resize it because otherwise it's too big to be accepted. Absolute kerfuffle when all I'm trying to do is submit a reading. Then after 5 years with B.E.S. I am finally offered a smart meter. Absolute joke, so happy to be leaving this company at the end of August

records.title: Superb service

records.title: Tyler on chat

records.title: I can thoroughly recommend OtM

records.title: Great customer service as always

records.title: Extremely easy to switch to a lower tariff
records.text: I've been on a variable tariff with OTM for a couple years and was looking for a cheaper one. My brother-in-law recommended another provider, and I was going to switch, but then I noticed printed right on p1 of my OTM bill, "Here's an alternative tariff we offer that would be cheaper for you than your current one with us". It was also cheaper than the other provider I was looking at.  I contacted OTM via chat on their website, and the change was made in about 45 seconds, with my direct debit now reduced by about £25 per month. Great service, glad I stayed with this provider who has been very easy to work with for as long as I've had them. Thank you also to Monalisa, who was the rep on chat who made it so simple and quick today.

records.title: Telephone access to OFTM was reasonably…
records.text: Telephone access to OFTM was reasonably quick and Manvir was a pleasure to deal with. He guided me through the options and helped me select the most suitable tariff, potentially saving me a considerable amount over the year. Also, he suggested that my direct debit payments be reduced. Great service by Manvir helps the retention of customers - well done.

records.title: IHD change of tariff
records.text: After my IHD did not update following a tariff change I phoned OTM and spoke with Aaron. He emailed me instructions to rectify the problem, also instructions what to do if that did not work - which it didn't. I followed the instructions for giving OTM the information regarding the meters and the IHD. A week or so later the IHD was giving the correct information. I then had an email from Bunmi checking with me that the IHD had been reprogrammed.Thanks to the excellent service from OTM all issues have been resolved.

records.title: Great Aneez was very helpful
records.text: Great Aneez was very helpful. Would have liked to have dealt with the issue straight away rather than been passed to another team but good customer service nonetheless.

records.title: Moving to a cheaper tariff

records.title: Excellent support service

records.title: Response received within 48 hours to my…

records.title: Wiktoria was really helpful with my Query

records.title: I moved over from Eon but had to move…

It's took a few weeks but everything is now correct.

records.title: Quick to establish connection
records.text: Quick to establish connection. Clear and quick to deal with my query. Wasn't able to fix the issue raised but escalated the issue for me and told me how long it would take to get a response. Azeez gave me everything he could to assist me.

records.title: Successful Tariff Change
records.text: I spoke to Bunmi ('Chat') and Aneez (telephone). Both were helpful, knowledgeable, and communicated well. The only reason the rating was not 5 stars was because I had to wait for approx 25 mins to speak to a representative when I phoned.

records.title: I needed to update the name on my…
records.text: I needed to update the name on my outfox utility bill for a council validation purpose. It was done by Urshad in a professionally and patiently, and what I needed was corrected with a minimum of fuss.Very happy with your customer service department. Well done.

records.title: Contacting through the chat line was…Pleasantly easy

records.title: Bunmi was really helpful in the chat…

records.title: Most helpful
records.text: Our opening gas readings were incorrect by a huge amount - not sure why! We had a live chat with Bunmi who was most helpful.  The pictures of the meter readings were sent over and dealt with straight away.  We have only given 4 stars as confirmation is required from our previous supplier to confirm that readings are correct before our account can be amended.

records.title: A bit slow to close account
records.text: We have just sold a property and notified outfoxthemarket. The automated reply stated that I would receive my final bill within six weeks, but fortunately Danni from their customer service team wrote after 10 days to confirm our final balance, and said this would be refunded within a further 10 days. Thanks Danni

records.title: Hollow words of resolution on Trustpilot. Don't believe OFTM
records.text: Following a complaint I was pleased to see this response on trust pilot for all to see;We’re truly sorry to hear about your experience. Please rest assured, we would love the opportunity to look into this further and assist you. To ensure we can address this properly, we’ve forwarded your review to one of our customer care team members, who will be in touch with you.We’re confident that we can find a solution and work to regain your trust.Kind regards,Team OTMTwo days later still no contact from the very team I complained about. It is all well and good leaving meaningful and reasonable responses with promises of action for all to assume you will look to resolve the issue. You haven't. No contact. You need to be true to your pledge. My original complaint mentioned lip service and here we have further evidence of it. If you do as you say and follow up with me I will gladly update this review. You have my email.and mobile number and again, I am available for contact.This is now resolved - had you have checked my account rather than just giving lip service on here you would have seen that! It us?a shame you have to 'kick off' to get any form of meaningful response. I have upgraded to a three star review.

records.title: I really hate it when I send lots of…

records.title: Where is the live chat button

records.title: They provide electricity which works. But be prepared to be spammed.

records.title: Difficulty getting the right tariff
records.text: I have been with Outfox the Market for a month. Initially, put on an Economy 7 tariff, despite not wanting it, just because I have a dual rate smart meter. Despite numerous attempts to get it changed to a single tariff, I have been ignored.Today, have used "Chat" and raised it again with Wiktoria. At last, someone within the company who has listened and acted. All should now be sorted.5 stars for Wiktoria, but only 3 stars for OTM due to the hassle of getting this sorted

records.title: Don't call the help line the day after a new OFGEM price cap takes effect!
records.text: A long wait of about 1 hour in the queue has significantly downgraded the rating. However, it was the day after the new OFGEM price cap took effect. Mitesh who helped me, was positive and professional, and I was very satisfied with the outcome.

records.title: At long last someone will read my meter…
records.text: At long last someone will read my meter manually as the gas smart meter is not connected & I have mobility difficulties.

records.title: i really hate the extended delays in…
records.text: i really hate the extended delays in reaching a real human, but Faraaz was very helpful when I did reach him, and even rang me back because the signal was distorting. Excellent service from him, and much appreciated.

records.title: Poor account admin…

I pay by DD so I am not concerned personally - but a business that cant get its bills out might not be around for long!

records.title: Problem with IHD

records.title: Automated systems not good - personnel much better

I may now get e refund, and possibly a lower monthly DD. If it works out this way then 5* would be appropriate .... time will tell.

records.title: Super basic app👎🏽

records.title: Make sure Outfox can access your Smart Meters Remotely
records.text: Outfox The Market supply our energy up to 2001. We then went to UW. We switched back to Outfox the Market on 1st of June 2024. I gave you our meter readings and I made sure that the meter Serial Numbers were correct on our application form.When the online account was reactivated, our meter readings were entered against defunct Serial Numbers. Our meters were replaced twice because they could not be accessed remotely. That was not an acceptable outcome and had to call Outfox twice to get it sorted.My concern remains that whoever supplies us our energy are able to read out smart meters remotely. I hope Outfox The Market can.

records.title: I have been chasing a refund for weeks…
records.text: I have been chasing a refund for weeks and appeared to be getting nowhere. This latest reply gives me a later date for payment than my earlier reply. Not impressed

records.title: It was difficult to start

records.title: I have been a customer with Outfox for…
records.text: I have been a customer with Outfox for quite a few years, since it was Fisher, and other names that followed. Never had any issues with them. My direct debits were always kept to a minimum, Used to supply them the meter readings manually every month till they decided to install a smart meter. Now I am having problems with my smart meter, not showing any information on the screen and keeps rebooting itself every couple of seconds. Spoke to an agent twice, Bunmi, who is helpful and trying their best to get this resolved asap. The smart metering team are giving excuses. I have been waiting for 2 weeks now. I would give 5 stars if the matter had already been resolved.

records.title: Good service once you're connected
records.text: The team member was able to answer all my query. However, 3 stars are for the long waiting time it took to get through to a person via the Live Chat function. I was unable to connect with anyone on a call as no one was able to answer the call. The company need to do better

records.title: I tried so many times to get through on…
records.text: I tried so many times to get through on the phone to change my bank details, once for over an hour, I was next in the queue and then told it was not possible to take my call. I stopped my direct debit because there was insufficient funds in that old account. I was then threatened with a change of account and a higher tariff. I was, more than a week later, advised to ring another number to change my details. Success! But no.they took the next payment from my old account, causing an unauthorized overdraft, even though I'd informed them in good time. My energy account was also heavily in credit! I asked for a refund and they even paid that into the wrong account! Finally they have taken this month's payment from the correct account.

records.title: Monalisa
records.text: Was told by Monalisa, that they had sorted the computer error on my direct debit but later in the month almost three times my agreed DD amount was taken, thankfully my bank stepped in & corrected the error.Then I received messages that my energy deal was to be switched but hopefully this will be fixed I’m assured, I’ll wait & see

records.title: High direct debt set and won't reduce sensibly
records.text: The property is empty and will remain empty as I've stated from the start on my contract for electric . they put me on a £47 per month rate and have reduced it to £43 per month citing we are heading in to the winter therefore they need to take more to cover the increased winter usage. They get daily reading from the smart meter so can see the very low usage as it's unoccupied but forcing me to build up credit which I don't want to do. They are unwilling to reduce further. I get gas via Ovo who have been happy to set a sensible usage rate no problem.

records.title: Customer service lessons to be learnt
records.text: Following the use of my name by other persons to obtain gas and electricity leading to outstanding  energy costs of over a £1000 against me and the use of debt collectors to harass me.  I tried without success for several months to try and clear my name.  each contact with Out Fox the market was provided with details to enable them to help me do so.  However each contact did not own the issue or seek to address my concerns. i was repeatedly dealing with one individual after another and providing the same information time after time, the responses usually taking several days or more before the next person got back to me. Any written correspondence sent from Out Fox would be dated, but the posting date would usually several days later followed by up to 10 days before the letters arrived with me.  it was only when Carolina got involved and continued to correspond with me that the mater was finally resolved.From my view the claimed level of customer service satisfaction is not deserved.  Staff need to be trained to take ownership of issues and to pass on to a higher authority if they are unable to do so.  failure to do this alienates your customers.  You need to look at your postal issues if it is taking over 15 days or more for letters to arrive with the customer but you put within your letters that replied must be received within 7 days then straight away the customed would appear to be at fault.  I have received from you a letter that had 6 days between letter date and post marked date on the envelope. then add on the second class or in this case third class delivery you therefore have issues.

records.title: Customer support is a joke
records.text: I tried to change tariff a number of times to a fixed rate before the October price change by time time they answer you the tariff has been withdrawn. I responded to their email right away on the 28 of september and it took till the 14th of October to respond. Why they can just show all the prices on line on their web site and allow online switching like other firms do I have no idea. They do there best to hide tarriff prices from customers, kind of thinking it might be time to move. (Price is good even if the service is the worst) They do like to put my DD up even though I am now 700 pounds in credit now, why can't there algorithm work out how to return money over than just say a year rather than just work of how much to pay based on a zero balance.

records.title: Accuracy with meter readings not good!
records.text: We recently switched supplier to Outfox the Market (OTM).  It has also been straightforward to change OTM tariff, if required.  Seems like a good supplier.  Outfox the Market currently has the best Fixed Energy deals on comparison websites such as MSE (top of the comparison table).  This is how we came across the Company.  I am writing this Review on behalf of my mother.Update 5/11/24 - Received our first bill.  Wrong opening reading used for Gas.  Charged twice for the same Gas energy - correctly by our old supplier, wrongly by Outfox The Market.  Outfox The Market DID NOT use the correct opening reading we submitted to them online on our switch date.  Their customer service seem unwilling to amend our Gas opening reading (they must be quite happy for us to pay twice for the same Gas energy, and maybe they just don't care).  This demonstrates a lack of care.  Hence our downgrade today from 5 to 2 Stars.

records.title: Impossible to engage with Outfox’ customer service
records.text: Frustrated by the lack of access - it is pointless calling by phone (though it was ironic to be told that Outfox are Number 1 for Customer Service) , and recent email contact dried up. records.title: Just fantastic

records.title: Very efficient
records.text: Very efficient.  I phoned in the morning to see if the company could be a bit more precise about the time of the installation(9-6 by the phone seems too long to wait when the weather's nice enough to be in the garden!) Initially they had nobody available to check whether it had, until I threatened to complain. Eventually they confirmed it had arrived. We went through the switching process and they objected on the same basis, despite having the information and us being in credit. They have now had three months' money from us on that basis. Lots of emails explaining why we shouldn't switch, but none requesting that we review their performance.

When we had no bill from February eventually I reached an agent who told me that due to a new computer system we would not receive our next bill until JULY -- five months wait in which our bill could be anything from £1000 to £2000!Why weren't customers advised of this delay, and how can they budget when they have little notice of such hefty sums being debited from their bank accounts?
