records.title: Shame we had this bother...
records.text: Pros:They are reasonably priced, they offer a range of services which are conveniently consolidated on one bill. They are usually prompt to respond to enquiries.Cons:One of our businesses moved. We gave a final meter reading at the old address whereupon it has taken 6 months, an inconceivable amount of time on the phone where their operatives admitted that the bill couldn't possibly be right, innumerable emails, their threats, to arrive at an almost correct (we are still somewhat out of pocket) final bill.The aggravation they have caused my missus, and therefore me, cannot be expressed in monetary terms.The ridiculous thing is that having moved, under different circumstances, it would have been logical to have made them our supplier at the new premises but as it stands we are now with someone else.It's often said that you only get the measure of a company when there's a problem, had it not been for this unnecessary hassle I could only have been justified in giving them a good review.

records.title: Not 2 weeks as promised.
records.text: Changing over Broadband.......Was told 2 weeks, but now 17 days! Had to change date for new till installation......Not ideal

records.title: Completely exasperated!
records.text: Really disappointed in the level of service, lack of promised call backs and most of all unreliability of the service they are providing and lack of understanding.We are reliant on a  phone for appointments for customers and for them contacting us however the lack of basic availability of a phone service is now costing me and my business money, at the busiest time of the year.Do not recommend at all and would never choose them again.

records.title: Very confusing company
records.text: Very confusing companyI'm not against any company being the middle person with clear Business. Mobile phones not modern but hang on, broadband bang on, insurance bang on, card machine? Get it somewhere else I got sold thae wrong package which is not suitable or my small non profit organisation not used it onceThey won't let me cancel without buying myself out an 18 month contract world way was very helpful and understanding and is only charging me 1 month I've found a company £22 all in no contract and I'm happy. Like every business you get nice guys and not so nice guys the manager was not a nice guy sorry I am not paying no 18 month fee are you mad?

records.title: Whole process very complicated.
records.text: We have been forced to change our card machine from Clear Business as they are upgrading to Worldpay. The whole process has been very difficult and has caused a great deal of hassle. The amount of emails sent don't provide clear information regarding the whole set process, it just over complicates the whole process. Clear business don't have clear answers to any problems and just pass you over to Worldpay. I would never use again.

records.title: i am sick to death of this company
records.text: i am sick to death of this company! i have phoned, emailed, sent  paperwork back and no one resolves our issue of them demanding money for a new property already on our exisitng supply,I am sorry i am not going to pay twice for the same supply. No one returns calls or emails. i have explained the situation to over 5 people and no one resolves it or actually comes back to discuss, is there someone who might actually listen and sort this out?????

records.title: Had the pleasure of dealing with Jess
records.text: Had the pleasure of dealing with Jess. I can’t thank her enough for sorting out my broadband and card machine for my new business. However, now I’ve signed a contract and I’m having issues with my installation and bill - nobody answers my calls.It’s a real shame as what I was offered before signing a contact isn’t what I’m paying for now. There’s a lot of jargon on my bill which I all want to do is discuss.All customer services have done is put me through to somebody in “billing” (South Africa) who barely understands what I’m trying to say, which is frustrating for both of us. It’s such a shame as I had such a great experience before I was a customer. They honestly couldn’t do enough for me. But now it’s a totally different story.

records.title: Customer Service support is poor
records.text: Been with their broadband service for about 2 years and this has been good but price leapt up and I agreed a new discounted deal to stay.3 months later this discount has not been applied despite signing contracts and tried contact online and by phone (ironic) to no success.£56 for just broadband is just not competitive.

records.title: over a month now and still no…
records.text: It's been over a month now and still no broadband, the money leaves my account regularly though.I've been using a data dongle for my internet since I joined Clear Business.All I got is broken promises and missed engineer's appointments.Dear Clear Business, why are you ignoring me?

records.title: A company that promises so much
records.text: A company that promises so much, but delivers so little.Promised me the world to sign up, miss sold what their card machines could do (integrate with epos) when they couldn't,  I have received many calls from them checking everything was working OK, which became over bearing and there was infact an alternative motive to try and sell me some other service.Would call me from random Mobile numbers and expecting me to give over personal information.I regret..  having to deal with this company as it's caused more headaches than its solved.

records.title: With them all of 5 days and cancelled
records.text: With them all of 5 days and cancelled. Anthony Clarke I hope you get your £5 bonus revoked now?!! Originally wanted a new card machine and they gave a really good price of £15 a month and then offered it for FREE if I took broadband, told them I wasn't sure if I was in contract and they said don't worry we'll check and if you are in contract don't worry we'll cancel. Amazing! I was in contract so couldn't move and understood I couldn't have my card machine for free but.... low and behold they changed the price of my card machine to £20 a month instead of £15 originally quoted and blamed the rep who gave me the price at first and said id already signed the contract so id have to pay to leave!!! 2 days of phoning and explaining and thankfully Adam canceled my brief contract and apologized that it had been mismanaged and the price shouldn't have changed! THANK YOU ADAM ( only reason this is a 2 star review and not 0 stars )Never again will I use this company!!!!Be careful what you sign because they change the price on the contract without telling you, clear business... More like muddy business 🤡

records.title: Stole £200 terrible customer service . Resolved by Zoe
records.text: Absolutely useless.Had fault terminal, wrong merchant id, data breaches. But what's worse was the customer service. Tristan was smug, aloof, arrogant.He's put a leaving charge as they were so bad on me of £200 for a month on the contract. They admitted faults, I also requested to ride the contract if there was a termination fee. Tristan is a not nice to deal with.Be very careful if thinking about this company. There are better ones out there.Spoke to Zoe Borrell Today, an account managerShe was extremely understanding and very helpful.  She was very empathetic with what happens and explained that it is not clear pays usual process to work like that.  She resolved my issues and actually helped me with the closing process.  Thank you, Really appreciate your time and understanding.

description: We generate around one fifth of the UK's electricity and employ around 15,000 people. We supply electricity and gas to thousands of residential and business customers, making us one of the UK's biggest energy suppliers. We are also the UK’s largest producer of low-carbon electricity.

records.title: Such patience
records.text: Such patience, explained in detail billing, where and how I can reduce my costs with advise that has changed my energy usage approach. Even identified a cheaper tarriff and other ways to pay bills, which aleviated further stress. A brand to be trusted in my view. Thank you very much for your help today.

records.title: In-Home display unit not working
records.text: For Sharon N - team 12B. 01.01.25 Thank you so much for sorting out my in-home display unit. You were so professional knowing what my problem was straight away after waiting over 3 months to get it working when two others had failed to sort it out for me during that time. I was thinking EDF was not bothered about their customers and thinking of changing companies although I have been a loyal customer. Thanks to you Sharon my faith in EDF has been restored.

records.title: Changing tarrif
records.text: We were changing suppliers to a cheaper tariff, got an email from EDF offering £100 to stay with them on a fixed rate tariff, spoke to a lovely lady Carol and she sorted everything out for us. We were very impressed with the way she conducted the call even ringing us back when we were cut off.Thank you Carol.

records.title: My experience with Sara Graney Team 18B at EDF Customer Services.
records.text: 3/1/25I’m pleased with my call with Sara Graney at EDF today. Sara was extremely helpful and polite giving me clear information on three cheaper dual fuel energy tariffs that were available for me to choose from EDF. Sara explained the costing and savings of all of the tariffs. My chosen cheapest tariff was fully itemised and Sara said she’ll contact me in 3 months time to review the energy we’ve used in view of the fact we had a new boiler fitted in July so our annual energy use could be lower than the previously predicted estimate of the last years usage. Sara will ensure my monthly payments are covered by my at present unchanged direct debit payments with our account being in credit.

records.title: Direct Debit Increase
records.text: I received an automated mail stating there would be an increase to my DD, i was already in credit & felt i wouldn't need an increase between now and spring, when generally i will use less gas for heating purposes.i contacted the EDF help team and spoke with Cara on Team13F who was immensely helpful and politely agreed that no increase would be necessary. It's nice to be able to converse directly and not with a chat-bot. Full 5 star rating for Cara and the team & with EDF for ensuring communication is with real people.

records.title: Smart Meter
records.text: I was supposed to have a smart meter installed but the Engineer never turned up. I contacted EDF and spoke to Colin Team 5e, he was amazing and went overboard trying to help me, I never wanted a smart meter and after I was let down today I definitely didnt want one. so Colin put me on another Tariff where I didn,t need to get a Smart meter yet.Very happy with this outcome

records.title: Conscientious Service
records.text: Sheena listened to our problem and advised us accordingly. She showed knowledge of smart meters and helped us set up our display. She advised us regarding our direct debit payments.She was polite and courteous throughout our conversation. She is also conscientious as she will check our account refund next week

records.title: Cancellation of Smart Meter fitting
records.text: I had to cancel the installation of my new smart meter due to ill health and not being able to stand having the heating and electrics off for 2 hours while they did the job.  I will be arranging another appointment when we have better weather. Cara of Team 13F was very helpful this morning.

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: Thanks to Dave on Team T who answered my query quick smart and sorted out my query quickly and professionally. This level of service is not my experience of previous energy providers I have had to deal with. Congratulations EDF on having him on your staff, I was very pleased. Ty

records.title: Had an issue with a delay in change of…
records.text: Had an issue with a delay in change of provider to EDF. Called up and after a short wait, Annah had sorted the problem for me. Easy and hassle free. Really justifies my decision to go with EDF because of their excellent customer service.Thanks again Annah!

records.title: Great service and prices
records.text: Great service from very, very helpful lady called Susan (Team 12D). Good package and reasonable prices.  Only frustrating thing is my account, which was linked to business supply although now residential, auto directs my call to the business team so ended up spending an additional 15 mins being redirected to the right team. Susan however restored my faith!

records.title: Excellent service with a great outcome, but minor issues to be resolved
records.text: The lady I spoke with was very friendly and helpful. She quickly navigated the current offers available and was able to save me approximately £50 per month. Excellent service with a great outcome! However, an adjustment has been applied which she said would be removed, but was still there on the confirmation email received. I've asked for this to be removed and await a response.

records.title: Support engineer understood .
records.text: The support engineer understood that the price increase was exaggerated, EDF system cost algorithms wanted to charge me with an increase of 90%, even though we were in credit.The support gent, re summed the totals, and no increase was made. You just need to keep a sharp eye on this company, especially if you are elderly.

records.title: Great Customer Service
records.text: We have dealt with EDF Energy to set up a business account. The customer service is really good & very helpful when asking any questions & respond to you very quickly. In particular we dealt with a lady called Kirsty who was extremely helpful & friendly in dealing with our requests.

records.title: Very Helpful Agent, but...
records.text: I did not appreciate the 10 minute+ wait to be connected to your advisor. But once connected, Emma (your advisor) was quick to understand my Tariff inquiry, take me through the options clearly and concisely, and enabled my decision.The switch of Tariffs could not have been simpler, and Emma was able to set it up speedily.Had it not been for the eait to be connected, It would have been 5 star !

records.title: After a long wait to get through to…
records.text: After a long wait to get through to someone to help with my query, i was lucky enough to speak to martin, who after letting me explain the situation made short work of sorting everything out for me. Thanks martin for your help, top service 👍

records.title: Helpful Samuel
records.text: Samuel was very helpful and has now put me on the cheapest tariff without a smart meter. I do not want a smart meter as I have read too many bad reports.  Samuel was polite and didn't try to persuade me to have a smart meter fitted.  I'm 86 years old and cannot cope with problems any more!

records.title: Caroline from team X was most helpful…
records.text: Caroline from team X was most helpful when I contacted re my smart meter not sending data, she tried to resolve the issue but was not able too at the time, but gave me good advice and advised me the issue would be resolved. Caroline also gave me advice about new contracts available, so I also got a new contract. Friendly helpful lady!

records.title: My experience with  customer service…
records.text: My experience with  customer service was very good. They always help me the best way (even though they're helping with a problem they put me in) but their CS is very good and helpful. Thanks

records.title: domestic charges
records.text: EDF (rather surprisingly!) agreed to freeze my domestic charge this year rather than insist upon their suggested annual increase , since I was in credit.

records.title: I spoke to two different people and…
records.text: I spoke to two different people and found bother extremely helpful and friendly.It would have been 5 stars but the waiting time was longer than I would have expected.

records.title: The agent provided the copy invoice as…
records.text: The agent provided the copy invoice as requested. He also helped me create an account so that I can get invoices directly.

records.title: After spending 4 months trying to sort…
records.text: After spending 4 months trying to sort out my account transfer from previous owner I finally spoke to a young lady this morning who was most helpful, however the wait time to speak to customer service was over 10 minutes.  Unfortunately my query could not be sorted automatically on-line

records.title: EDF customer service staff Cherry Lyn…
records.text: EDF customer service staff Cherry Lyn was great  she has explained me properly about all the tariffs and I agreed and accepted.Best customer service and Happy new year. Thanks.Regards Ashok Kumar

records.title: Customer service support worker Tom…
records.text: Customer service support worker Tom assisted in rectifying my meter reading and issuing a correct bill. Very kind, courteous and supportive. I didn't write this review.  Tom did help sort out a direct debit problem not a meter reading problem.  I'm a little concerned that a review has been written in my name not by me.

records.title: The phone message from Julie
records.text: The phone message from Julieon 30 th. Dec ‘24 was reassuring telling me that a refund would besent to my bank account withina few days.Protima Tadevossian

records.title: As a vulnerable and disabled person
records.text: As a vulnerable and disabled person, speaking with the agent today alleviated my stress.  The agent was patient and showed empathy.  At the end of our discussion it was resolved to my satisfaction.  Thank you !! :)

records.title: This time I didn’t have to wait a long…good
records.text: This time I didn’t have to wait a long time for my call to be answered, the lady who answered was helpful and sorted an appointment out.

records.title: The customers service lady was a good…
records.text: The customers service lady was a good listener, she was calm on the phone while I was stating out my numerous issues regarding the newly installed smart meter in my flat. The old meter had £42.29 pence on it, which was not transfered to the new meter. She immediately made the transfer and asked me to send her a prove for the said amount.

records.title: Relatively fast to contact a human
records.text: Relatively fast to contact a human. My contact was understanding about my issue and efficiently put my account right and my mind at rest after a stressful weekend worrying about my error. Very polite and helpful.

records.title: Reason for leaving after many years with EDF
records.text: Speaking to Ellie & getting her confirmation of the free switch capability within 49 days was good, However my recent experience has not been good. Examples 1. Finding the right telephone contact number - you have so many & some advertised but not working. 2. getting through on the phone. 3. NOT RECEIVING NOTICE OF THE 49 DAY RULE until I picked up on it from elsewhere.

records.title: Interesting to note that Edf reviews…
records.text: Interesting to note that Edf reviews have 2 review sites here on Trustpilot. All the good reviews are generally to be found here under 'EDF' . All the poor reviews are under 'EDF ENERGY' . How misleading for Trustpilot to allow this.

records.title: Good customer service the app has given me a bad taste.
records.text: Great customer service by the most recent representative called Nigel I spoke to on the 19th of Dec.Unfortunetly due to a system error on the App.The was linked to a old account from a old address and I wasn't able to for some time look at cheaper tariffs.Which is one of the reasons I am paying back alot of money to edf.

records.title: 🤔Was with them for a few years and they…
records.text: 🤔Was with them for a few years and they were OK - didn't have any problems until :I always paid by DD for the actual amount of fuel used but they suddenly changed this to fixed monthly amount without notifying me. Sorted out after several emails but .............🤔ChatBot is ridiculous and horrendous waits on phone.+ They did successfully install Smart Meters.So moved seamlessly to Octopus 🐙

records.title: Although Natalie was extremely helpful…
records.text: Although Natalie was extremely helpful and sorted our primary issue (5 stars for her), the process of swapping over to smart meters has been difficult from engineers not turning up or only doing half the job when they do turn up. I have had to take 2 days off work up to now and the issue is still not sorted. While the customer service team are apologetic and try to sort things out, the experience as a whole has been far from ideal.

records.title: Roozbeh deserves a raise
records.text: To start, our experience over the past 3 months with EFD has been horrific. The incompetence of the business team to handle a change over has been nothing short of a joke. That being said, the service I had from Roozbeh on the phone today was 5 star. He was very helpful, polite, funny and did everything he could to help rectify the issue I had. A superstar! He is the only reason I gave 3 stars on this review, without him it would have been 1.

records.title: Final Bill Problems
records.text: Problems caused through inattentive checking before posting things like the Final Bill. Raising a dispute was easy and the dispute was handled well by Syed Halder .This whole episode could and should have been avoided.

records.title: No 24/7 help at weekends  waiting ages…
records.text: No 24/7 help at weekends  waiting ages to speak to anyone when phoning, some e.mails don't get answered for days on end

records.title: Smart meter display did not work when…
records.text: Smart meter display did not work when the smart meters were installed.It took a long time to get an engineer assigned to the repair but once assigned the engineer resolved the issues quickly

records.title: Make sure you challenge their estimates
records.text: Positives- willing to discuss their estimates of our usage and amend accordingly.- pointed out a better deal than we were on, which included no exit fees. We'll save money whatever.Negatives- despite having a good handle on our usage they still wanted to charge £30 per month more than they knew (and admitted) we would spend. That way they had our money and could get the interest.- didn't take into account the fact we had built up £500 in credit (due to their previous overcharging).

records.title: A long road to satisfaction
records.text: A gross overestimate of electricity used (700kWh in 3 weeks and 2 days, in the summer, when I have PV  panels and battery) could not be sorted by multiple email conversations - I was told the readings were correct,   when I knew for certain that they were not, over the course of 8 weeks  ( I have a very accurate Tesla App)- BUT a phone call with short wait and the problem was sorted in 2 days......so PHONE THE HELP LINE first.

records.title: Smart meter finally fully commissioned…
records.text: Finally after waiting almost 3 years our smart meter has been commissioned on our gas meter.Although the number of times I have contacted EDF has been frustrating, finally Leeanne was able to send an engineer out who sorted the problem in no time. So thank you to Leeanne and Mohamed.

records.title: EDF terrible, Marie was fantastic
records.text: As a company EDF are impossible to contact, with long on hold times and not replying to emails, text or WhatsApp. On the whole they are pretty dire, with having to explain things over and over again. It took 3 months for them to finally get my correct solar electricity tariff sorted out. It was only when I threatened to go to Ombudsman that things started to move. My complaint got sent to Samantha and Marie in team 4E eventually sorted everything properly. Marie took charge of my case and progressed things to a satisfactory conclusion. EDF 1/5, Marie 5/5

records.title: Rebooting smart meter
records.text: My smart meter went off in the power cut  and EDF sent me an email on how to try & fix it but not knowing the model name I wasn't sure which method to try.  However common sense prevailed and I found the reboot button!

records.title: Good/Bad
records.text: Responded well to my enquiries about changing tariff. Good.Has still not responded to my query about smart meter repair. It is now well over a month since a man came to say it was bust; he would contact edf to arrange a new meter. That was bad and failure to follow up from Friday also bad.Reference Carol Bell Team 18 C

records.title: Kochi was very helpful…
records.text: Kochi was very helpful and sorted my problem very goodHowever you offer what's app chat and email and I don't seem to get the same helpful response through those medias, I have to phone, which when you are working full time does not work easily

records.title: Contact was polite and efficient but procedure bizarre
records.text: The contact was polite and responded promptly. However the procedure the company uses (to transfer ownership of solar panels for a Feed-In tariff) seems unnecessarily complicated. First you are sent a form to complete, but then you are asked for a series of additional documents that are not mentioned on the form.

records.title: The operative was too eager to help…
records.text: The operative was too eager to help which is not a bad thing but it requires the ability to listen to the 'whole' question and not offer a 'half baked' response/solution. We got there in the end but it was a bit of an effort to achieve the information I was requesting.

records.title: Great staff but frustrating I have to keep ringing
records.text: Always very helpful staff over the phone and wait times are reasonable, but I have to keep ringing to submit a generation meter reading for my feed in tariff. The online form they send me never works, I've asked a few times why this might happen but no one is able to resolve the issue.  Pleasant experience over the phone but would prefer to not have to keep ringing to submit a meter reading.

records.title: timely expereince
records.text: The whole process an absolute nightmare, spent hours of my time trying to sort this out. Allister finally sorted it today so thank you very much however £20 compensation isn't great for the amount of time this has taken to resolve.Allister did great today finally resolving it though.

records.title: EDF Are Very Lucky To Have Carol
records.text: Firstly, if it wasn't for Carol who dealt with the call today (and who I have been fortunate enough to speak to before - she's really good) this would be a 1 star review.EDF clearly have a major customer service problem. Rather than bore you, suffice to say that getting a meter changed has been an utterly woeful experience, but it's finally installed, after 3 attempts by them. I tried to call them on 27th but at 4.00pm on the dot my call got cut off (while I was on hold to a staff member).I called back this morning, around 9.00am, using the same number, to get a message saying they're closed  ...... what????So, after a lot of searching I finally found another number which got me through to Carol, than goodness. She was unable to resolve a couple of things (through no fault of hers) but has got me further down the track.She also suggested a new cheaper tarriff, which I obviously took, thereby implying I have been paying more than I needed for a while, because I'm stupid enough to work for a living and stupidly assumed that the last tarriff would have stayed as the cheapest (it was still current).There's no special electricity; it works the same, whether I'm paying more or less.Summary of EDF: shambolic customer service management, with problems at the top of the organisation; rip off pricing system, saved by them having a few (not many) good people willing to field calls and resolve their appalling service

records.title: EDF inflexible
records.text: EDF supply electric to our hut.  It’s a little bolthole that we visit through the Summer as the site it’s in is closed from November to April.Now being told that EDF want a monthly meter reading.So now I am expected to driver the hour or so to get the meter reading & then home.I will get a meter reading settle the account & move to a supplier who might be a little more understanding

records.title: The contact person did not know how to…
records.text: The contact person did not know how to resolve the situation. She said that she would find out and ring back the same day, she didn’t. She rang the next day and stated that everything was sorted but within 15 minutes, I received a text stating otherwise. The issues is still not resolved and I am very low on meter credit. The answer time was in excess of 30 minutes each time that I rang.

records.title: First I just want to say 2* is for EDF…
records.text: First I just want to say 2* is for EDF because they still haven't sorted out a mistake on my bill which keeps estimating my gas usage £283 a month. I barely even use that in a year. ANGELO DESERVES 5* who I spoke to today who adjusted my DD because I was paying more than I was using. He was helpful and friendly. Also professional. If EDF don't sort the problem out I'm changing companies

records.title: I asked for my monthly bill after…
records.text: I asked for my monthly bill after reading my meter myself. I was just sent an amount to pay rather than an electronic bill. I pay significantly more by paying in this way rather than direct debit so I would like the service I pay for. If you can’t do this reduce my bill to that of others paying by direct debit.In reference to your response the hard copy of the bill was not sent to me by email, that was the problem!

records.title: Lying service info
records.text: I've had my ups and downs with this crew. I was sent a text thanking me for my low usage and was told that as a reward I could enjoy free electricity from 8 am - midnight on the 15/12/24 today. LIARS. I got up and put on a washing as every Sunday and my smart meter is/was registering high usage.  Why lie? What's the marketing strategy behind this?

records.title: not happy with EDF
records.text: Constantly having to contact you to resolve issues, not being offered a great deal, keep changing my direct debit although i am more than £250 in credit.Being told by one of your agent, i can benefit from 8 hour free electricity as a good will and told at the end of the conversation, i might not qualify for it.No consistency.

records.title: Kim was very helpful and polite on the…
records.text: Kim was very helpful and polite on the phone but the information I was given was completely wrong. I was told that I could get a replacement key at one of two stores so my wife (who does not drive) had to take a taxi only to find out that the first and closest store to us did not have any keys available. No problem, jumped back in the taxi went to the second store about 4 miles away and surprise surprise they had no keys either. My wife returned home and called me at work and I spoke to another representative who put me on hold for 15 minutes but came back to me and said she had spoken to a third shop and they had a replacement key. My wife called another taxi went to the third store some 5 miles away and was told they did not have any. My wife was extremely upset by this as she had returned home and called me again. She had now been without electricity since 9am and unable to make a drink and out of pocket to the tune of £37. Eventually I called and spoke to another chap who was extremely helpful and knowledgeable. He called stores in Exeter where I was working and checked that they had a spare key then arranged for them to hold it for me. I arrived an hour later and it was all sorted and I had the replacement key finally. It should not have been this complicated or time consuming but at least it got sorted in the end thanks to the chap who's name I don't recall.

records.title: Appalling telephone line, couldn't hear a lot of it
records.text: Francisco was very helpful but it was almost impossible to hear him with such a terribly bad line.  His end, definitely not mine as my office landline is very good.I could not hear at least fifty per cent of what he was saying

records.title: I had to call 3 different times and…
records.text: I had to call 3 different times and spend over an hour each time on hold and still did not get through. Then on the 4th time I got through I could not hear what the chap was saying as it was such a poor line so I had to call again. Eventually, I got to speak to Daisy who did manage to sort things out for me and change the wrong details that you had for me.

records.title: So handy being able to WhatsApp Eon
records.text: So handy being able to WhatsApp Eon. Also u like other companies they actually sort things out over live chat rather than making you give all the details then make you ring them anyway!

records.title: A good fair energy supplier
records.text: I have recently signed another contract with E.ON for 12 months.  I did so because they installed smart meters that actually work not like the ones that were installed by my previous energy supplier. I'll stay with them as long as they continue to provide a competitive price for my energy.

records.title: Straightforward transfer to Eon Next
records.text: Eon Next provided the best fixed price rates for 2025 so we transferred across to them. The transfer was very straightforward, all we had to do was send in the gas and electricity readings on day of transfer and they sorted out the rest eith our previous supplier.

records.title: VERY EASY TO SET UP NEW CONTRACT FOR FIXED TERM ELECTRICTY PRICES INCLUDING ECONOMY 7
records.text: AS OFGEM WAS INCREASING FUEL PRICE FROM JANUARY I DECIDED TO SELECT A NEW FIXED TERM RATE. MY ELECTRICITY INCLUDES ECONOMY 7. I HAVE SECURED AN EXCELLENT RATE FOR BOTH DAY/NIGHT RATES. EON WERE REALLY HELPFUL AND KEPT ME INFORMED ABOUT DATES MY NEW FIXED TERM WOULD START. HIGHLY RECOMMEND EON. I HAVE BEEN WITH THIS COMPANY FOR MANY  YEARS

records.title: Helpful service
records.text: My issue about a new tariff and about a discrepancy over a bill was sorted out efficiently. Usingvthe WhatsApp service worked well and saved me waiting on the phone. The advisor was really helpful and explained things clearly.

records.title: Contact was easier than usual
records.text: Contact was easier than usual. Excellent help from lady. Put me on a suitable electricity and gas plan. Advised the gas and electricity being monitored already. Living on my own the lady’s help was invaluable.

records.title: Shannon was great to chat to!
records.text: Shannon was really helpful over WhatsApp and it was so useful being able to have a conversation whilst going about my day rather than having to wait on a call. Shannon answered all my questions and was really kind!

records.title: Been with E-On for 5 years
records.text: Been with E-On for 5 years - never had an issue with service. App is very handy and easy to use. Reminders if I am in too much credit to request a refund if I want, adjust my direct debit payments easily up or down through the year :)

records.title: Speedy email response
records.text: I sent an email requesting clarification on new tariffs. I received a reply within the hour and after some toping and frying, got transferred to the new tariff. I was impressed at the speed of reply for a big company and ease of doing business. It was vastly better than sitting on a phone for ages.

records.title: E-ON website is fairly easy to…
records.text: E-ON website is fairly easy to navigate.  Tariff options were given, supposedly the cheapest ones available. Usually we go for 12 months but this time we chose 18 months for peace of mind and also to prevent stress next December.  E-ON have usually been good at communication both via email/text or phone. A lot of people think we pay a high figure but it’s very difficult to understand the different tariffs and cautious to change company in case it works out more expensive.  App is very handy to use.  Smart meter doesn’t really give us much information.  Been with E-ON for over 16 years, always had good service, friendly staff.

records.title: Started Well
records.text: The switch over from my previous supplier was fine. I then signed up to the EV tariff which went through in two days so this was very well coordinated. Noticed then that gas readings not being updated even though I have a smart meter. Talked to customer service who told me I did not have a gas smart meter which was not true as I had it installed in 2022. Had to prove with screen shots and photos to prove I was telling the truth. Have been told they will try and update their system. I will wait and see as energy companies always seem to let you down in some way even though they charge us extortionate rates.

records.title: Changing Household Fuel Tariff with E-OnI wanted to try to reduce my household…
records.text: I wanted to try to reduce my household fuel charges and wanted to fix the price for as long as possible in order to manage my expenses.  I was also looking at the exit charges in case I switch my supplier in the future.  I was happy to find a suitable tariff with no exit fees  and therefore changed my tariff.  The whole process was straightforward and the tariff I selected has no exit fees.

records.title: This power company has kept me in the…
records.text: This power company has kept me in the loop ever since I joined them with deals that I might like saving me money. They pay me for electricity my Solar panels produce over what I use at a fair return. All in All a fair power supplier.

records.title: No working Smart Meter
records.text: Used the app today to change my tariff which was simple and easy. I also provided my meter reading which was easy to do but also disapointing after almost 12 months I still don't have a working smart meter. I am 71 living on state pension without the ability to manage my energy use.

records.title: I wish EON would read questions fully, a good energy supplier otherwise
records.text: EON asked me for a review. It's true if you are afraid of any answers, you shouldn't ask the question, so I'll be frank & honest.I want to make it clear, EON are a very good energy provider. They bend over backwards to help you, keep you informed, help you to decide which tariffs you can consider. However there is a but..... and that is they don't read your specific questions fully and give you quick 'general' answers which they think you are asking. Very frustrating sometimes when you are trying to clarify aspects of fixed tariffs etcGenerally very happy with EON, and despite looking at other energy suppliers, I see no reason to change.

records.title: Initially upset but then the issue was sorted extremely well.
records.text: At first I was annoyed as I couldn't change my tariff online on it's last day but the next day I could and as I had also phoned, the call handler was extremely helpful and knowledgeable so all was sorted. I have however been waiting months for a new IHD and the smart meter is only reading the electric not the gas. However the call handler explained they are waiting to make a bulk buy of the parts needed.

records.title: When I originally told them I was…
records.text: When I originally told them I was moving they didn't tell I had to do a special switch, which delayed everything. Luckily I noticed that my account hadn't been sorted properly, so their help with switching was very good and smooth.

records.title: Good value tariffs
records.text: Good value tariffs and relatively easy to switch. Slightly frustrating messing about to get my smart meters talking to Eon (they worked fine with previous supplier) but got there in the end. Customer support via email and WhatsApp was excellent.

records.title: A good and swift to fix my tariff but it has room to improve.
records.text: To select my tariff was easy and it was done quickly. The only thing I'd say is the monthly direct debit amount of my payments was not the same as it was set in the fixed terms by E.ON (I have quite a bit credit in my account so the new tariff has lowered monthly payments for the first 6 months of the fixed term), instead, it was still debited as before.

records.title: Lack of initial communication resolved
records.text: Advisor didn't argue and saw my point of view.Mutual agreement was met Thank youShe was also very courteous at all times and very friendly, a credit to your business.

records.title: EON next have a fantastic 18 month…
records.text: EON next have a fantastic 18 month fixed deal for gas and electric. The rates are very competitive. The customer service team has been good and I had smooth transition from previous provider. Thank you EON 👍🏼

records.title: Fixed tariff
records.text: They answered my email about a fixed tariff and when I decided to take one they accepted and put me on  it from commence date no problem.

records.title: Best deals required online
records.text: Virgin Media is a great media provider but getting rather expensive. The best discounted deals at Virgin Media are always when you speak to an advisor via telephone. Although the advisors are extremely helpful, it would be great to get the best deals online.Also, when down grading a package, this cannot be done online but only via telephone. Finally, please could VM offer the same deals to their existing, loyal customers as they do to new customers.

records.title: Made easy the option to accept a fixed…
records.text: Made easy the option to accept a fixed tariff for 1 year I would be interested to know if we end up paying less for our energy this year than we would have if we had continued with our open  cost for gas and electric, once the energy cap 🧢 is off.

records.title: Find them an easy company to deal with
records.text: Can manage my account online quick and easy but don't usually have to wait to long to be answered on the phone if I really want to speak to them

records.title: Knowledgeable and courteous
records.text: The lady who I spoke to was very pleasant and knowledgeable. She soon sorted out both my requests to my satisfaction. I would have given top marks to the company apart from the fact that the person who rang to arrange an appointment for the fitting of a smart meter display didn't return my call after I missed her calls.

records.title: Price comparison was the best at the time fixed 18 months.
records.text: I compared prices with a couple of other companies I had been highly recommended to go to but actually the plan I selected was the cheapest so decided to stay. I like doing my own readings and control my account on line as it states in the terms and conditions of my new plan. However I’m fed up with constant calls to have a smart meter. The law states I do not have to have one! Until I hear better reports on them I don’t want one. I know a good many people whose meters do not work in my area and are not being charged their tariffs correctly or they just don’t work! My new contract did not state I have to have one, like the others on offer did but can manage on line and give readings. So please stop hassling me! When and if I want one I will contact you.

records.title: Dealt with closure of account promptly…
records.text: Dealt with closure of account promptly and send refund cheque. Had reduced DD regulraly whilst house being sold. It wouldn't allow me to reduce by as much as I wanted but only £170 credit at closure so better than B Gas. Cheque couldn;t be banked via banking app which meant a trip to the bank.

records.title: Fairly easy to navigate though…
records.text: Fairly easy to navigate though sometimes finding what you need needs some digging. Good access to statements etc so keeping an eye on any credit is easy, not always the best option for renewing your account as competitors can sometimes have really good offers.

records.title: Not alot of choice and fees are a joke
records.text: Did not like one off donation to woodland trust, this should be a choice not Compulsory also did not like exit fees being introduced.. If best prices quoted for tariffs why charge exit fees unless worried people could leave if another company offers a better offer.  Only took deal as I wanted to continue with Eon.

records.title: Hopefully got there eventually .Got gas  meter reading in no problem…
records.text: Got my gas meter reading in no problem yesterday but was not able to type in electricity one. Despite several attempts using a different link.Eventually when I was sent another email using these links I was able to type in the electricity reading.After several attempts being told there had been errors. I think it was received.

records.title: German efficiency? Not in the UK mate.
records.text: German efficiency? Not in the UK mate.German efficiency does not seem to have reached the UK branch of this company. Their inefficiency is quite shocking. It took them six months and broken appointments to upgrade my smart meter so that I could be put onto an EV tariff. Now it looks like history is repeating itself at another property.

records.title: Confusing - Pot Luck!
records.text: I didn't like having to sort out all the options. I have no idea if I have chosen the most economic tariff for my home. In the end it was a hopeful guess. I am trusting EON, a company that does communicate with it's customers, but is never the less only interested in profit making. I pay regularly by DD as I have for years but my understanding of the different options is not good. Advice is what is needed.

records.title: Login problems
records.text: I tried for 3 days to log into my account and it just kept returning to the login page. I had not typed the wrong details. It was just before Christmas so when I rang I couldn't speak to anyone and therefore ended up a day out of a fixed tariff. Not the end of the world, just frustrating.  This has never happened before which is why I didn't think there would be a problem  leaving it late to fix.

records.title: Nothing to say just looking for a…
records.text: Nothing to say just looking for a decent deal. However I am sick to death of being nombarded by text email and phone calls regarding a smart meter..  I do not need one I am perfectly capable of minimising my impact on the environment.

records.title: Easy to navigate, limited info
records.text: Liked the website - easy to navigate. Didn't like the fact that you cannot compare tariffs side by side but have to switch screens to do so, and other suppliers show you usage graphically and compared to averages.

records.title: Refunds result in monthly price hike
records.text: Asked for a refund as £500+ in credit and my smart meter reporting £87 in December.They refunded £340 and raised my direct debit to £154 or almost double my monthly usage.They really want to keep those interest free loans from all the customers.

records.title: Smart Meter Fitting
records.text: I had arranged a for a smart meter to be fitted on 2nd January. After receiving multiple texts, emails and calls to make sure I was in and all essential points of access were clear, no visit took place. I had to call at 1.30pm only to be told the visit wasn’t happening due to a mix up with schedules. Having booked the day off work (as the wrong part and contractor were sent out first time round which took time to work through) it was so disappointing that there was a lack of respect of my time when it was so highly demanded of me when making initial arrangements. That being said, I spoke to two advisors ahead of the visit, both of whom were polite, knowledgable and very professional. Hoping for third time lucky for the reschedule in February!

records.title: Liked easy non complicated way to fix…
records.text: Liked easy non complicated way to fix next tariff but sad about daily charging which is totally unnecessary as we are on holiday throughout the year but still charged.I am in need of a new monitor so I can keep an eye on my charges, so if you can supply me  with one it would be greatly appreciated.Happy New Year

records.title: Happy with your updates
records.text: Happy with your updates. Recently changed tariff. Easy to do but confusing about regular monthly payments. Constant pressure to switch meters. Absolutely nothing wrong with our current one. Stats show 3 million new meters are inaccurate?? !!

records.title: No idea why they sent me this review…
records.text: No idea why they sent me this review opportunity. They supply my energy and collect the payment every month.That's it.Nothing special.

records.title: Still waiting for smart meter to be…
records.text: Still waiting for smart meter to be connected. Told no access was required which was not true. Work carried out was satisfactory.

records.title: Good company
records.text: I am bombarded with emails telling me about fixing my next tariff, which I do.  It takes ages for my direct debit to change to the new amount!  They have been helpful sorting out the bills for my parent's house following bereavement. Other than this I am very happy with Eon as my supplier at this time.

records.title: Still waiting for written confirmation
records.text: The lady I spoke to was very helpful and provided me with the information I needed to make the decision to switch to a fixed tariff.  However, although I asked for confirmation in writing (and she agreed to send a confirmation email) I am disappointed that this has not happened.  I am still waiting for the written confirmation.

records.title: DIrect Debit change without notice!
records.text: I disliked that for the 3rd time I had to contact you to explain why my DD had to be higher than what you had put it at which was very frustrating. However the assistant that I spoke to this time and the one I dealt with by email was very helpful and sorted it out once again.

records.title: ThE transition is not smooth from…
records.text: The transition was not smooth from prepaid to credit. I had to move into my new apartment without electricity. However the technician came to fix this After a call to the care line. He did a great Job.

records.title: 3x credit on my account
records.text: i've got so much credit on my account and its 3x my monthly direct debit. eon not doing anything to lessen what i am paying and its been like that for a long time. im just wondering if they do that on purpose to all their customers.

records.title: Got the refund eventually
records.text: Got the refund eventually, but it was like getting blood from a stone.Threw a lot of obstacles in the way and put our monthly direct debit up even though I knew it didn't need it and I was able to drop it again before it went out of the account.It should have been easier as my account is very rarely in debit and had a lot of credit when it renewed  in November

records.title: I have been trying for weeks to…
records.text: I have been trying for weeks to transfer to eon next drive tariff, after numerous phone calls and glitches in the website it's still not possible. I have been transferred to a different tariff whilst I await a callback from the ev team again. Not holding my breath as they didn't ring last time... if this doesn't get resolved this time I'm going to move suppliers because after 6 weeks I'm fed up of calling!

records.title: Unhappy new customers
records.text: We have recently moved to a new house and become Eon customers as this was the service provided.We were shocked to receive an incredibly high bill for just 4 weeks. I have tried emailing and calling to discuss this as I believe that the system/ meters probably need looking at as before our residence the house has been unoccupied for 2 years. The only reply I have received is that as we have a smart meter it has to be right!VERY DISAPPOINTED

records.title: I must give credit for the help given…
records.text: I must give credit for the help given by your telephonists when I have called for help. However,  problems with the Smart meter have not been sorted. It does not work following a visit by one of your engineers, which incidentally I did not ask for.The meter is now useless. I  do not know how much electricity I am using on a daily basis during the critical winter months. I was persuaded to have this piece of equipment to make things easier for E-on, but clearly not for my benefit. When will this be sorted out?

records.title: The Ryanair of energy suppliers
records.text: There is a pathetic range of tariffs, so similar, that there is no choice. The standing charge is criminal, nothing more than a means of dodging aspects of the price cap for this revenue stream.The concept of including an exit fee for change of supplier is just shabby. You need to engender loyalty through superior service, not charge us for seeking it elsewhere.

records.title: Good customer service but very bad app.
records.text: Their customer services are great but their app is very bad, when I login on Google chrome it works but whenever I try to login through the app, it keeps rejecting me by saying either my email address or password is incorrect. And sometimes it says my Samsung is not compatible with their app 🙄.

records.title: Average at best
records.text: Average at best, only with eon by default, like all energy suppliers they get to do very little while recieving huge profit margins so changing supplier is just more hassle than it's worth these days.Would like to thank eon for the early Christmas gift of a upcoming energy price hike, so on behalf of all your customers.... Cheers guys.

records.title: Energy supplier the worst thieves of all…
records.text: They Lowered my direct debit so I would assume that the price went down, but it increased. I was not paid for my export electricity yet and it is not possible to check on the app or request by app like with the standard account. Double standards for us and them.

records.title: Service was polite but a simple request took a month and required endless chasing
records.text: The request was quite straightforward to switch me to a new tariff but it required over 5 emails to chase people, one thirty minute phone call and finally a threat to leave them to get my tariff switched. overall the process took around a month which should have taken a few minutes. Customer service do respond via email and phone so that is great.  Not sure where things went wrong

records.title: Confusing tariffs
records.text: I received a letter in November setting out new tariffs and how much I could save over 12 months. I find this type of thing confusing at the best of times so had been dreading having to sort it, so had been putting it off. When I got into my account on New Years Eve (the password always seems to require a reset) the tariffs on the letter were not the same as those on the website and they did not compare between my current and new deal showing me how much I could save annually. This flummoxed me and I ended up just choosing the top option. Now I just hope I made the right choice.

records.title: Prices constantly rising
records.text: Prices constantly rising, even when I’m in credit by over £200! Requested my credit but was told my monthly price would increase if I did, so you can gain interest on my money………

records.title: Home move palaver!
records.text: Contacted E.ON as was moving house to transfer account to new property.Instead they initialised a cancellation of account and so had to contact them to say this was not the case but a home move!Then had to go through the tedious process of dealing with a E.ON staff member via email which took days to sort.After finally sorting, then got an email to discuss my home move! Clearly their home move process is flawed.

description:
We are the largest independent distributors of fuel and lubricants in the UK. We deliver over 6 billion litres of oil to customers across Britain every year.

We have always provided our customers with excellent personal service and a great range of energy products and services. Our extensive and reliable delivery network comprises more than 130 depots, over 900 tankers and 2,300 employees.

records.title: Thanks
records.text: Thanks, Certas Ashford! I missed the boat on our local group heating fuel order due to a group email malfunction and turned to various local suppliers. Got the best deal from Certas who were friendly, courteous and flexible. Understandably they were unable to match the group order price but gave me the best price I could find outside the group.  I've now created an account with them for future use.

records.title: Excellent
records.text: Great service. Ordered in 31st December over phone. Quoted good price and delivery on 7th January. That was amended to 2nd January which was great for me. Texted when delivery was 5 miles away. Delightful driver and quick turnaround. Thanks Certas. Highly recommended.

records.title: Usually quick delivery after ordering
records.text: Usually quick delivery after ordering, communication from driver when on his way is good. Driver being able to access tank should we be out, means we dont have to hang around all day.

records.title: Excellent company
records.text: Excellent company if it's heating oil you need this is the company you all want Don't look any further afield buy local the company you can Trust

records.title: Very prompt service but a small mistake could have made an oil delivery to us still outstanding
records.text: Very prompt service . Very professional delivery driver. My only complaint is  l ordered oil wasnt told l had to pay before delivery. So was waitling to be notified of delivery day, and had to chase it up as not hesrd from you. Then found out the reason . Wasnt given chance to pay . If l had not phoned l would have still been waiting as l trusted you to have it all in hand

records.title: Prompt service
records.text: As soon as I ordered no sooner than the oil arrived! The delivery man contacted me to say that he was nearly at my home! He was very sufficient and helpful getting the oil in the tank!

records.title: We always have great service.
records.text: We always have great service when ordering the heating oil. The delivery is always easy and arrives on time with a text to say that it is coming that day.

records.title: I received a first class service and…
records.text: I received a first class service and Certas Energy are the only company that we have used for our supply of oil.

records.title: Watchman break down.
records.text: Our oil was delivered after our watchman broke. We were down to the last of our oil and Certas got the oil to us in two days. It was during a cold snap and the effort they put into it was greatly appreciated.   Thank you Certas.

records.title: Efficient polite ordering by phone
records.text: Efficient polite ordering by phone, price given. Told when the delivery would be snd it was on time. Delivery quiet early morning.

records.title: Online ordering good.
records.text: Online ordering was good. My only suggestion for improvement is sone indication of when the delivery will turn up. It would be useful if this could be communicated a day or so in advance.

records.title: Good service but DD arrangements need improvement
records.text: This is a good company which provides good service but their system for predicting requirements and the changes they make to one’s DD/SO don’t work well and they need to make improvements.

records.title: The oil was delivered, but...
records.text: The oil was delivered.  However I was away and Certas drivers no longer use a "master key" to unlock the tank as they did in the past. I had to have my friend visit and unlock the tank after Certas's first, unsuccessful attempt at delivery.  I had spoken to a Certas employee beforehand and asked for the "master key" to be used, but it was not.

records.title: Everything was fine except for Certas’ overzealous insurers
records.text: Everything was fine, except for the fact that Certas use insurers who won’t allow the hoses to go through our outhouse to the tank in the back garden, where it has been for at least 20 years.The outhouse is apparently no longer one, as it is tiled and contains a washing machine, but the house itself.If this nonsense continues we shall have to find an alternative supplier.

records.title: The oil delivery was good and prompt…
records.text: The oil delivery was good and prompt but I still have not had the meter installed or received information on new boilers which the sales person promised I would receive

records.title: Curious pricing
records.text: To their credit Certas delivered on the date promised but I wonder how can it be cheaper to buy from BoilerJuice and it be delivered by Certas than buying direct from Certas.

records.title: Good service in delivery of oil
records.text: Good service in delivery of oil. Prompt and drivers always polite and helpful.  You do have to challenge prices though when ordering.

records.title: Friendly and reliable service
records.text: Ordering a delivery of oil by phone was easy and the people on the customer team were friendly and helpful. I felt my custom was important. Delivery was within a week and I was kept well informed on its progress.

records.title: Easy to order and delivery went well
records.text: Easy to order and delivery went well, so the only downside was a delay in delivery due to driver illness, which left us without heating for the weekend. We ordered late so that was partly our own fault. Certas certainly did their best to get the oil to us once I explained that we were very low on oil.

records.title: On the whole, good
records.text: Order was made simply, easily and delivery was on time without fuss My only complaint is the constant attempts to try to increase the standing order by default by an amount which seems to be in excess of annual consumption.Your prices could also be keener without the need to haggle  but I guess that's business.

records.title: I  thought the wait was quite long
records.text: I  thought the wait was quite long, I’d paid in advance for my oil, that’s fine, but had over ordered the amount needed, when I rang to find out when I would receive a refund I was told it could take up to 10 days,not happy, especially as I waited two weeks for delivery, why does it take 10 days??? On the up side the Delivery guy, was really nice, polite and helpful

records.title: Best oil price
records.text: £30 cheaper than boiler juice will use again

records.title: Good response for 'priority services' customer
records.text: Delivery avoided date I wasn't able to take delivery. Then Kent gridlocked for whole day prior to expected delivery date, so deliveries delayed; but Certas ensured delivery on the next day because I am on the 'priority services' register.  So I couldn't expect more at a busy time of year.

records.title: Later than promised ... again
records.text: Original delivery target date was missed, but rescheduled reasonably soon afterwards. The centralised ordering system repeatedly fails to assess accurately the current delivery load on local distribution depots.

records.title: Service excellence
records.text: It is, fundamentally, a very good service in terms of oil use monitoring and boiler maintenance, and we appreciate this. Administration is a bit hit and miss: we have repeatedly asked for our account in both my own name (which it is) and my wife's (which it is not). We would like to see this arrangement as soon as is reasonable convenient.

records.title: Had to order twice
records.text: Had to order twice, first one cancelled due to lack of payment even though my card details were taken over the phone. The 2nd guy I spoke to was very helpful and sorted it all out for me

records.title: Good when it arrived
records.text: £30 discount made my 800 litre top-up good value. Ordered via phone and call handler was prompt and courteous. Delivery was postponed three times due to driver running out of hours,but when it did arrive, the driver was polite and efficient.

records.title: On time
records.text: On time, no fuss.Haven’t had an account update since the delivery though.

records.title: Time for oil delivery from ordering
records.text: Being able to order online,

records.title: Very helpful driver tried to contact me…
records.text: Very helpful driver tried to contact me when Certas office hadn’t sent night before email as promised. He also put padlock code on the system for future use.

records.title: Delivery Timing Problems
records.text: Invariably the the delivery date that is first indicated at the time of order, is not adhered to.  This makes the timing of order placement difficult to judge, because there is then a need to place an order before the oil is required and this affects the size of the oil requirement.This failure necessitates time-consuming emails or phone calls to press for the order to be delivered.  Certas needs to improve its performance in this respect.

records.title: Certas - Worsening service
records.text: I have used Certas energy for over almost 20 years but in the last couple of years the service and customer care has worsened. Last year they failed to deliver in December - changed the due date four times and I ran out of oil before they actually prioritised me. This year they again postponed the delivery date three times without warning and although I didn’t run out of oil - what they delivered was 25% less oil than I requested meaning they I now need to order another delivery much sooner than I had hoped. There does not appear to be a centralised customer service and every time one rings to review an issue - there appears to be no record of previous calls or detail. Shocking service

records.title: I’m getting fed up with having to keep…
records.text: I’m getting fed up with having to keep asking for you NOT to increase my direct debit. I manage this myself I don’t need your algorithm telling me what I need to pay. Please do not increase my direct debit

records.title: Messages not passed to delivery depot from order office
records.text: After telling person not to deliver before a certain day as no one at home to block tank I had 2 delivery messages before then, after 2 more phone calls and an email I still had a delivery planned before the day we could unlock. I got the delivery ok but office staff not passing on messages

records.title: too difficult to get through so called…
records.text: too difficult to get through so called security checks. no other company does this to the same extent. Communication is also not brilliant.

records.title: Delivery guy not happy
records.text: The guy, who we had never seen before, was not very happy about how he needed to get to our tank. Since 2016, when we moved to our cottage, all the delivery guys were wonderful, without exception. However this chap was not happy , sullen and not customer focused.

records.title: Always late
records.text: Always late - they never deliver on time.

records.title: Poor customer service
records.text: I could not order via the website (it was not working), so had to order by phone. I specifically ordered basic heating oil, but Glowmax was delivered (and charged for). I was told that I would be phoned the day before delivery, but I wasn't.

records.title: Not the usual service I would expect
records.text: Usually a very good service having been a customer for many years but most recent experience was less than adequate. Poor communication and several delays in receiving an oil delivery due to wrong depot, driver running out of hours and general other delays. Senior customer service agent more helpful but outstanding issue still awaiting resolution. Hoping next oil order goes more smoothly.

records.title: First attempt to deliver did not happen…
records.text: First attempt to deliver did not happen because driver could not be bothered to follow diversion to avoid road closure and no information provided till I phoned to query non delivery. Second time was fine. Driver diverted round road works and made delivery.

records.title: Certas monitor
records.text: Certas has never helped me sort out my oil tank monitor which is permanently on red .I am extremely concerned as to my top up service . I live alone and am a pensioner and would like to know if I get a good enough price for my oil in this current expensive climate? I have been a continued loyal customer.

records.title: Generally satisfied but promised text before delivery was not received
records.text: The contact centre was helpful for my first supply when I moved home.They explained the delivery window and said I would receive a text with confirmed date in advance of delivery. That was important as I wanted to be at home when the tanker arrived. Unfortunately that did not happen. I did not receive a text, the delivery was made on a Monday and I missed the connection as no advance notice was received.

records.title: Can take ages to answer the telephone…
records.text: Can take ages to answer the telephone when ordering oil .Certas take it upon themselves to increase / reduce monthly payments,  They publish this in the small print.At the year end they want to collect or give out monies , therefore interfering with customer accounts again. They should trust the customer more

records.title: Good delivery after a hiccough
records.text: I specified a medium sized vehicle. A large vehicle arrived. There was some overgrowth of neighbours hedge narrowing the entrance. He refused to enter. A few days later (after hedge trimmed) a similar sized vehicle arrived and he delivered the oil. Manoeuvring was difficult. So I received my delivery with just a little drama

records.title: Problems with delivery
records.text: Problems with delivery. Order arrived a week late.  As an elderly person I was becoming a little agitated before arrival. To be fair this has only occured  once before in many deliveries.

records.title: On calling one afternoon at 16:25hrs I…
records.text: On calling one afternoon at 16:25hrs I held until 17:05hrs when a voice came on informing me of the office hours and then went dead. On the following day I eventually got through, and after explaining my previous days plight was told sorry and no other explanation. I was given a 10 day delivery schedule, after 11 days I called and told within 2 days and that I would receive a call 24 hours before delivery, the first and only call I received was from the driver 2 days later saying he was 2 miles away. On arrival he was efficient and courteous. A company your size should have a better system, retaining clients is just as important as getting new clients. Hence my generous score of 3 out of 5.

records.title: Don't order oil from Certas through Boiler Juice
records.text: Update:After the messing around detailed below, the oil turned up this afternoon anyway! Delivery guys perfectly nice so no complaints there. However, the rest of the comments still apply.--- I got a text from Certas yesterday confirming heating oil ordered through Boiler Juice would be delivered today - the last day of the express 5 day delivery I paid extra for. This morning I got another text saying they wouldn't be delivering - no new date was provided.  The text gave a number to call but when I called it they refused to discuss my delivery because it was ordered through Boiler Juice. I called Boiler Juice who said their system shows delivery WOULD be today!Clearly CERTAS know where their drivers are delivering but wouldn't confirm either way simply because the order wasn't direct with them.  I can only surmise they had too little capacity today and the first to lose out are those who are not direct customers.

records.title: Order by phone!
records.text: The only way to pay on account is by telephone. Otherwise you are charged the full amount at the point of ordering, sometimes two weeks before oil is delivered.  Also the online price is usually quite a bit more than the telephone price.

records.title: Third delivery  from Certas
records.text: I've used Certas twice before and all was fine but this time the delivery was very late. I complained, the agent was very helpful, found out what the problem was (apparently a local problem with vehicles) and she updated me daily. It was a bit annoying at the time but no harm done.

records.title: Certas service / delivery.
records.text: Took all payment at the time of order.Then told us ‘14 days’, usually far to short at 3 to 6 days.No communication then no update.Went past the ‘14 days’, no communication.No reply to our request to formally raise a complaint - still no response …… !Eventually delivered 19/12, 21 days from order. Actual delivery; good as usual …..

records.title: Customer accounts that don’t work for the customer
records.text: They appear to have changed how they operate accounts, with a year end arrangement that makes no sense to me at all. I’ve just ordered oil, I have enough money on my account to cover the order but I’m told I will have to make additional payments, but they can’t explain why. Certas, you keep reducing the amount I pay each month, I’d rather pay a little bit extra each month so I have some headroom for price rises, but you keep changing it without checking with me. I would like to change to a standing order so I have control over what I pay to you, because clearly I’m better at forecasting than you, but you won’t let me do that. I do have another option and that’s to find another supplier, that’s what I’ll be doing over the next few months.

records.title: Changing delivery dates
records.text: Order was due to be delivered by 13th December. Not delivered but email received saying delivery would now be 17th. Not delivered again but email received saying delivery would now be 19th. It was delivered that day

Well, for a start, I all way top up around November December time and I've had an account with you for over 13 years yet because when it comes up to my tears end I'm nit aloud to order because I don't have enough in my account. Even though you refund me what's in my account after year is up. What's the point of having an account when you told sorry year end is coming up and you have to pay up front, in my eyes this is not account. And then once I was aloud to order it took 16 days for you to deliver in which I had ran out twice and had to spend hundred pounds on oil,which I didn't want to spend on this hence the account. And the only reason I ran out is because I'm not aloud order before years end with out paying up front.Really poor way of treating you long term account holders, oh and you keep putting my monthly bill up,  and I have to keep ringing and changing back. Even though you can check my records and you will see I all ways end the year in credit.So not a happy chap

records.title: Late with delivery even after a long…
records.text: Late with delivery even after a long expected wait . Had to be chased to get priority after time had expired in expected delivery dates and we nearly ran out of oil as a result of your extra delay .  No issues with actual delivery itself .

records.title: Late delivery
records.text: Late delivery. Complete lack of communication with customer from central sales/depot. Delivery rescheduled for a day when you had  been told was unsuitable. When eventually delivery eventually arrived driver was very good.

records.title: Delivery was delayed
records.text: Delivery was delayed and took over 3 weeks to arrive. Had no updates and had to call three times to chase. Also, top up reminders do not arrive. Very poor.

records.title: The oil took ages to come
records.text: The oil took ages to come, and usually I get the difference refunded to me pretty quick, didn’t get anything this time

records.title: Friendly people but lots of issues
records.text: Friendly people in customer services and driver but lots of issues. 1st told I could pay on invoice after delivery. No delivery and when chasing told need to pay up front. Then tried over 10 times to make card payment  over phone but the system wasn’t working. Eventually had to do a direct bank payment. I was constantly having to call for progress and if the could send the oil. Then had to chase to receive the refund of oil amount not delivered (just over £100) which took a month. Very disappointing for a large company.

records.title: The company needs to talk to each other not work in silos
records.text: The company needs to follow up with both telephone conversations and emails. Not contact customers to pay for faulty equipment which they already agreed I could return

records.title: I struggle with computers

records.title: Decent to deal with

records.title: Always able to speak to someone
records.text: Always able to speak to someone. Fairly competitive tariffs. One criticism, no where is there a total usage figure for customers to use to compare other prices. Just bar charts for vague monthly usage.

records.title: Usually pretty good to deal with but…

records.title: The company like all utility companies…

records.title: Why ignore my requests for them to fix my Smart MeterPrior to accepting the Fixed Rate deal…

records.title: Mixed opinion... Do checkout others

records.title: I've rated 3 stars because we've been…

records.title: I hate being lectured.

Carbon Dioxide is essential for plant life, without it humans would have nothing to eat at all. It is only present in our atmosphere in microscopic quantities (0.04%) and of that small proportion it is unclear how much came from human activity (such as breathing out). A lot of people are making serious money out of this fraud, it's all based on a lie fed to the gullible, and there should be a stop to it.

records.title: Worst company
records.text: I had a water contract with a company that unfortunately went awry. The water company has been charging me approximately £185 per month solely for retail fees, which is exorbitant. As a small business owner, my water usage is only £100, while the retail fee is £185. This situation is highly unjustified.I have repeatedly communicated with Swift Switch to resolve this issue, but my efforts have been consistently unsuccessful. The water company has informed me that the problem lies with the contract I made with the broker, and they are unable to intervene. Consequently, neither the broker nor the water company is providing any assistance.Prior to this incident, everything was in order. However, since I switched to Swift Switch, the situation has deteriorated significantly. While they are courteous when seeking contracts, their support once the contract is in place is minimal. I strongly advise against using this company, as they do not provide consistent assistance.

records.text: Done me right dirty. All the bells and whistles of how I was saving money and the rates were oh so cheaper than my current supplier. Very annoyed. However I have now received a charge of £1356 and pennies from a company acting on behalf of Swift Switch for a failed contract agreement. Nothing I can do apart from play the moral card and I completely made a mistake. Not interested pay up is the response so far. I have a tiny workshop and my annual electricity bill is £300 on average. Please be very careful and don't have a lapse of memory like I did.

records.title: Take Care Of Hidden Costs
records.text: In April 2024 I contacted ‘SwiftSwitch’, having found their website on a Google search, in connection with finding the best price for our business water contract, which was due to expire.I was contacted by the Procurement Adviser for SwiftSwitch, who having taken details of my requirements, offered me a competitive price from a company called ‘Water Plus’.Having agreed the price, I joined Water Plus and subsequently received the first bill, which to my dismay, included a ‘Retail Fee’ of £1.46 per day, which, even though it was given a cursory mention during the call, had not been explained to me and appeared nowhere in the written quote I was given. Having complained to SwiftSwitch, I eventually was told that a ‘Retail Fee’ was mentioned during a conversation and they agreed the details had not been given.I feel as though I have been duped into agreeing this contract and Water Plus have referred me to ‘SwiftSwitch' and refused to take any blame.

records.title: Not to be trusted

Which works out more expensive that previous supplier. Official Complaint had been made to Swift Switch which the salesman then tried to get in contact to confirm procedures were not followed. But heard no more. Complaint will be sent to Ofwat.From signed document to hold agreed prices from Swift Cover: This letter does not authorise SwiftSwitch Ltd to accept or sign any new contract or agreement without prior agreement. This is not ignored by and we were changed suppliers.
